jobs.title: Senior Devops Engineer
jobs.text: Position Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to lead the modernization, optimization, and governance of our software delivery ecosystem. This role will be responsible for evaluating and improving existing DevOps processes, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, deployment practices, cloud operations, and engineering standards across the organization. The ideal candidate will act as both a technical leader and an engineering governance partner, ensuring that software is delivered securely, reliably, efficiently, and at scale. This individual will work closely with Engineering, Architecture, Security, AI, and Product teams to drive DevOps maturity while introducing modern practices that support cloud-native development, AI-powered engineering, and platform automation. This is a highly visible role that will influence how software is built, reviewed, deployed, monitored, and operated across the organization. Key Responsibilities DevOps Strategy & Modernization Assess current DevOps capabilities, processes, and tooling across all engineering teams. Develop and execute a roadmap to improve DevOps maturity, reliability, scalability, and developer productivity. Standardize CI/CD pipelines, deployment methodologies, release processes, and operational practices. Introduce modern DevOps and Platform Engineering principles across the organization. Establish engineering standards, deployment controls, and operational governance. CI/CD & Release Management Design, implement, and optimize automated build, test, deployment, and release pipelines. Improve deployment frequency while reducing change failure rates. Establish release quality gates and automated validation mechanisms. Implement deployment strategies such as Blue-Green, Canary, Rolling, and Progressive Delivery. Create deployment metrics and reporting to measure release quality and operational efficiency. Code Review & Engineering Governance Review pull requests and deployment plans for adherence to engineering, security, and architectural standards. Develop automated controls to improve code quality and deployment readiness. Create dashboards and reports that provide visibility into: Pull request quality Code review effectiveness Deployment success rates Lead time for changes Change failure rates Developer productivity trends Partner with engineering leadership to continuously improve development practices. Cloud & Infrastructure Engineering Design and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions. Improve cloud architecture, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency. Drive automation across provisioning, configuration management, monitoring, and incident response. Ensure environments are consistent, repeatable, and auditable. Optimize cloud utilization and operational costs. Security & Compliance Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows. Implement DevSecOps practices throughout the software development lifecycle. Ensure compliance with organizational security standards and regulatory requirements. Collaborate with Security teams to automate vulnerability management and remediation processes. Establish deployment governance and approval workflows where required. AI-Powered Engineering & Automation Evaluate and implement AI-driven engineering tools that improve developer productivity and operational efficiency. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive engineering and operational tasks using AI technologies. Establish standards for responsible use of AI-assisted development tools. Implement intelligent deployment validation, anomaly detection, and operational insights. Support the organization's broader AI engineering initiatives and platform modernization efforts. Observability & Reliability Engineering Improve monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability capabilities. Establish service health, availability, and performance metrics. Drive Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices where appropriate. Participate in root cause analysis and continuous improvement activities. Define and track operational KPIs and SLAs. Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering roles. Strong experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines. Assist with supplier management activities for assigned lower-complexity commodities, with development toward independently managing selected suppliers and standard components over time. Collect and analyze supplier quotations, pricing changes, delivery information, and basic cost drivers to support sourcing decisions and negotiations. Coordinate with engineering, quality, operations, planning, finance, and suppliers to support part changes, supplier performance follow-up, launch readiness, and continuity of supply. Support cost reduction, productivity, and supplier improvement initiatives by preparing data, tracking actions, following up on open items, and documenting savings or avoidance opportunities. Learn and apply procurement processes, ERP/SAP transactions, supplier communication practices, and internal approval workflows under guidance from the category team. Develop capability to manage supplier issues, escalate risks, support recovery actions, and contribute to long-term supply base strategy as experience grows. Knowledge: Foundational understanding of purchasing, supply chain, supplier management, and basic business processes, with willingness and ability to learn procurement practices quickly. Basic knowledge of manufacturing environments, supplier performance measures, and quality, delivery, cost, and responsiveness expectations. Developing understanding of how business, engineering, operations, manufacturing, and purchasing priorities connect. Basic familiarity with ERP/MRP concepts and purchasing systems; SAP experience or exposure preferred but not required. Experience: 1-3 years of purchasing, supply chain, operations, manufacturing, engineering, or related experience; strong co-op, internship, or rotational program experience will be considered. Preferred experience or exposure managing, supporting, or purchasing C-class components, including nuts, bolts, washers, labels, fasteners, or other standard components. Nice to have basic exposure to stampings, machining, forgings, special components, supplier quotations, part drawings, bills of material, or manufacturing cost drivers. Experience working with ERP or purchasing systems preferred; SAP exposure is a plus. Exposure to quote analysis, supplier follow-up, cost reduction support, negotiation preparation, or project tracking is preferred but not required. Skills: High learning agility with a strong interest in procurement, supplier management, manufacturing, and commercial problem solving. Strong attention to detail, follow-through, organization, and ability to manage multiple priorities with guidance. Analytical mindset with ability to review quotes, pricing data, supplier information, part details, and basic cost drivers. Effective communication skills with ability to interact professionally with suppliers and internal stakeholders across engineering, quality, operations, planning, and finance. Problem-solving capability, including active listening, issue identification, data review, escalation, and timely follow-up. Comfort working in a fast-paced, matrixed environment with willingness to learn global and regional procurement processes. Basic negotiation awareness preferred, including preparation, data gathering, supplier communication, and support for commercial discussions. Education: Bachelor's degree required; Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, or related field preferred. Co-op, internship, or academic project experience in Purchasing, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Engineering, or Operations is strongly preferred. jobs.title: Technician, Service- Packaging- 2nd shift
jobs.text: Mon - Fri 3 PM - 11 PM, $20.88/hr + $1/hr differential + mandatory overtime (2 hours earlier/ day + Saturdays on occasion) Benefits start day one! General: Responsible for ensuring products are packaged safely and accurately for shipment in accordance with company standards and customer specifications. This role includes inspecting, labeling, sealing, and packing items, as well as operating various equipment and machinery as needed. Workers are expected to perform thorough quality inspections to maintain accuracy and product integrity, while also completing all required documentation in a timely and accurate manner. Key Duties Inspect products for quality and accuracy prior to packaging Label, seal, and pack items according to specifications Operate packaging equipment and machinery safely and efficiently Maintain compliance with company standards and customer requirements Assist with inventory management as needed Work Environment & Expectations Work in a fast-paced environment requiring prolonged standing Perform frequent lifting and handling of parts Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area Follow all safety procedures and guidelines at all times Workers will be cross trained on multiple stations within the department, with the first day consisting of observational training. Work Location: BDC (Bendix Distribution Center) Additional Duties: Other responsibilities may be assigned as needed. Packaging Workstation: Auto Bagger – The worker will enter production order information into the system, retrieve parts from the presentation area, and transport them to the workstation. Based on the production order, parts will be placed into automated bowls that feed items into bags and/or manually fed into bags as required. A first-piece inspection must be completed at the start of each order. Once a full tote of packaged parts is completed, it will be transferred to a pallet box. Hand Bagger – The worker will input production order information into the system, retrieve parts from the presentation area, and transport them to the workstation. In accordance with the production order, parts will be packaged manually into bags. A first-piece inspection is required. Completed totes of bagged parts will then be loaded into a pallet box. Jones Machine – The worker will enter production order information into the system, retrieve parts from the presentation area, and transport them to the workstation. Based on the production order, parts will be manually placed into boxes supplied via conveyor. A first-piece inspection must be completed. Once a tote is filled, it will be loaded into a pallet box. Hand Pack – The worker will input production order information into the system, retrieve parts from the presentation area, and move them to the workstation. Per production order requirements, parts will be manually packed into boxes. A first-piece inspection must be completed. Depending on job specifications, parts may be packed individually or as full totes, then loaded into a pallet box or placed individually on a pallet. Taper Line – The worker will enter production order information into the system, retrieve parts from the presentation area, and transport them to the workstation. Parts will be manually packed into boxes according to production order requirements. A first-piece inspection is required. Depending on specifications, parts may be packed individually or as full totes, then loaded into pallet boxes or placed individually on pallets. This role involves higher production volume compared to the Hand Pack position. Hoist Line – The worker will input production order information into the system, retrieve parts from the presentation area, and move them to the workstation. Per production order requirements, parts will be manually packed and placed individually onto pallets using a hoist or lift-assist device. A first-piece inspection must be completed. Spider – The material handler is responsible for supporting all production areas by supplying raw materials to bagging stations, production lines, and machinery to ensure continuous workflow. This position requires forklift operation and maintaining efficient material flow. Tools: Staple gun, shipping tape gun, utility knives, RF scanner computer/software, printers, pallet jack, forklift, and hoist apparatus. Protective Personal Equipment: Steel toe shoes, anti-fatigue mats, and anti-cut gloves are optional. Environment: The work environment is climate-controlled but can be noisy, with frequent heavy forklift traffic. Workers work collaboratively with others to ensure production is maintained at the required pace throughout the shift. Essential Job Requirements Must be able to maintain good attendance including working overtime as required Must be able to safely and effectively operate in an industrial environment Must be able to read, write and comprehend work instructions, communications, policies, job safety analysis, etc. Must be able to perform basic mathematical calculations Must be able to communicate effectively, verbally and in writing Must be able to reason, analyze and trouble shoot issues on the job Must be able to work as a team member, including but not limited to resolving issues as part of a team, and get along with co-workers Must be able to consistently meet production, safety and quality standards Must be able to safely and effectively perform all functions of the job as described in the physical job analysis listed below Must be willing to participate in daily pre-work stretching program Must be willing to assume other duties as assigned Must be able to wear required personal protective equipment as described in the standardized work instructions Must be able to comply with customer requirements (ex. Shipping instructions, packaging requirements, etc.) Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds Must be able to stand for long periods of time

jobs.title: Technician, Service- Shipping
jobs.text: 1st shift: Mon - Fri 7 AM - 3 PM, $20.88/hr 2nd shift 3 PM - 11 PM, +$1/hr differential Mandatory overtime (2 hours earlier/ day + Saturdays on occasion) Benefits start day one! General: This position involves operating a forklift in a standing position to prepare and manage outgoing shipments. Responsibilities include accurately picking, packing, labeling, staging, and/or loading products onto delivery trucks. The role also requires ensuring all shipment documentation is completed accurately and that orders are processed, tracked, and delivered on time. Workers will frequently mount and dismount forklifts throughout the shift and must be able to perform in a fast-paced environment that involves regular lifting of materials. Strong attention to detail is essential. Workers are expected to cross-train across multiple workstations, beginning with an initial observation period. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support operational objectives. Work Location: Bendix Distribution Center (BDC) Shipping Workstation: Bin Picker - The worker will utilize an RF scanner to identify items to be retrieved from shelving and rack locations. Items are placed on a cart and transported to moving conveyor lines, which deliver products to the sorter area for distribution to the appropriate shipping locations. This role may require the use of a stepladder to access higher shelving. Anti-fatigue mats are provided along conveyor areas to support ergonomics. This position primarily involves continuous picking of finished goods without the use of a forklift. Stand-Up Picker - The worker will operate a stand-up picker and use an RF scanner to retrieve items from shelving and rack locations. Items are placed on the picker and, once full, transported to moving conveyors for delivery to the sorter area. This role involves continuous picking of finished goods using powered equipment. Forklift Picker - The worker will operate a stand-up forklift and use an RF scanner to retrieve larger items from storage locations. Materials are transported on pallets or in pallet boxes to designated pack-out areas within shipping. Truck Packing - The worker is responsible for packing pallet loads delivered to the shipping pack-out area. Pallets and pallet boxes are filled with finished goods supplied by picker roles. Responsibilities include ensuring all required documentation is included with each order, printing and applying appropriate labels, and verifying shipment accuracy. Workers may handle approximately 50–60 boxes per hour, with weights ranging from under 5 pounds up to 52 pounds and carrying distances between 10 and 50 feet. Once orders are complete, pallet boxes are adjusted or cut to ensure proper fit for shipment. Small Package Packing - The worker will pack individual orders and prepare shipping labels using a computer system. Boxes are secured using a banding machine. This position may handle approximately 450–500 boxes per shift, with individual box weights exceeding 70 pounds. Workers will lift boxes from a 28-inch working height to pallets positioned at floor level. Boxes are generally 8–10 inches in height. Tools: Staple guns, utility knives, stand up forklifts, cherry picker forklifts, RF scanner computer/software, printers, banding machine, pallet jack, step ladder. Protective Personal Equipment: Eye protection (UPS areas), steel toe boots, anti-fatigue mats, and anti-cut gloves. Environment: Work is conducted in a climate-controlled environment that may be noisy and includes frequent forklift traffic. Workers are expected to work collaboratively with team members to maintain consistent production flow and ensure output meets established pace requirements throughout the shift. Essential Job Requirements Must be able to maintain good attendance including working overtime as required Must be able to safely and effectively operate in an industrial environment Must be able to read, write and comprehend work instructions, communications, policies, job safety analysis, etc. Must be able to perform basic mathematical calculations Must be able to communicate effectively, verbally and in writing Must be able to reason, analyze and trouble shoot issues on the job Must be able to work as a team member, including but not limited to resolving issues as part of a team, and get along with co-workers Must be able to consistently meet production, safety and quality standards Must be able to safely and effectively perform all functions of the job Must be willing to participate in daily pre-work stretching program Must be willing to assume other duties as assigned Must be able to obtain and maintain a standup and cherry picker (which is also a stand-up lift) forklift certification and operate in a safe manner Must be able to wear required personal protective equipment as described in the standardized work instructions Must be able to comply with customer requirements (ex. Shipping instructions, packaging requirements, etc.) Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds Must be able to stand for long periods of time

jobs.title: Facilities Maintenance Technician- Commercial HVAC Journeyman
jobs.text: POSITION SUMMARY: The Facilities Department is responsible for repairs, maintenance, and modifications to the site, building, and production supports systems (e.g. HVAC, electricity, compressed air, plumbing, etc.). To perform the tasks related to these responsibilities, Bendix utilizes a mixture of contractors and in-house labor. The in-house labor, being the Facilities Department Technician (technician) will usually be assigned tasks via the computerized maintenance management system (CMMS), then complete the assigned tasks, either solo, part of a team, and or by working with a designated contractor. We are looking for a Licensed Commercial HVAC Journeyman in Kentucky with a Valid EPA Certification. Upon assignment of a repair, the technician will investigate and perform a root cause analysis, then work to make immediate repairs, as well as develop and communicate countermeasures that will prevent the failure in the future. If parts are needed, the technician will either utilize the onsite spare parts inventory, or research to determine what resource outside of Bendix has the necessary materials. The technician will communicate with the appropriate parties to schedule the work, go about the activities to complete the work, then complete the necessary Return to Service documents, and document all the labor, parts, and materials in the CMMS with closure of the work order. Upon assignment of preventive maintenance activities, the technician will review the job plan, gather the indicated tools, and materials, adhere to the indicated safety plan then complete the indicated tasks to the best of his ability. Upon completion of the PM activities, the technician is expected to test the machine or system, replace all panels and applicable fasteners, clean up the work area, return tools and unused materials to appropriate locations, and document all the labor and materials used in the CMMS. When assigned a modification, the technician could be expected to work with the designer to prepare for the modification in a variety of ways. Either by assisting with data gathering, selection of parts and materials, layout of piping and components, planning or scheduling of the work, or other assignments as necessary. As the Bendix culture supports continuous improvement, the technician is expected to look for, and report, recommendations for the improvement of job plans, spare parts inventory, tools used, communication methods, planning, etc. The technician may be asked to analyze failure frequency, or failure modes, or other available information necessary to determine an improvement to one of the areas of responsibility. ESSENTIAL DUTIES: Use the CMMS to receive work assignments, look up parts, materials, and tools in advance of the actual work. Use the CMMS to record readings, conditions found, time, date, and other triggers for maintenance activity Use the CMMS to document activity information, to capture labor information, and to close out the assignment. Utilize checklists to perform Autonomous Maintenance walks on the Facilities Department areas of responsibility, and report anomalies found. Provide and utilize basic hand tools to complete the assigned repairs, maintenance, and modifications Keep tool boxes, storage cabinets, work areas, machines, and systems clean, clear of trash, and well organized (i.e. 5S) Perform repairs, maintenance, and modifications in safe, efficient, and high-quality manner with little or minimal disruption to operations Perform root cause analysis of failures to determine necessary repairs and countermeasures Complete required trainings and on schedule Participate in meetings related to the department and training QUALIFICATIONS: Licensed Commercial HVAC Journeyman with Valid EPA certification required. Possess and provide basic hand tools, chest, box, and or bag, needed to perform the work, large and common tools will be provided by Bendix Must be able to fluently communicate in English, with writing, reading, and speaking Must be able to perform basic math and arithmetic functions Must hold a diploma from an accredited high school, or an approved equivalent (e.g. GED); prefer candidate to have successfully completed some type of technical degree (e.g. engineering, physics, mathematics, etc.) Understands and can teach the refrigeration cycle Possess a current license, preferably Universal level, to procure and handle chlorinated fluorocarbon refrigerants Must be able to read and understand wiring schematics and diagrams Experienced in an industrial facilities maintenance role, incorporating HVAC, pneumatics, hydraulics, electrical, and controls. Knowledgeable of a computerized maintenance management system of some variety, preferably SAP-Plant Maintenance Module. Able to search and utilize the internet as a resource for maintenance needs. Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, or some other spreadsheet software Basic knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, or some other email software Knowledgeable of, and experience with, root cause analysis tools, such as 5 Whys, A self-starter, with high quality and performance values. Willing and able to work on all assignments from restroom to roof PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: Able to perform physical activities such as walking, kneeling, squatting, lifting, pushing and pulling for extended periods Able to carry tools, parts, refrigerant etc. Able to work atop roof, ladders, and lifts Able to operate various types of powered industrial trucks and personnel lifts Able to discern colors In performing the essential elements of this position the following physical activities are required. The activities are measured in the amount of on-the-job time that is spent performing these activities. None up to 1/3 1/3 to 2/3 2/3 and more Standing Walking Talking Hearing Using Hands or Fingers to Handle or Feel Stoop, Kneel, Crouch, or Crawl Reach with Hands and Arms Taste or Smell In performing the essential elements of this position the following weight is required to be lifted or force to be exerted. These activities are measured in the amount of weight lifted or force exerted and how often. None up to 1/3 1/3 to 2/3 2/3 and more Up to 10 pounds Up to 25 pounds Up to 50 pounds Up to 100 pounds More than 100 pounds In performing the essential elements of this position the following vision requirements apply. Yes No Close vision Distance vision Color vision Peripheral vision Depth perception Ability to adjust focus WORKING ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS : May be exposed to moderate heat, light dust and fumes. jobs.title: PRODUCTION PROGRAMMER 1
jobs.text: Position Summary : The production planner is responsible for translating customer demand and business forecasts into executable production and material plans that support on-time delivery, inventory optimization, and operational efficiency. This role serves as a critical link between Customer Service, Production, Purchasing, Engineering, Logistics, and Suppliers to ensure material availability, schedule adherence, and achievement of service level objectives. The position owns end-to-end supply planning activities including production scheduling, inventory management, capacity analysis, shortage mitigation, and continuous improvement initiatives while supporting the Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SIOP) process. Essential Functions: Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Develop and maintain short-, medium-, and long-term production schedules aligned with customer demand, capacity constraints, and inventory targets. Convert demand requirements into executable production plans and manufacturing orders. Balance customer requirements, production capacity, labor availability, and material constraints to optimize plant performance. Drive schedule adherence and production order fill rate performance. Monitor capacity utilization and identify opportunities to improve throughput and resource efficiency. Support SIOP, forecasting, and demand review processes Monitor inventory levels, safety stock strategies, excess and obsolete inventory, and inventory turns Review component shortages and develop mitigation plans to avoid production disruptions. Manage production order releases, prioritization, and scheduling activities within SAP. Perform ATP reviews, shortage analysis, and production readiness assessments. Analyze and resolve system exceptions including COGI and planning errors. Coordinate engineering changes, PPAP implementation, prototype launches, and BOM updates. Ensure proper execution of production labeling and manufacturing documentation processes. Act as a primary planning liaison between Manufacturing, Purchasing, Customer Service, Logistics, Engineering, Quality, and Suppliers Analyze planning performance metrics and identify improvement opportunities. Lead root cause investigations for shortages, backlog, inventory discrepancies, schedule misses, and delivery failures. Develop corrective and preventive actions to improve planning effectiveness. Support digital planning initiatives, process standardization, and automation projects Support PSA Activities and procedures with team members. Perform all those activities that by the nature of the position are required. Management & Supervisory Responsibilities: N/A Experience: 5+ years of experience in production planning, supply planning, scheduling, materials management, or supply chain operations. Experience in a manufacturing environment required. Experience supporting SIOP processes preferred. Experience managing supplier-related material constraints and recovery plans preferred. Skills: Advanced SAP ERP/MRP knowledge. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Production scheduling and capacity planning. Inventory management and optimization. Material Requirements Planning (MRP) Data analysis and reporting. Forecasting and demand planning principles. 100% Bilingual (English/Spanish) Education/Certifications: Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or related field. APICS/ASCM certification preferred

jobs.title: Komponentmontör
jobs.text: Komponentmontör till Knorr-Bremse – Gör skillnad varje dag Vill du ha ett arbete där du gör verklig skillnad? I vår serviceverksamhet handlar jobbet om mer än demontering och montering, det handlar om att säkerställa att våra kunders tåg hålls rullande och bidra till säkra transporter i hela Europa. Som en del av vårt team blir du en viktig länk i ett flöde som påverkar tusentals resenärer och godstransporter. Här får du möjlighet att kombinera praktiskt arbete med tekniska moment, utveckla din kompetens och arbeta i en miljö där samarbete och ansvar är centrala värden. Om du uppskattar att ta ansvar, arbeta tillsammans med andra och se konkreta resultat av ditt arbete, då är du rätt person för oss på Knorr-Bremse. Vi söker nu komponentmontörer till vår serviceverksamhet i Lund. Hos oss får du lära dig hur bromssystemen på tåg är uppbyggda och bidra till att skapa säkra och hållbara transportlösningar. Du kommer att arbeta med demontering, montering och slutprovning av bromskomponenter i olika produktionslinjer. Arbetet kräver att du kan läsa ritningar och att du är noggrann med en stark känsla för kvalitet. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från montering och underhållsarbete, gärna inom pneumatik eller hydraulik, samt om du har arbetat i team tidigare. Vana vid momentdragning och användning av limmet Loctite är också önskvärt. Som person är du positiv, flexibel och ordningsam. Du motiveras av att lära dig nya saker och har en god samarbetsförmåga. Du vågar fråga när du behöver stöd och bidrar med ditt bästa för att uppnå produktionens mål. Vi värdesätter serviceinriktning, struktur och initiativförmåga, och vi tror att du trivs med att arbeta i team där alla hjälps åt för att nå gemensamma resultat. Hos Knorr-Bremse blir du en del av ett engagerat team där vi värdesätter kvalitet, samarbete och utveckling. Vi erbjuder både visstidsanställning till ett längre projekt men också tillsvidareanställning. Vi har kollektivavtal Teknikavtalet - IF Metall. Till vår verksamhet i Lund finns det möjlighet att åka med kollektivtrafik. Vidare erbjuds du friskvårdsbidrag, frukost varje morgon och stora utvecklingsmöjligheter. Arbetet är förlagt på dagtid, måndag till fredag, med möjlighet till flextid. Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan via vår hemsida redan idag! Vi arbetar med löpande urval och ser gärna att du ansöker snarast, dock senast söndag 23 augusti 2026. Vänligen notera att under sommarperioden hanteras ansökningar i begränsad utsträckning, vilket kan innebära längre återkopplingstid än vanligt. Vi har inte heller någon möjlighet att ta emot ansökningar via e-post. Har du frågor är du välkommen att kontakta Frida Dahlqvist, HR Generalist, på frida.dahlqvist@knorr-bremse.com.

jobs.title: TACTICAL PLANNER
jobs.text: Position Summary: Tactical Planner is an entry-level, tactical role responsible for executing foundational SAP transactions and clerical activities in support of Central Planner 2, Central Planner 3, and Supplier Integrators. This position focuses on transactional accuracy, documentation discipline, foundational SAP execution and maintenance, and report distribution. The role does not include planning decisions, shortage management, or decision-making. Essential Functions: • Create, adjust, and maintain purchase orders for externally sourced components • Update purchase orders with supplier-acknowledged ship dates and quantities • Confirm purchase order pricing and quantities, support invoice matching • Input and maintain customer and supplier order data within ERP systems • Transmit releases to suppliers and track acknowledgements • Assist in monitoring inventory levels and inventory accuracy for purchased components • Maintain material master, purchasing info records, and planning parameters as directed • Ensure FIFO compliance through data accuracy and transaction timing (no physical handling) • Track inbound shipments and verify receipt or non-receipt for purchased materials • Communicate with freight carriers, customs brokers, and logistics partners as needed • Support expediting activities by tracking delivery risks and hot parts • Maintain documentation related to compliance (packing slips) • Refresh and distribute standard purchasing and inventory reports • Document discrepancies, corrective actions, and transaction changes • Maintain filing and audit documentation for orders and receipts • Interface with Purchasing, Supplier Integration, Quality, and Finance teams • Participate in cross-functional meetings to build supply chain knowledge • Follow EHS and system governance requirements Knowledge: • SAP navigation and data entry; detail orientation; documentation discipline; basic Excel/report refresh; clear written communication. •Basic knowledge of MRP/ERP systems (SAP preferred). •Understanding of data integrity and system alignments, supplier risk management, escalation processes, and compliance frameworks. Experience: • 0–2 years in supply chain/operations (SAP exposure preferred). Skills: • Ability to establish credibility and trust. • Ability to manage projects and assignments with little guidance. • Basic interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills. • Possesses good analytical skills. • Ability to influence and persuade to inspire action. • Self-starter who is action oriented and possesses a strong sense of urgency. • Capable of performing in a customer-focused, team-based matrix organization is essential. • Capable of successfully performing independently as well as in a team setting. • Possesses advanced planning and organizational skills. • Results oriented with demonstrated capability of meeting tight deadlines. • Basic systems and data management skills required. • Proficient in Microsoft Office products. • Possesses the skills to extract data from system queries to create management reports. Education: • Bachelor’s degree in operations, Supply Chain Management, or Business Administration preferred.

jobs.title: Electronic Systems Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.text: Your responsibilities: technical lead of brakes system projects, specify functional and safety requirements for SW and HW based on customer requirements, lead technical discussion with internal and external customers, develop control subsystems based on Knorr-Bremse and 3rd parties electronic platforms, develop of control application SW and perform SW testing (SW integration tests, HIL tests), support for system commissioning team, execute project activities with respect to project time line in compliance to V-model based Knorr-Bremse system engineering process and supporting processes like: change management, configuration management, version management, collaborate with other Knorr-Bremse locations / departments to align project solutions with project needs and product strategy, collaborate with project team members from all over the world: project manager, other system engineers, validation engineers. Our requirements: bachelor or master degree in engineering (electronics, electrical, mechatronics, robotics, automation or similar), experience in railway, automotive or in other industry (minimum 2 years will be an advantage), experience with requirements management, change management, configuration management and process driven system / SW engineering, good understanding of electronics (HW interfaces), electrical schematics, good work package organization and analytical thinking, team player with specific role inheritance, fluent English (written and spoken). Optional: knowledge about embedded SW, PLC or Matlab/Simulink will be an advantage, C/C++ programming skills will be an advantage, knowledge about mechanics, pneumatics, automatics or mechatronics will be an advantage, functional safety understanding will be an advantage. What we offer: stable employment and long‑term career growth, annual bonus up to 10% of your annual gross base salary, flexible hours (start between 7:00 and 9:30 a.m.), hybrid work model, subsidized lunch card (SmartLunch), private healthcare (upgrade options and family add‑ons), subsidized Multisport membership, partial funding for professional training, life insurance, vacation allowance, benefit points through the MyBenefit platform, a comprehensive, role‑specific training program, opportunities for development and upskilling, a friendly culture and supportive team, additional bonuses and recognition awards.

jobs.title: Site Engineer 1 (Base in Singapore)
jobs.text: Location: Singapore Full-Time. Initial 3-Year Contract (Renewable) Reporting To: Project Manager/Project Engineer Position Summary We are seeking a proactive Site Engineer to join our team for a long-term Land Transport Authority (LTA) project focused on Platform Screen Door (PSD) systems. This role involves supervising and coordinating site activities including replacement, upgrading, testing, commissioning, and lifecycle management of PSD electronic and mechanical components. You will play a key role in ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant execution of works in a live railway environment. Key Responsibilities Site Supervision: Coordinate and supervise daily site activities for PSD component replacement and installation. Installation & Testing: Coordinate dismantling, alignment, adjustment, fault rectification & Troubleshooting, testing and commissioning works. Quality & Safety: Ensure compliance with LTA, SMRT, and railway safety standards. Stakeholder Coordination: Liaise with subcontractors, planning teams, and site personnel to ensure smooth execution. Reporting: Prepare daily site reports, inspection records, and work progress updates. Technical Support: Assist in troubleshooting, fault rectification, risk assessments, and method statement preparation. Standby for Defect Liability Support What We’re Looking For Diploma/Degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related discipline. 3–5 years of experience in railway, MRT, E&M, or infrastructure projects. Experience in LTA/MRT-related projects in Singapore preferred. Familiarity with Platform Screen Door systems, CANbus networks, and railway operational constraints. Ability to interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, and specifications. Strong coordination, communication, and problem-solving skills. Preferred Extras Experience in live operational railway environments. Familiarity with LTA, SMRT, or SBS Transit procedures. Knowledge of permit-to-work systems and railway safety requirements. If you’re hands-on, detail-oriented, and ready to take on a dynamic role in Singapore’s railway projects, we’d love to hear from you. Interested candidates, please apply here with upload your CV and cover letter. Personal Data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.

jobs.title: Service Center Engineer (Base in Singapore)
jobs.text: Location: Singapore Report to: Service Center Manager Position type: Permanent Job Summary The Service Center Engineer is responsible for servicing, troubleshooting, repair, overhaul, testing, and maintenance of railway control systems and related components in the service center. The role also supports the Service Center Manager in daily operations, including maintaining equipment and tools, managing spare parts and inventory, and ensuring the workshop is safe, clean, and well-organized. This includes coordinating timely availability of parts, resolving non-conformances, and supporting continuous improvement of service center activities. Key Roles & Responsibilities Service Repair & Overhaul Perform inspection, troubleshooting, repair, overhaul, and functional testing brake control systems and components. Diagnose electrical, pneumatic, and mechanical faults in brake equipment. Disassemble, clean, inspect, repair, and reassemble brake control units and assemblies. Replace defective parts and perform adjustment and calibration activities. Conduct overhaul activities according to OEM manuals, maintenance procedures, and customer requirements. Perform pressure, leakage, and functional tests after repair and overhaul. Ensure repaired units meet technical performance and safety standards. Technical Support & Troubleshooting Analyze failure modes and support root cause investigation. Prepare technical findings and repair reports. Support field service teams on technical escalations when required. Assist engineering team in reliability improvement initiatives. Support warranty and failure analysis activities. Workshop & Service Center Operations Maintain accurate repair and overhaul records. Update service status in SAP systems. Support spare parts tracking and inventory control. Ensure special tools and testing equipment are properly maintained and calibrated. Support continuous improvement and productivity initiatives. Quality, Safety & Compliance Follow railway safety standards, workshop SOPs, and quality procedures. Maintain proper housekeeping and 5S standards in the workshop. Support internal and external quality audits. Requirements: Qualification and Experience Bachelor’s Degree / Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related discipline. At least 3-5years of relevant experience in railway, MRT, E&M, or infrastructure projects. Experience in LTA or MRT-related projects in Singapore is preferred and experience in installation, testing and maintenance is an advantage Familiarity with LTA, SMRT or SBS Transit engineering procedures and safety requirements. Preferred skills and technical competencies Knowledge of permit-to-work systems and railway safety procedures. Ability to interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, and engineering specifications. Knowledge of testing, troubleshooting, and site coordination practices. Proficient in Microsoft Office and basic reporting tools. Strong communication skills, stakeholder coordination and good teamwork Personal Data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.

jobs.title: Quality Manager (Base in Singapore)
jobs.text: Location: Singapore Full-Time. Initial 3-Year Contract (Renewable) Reporting to: General Manager, Singapore Branch Office Position Summary We’re looking for a Quality Specialist/Manager to champion excellence across railway projects, service center repairs, and overhaul operations. You will act as the primary focal point for quality assurance, investigations, corrective actions, and customer communication, driving excellence and continuous improvement across the organization. Key Responsibilities Quality Management : Develop, implement, and maintain the Quality Management System (QMS) in line with ISO 9001, LTA, SMRT, and railway standards. Compliance Oversight : Ensure projects, repairs, and overhaul activities meet contractual, regulatory, and customer requirements. Audit & Reporting : Conduct internal audits, support external audits, and prepare quality reports, inspection records, and management reviews. Investigation & CAPA : Lead structured investigations, root cause analysis, corrective/preventive actions for non-conformances. Customer Engagement : Act as the key quality representative, presenting findings and ensuring timely resolution of customer concerns. Continuous Improvement : Drive initiatives to enhance reliability and operational effectiveness. What We’re Looking For Degree in Engineering or Quality Management. ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification. At least 8 years’ experience in railway/MRT/infrastructure quality management. Strong knowledge of QMS, railway standards, and inspection/testing procedures. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage multiple quality issues in a fast-paced railway environment. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and quality reporting/document control systems. Preferred Extras Experience with Platform Screen Door systems. Familiarity with LTA, SMRT, SBS Transit procedures. Background in railway asset renewal or lifecycle projects. This is a unique opportunity to play a critical role in ensuring the safety, reliability, and compliance of Singapore’s railway projects. You’ll work closely with engineering teams, service centers, and customers to uphold the highest standards of quality and operational excellence. We offer stability, growth, and the chance to make a lasting impact on Singapore’s rail infrastructure. Personal Data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.

jobs.title: Lagermedarbetare
jobs.text: Lagermedarbetare till Knorr-Bremse Rail Systems Sweden AB i Lund! Vill du ha ett jobb där du gör verklig skillnad, varje dag? Hos oss handlar jobbet om mer än lager och logistik. Du blir en del av ett flöde som håller tågen rullande och bidrar till säkra transporter i hela Europa. Här får du arbeta praktiskt, utveckla din kompetens och arbeta i ett team som stöttar varandra. Om du gillar ansvar, samarbete och att se resultat av ditt arbete, och har möjlighet att börja omgående, då är du rätt person för oss! Som lagermedarbetare hos Knorr-Bremse får du en varierad arbetsdag där du arbetar med plockning och packning både för hand och med truck, lastning och lossning av lastbilar samt inleverans av gods. I rollen kan det också förekomma utkörning och transporter av mindre gods, vilket innebär att B-körkort är ett krav. En del av ditt arbete kommer också innebära avsyning, registrering och hantering av både serviceprodukter och reklamationer. Du kommer att ha tät kontakt med kollegor i såväl Sverige som Europa och världen samt kunder och transportörer. En stor del av vårt dagliga arbete sker i SAP, där vi hanterar hela flödet – från ankomstregistrering och utleveranser till fakturering. Vi arbetar kontinuerligt för att säkerställa att rätt produkter finns i lager och att kvaliteten uppfyller gällande standarder. Dagliga inventeringar och interna kvalitetskontroller, både i SAP och i externa system, är en naturlig del av arbetet. För att lyckas i rollen krävs god förmåga att hantera digitala lösningar och affärssystem. Vi söker dig som är serviceinriktad, strukturerad och initiativtagande, och som trivs med att arbeta i team. Som person är du positiv, flexibel och ordningsam, och du motiveras av att lära dig nya saker. Det är viktigt att du har en god samarbetsförmåga, vågar fråga om hjälp och har en stark vilja att bidra med ditt bästa för att uppnå produktionens mål. Hos oss är din personlighet och din vilja att utvecklas viktigare än tidigare erfarenhet. Vi tror på att rätt inställning och engagemang är nyckeln till framgång, resten lär vi dig på vägen. Hos Knorr-Bremse blir du en del av ett engagerat team på 10 personer där vi värdesätter kvalitet, samarbete och utveckling. Hos oss har du många bollar i luften, jobbar med alla typer av arbetsuppgifter och hoppar in där det behövs. Ingen dag är den andra lik, vi hjälps åt och ser till att jobbet blir gjort tillsammans. Vi erbjuder en visstidsanställning på 6 månader enligt kollektivavtal Teknikavtalet – IF Metall. Start önskas omgående. Arbetet är förlagt på dagtid, måndag till fredag, med möjlighet till flextid. Krav: B-körkort Truckkort A1-4, B1 och B2 Svenska och engelska flytande Meriterande: Erfarenhet i SAP Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag och bli en del av vårt team. Kontakt och ansökan: Vi arbetar med löpande urval och ser gärna att ansöker via hemsidan snarast, dock senast söndag den 2026-08-23. Vänligen notera att under sommarperioden hanteras ansökningar i begränsad utsträckning, vilket kan innebära längre återkopplingstid än vanligt. Frågor besvaras av Kristoffer Jensen, Teamleader lager på kristoffer.jensen@knorr-bremse.com eller Frida Dahlqvist, HR Generalist på frida.dahlqvist@knorr-bremse.com . Om Knorr-Bremse: Knorr-Bremse har haft ett enda uppdrag i över 110 år: att göra mobilitet på vägar och järnvägar säker, hållbar och miljövänlig. Idag är Knorr-Bremse-koncernen, med huvudkontor i München, Tyskland, världens ledande tillverkare av bromssystem och en ledande leverantör av säkerhetskritiska delsystem för järnvägs- och nyttofordon. Vi ser oss själva som en innovatör inom våra områden som driver mobilitets- och transporttekniken framåt. Den grundläggande omvandlingen av rörligheten öppnar nya möjligheter för Knorr-Bremse. Globala megatrender som urbanisering, ekoeffektivitet, digitalisering och automatiserad körning definierar dessa förändringar. Vi är idealiskt positionerade för att hjälpa till att forma en ny värld av rörlighet. Mer än 30 000 anställda ägnar all sin expertis och passion åt våra kunder och partners – på över 100 platser i mer än 30 länder runt om i världen Besök https://www.knorr-bremse.com/en/ för mer information om företaget

jobs.title: Category Lead
jobs.text: About Lenskart Twelve years ago, Lenskart started with a simple mission—to eliminate preventable blindness. What began as a small startup has now become Asia’s largest eyewear company , having served over 40 million customers globally. With 10,000+ Lenskartians, 2000+ omnichannel stores across 175+ cities in India, Singapore, Dubai, and beyond, we now ship a pair of eyewear every 2.5 seconds—powered by one of the world’s most automated eyewear factories. Investors include Softbank, ADIA, Temasek, Kedaara Capital, Premji Invest, KKR, Alpha Wave, Bay Capital. Our Next Chapter We’re on an ambitious mission to serve 1 billion eyes in 2025 . And we’re going beyond vision correction—to transform how people see and experience the world. This requires cutting-edge technology, unmatched customer experience, and exceptional people. Our strategic priorities over the next three years include tech innovation, global expansion, manufacturing scale-up, and building a deep bench of entrepreneurial talent. We’re growing existing categories, entering new ones, and scaling across geographies and channels. The Role: Category Head As Category Head, you will be the business owner of your category—responsible for driving exponential growth through product strategy, assortment, pricing, and margin management. You will own the entire P&L , playing a critical role in shaping customer experience, influencing repeat behaviour, and transforming eyewear from a utility to a fashion-first, high-frequency purchase. Key Responsibilities P&L and Business Ownership Full ownership of category P&L: revenue, margins, inventory turns and working capital. Drive top-line growth and bottom-line profitability across all channels (online, offline, home). 2. Strategic Category Management Build and execute the category growth roadmap. Lead assortment planning: width, depth, OTB, category gaps, and range rationalization. Define the right mix of core vs. fashion, trend-led vs. evergreen. 3. Buying & Merchandising Lead seasonal buying across geographies and channels. Partner with vendors and in-house design teams to drive trend-forward innovation. Reorder high-performing styles and ensure sufficient stock (DOH) on bestsellers. 4. Launches & Channel Execution Plan successful collection launches with targeted store assortments. Collaborate with Marketing, VM, and Training teams to drive GTM success. Avoid over-spread by tailoring assortments by store type, geography, and consumer profile. 5. Daily Trade & Lifecycle Management Monitor ROS and manage the product lifecycle: launches, in-season moves, and exits. Optimize store and warehouse distribution; identify slow movers and take timely actions. Recommend data-led product pricing and discounting strategies. Conduct product trainings for store teams to boost conversions and engagement. 6. Margins, Inventory & Quality Control Own and manage product costing to deliver healthy margins. Maintain inventory discipline with strong turns and minimal ageing. Uphold the Lenskart quality promise —reduce returns and NPS detractors by ensuring consistent product quality. Ideal Candidate 7+ years of relevant experience in category management, buying, or merchandising. Fashion industry experience preferred. Strong commercial acumen with a deep understanding of consumer trends and market insights. Proven track record in P&L ownership and scaling categories. High ownership mindset; collaborative and impact oriented. Data-driven, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Join us to shape the future of eyewear—and how the world sees.

jobs.title: Replineshment Lead
jobs.text: Role Title: AI Replenishment Intelligence Lead Location: Delhi, India | On-site | Full-time Mission Brief: Reinvent How Lenskart Never Runs Out — or Runs Over This is not a replenishment role. This is a product transformation mandate . Lenskart operates one of India's largest and fastest-scaling retail networks — thousands of stores, millions of SKUs, and a supply chain that must move at the speed of fashion and the precision of science. Today, our replenishment function is being fundamentally reimagined: from reactive and rule-based to predictive, intelligent, and productized as a scalable AI platform . You will be the architect of that shift. As the AI Replenishment Intelligence Lead , you will own the end-to-end product vision, design, and deployment of Lenskart's AI-driven replenishment platform — a system that ensures the right product reaches the right store at the right moment, every time. You will operate at the intersection of machine intelligence, product management, and retail operations , converting data into decision systems that directly drive availability, profitability, and customer delight across India and global markets. If you've been waiting for a role where AI is not a feature but the core product , this is it. 🔑 Core Mandate 1. AI Platform Development — Build the Brain Own the product vision, roadmap, and lifecycle of Lenskart's replenishment intelligence platform. Define and evolve the product architecture for real-time inventory visibility, ML-driven demand forecasting, dynamic safety stock models, and system-generated replenishment decisions that eliminate manual intervention. Translate complex retail and supply chain problems into clear product requirements, user stories, and technical specifications for Data Science and Engineering teams. Act as the product owner for all AI/ML capabilities within replenishment, ensuring models are production-ready, scalable, and continuously improving. Drive success through clearly defined product metrics such as forecast accuracy (MAPE/WAPE), fill rates, inventory turns, and system adoption — and own these as core product KPIs. 2. Intelligent Assortment & Inventory Optimization — Drive the Business Build and scale AI-powered product features that solve high-impact commercial problems: assortment optimization (store-wise product mix), demand sensing across fashion cycles, and automated markdown and liquidation intelligence. Design systems that dynamically connect inventory decisions with financial and customer outcomes , influencing working capital efficiency, sell-through, and availability. Transform Open-to-Buy into a real-time, system-led product capability , where buying signals are continuously optimized based on live demand, inventory health, and business goals — moving from static planning to always-on decisioning systems . 3. Cross-Functional Leadership — Drive Adoption Drive product adoption and behavioral change across Merchandising, Supply Chain, Finance, and Retail Operations. Ensure the platform is not just built, but deeply embedded into daily decision-making. Act as the voice of the user , continuously refining the product based on stakeholder feedback, usability insights, and operational realities. Build, mentor, and elevate a team of planners and analysts to operate as product users and contributors , fostering a culture of experimentation, data fluency, and trust in AI-led systems. The Essentials Experience: 5–8 years in product management, inventory planning, supply chain product roles, or merchandise planning , with demonstrable experience building or owning AI/ML-driven products or decision systems — not just using them. Technical Depth: Hands-on familiarity with demand forecasting methodologies (time-series models, statistical and machine learning approaches), replenishment algorithm design, and the ability to translate these into scalable product features and system requirements . Education: Degree in AI/ML, Data Science, Operations Research, Engineering, or a highly quantitative field. Top-tier MBA a strong plus. Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of retail operations, SKU-level planning, supply chain dynamics, and how fashion cycles complicate inventory logic — with the ability to translate these into product constructs and decision frameworks . The Mindset AI-Native Thinking: You don’t add AI to products — you build products around AI capabilities . You understand model strengths and limitations and design systems accordingly. Builder’s Instinct: You treat replenishment as a living product — iterating rapidly, measuring impact, and continuously improving. Analytical Rigor at Speed: You move from ambiguity to clarity fast — translating complex signals into scalable product decisions and features . Transformational Leadership: You drive alignment, build trust in AI systems, and lead product adoption across diverse stakeholders , turning skepticism into advocacy. Equal Opportunity Statement At Lenskart, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and identities — because the best intelligence, human or artificial, comes from many perspectives

jobs.title: Circle Lead - ROMG
jobs.text: Circle Head – Rest of Maharashtra & Goa Own the Region. Build the Future of Tech-Enabled Retail. Mission Brief: Lead Lenskart's Most Exciting Growth Frontier Rest of Maharashtra and Goa (ROMG) is one of Lenskart's fastest-growing and most strategically important markets — and we're looking for the leader who will own it completely. This isn't a management role. This is a founder's mandate: full P&L ownership, a high-performance team to build, and the rare opportunity to shape how an AI-powered, omnichannel retail brand scales in a dynamic, underpenetrated market. You will operate at the intersection of on-ground execution and intelligent retail — using real-time data, AI-assisted selling tools, and technology-driven insights to drive decisions that most retail leaders still make on instinct. If you've been waiting for a role where your actions move markets, this is it. 🎯 Core Mandate 1.Business Performance & P&L Ownership Own topline revenue, profitability, and unit economics across the region — with full accountability for outcomes. Drive same-store growth through conversion rate improvement, ticket size expansion, and repeat customer behaviour. Use store-level performance data and AI-driven insights to identify high-potential micro-markets and unlock new growth pockets ahead of competition. 2. AI-First Sales Strategy & Execution Define and execute a sharp, data-informed offline sales strategy — not just on gut feel, but grounded in real-time performance signals. Leverage Lenskart's technology stack including AI-assisted selling tools, demand forecasting at the store level, and live dashboards to drive precision execution across every store in your circle. Build a culture of accountability where numbers are owned, tracked, and acted upon daily. 3. Team Leadership & Capability Building Build and lead a high-performing bench of Area Managers and store teams. Create a culture where goals are clear, ownership is celebrated, and performance is rewarded. Invest in capability development across sales, customer experience, and tech-enabled operations — turning your circle into a talent factory for Lenskart's next generation of leaders. 4. Customer Experience & NPS Own end-to-end in-store experience and NPS for the region. Champion a customer-first operating model through regular store immersion, structured feedback loops, and rapid response to experience gaps. Ensure every touchpoint — from the moment a customer walks in to the moment they leave — reflects Lenskart's promise of premium, accessible, tech-enabled eyecare. 5. Operational Excellence & Intelligent Efficiency Maximize store productivity through smart staffing, AI-supported planning, and continuous operational improvement. Drive inventory discipline, cost efficiency, and process rigor — not through micromanagement, but through systems thinking and data-led decisions. Identify gaps fast and close them faster. 6. Market Intelligence & Expansion Stay deeply embedded in local markets, competition, and consumer behaviour across Rest of Maharashtra and Goa. Translate on-ground intelligence into expansion strategies — identifying where to grow next, how to win faster, and what Lenskart's customers in these markets need before they know it themselves. 7. Brand Custodianship & Tech-Led Retail Be the guardian of Lenskart's brand in the region — premium, accessible, and unmistakably differentiated. Ensure every store delivers a seamless blend of retail and technology: from AI-assisted dispensing and omnichannel journeys to data-driven clienteling. Champion an insight-led, tech-first operating culture across every team you lead. 🧠 The Mindset We're Looking For Owner, Not Manager. You feel the P&L personally. You move fast, take decisions with incomplete information, and course-correct without being told. Data-Led, Ground-Rooted. You love being in stores and markets — and you equally love opening a dashboard to understand what the data is telling you. You don't choose between instinct and intelligence. You use both. Builder at Heart. You're energized by building — teams, systems, culture, markets. You leave places meaningfully better than you found them. Tech-Forward Leader. You're genuinely curious about how AI, data tools, and technology can make your team smarter and faster. You don't wait for tech to be handed to you — you ask for it, learn it, and push for more. High-EQ People Leader. You build trust fast, give honest feedback, and create environments where people grow. Your team's success is your scoreboard. 📋 What You Bring 8–14 years of experience in retail, QSR, or consumer businesses — with a demonstrated track record of managing multi-store, multi-city operations Proven P&L ownership with consistent, measurable growth delivery Experience operating in fast-paced, high-growth environments where ambiguity is the norm Strong commercial instincts combined with comfort using data and digital tools to drive decisions A reputation as a talent builder — someone who grows teams and creates future leaders ⚡ Why This Role — Right Now Lenskart isn’t a conventional retailer dabbling in technology — we are a technology-first company with one of India’s largest and fastest-growing retail footprints. Rest of Maharashtra and Goa sits at a pivotal moment, with strong growth momentum, significant headroom, and rapidly evolving consumer demand. The leader in this role will see a clear, direct impact of their decisions on shaping one of the company’s most compelling growth You won't be executing someone else's playbook. You'll be writing it — with the full backing of Lenskart's proprietary tech stack, AI tools, supply chain infrastructure, and a leadership team that rewards bold thinking and fast action. This is the role for someone who wants to be known for building something remarkable. Lenskart is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diverse perspectives and are committed to building a team that reflects the markets we serve.

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.text: We are building the next-generation technology platforms that power the Lenskart Group — spanning multiple brands (Lenskart, Owndays, Meller, Aqualens) and operating across geographies including India, KSA, UAE, Singapore, Japan, and beyond. Required Skills & Qualifications ● 3–8+ years of backend development experience using Java Spring Boot ● Strong understanding of microservices architecture and REST API design ● Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases (MySQL, MongoDB) ● Experience with event-driven systems and message brokers (Kafka or similar) ● Familiarity with caching strategies (Redis, Memcached) and x design ● Solid foundation in object-oriented programming, design patterns, and clean code principles ● Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and deployments on AWS or GCP Nice to Have ● Experience building multi-brand or multi-tenant platforms ● Exposure to AI/ML integrations in production environments ● Background in e-commerce, retail tech, or global-scale applications ● Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Elasticsearch, and recommendation engines Why Join Us ● Build the global technology backbone of Lenskart Group — uniting brands, markets, and customer journeys under one intelligent platform ● Work at the intersection of vision, design, and AI, redefining how the world discovers and experiences eyewear ● Be part of a fast-scaling, global tech team solving complex challenges with data, systems thinking, and creativity ● Enjoy a culture of innovation, ownership, and collaboration ● Competitive compensation, learning opportunities, and a chance to create impact at global scale At Lenskart, you won’t just write code — you’ll help build the intelligent platforms that shape how the world sees.

jobs.title: Global Projects Lead
jobs.text: Global Projects Lead Lenskart.com · Gurugram, India · On-site · Full-time 🌍 Mission Brief: Set the Global Standard for Retail Excellence Lenskart is on one of the most ambitious retail expansion journeys in the world — scaling across Asia, the Middle East, and beyond. Every store we open is a statement: about our brand, our obsession with customer experience, and our belief that technology can transform even the most physical of spaces. This role is for the person who will own that statement globally. As Global Projects Lead, you will be the architect of Lenskart's physical retail future — defining how our stores are designed, built, and experienced across every market we enter. You will lead with data, build with precision, and raise the bar every single time. Reporting to the Global Head of Projects, you will operate at the intersection of design, engineering, technology, and commercial strategy — driving the execution engine that powers our global store network. This is not a maintenance role. This is a builder's role. 🔑 Core Mandate 1. Set the AI-Powered Global Design Standard Be the custodian of Lenskart's retail brand experience — but go beyond aesthetics. Use data and AI-driven insights to define what a world-class Lenskart store looks, feels, and performs like. Establish design frameworks and specifications that are dynamic, scalable, and informed by real-time market feedback, customer behaviour analytics, and performance data from existing stores. Every new store should be smarter than the last. 2. Build the Intelligent Project Governance Engine Lead end-to-end store design and delivery — governing BOQs, specifications, and quality benchmarks across all markets. Introduce AI-assisted project tracking, predictive risk monitoring, and real-time dashboards to move from reactive problem-solving to proactive portfolio management. Define the processes and governance models that enable speed without sacrificing quality. 3. Own the Global Expansion Roadmap Build and manage a multi-year, multi-country rollout roadmap that is anchored in data — using site analytics, demand modelling, and market intelligence to prioritise where and how we grow. Partner with senior leaders across Retail, Finance, and Supply Chain to ensure every new market entry is strategically timed and operationally ready. 4. Build a World-Class, Tech-Enabled Vendor Ecosystem Develop and govern a high-performance global vendor network spanning construction, fabrication, engineering, and maintenance. Go beyond traditional procurement — use data benchmarking, performance scoring, and AI-assisted vendor evaluation to ensure you're always working with the best partners at the best value. Build systems that make vendor governance scalable across geographies. 5. Lead Commercial Excellence & Value Engineering Champion a culture of intelligent value engineering — using material science, cost analytics, and AI-driven procurement insights to optimise every rupee spent without compromising brand experience. Own all project commercials: contracts, BOQs, procurement workflows, and financial controls. Bring the same rigour to cost as to quality.. 6. Drive Execution Excellence at Global Scale Establish quality standards and audit frameworks that travel across borders. Use technology to enable real-time visibility into project status, quality compliance, and post-handover performance across every market. Build systems that make consistent execution the default, not the exception. 7. Lead, Mentor & Inspire Regional Teams Build and lead a team of high-performing project professionals across regions. Create a culture of ownership, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement. Be the voice of the Projects function at the leadership table — representing the team's work, ambitions, and impact to senior stakeholders globally. ⚡ The Essentials Experience: 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in global retail or consumer brand projects, with a proven track record of leading multi-country expansion programmes for design-led, premium brands. Technical Depth: Strong expertise in design execution, BOQs, contracting, vendor governance, and engineering oversight — combined with a genuine appetite for using data and technology to make project delivery smarter and faster. Scale: Demonstrated experience managing large retail portfolios across multiple geographies, with the ability to balance local nuance with global consistency. Education: Bachelor's degree in Architecture or Civil Engineering. Advanced qualifications in Project Management or Business are a plus. 🧠 The Mindset Technology-Forward: You believe the future of retail project management is AI-assisted, data-driven, and real-time. You actively seek out tools and approaches that make your team faster, smarter, and more consistent — and you build the systems that outlast you. Obsessed with Quality at Scale: You understand that quality cannot be a manual inspection — it has to be designed into the system. You build standards, frameworks, and governance models that make excellence repeatable across every store, in every market. Commercial Sharpness: You think like a business owner. You understand that every design decision, every vendor choice, and every project milestone has a direct line to P&L — and you make decisions accordingly. Builder's Mentality: You are energised by complexity and ambiguity. You don't wait for a playbook — you write it. You see a new market as a canvas and bring the rigour, creativity, and discipline to make it exceptional. Transformational Leadership: You lead by conviction, not just authority. You inspire teams to raise their standards, challenge the status quo, and take ownership of outcomes — not just activities. At Lenskart, we are building a technology company that happens to sell eyewear. If you want to build the retail infrastructure of a global brand that is redefining an industry — this is your role.

jobs.title: Database Reliability Engineer Sql and MongoDB
jobs.text: The Role We are looking for a high‐caliber DataOps / Database Reliability Engineer who brings strong engineering fundamentals and a deep sense of ownership. You will design, build, and operate MySQL, MongoDB, MSSQL, and BigQuery platforms that enable product teams to ship quickly and safely - at scale. This role is hands‐on, impact‐driven, and aligned with top‐tier engineering standards. What You Will Do Database Architecture & Reliability ● Architect and operate highly available MySQL (InnoDB Cluster, Group Replication), MongoDB (Replica Sets, Sharded Clusters), MSSQL, and BigQuery environments. ● Lead migrations (version upgrades, cloud transitions to AWS RDS/Aurora, MongoDB Atlas, BigQuery). ● Define and enforce standards, schema design best practices, and governance policies. ● Drive SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for mission‐critical data services. Performance Engineering ● Optimize queries, indexes, and workloads using advanced profiling tools across MySQL, MongoDB, MSSQL, and BigQuery. ● Tune InnoDB internals, buffer pools, shard keys, working sets, and query execution plans. ● Resolve bottlenecks across CPU, memory, and I/O. ● Implement advanced monitoring and alerting (PMM, Ops Manager, Grafana, Datadog). Operational Excellence & Automation ● Automate backup/recovery (XtraBackup, mysqldump/mysqlpump, Ops Manager, filesystem snapshots, MSSQL native tools). ● Champion Infrastructure‐as‐Code (Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes Operators). ● Implement Change Data Capture (CDC) pipelines using Debezium and integrate with downstream systems. ● Enforce strong security: authentication, authorization, encryption, auditing. ● Conduct DR drills, capacity planning, and maintain clear documentation/runbooks. ● Continuously reduce operational toil through automation and engineering solutions. Collaboration & Incident Response ● Partner with DevOps/SRE teams to integrate DB ops into CI/CD pipelines. ● Mentor engineers on database best practices. ● Participate in on‐call rotations, lead incident response, and write clear, blameless RCAs. ● Work closely with product and platform teams to influence system design through the lens of scale, resilience, and cost efficiency. What We’re Looking For Core Engineering ● Strong foundations in Linux/Unix, networking (DNS, TCP/IP), and distributed systems. ● Proficiency in Python, Bash, or JavaScript for automation and tooling. ● Clean Git practices and strong software engineering discipline. Databases ● Deep expertise in MySQL and MongoDB. ● Proven experience with HA/DR setups, replication, and performance tuning. ● Backup/recovery expertise with XtraBackup, mongodump, Ops Manager, MSSQL native tools. ● Working knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, Cassandra, and BigQuery. ● Experience building and operating CDC pipelines with Debezium. Infrastructure & Tooling ● Infrastructure as Code using Terraform (required). ● Configuration and automation using Ansible/Chef (preferred). ● CI/CD integration with Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions. Observability & Reliability ● Metrics and alerting: PMM, Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager. ● Tracing/APM: Datadog, New Relic, OpenTelemetry. ● Incident management experience (PagerDuty or equivalent). Nice to Have ● Experience with managed database services (AWS RDS/Aurora, MongoDB Atlas, BigQuery). ● Exposure to DevSecOps and cloud security. ● Experience operating high‐traffic, consumer‐facing systems. ● Relevant certifications (MongoDB Certified DBA, Oracle MySQL DBA, MSSQL certifications). ● Strong written communication (design docs, RFCs, runbooks). What Success Looks Like at Lenskart ● Databases that are reliable, scalable, and boring in production. ● Faster delivery with fewer incidents. ● Strong developer trust in the data platform. ● Systems that scale seamlessly with business growth. Why Lenskart ● Real‐world scale with tangible customer impact. ● Strong engineering ownership and autonomy. ● Opportunity to shape data platforms used across the company. ● A culture that values craft, clarity, and engineering excellence.

jobs.title: Plant IT support executive
jobs.text: Role Summary The IT Support Engineer will be responsible for providing end-to-end technical support for all plant-level IT systems including production floor equipment, hardware, network infrastructure, shop-floor applications, and user devices. They will ensure high system uptime, timely troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and adherence to IT standards, while supporting day-to- day operations critical to manufacturing continuity. Key Responsibilities Technical Support - Provide first-line and second-line support for desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, handhelds, PLC-connected systems, and production terminals. - Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network issues raised by plant users. - Install, configure, and maintain Windows OS, industrial applications, and security software. - Manufacturing Systems & Applications - Support MES, SCADA/HMI interfaces, SAP/ERP access, and shop-floor automation devices. - Troubleshoot connectivity between OT (Operational Technology) and IT systems. - Coordinate installation, updates, and patching for plant-critical applications. Network and Infrastructure - Manage LAN/WAN connectivity, Wi-Fi access points, switches, CCTV monitoring, access control systems, and IP telephony. - Coordinate with central IT for firewall policies and network security. Maintenance & Compliance - Perform periodic preventive maintenance across plant systems. - Maintain asset inventory, AMC records, and compliance documentation. - Support IT audits, data backup, antivirus deployment, and patch compliance. User Support & Training - Provide technical guidance to employees on system usage, safety, and best practices. - Conduct basic training sessions for plant and office staff. Vendor & Stakeholder Coordination - Liaise with vendors for equipment servicing, component replacement, and AMC. - Work with cross-functional teams (production, maintenance, quality) to ensure smooth operations. Required Skills and Competencies - Strong knowledge of Windows OS, Active Directory, user management. - Basic understanding of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs). - Experience supporting manufacturing environments, OT/IT integration (preferred). - Hands-on exposure to industrial peripherals, barcode systems, production terminals. - Familiarity with CCTV, access control, printers, handheld devices. - Good analytical and troubleshooting capabilities. - Ability to prioritize and resolve issues under time pressure. Qualifications - Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or related field. - 2 to 5 years of IT support experience, preferably in a manufacturing plant. - Certifications such as CompTIA A+, N+, CCNA, or Microsoft MCP are a plus.
