jobs.title: Marketing Lead
jobs.text: This is a high-impact, founder-proximate leadership role focused on one thing: taking Lenskart from a well-known eyewear company to an iconic global brand. You will be the architect responsible for transforming how the world perceives, talks about, and emotionally connects with Lenskart moving us from category leader to cultural phenomenon. Your mission is to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI-powered marketing and exponential global brand growth. You will define and deliver the system that ensures we show up with the right story, in the right format, in the right culture, at the right moment maximising brand love, customer acquisition, and revenue impact across every market we operate in. Lenskart is already a $1 billion revenue company. 2,500+ stores across India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Japan, and the US. 40M+ customers. A vertically integrated, tech-first model that designs, manufactures, and delivers eyewear end-to-end. Now we're going after the next 10x. This role is based in Thailand and owns brand and marketing strategy across all Lenskart markets globally India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Japan, and the US. 🔑 Core Mandate: Brand Transformation & Business Growth 1. Build a Cult Global Brand (The Builder's Focus) Brand Visionary: Own the strategic vision and execution for taking Lenskart from a known eyewear brand to an iconic, cult brand one that creates virality, drives style statements, and makes eyewear a fashion-first category globally. Portfolio Architecture: Define and evolve brand positioning for Lenskart and its portfolio brands (John Jacobs, Aqualens) across every market we operate in ensuring local cultural resonance without sacrificing global brand coherence. Cultural Ownership: Build a brand that doesn't just sell eyewear but owns the conversation around vision, style, and self-expression for the next billion consumers globally. 2. Social-First, Culture-First Content Engine (The Distribution Focus) Platform-Native Creative: Build and scale a content engine natively built for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and whatever platform emerges next, across every market. No repurposed TV ads. No committee-approved creative. Creator Ecosystem: Build creator and influencer ecosystems across every market from mega-influencers to nano-creators, from artists to athletes with a programmatic, data-driven approach to partnerships. Community-Led Growth: Make Lenskart a brand that Gen Z and Millennials don't just buy from they talk about, create with, remix, and feel part of, in every geography. 3. AI-Powered Marketing 10x Faster, 10x Smarter (The Leverage Focus) Non-Negotiable: This is not a role for someone who is "exploring AI." You will leverage AI better than anyone else in the industry and build a marketing function where AI is the operating system, not a tool. AI Creative Engine: Deploy generative AI to produce content at a scale and speed no traditional team can match dynamic creative variants, AI-generated ad copy, personalised visual assets, and simultaneous multi-market campaign launches. Intelligent Targeting & Personalisation: Build AI-powered audience segmentation, predictive targeting, and real-time personalisation systems across markets. AI-Driven Performance Systems: Implement automated bidding strategies, AI-generated creative optimisation loops, and LLM-powered campaign intelligence that continuously learns and improves ROAS without manual intervention. Tech-Enabled Marketing Stack: Own the architecture of a world-class marketing tech stack CDP, AI-native attribution, experimentation platforms, virtual try-on, computer vision for product discovery all wired to a single source of truth. Force Multiplier Mindset: We are not building a 200-person marketing department. We are building a lean, AI-powered marketing machine that operates at the output of one many times its size. 4. Numbers-Driven Performance & Growth (The Business Focus) Marketing P&L Ownership: Own the full marketing P&L and business plan across all markets. You're not just a creative leader you're accountable for CAC, LTV, ROAS, and incrementality across every channel and geography. Experimentation at Scale: Drive a relentless test-and-learn culture. We expect 100+ experiments a quarter, not 10. Omnichannel Integration: Drive integrated online-to-offline marketing that bridges digital channels with 2,500+ physical stores globally, creating a seamless consumer journey from first impression to in-store conversion. 5. Multi-Country Playbook & Global Scale (The Global Focus) Localised GTM: Develop localised go-to-market strategies for each market while maintaining a unified global brand playbook. What works in India won't copy-paste to Dubai, Bangkok, or Tokyo and you get that intuitively. Global Remit, Regional Base: Based in Thailand, you'll set and drive brand strategy across India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Japan, and the US with Southeast Asia as a natural anchor market given your location, while carrying full accountability across the global portfolio. New Product & Category Launches: Own the marketing engine for new product introductions across all markets from category creation moments to viral launch campaigns. The Essentials Experience: 10+ years in marketing, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership role at a high-growth D2C or consumer-tech brand. You've scaled at least one iconic brand something that went viral, became a style statement, and captured cultural attention. AI & Technical Fluency: You've built or managed an AI-native marketing stack. Not experimented with AI for copy actually deployed AI systems at scale for creative, targeting, or personalisation. Multi-Country Track Record: Multi-country experience is non-negotiable. You've led marketing across at least 2–3 international markets and understand the nuance of cultural adaptation vs. global consistency. Experience across Southeast Asia specifically is a strong plus. Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field or equivalent exceptional experience. jobs.title: Buying Planning & Merchandise Lead
jobs.text: About Lenskart Lenskart is a tech-led, omni-channel eyewear company with a growing footprint across India and international markets. We operate an integrated value chain across design, manufacturing, retail, and e-commerce. Role Overview The Buying Planning & Merchandise Lead will own the flow of merchandise from vendor to warehouse across all categories and regions. The role is anchored in demand forecasting, OTB, vendor capacity planning, and lead-time reduction — ensuring the right quantity of the right product reaches the right warehouse at the right time, at the right cost. Key Responsibilities Demand Forecasting Own global demand forecasting across categories, channels, and regions. Drive forecast accuracy through structured S&OP cycles, sell-through analysis, and seasonality modelling. Translate top-down financial plans and bottom-up category plans into a single, executable demand view. OTB & Buying Planning Own the Open-to-Buy (OTB) process — building, tracking, and re-forecasting through the season. Manage inflow planning, phasing, and depth-vs-breadth decisions in line with sales, stock, and margin targets. Partner with the buying and category teams to convert assortment plans into actionable buy quantities. Vendor Capacity Planning Lead capacity planning with the vendor base — aligning monthly and weekly production capacity with the demand plan. Work with sourcing and manufacturing partners to lock capacity ahead of peak periods and manage flex during demand swings. Build visibility into vendor performance on capacity, on-time delivery, and fill rates. Lead-Time Reduction & Inflow Drive reduction of lead times across the vendor-to-warehouse cycle through better planning rhythm, order release discipline, and vendor collaboration. Improve PO-to-receipt timelines, in-transit visibility, and warehouse inbound predictability. Work with logistics and warehousing teams to smooth inflow and reduce bullwhip across the network. Inventory & Allocation Own inventory health across warehouses — turns, cover, ageing, and excess. Drive allocation and replenishment models that maintain availability with controlled markdowns. Collaboration & Leadership Work closely with Buying, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Logistics, Retail, E-commerce, and Finance. Build and lead a strong planning and merch supply chain team. Key Requirements Relevant experience in demand planning, merchandise planning, OTB, or merchandise supply chain roles. Strong grounding in demand forecasting, OTB, vendor capacity planning, and lead-time management. Commercial understanding of inventory turns, fill rates, markdowns, and working capital. Hands-on with planning and analytics tools (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, or equivalent). Experience working with vendor networks and cross-functional supply chain teams. Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, data-led environment. Why Join Lenskart Own the end-to-end merchandise flow from vendor to warehouse at scale. Operate at the intersection of planning, supply chain, and commercial strategy. Work in a data-led, digitally native environment with international scope.

jobs.title: Android/ iOS - Tech Lead
jobs.text: The Role We are looking for a hands-on Tech Lead to own our Android and iOS app platforms end-to-end, along with the Java-based middleware layer that powers them. You will lead a pod of engineers, work closely with Product, Design, Analytics and Business, and be accountable for both how fast we ship and how reliably the platform runs. This is a technical leadership role, not a purely managerial one: you will still reason about code, architecture and trade-offs, set technical direction, and step in on the hardest problems yourself What You Will Own • Mobile platforms: architecture, release management, performance and stability for both the Android and iOS applications . • Backend & middleware: the Java middleware layer between the apps and core services, handling millions of requests a day with high availability. • Engineering leadership: technical decision-making, code and architecture reviews, hiring, mentoring and delivery for your pod. • Release & reliability: release processes, feature rollout safety, observability and the platform's overall reliability posture. • Scale & expansion: enabling new brand and new market launches on the existing codebase without forking it. What You Will Do • Set and drive the technical roadmap for the mobile platforms and the middleware, balancing feature delivery against platform and tech-debt investment. • Lead a team of engineers across mobile and backend, owning hiring, mentoring, performance and day-to-day delivery. • Make and defend architecture decisions, including what ships in the binary versus what is configured dynamically from the server. • Own release safety across app stores feature flags, staged rollout, kill switches and lead incident response when things break in production. • Keep Android and iOS at feature parity without duplicating every effort, and keep both platforms fast, stable and within crash and performance budgets. • Partner with Product and Business to connect technical work to measurable outcomes, and to launch new brands and markets on the existing platform. What We Are Looking For • Significant hands-on experience owning production Android and iOS applications at scale, with genuine depth in at least one and strong command of the other. • Strong backend engineering ability in Java, including designing services for high availability, handling partial failures, caching correctly in e-commerce paths and managing API versioning for users who cannot be force-upgraded. • A track record of leading engineering teams — setting technical direction, hiring well, handling underperformance, and negotiating scope and timelines credibly with Product. • Practical debugging depth: the ability to diagnose cold-start regressions, ANRs, memory leaks, retain cycles and production incidents using real tooling, not just describe them. • Sound judgment on trade-offs migrations, server-driven configuration, multi-brand and multi-region architecture — with clear reasoning about cost and risk. • Experience with high-scale consumer e-commerce or similarly demanding mobile products is strongly preferred. Why Join Us You will own the technology behind how millions of customers experience Lenskart, at a company scaling aggressively across India and internationally. The work is high-ownership and high-impact: your decisions directly shape platform reliability, delivery speed and the company's ability to enter new markets. also hiring manager said

jobs.title: Research Leader
jobs.text: Retail is at a pivotal point, approaching the singularity we envisioned earlier. The convergence of AI, real-time visibility, autonomous operations, and composable commerce is fundamentally reshaping how retailers compete. This isn't incremental disruption; it is a transformation so complete that traditional retail models will become obsolete. Retailers who understand and navigate this inflection will dominate. Those who don't will disappear. You will author the definitive book on this moment. No other work comprehensively addresses retail singularity with the rigor and insight this book demands. It will be the authoritative resource for retail executives and technology leaders navigating this critical transition. While you author this seminal work, you'll simultaneously drive Litmus7's thought leadership, research, and market intelligence strategy. You'll lead a research team, establish proprietary POVs, and generate market insights that fuel sales opportunities. This is a business-critical, multi-dimensional leadership role. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES • Author the Retail Singularity Book: Own intellectual vision, research methodology, and primary authorship. Conduct 40–60 primary interviews with retail C-suite and technology leaders. Deliver publication-ready manuscript with original insights, rigorous sourcing, and compelling narrative. • Sales Enablement & Market Intelligence: Translate research into actionable market insights that directly fuel Litmus7's sales pipeline. Identify emerging opportunities where we can pitch, compete, and differentiate. Provide sales teams with competitive positioning, customer intelligence, and market context that wins deals. • Lead Research Team: Build and manage a team of 3–5 researchers and analysts. Set priorities, establish methodologies, mentor talent. Drive quality, productivity, and intellectual rigor. • Deal Intelligence: Analyze customer engagements, RFPs, and competitive wins/losses. Synthesize into organizational learning. Identify gaps and market opportunities Litmus7 should exploit. Support major deals with research-backed due diligence. • Establish Proprietary POVs: Build 4–6 proprietary points of view on critical retail transformation topics. Author 8–12 thought leadership articles annually for LinkedIn, Forbes Tech Council, industry publications. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Research & Book Authorship • Design and execute multi-modal research: primary interviews, market data analysis, competitive intelligence, trend forecasting, scenario development. • Conduct strategic interviews with retail C-suite (CIOs, CMOs, COOs, CEOs) and technology leaders. Uncover competitive intent, technology investments, business imperatives. • Write publication-ready prose across formats: book chapters, articles, white papers, market briefs. • Create compelling case studies, examples, and frameworks that illuminate complex concepts. Maintain editorial schedules; coordinate with editors and publishers. Sales & Business Impact • Support Quarterly Business Reviews with market insights that can lead to farming opportunities. • Develop market context decks, competitive summaries, battle cards. Support RFP responses and customer engagements with research-backed positioning. Team & Stakeholder • Recruit, onboard, mentor and develop research team members. Establish clear expectations and growth paths. Conduct regular 1-on-1s, performance reviews, career development conversations. • Set research priorities and assign projects. Monitor progress and quality. Provide mentoring and feedback. Foster culture of intellectual rigor. Mandatory Qualifications • Postgraduate in engineering/business/economics with 10–12 years of specialized experience in retail technology research at tier-1 analyst firms. • Deep retail domain expertise: Genuine understanding of retail operations. Know what drives retail technology decisions. Should have spent at least 8-9 years in analyzing the Retail industry. • Writing at scale: Published reports, white papers, monographs, or articles demonstrating analytical depth and publication-ready quality. • Primary research mastery: Design methodologies, recruit and conduct interviews, analyze qualitative data, draw defensible conclusions, transparently address limitations. • C-suite credibility: Engage senior executives as a peer advisor. Conduct strategic interviews that uncover authentic business imperatives. • Sales acumen: Understand how research translates into business opportunities. Experience supporting sales teams and identifying market gaps. • Team leadership: Experience managing or mentoring research teams, analysts, or junior consultants. Demonstrated ability to develop talent and drive quality. • Research rigor: Multi-modal research design. Comfort with ambiguity. Systematically form and test hypotheses. Synthesize disparate data into coherent narratives. Rigor in fact-checking, citation accuracy, quality assurance. • Communication excellence: Publication-ready writing across formats. Articulate speaking. Explain sophisticated concepts accessibly without sacrificing accuracy or nuance. • Collaboration & independence: Work productively with sales, marketing, practice leads without ceding intellectual independence. Transparent about research process and findings. Report honestly even if findings challenge organizational preferences. • Intellectual humility: Willing to update thinking based on evidence. Acknowledge complexity and counterarguments. Resist false certainty. #LI-AC1

jobs.text: Role Overview We are looking for a detail-oriented Fund Accounting Analyst to manage custody operations, reconciliations, fund accounting, client transactions, and operational reporting for our Portfolio Management Services. Key Responsibilities Custody & Reconciliation Monitor daily custodian feeds for trades, holdings, and cash movements. Perform daily reconciliation of securities, cash balances, corporate actions, and fund movements. Resolve reconciliation breaks with custodians, brokers, and counterparties. Ensure timely trade settlements and smooth fund flows. Fund Accounting Validate daily NAV, MTM valuations, expense accruals, and corporate action accounting. Reconcile broker trades, custodian positions, cash balances, and collateral balances. Review brokerage, management fees, statutory charges, and other expense allocations. Investigate discrepancies, perform root cause analysis, and ensure timely closure. Operations & Reporting Process client transactions including top-ups, withdrawals, and strategy switches. Prepare client reports, operational MIS, and regulatory reports. Maintain operational SOPs and drive continuous process improvements. Skills & Qualifications Graduate/Postgraduate in Finance, Commerce, or related field. 2 - 5 years of experience in PMS, AIF, Custodian, Fund Accounting, Mutual Funds, or Capital Market Operations. Strong understanding of custody operations, reconciliations, settlements, and fund accounting. Should be well-versed with Wealth Spectrum Excellent MS Excel skills; experience with fund accounting or portfolio management systems is preferred. Strong analytical ability, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Client Onboarding Analyst
jobs.text: Role Overview We are looking for a detail-oriented Account Opening & Client Onboarding Analyst to manage the end-to-end onboarding process for Portfolio Management Services (PMS) clients, AIFs, ensuring timely account activation, regulatory compliance, and a seamless onboarding experience. Key Responsibilities Client Onboarding & Account Opening Manage end-to-end account opening for PMS investors (Individual, HUF, Corporate, NRI, Trust). Coordinate with Investors, Relationship Managers, and distributors for KYC, CML, FATCA, and onboarding documentation. Review account opening forms for completeness, accuracy, and regulatory compliance. Liaise with custodians, depositories, and internal teams for account setup and strategy allocation. Track onboarding progress and provide regular status updates to stakeholders. Ensure timely activation of investment accounts and resolve onboarding-related queries. Documentation & Compliance Verify investor documentation in line with SEBI, KYC, and AML guidelines. Maintain accurate onboarding records and client documentation. Coordinate with Compliance for any documentation or regulatory clarifications. Ensure adherence to internal SOPs and onboarding timelines. Process Management Maintain onboarding trackers and MIS reports. Identify process bottlenecks and recommend improvements to enhance client experience. Support automation and digitization initiatives within onboarding processes. Skills & Qualifications Graduate/Postgraduate in Finance, Commerce, or related field. 0–2 years of experience in PMS, AIF, Mutual Funds, Custodian, Broking, or Financial Services Operations. Strong understanding of Individual, HUF, NRI, Trust, and Corporate account opening processes. Knowledge of KYC, CML, FATCA, and regulatory documentation. Proficiency in MS Excel. Strong communication, coordination, and organizational skills.

jobs.title: Senior Quantitative Data Engineer
jobs.text: About the Role We are seeking a Senior Quantitative Data Engineer to support and enhance our automated trading infrastructure. You will work closely with researchers, traders, and execution teams to build reliable data pipelines, automate workflows, investigate production issues, and ensure the availability and quality of data powering our live trading systems. This role provides exposure to quantitative research, trading operations, and large-scale financial datasets. You will own critical systems end-to-end and drive improvements in reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency. Responsibilities Data Engineering & Platform Ownership Design, develop, and maintain robust data pipelines and ETL workflows. Build tools for data onboarding, validation, reconciliation, and monitoring. Drive automation to eliminate manual operational processes. Work with large structured and time-series datasets using Python and modern data libraries. Optimize database schemas, storage, and data access patterns. Data Quality & Quantitative Research Support Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of datasets used in research and live trading. Develop automated data quality checks and anomaly detection frameworks. Support researchers in cleaning, enriching, and featurizing datasets. Investigate and resolve discrepancies across multiple data sources. Production Support & Incident Management Own and proactively monitor production data pipelines and critical trading processes. Perform root-cause analysis and implement long-term preventive solutions. Troubleshoot issues involving APIs, brokers, exchanges, and third-party data vendors. Ensure high availability and reliability of mission-critical systems. Participate in production support during market hours and respond to time-sensitive issues. Architecture & Process Improvement Drive improvements in data infrastructure, scalability, and operational efficiency. Establish best practices for monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability. Design fault-tolerant and maintainable systems. Improve deployment and release processes. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with quantitative researchers, traders, and software engineers to deliver reliable solutions. Coordinate with external vendors, brokers, exchanges, and data providers. Document systems, workflows, and operational procedures. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical excellence across the team. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Quantitative Engineering, or Data Operations. Strong Python programming skills and experience with Pandas, Polars, NumPy, and PyArrow. Expertise in SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL) and database design. Strong Linux and shell scripting skills. Experience designing and maintaining ETL and data processing pipelines. Excellent debugging and root-cause analysis skills. Experience working in production environments with high reliability requirements. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, live trading environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience with financial datasets, market data, and corporate actions. Knowledge of equity, futures, and options markets. Experience with Bloomberg, Refinitiv, NSE/BSE, or exchange data. Familiarity with Redis/KeyDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery, or other messaging systems. Experience with Parquet and columnar data formats. Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/GCP). Experience with monitoring and observability tools. Nice-to-Have Experience with FastAPI and REST APIs. Familiarity with ClickHouse or time-series databases. Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines. Knowledge of distributed systems and multiprocessing. Exposure to quantitative trading systems and research workflows. What You'll Get Opportunity to work on mission-critical automated trading systems. High ownership and autonomy. Exposure to quantitative research and live trading operations. Fast-paced environment with direct impact on business outcomes. Opportunity to mentor others and shape the evolution of the firm's data infrastructure.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer — Low-Latency Trading Systems (Python)
jobs.text: About the Role We are a proprietary trading and market-making firm operating across global markets, executing strategies that depend on fast, reliable decision-making and execution. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and optimize the Python-based systems that power our trading operations — from market data processing and order execution to risk and monitoring. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building high-performance, production-grade Python systems for a latency-sensitive trading environment. You'll work closely with quantitative researchers, traders, and infrastructure engineers to keep our systems fast, reliable, and competitive. What You'll Do Design, build, and maintain trading infrastructure in Python, including market data handlers, order execution logic, and strategy runners Optimize Python code paths for low latency and high throughput using techniques such as asyncio, multiprocessing, vectorization (NumPy), and just-in-time compilation (Cython, Numba, or similar) Build and maintain tooling for research-to-production workflows, enabling quants to move strategies into live trading quickly and safely Develop and improve simulation, backtesting, and replay frameworks to validate strategy and infrastructure changes Build robust monitoring, alerting, logging, and risk-control systems for live trading Profile production systems to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks Collaborate with quant researchers to understand strategy logic and ensure efficient, correct production implementations Participate in incident response and on-call rotation for production trading systems Conduct code reviews, mentor junior engineers, and help shape engineering standards and practices Continuously evaluate new tools, libraries, and techniques relevant to high-performance Python systems What We're Looking For 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time spent on performance-sensitive or production trading systems Expert-level Python, including deep familiarity with the asyncio ecosystem, concurrency/parallelism patterns, and performance profiling Experience writing performant Python using NumPy/pandas, and optimizing hot paths with Cython, Numba, or similar tools Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/UDP, multicast) and how they affect latency in trading systems Experience with exchange connectivity or market data protocols (e.g., FIX, WebSocket APIs, REST APIs, proprietary feeds) Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and systems-level performance optimization Comfortable working in a fast-paced, low-latency production environment with high accountability Experience with profiling and performance analysis tools (cProfile, py-spy, line_profiler) Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field (or equivalent experience) Nice to Have Prior experience at an HFT, market-making, or proprietary trading firm Experience interfacing Python with C/C++ extensions (pybind11, ctypes, Cython) Experience with high-performance messaging systems (ZeroMQ, Kafka, Redis pub/sub) Exposure to colocation environments, bare-metal infrastructure, and network tuning Familiarity with futures, options, equities, or crypto market microstructure

jobs.text: About the Role We are looking for a dynamic Associate – Investor Relations to engage with prospective investors, convert qualified leads into clients, and build long-term investor relationships. Achieve monthly and quarterly acquisition and revenue targets. Provide regular updates and reports on lead pipeline and conversion performance. Requirements Bachelor's degree in any discipline. 1–3 years of experience in Sales, Wealth Management, Financial Services, Investor Relations, or Business Development. Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Experience in handling client calls and lead conversions. Familiarity with CRM tools and Microsoft Office. jobs.title: Solution Engineer
jobs.text: About Signeasy Contracts run businesses. We are unlocking the intelligence inside them. Signeasy began fifteen years ago with a simple idea. Signing should be effortless. That idea helped the world go paperless. But signatures were only the beginning. Today, contracts define revenue, risk, compliance, and growth. Yet in most companies, they remain scattered across systems, frozen in PDFs, and forgotten after execution. We believe contracts are one of the most valuable and most neglected data assets in a business. 2025 marked our inflection point. While others continued to treat contracts as paperwork, we started turning them into livinxqg, searchable, intelligent systems of record. We shipped over 250 product releases, achieved 21 CFR Part 11 compliance, and built the foundation for Intelligent Contract Management. 2026 will be our biggest year yet. With the launch of Intelligent Contract Management, we are going to market with an AI-powered contract management platform built for modern teams who expect more than storage, signatures, or status quo software. This is the moment. And this is the team building it. If you want to help shape the future of contracts with us, please read on. About the role This is a front row seat to revenue. As a Solutions Engineer at Signeasy, you will work at the intersection of sales, onboarding, expansion, product, and engineering. You will help win deals, deliver customer value, and unlock growth through deeper use cases and feature adoption. This is not a demo only role. You will be hands-on with real customer environments, troubleshooting complex workflows, building simple technical solutions, and finding practical workarounds that keep momentum moving. If seeing deals close, customers go live, and accounts expand gives you a thrill, this role is built for you. You will support all markets and work a global shift from 4 pm to 1 am IST. This timing is intentionally designed to ensure strong overlap with our Product, Engineering, and Go To Market teams, enabling faster decisions, tighter collaboration, and better customer outcomes. What you will do Support sales and win revenue Partner closely with Account Executives to own the technical solution strategy during evaluations and proof of concepts Design engaging, credible solution approaches that align Signeasy’s platform to real business needs and simplify complex ideas Identify risks early, troubleshoot issues quickly, and propose workarounds that unblock deals Maintain a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors, and how to position Signeasy in relation to them Onboard customers and drive time to value Support technical onboarding and early implementations for new customers Help customers configure workflows, integrations, and data models Build simple scripts, API based workflows, or configurations to meet customer-specific requirements Ensure smooth handoffs from sales to customer success with strong technical documentation Drive expansion and product impact Support advanced use cases, new team rollouts, and expansion opportunities Partner with Customer Success on renewals and upsells with strong technical credibility Capture customer feedback, technical gaps, and feature requests and translate them into clear input for Product and Engineering AI first expectations At Signeasy, AI is core to how we build and how we work. As a Solutions Engineer, you are expected to actively use AI to accelerate problem solving, solution design, and execution. This includes using AI tools to prototype workflows, troubleshoot issues, explore integrations, and identify smarter ways to deliver value to customers. Experience building or experimenting with AI powered workflows, automations, or agents is strongly preferred. Curiosity and comfort with learning fast matters as much as prior exposure. What we are looking for Minimum 4+ years of customer-facing experience in a Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or technical consulting role Strong technical foundation with SaaS platforms, APIs, and cloud-based systems Hands-on experience in testing and integrating API-based solutions, working with REST APIs, JSON payloads, webhooks, and API testing tools such as Postman (or equivalent) Ability to independently build simple technical solutions to unblock customer use cases and experience using AI-native tools for rapid prototyping (e.g., Claude, Cursor). Experience in troubleshooting integrations and complex workflows across multiple systems Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly Comfort operating in ambiguity with a bias toward action Motivation to work close to revenue and customer outcomes Willingness to work a global shift from 5 pm to 2 am IST Nice to have Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, experience using LLMs and AI-native IDEs for rapid prototyping (e.g., Claude, Cursor). Experience with contract management, document automation, or workflow platforms Exposure to regulated industries such as healthcare, pharma, or financial services Experience supporting mid market sales motions Why this role matters You will see the full arc of revenue, from first conversation to expansion. You will influence deal success, customer confidence, and long term growth. You will work on an AI native platform at a defining moment in its journey and have real ownership from day one. If you are ambitious, technically curious, and energized by impact, this role will accelerate your career fast. Why work with Signeasy: Signeasy values Accountability, Respect, Integrity, Growth Mindset, and Trust. We operate as a smaller, close-knit, and nimble team. We are opinionated but collaborative. We disagree but commit to a mutual decision. We are modern but do not follow trends blindly. We are easy to work with, but we believe in having difficult conversations. We ask many questions, but try to experiment and fail fast. We are deeply empathetic towards our customers, our colleagues, and ourselves. We are the EasyTribe, and we highly recommend you ask enough questions about our culture and see if there is a job-human connection that can make this a fascinating experience for you and us at Signeasy. Our people are our most significant assets. You will be working alongside some of the smartest, most humble people across the globe who come from diverse backgrounds and have unparalleled experiences. We are a remote-friendly organization that believes in hybrid workplace flexibility, a mix of in-person collaboration at the office, and focused work from home. Meet Signeasy's leadership and core team: https://rb.gy/ftyfkw Read our origin story: https://rb.gy/azsda0 Take a peek at Signeasy's culture: https://rb.gy/nvra6o/ Learn more about growth at Signeasy: https://signeasy.com/jobs/ Signeasy is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Prepare techno-commercial comparisons and recommend the most suitable sourcing options. Ensure timely procurement and delivery of goods and services aligned with business requirements. Manage contracts, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), software renewals, and commercial documentation. Monitor vendor performance against agreed KPIs and SLAs. Stakeholder Management Partner with HR, IT, Finance, Admin, Marketing, and other business functions to understand procurement requirements. Provide timely updates on sourcing activities, delivery schedules, and procurement status. Ensure stakeholder satisfaction through effective coordination and service delivery. Support budgeting and procurement planning initiatives. Cost Optimization & Process Excellence Identify opportunities for cost savings, supplier consolidation, and procurement efficiencies. Track and optimize spend across indirect procurement categories. Support implementation of procurement best practices and process improvements. Maintain procurement records, vendor databases, and sourcing documentation. Generate procurement reports and spend analysis for management reviews. Requirements Must Have Strong negotiation and commercial acumen. Experience in category management and strategic sourcing. Good communication and stakeholder management skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Knowledge of contract management and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Familiarity with ERP and procurement tools such as SAP or similar platforms. Ability to manage multiple procurement categories simultaneously. Continuous learning and improvement. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment. Collaboration across functions to drive business outcomes. Why Join Us? At Unbox Robotics, procurement is more than purchasing—it is about building strategic partnerships that enable innovation, operational excellence, and business growth. As a Procurement Executive – Indirect Sourcing, you will play a key role in optimizing spend, strengthening supplier relationships, and ensuring the organization has the resources it needs to build the future of warehouse automation. jobs.title: Solution Design Engineer
jobs.text: Solution Design Engineer (Mechanical) Solutioning Team | Pune, India | In Campus About Unbox Robotics Unbox Robotics builds the world’s most compact, AI-powered mobile robotic sorting and order consolidation systems for warehouses and distribution centers — installing 10X faster, saving 50%+ space, and delivering 3X productivity gains. Backed by marquee investors, we’re scaling our Solutioning team with strong hardware and domain expertise. The Role You will be the hardware backbone of the Solutioning team — translating customer operational requirements into deployable sorting and order consolidation solutions. From defining product specifications and releasing BOMs to planning site layouts and questioning operational processes for optimization, you will own the hardware decision-making that bridges engineering capability with real-world warehouse constraints. Key Responsibilities Design end-to-end solution layouts for parcel sorting and order consolidation systems tailored to customer warehouse environments. Lead BOM (Bill of Materials) — validate component selection, cost optimization, lead times, and vendor alternatives for every solution proposal. Define and refine product specifications by deeply understanding the robotic platform’s mechanical discovery — question existing sorting/consolidation workflows, identify bottlenecks, and propose optimized process designs that leverage robotic capabilities. Create 2D CAD layouts (AutoCAD/SolidEdgelectrical, and electronics subsystems (drives, sensors, power distribution, charging systems, conveyor interfaces). Plan detailed site layouts in collaboration with customers — robot zones, charging stations, induction/discharge points, conveyor routing, buffer areas, and operator workstations etc.. Assess site civil and structural readiness: flooring type, flatness, load-bearing capacity, floor coatings, expansion joints, ramp gradients, and ceiling clearances. Conduct operational process e) and 3D renderings to communicate solution designs to customers and internal teams. Collaborate with Mechanical, Electronics, and Production teams to ensure solution designs are manufacturable, serviceable, and field-deployable. Support Sales and BD with technical sizing, throughput calculations, ROI models, and solution proposals during customer engagements. Run simulations to validate throughput, robot fleet sizing, and system performance against customer SLAs. Requirements B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related engineering discipline. 2–5 years in solution design, product engineering, systems engineering, or industrial/warehouse automation. Strong understanding of mechanical and electrical/electronics systems — motors, sensors, power systems, wiring, enclosures, and safety standards. Proficiency in 2D CAD (AutoCAD) and/or 3D CAD (SolidEdge, SolidWorks) for layout and product design. Hands-on experience with BOM creation, review, and cost analysis across electromechanical assemblies. Ability to read and assess civil/structural drawings, flooring specifications, and site infrastructure readiness. Strong analytical skills for throughput modeling, fleet sizing, and operational process optimization. Excellent communication skills to lead customer workshops, present technical solutions, and drive cross-team alignment. Good to Have Experience with robotic systems, AGVs/AMRs, or conveyor-based automation in warehouse/logistics environments. Exposure to simulation tools (FlexSim, AnyLogic, or similar) for material flow and throughput analysis. Understanding of industrial safety standards (CE, UL, ISO 12100) and electrical compliance (IEC 60204). Familiarity with PLC/SCADA systems and industrial communication protocols (Modbus, Profinet, EtherCAT). Knowledge of warehousing operations: sorting methodologies, wave planning, order consolidation strategies, and SLA frameworks. Prior experience working directly with customer operations and facility teams on-site. We Value A questioning mindset — you challenge assumptions in ops processes and push for better solutions. Strong ownership and end-to-end accountability from concept to deployment. Comfort with ambiguity and fast iteration in a start-up environment. Hands-on attitude — willingness to visit sites, get on the warehouse floor, and validate designs in the real world. Location Pune, India (In Campus) Experience 2–5 Years Compensation Competitive Salary Ready to build the future of warehouse robotics? Apply now!

jobs.text: IT Admin — Function Lead Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India | Work: HQ, Pune | Department: Information Technology | Reporting : CTO | Experience: 8+ years (including team / function leadership) About Unbox Robotics Unbox Robotics builds cutting-edge robotics and automation that is transforming warehousing and logistics. Our systems help some of the fastest-growing supply chains move faster, sort smarter, and scale without limits. As our team and infrastructure grow, reliable and secure IT is foundational to everything we ship — and that is exactly where this role comes in. Role Purpose The IT Admin Function Lead owns and governs IT administration across the organization and all its locations. You will be accountable for reliable, secure, and standardized IT services — end-user systems, servers, endpoints, access, and IT operations — and for the processes, documentation, and controls that keep them audit-ready as the company scales. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role. You will set the standard for how IT administration runs at Unbox: lead and grow the IT Administration team, enforce SOPs and least-privilege access, drive full traceability of changes, and coordinate closely with the Security and Networking / Infrastructure functions. Key Responsibilities 1. IT Administration & Operations Management Own and govern day-to-day IT administration activities across all locations. Ensure the availability and performance of end-user systems, servers, and IT services. Define and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all IT administration tasks. Coordinate with vendors for IT support, licensing, and service delivery. 2. User, Endpoint & Device Management Govern user provisioning and de-provisioning, and set the standard for employee onboarding and offboarding end to end. Define endpoint configuration standards for laptops, desktops, and peripherals. Oversee OS builds, patching, EDR/antivirus deployment, and system hardening. Manage the fleet through MDM / UEM tools such as Jamf, Microsoft Intune, and ManageEngine . Ensure asset tagging, lifecycle management, and disposal compliance. 3. Access Control & Privilege Management Govern administrative access and enforce least-privilege principles across systems. Ensure privileged access is granted only with proper approval and documentation. Run a Privileged Access Management (PAM) program and coordinate with Security on access reviews and audits. Maintain accurate records of admin access, temporary permissions, and approvals. 4. Infrastructure & Application Support Coordinate with infrastructure and networking teams on server, storage, and network dependencies. Ensure availability and support for business applications and internal tools. Manage application installations through approved, controlled processes. Oversee endpoint and application licensing compliance. 5. IT Service Management & Reporting Ensure all IT activity is tracked through ITSM tickets, email trails, and documentation — no ad-hoc or undocumented work. Monitor SLAs and ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests. Maintain daily and weekly status reporting for management review. Keep full traceability across every change and request. 6. Security, Audit & Compliance Maintain audit-ready documentation for IT administration, and support internal and external audits (IT, security, compliance). Drive closure of audit points and corrective actions within defined timelines. Keep IT policies, SOPs, and checklists current. Coordinate with the security team and specialist vendors across DLP, web security (Zero Trust / SSE), Web Application Firewall (WAF), cloud security, server & endpoint backup, and continuous threat exposure management (red teaming). 7. Team Leadership & Coordination Lead and mentor the IT Administration team; assign clear ownership, timelines, and reporting. Review team performance and uphold professional, disciplined work practices. Act as the escalation point for complex IT administration issues. Coordinate closely with the Cyber Security and Networking / Infrastructure leads. 8. Business Continuity & Improvement Support business continuity planning (BCP) and disaster-recovery activities. Identify gaps in IT administration processes and drive continuous improvement. Recommend automation and standardization to improve efficiency and strengthen security posture. Key Accountabilities Stable and secure IT administration operations. Zero undocumented changes or access. Timely incident and request resolution within SLA. Accurate, timely reporting to management. Audit-compliant IT administration processes. Requirements Must Have 8+ years in IT Administration, System Administration, or IT Operations, including 2+ years leading a team or function. Strong Windows and Linux administration. Endpoint management and patching at scale, with hands-on experience across MDM / UEM (Jamf, Microsoft Intune, or ManageEngine) and EDR/antivirus. IT asset management, and application and license management. Hands-on experience with ITSM tools and ticketing systems, and SLA-driven service delivery. Identity and access governance across Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace and SaaS tools, including privileged access management. Proven vendor and stakeholder management. Strong documentation, process discipline, and audit-readiness. Clear leadership, coordination, reporting, and escalation skills. Good to Have ITIL certification and relevant system or security certifications (e.g., Microsoft, Jamf, CompTIA). Experience standing up and scaling IT in a startup, high-growth, or multi-entity (India + overseas) environment. Experience supporting audits in a regulated, high-governance, or pre-IPO context. Exposure to security tooling — DLP, Zero Trust / SSE, WAF, cloud security, PAM, and CTEM / red-teaming programs. Scripting or automation for IT operations. Qualification Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field. Tools & Environment You'll Govern You will own (and coordinate with the Security and Networking functions and specialist vendors on) a modern IT and security stack, including: Device & endpoint: MDM / UEM (Jamf, Intune, ManageEngine), endpoint security / EDR, antivirus, and patch management. Identity & access: Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace, SaaS access management, MFA, and Privileged Access Management (PAM). Service & operations: ITSM / ticketing, infrastructure monitoring and alerting, and server & endpoint backup. Data & network security: Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Web Security (Zero Trust / SSE), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and cloud security. Assurance: continuous threat exposure management / red teaming. Workplace: meeting-room AV and conferencing — screens, cameras, wireless presentation, and room scheduling for Teams, Zoom, Google Meet, and Webex. What We Value Ownership and accountability — leading by example. A strong customer-service mindset across the organization. Process and documentation discipline, and a bias for traceability. Proactive, pragmatic problem-solving. Raising the bar on IT reliability and security posture. Adaptability in a fast-paced environment, and a habit of continuous improvement. Why Join Us? Technology is at the core of everything we do. As the IT Admin Function Lead, you will own and shape the IT backbone that keeps every team productive and secure — and build the standards, controls, and team that let it scale as Unbox enters its next phase of growth. Your work will directly underpin the reliability, security, and governance of the entire organization.

jobs.text: We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst who can bridge the gap between business stakeholders and engineering teams. Prioritize requirements and manage product backlogs in collaboration with stakeholders. Facilitate sprint planning, backlog grooming, UAT, and release planning. Validate delivered features against business requirements and acceptance criteria. Perform gap analysis, impact analysis, and feasibility assessments. Analyze business processes and recommend improvements through automation and digital transformation. Monitor product performance using analytics and recommend enhancements based on user behavior and business metrics. Support change management, implementation, and user adoption. Stay updated with emerging technologies including AI, automation, cloud platforms, blockchain (where applicable), and modern software development practices. Experience working with distributed or international teams Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. 5–7 years of experience as a Business Analyst in software development or IT services. Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile/Scrum methodologies. Hands-on experience preparing: BRD FRD SRS User Stories Acceptance Criteria Use Cases Process Flow Diagrams Wireframes UML Diagrams Experience with requirement gathering, stakeholder management, and client communication. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize effectively. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.text: Roles and Responsibilities: Oversee the entire lifecycle of AI/ML features, ensuring their successful implementation, scalability, and maintenance. Implement key machine learning strategies across the business and collaborate with stakeholders for effective delivery. Coordinate end-to-end delivery of AI-driven projects, working closely with cross-functional teams including data engineering, product, and DevOps. Stay up-to-date with the latest AI/ML and Generative AI research, frameworks, and tools to contribute to continuous innovation. Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for AI and data science solutions. Develop and maintain APIs and microservices for integrating AI models with other business systems and products. Perform model testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting to ensure accuracy, reliability, and efficiency in production environments. Design, build, and deploy Generative AI components (e.g., large language models, text/image generation, summarization tools) to enhance product capabilities. Leverage frameworks such as LangChain, Hugging Face, and OpenAI APIs to integrate LLM-based features into existing workflows and systems. Experiment with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, and prompt engineering techniques to improve model outputs. Collaborate with cloud and DevOps teams to implement MLOps pipelines for continuous integration, delivery, and monitoring of AI models. Provide technical support and knowledge transfer to clients and internal teams, ensuring smooth adoption of AI technologies. Contribute to AI governance and ethical considerations for responsible AI usage. Mentor junior engineers and foster a culture of experimentation and learning in advanced AI areas, including Generative AI. Qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in designing, developing, and deploying AI/ML solutions. Strong understanding of AI/ML algorithms, deep learning architectures, and frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenCV, and Scikit-learn. Proficient in Python and experienced with frameworks like LangChain, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Hugging Face. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, and Azure, and familiarity with managed AI/ML services (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI). Expertise in Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision, and model deployment workflows. Hands-on experience developing and deploying Generative AI applications, including LLMs, diffusion models, and transformer-based architectures. Familiar with vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma) and embedding-based retrieval systems. Experience with MLOps practices, including CI/CD, model versioning, monitoring, and scaling. Knowledge of Big Data platforms such as Apache Kafka, Hadoop, and Snowflake, and experience using PySpark and Databricks for data engineering tasks. Strong software engineering background with a focus on clean, efficient, and maintainable code. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Familiarity with Generative AI frameworks and APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or Stability AI is an advantage. Experience with distributed systems and model optimization is a plus. Ability to work independently, communicate effectively with clients, and mentor junior team members. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, and innovation-driven environment. jobs.text: Title: UI/UX Analyst, D2C Product Reports To: Lead D2C Location: Mumbai (Work from Office) Who we are and Why we exist At The Whole Truth, our mission is to ‘re-build the world’s trust in its food’. About The Role As UI/UX Analyst, you'll diagnose friction, design better user experiences, and validate improvements through data. You're not a pure designer. You're not a pure analyst. You're the bridge – using session recordings, heatmaps, and funnel data to identify why customers drop off, and designing solutions to test. Key Responsibilities Session recording analysis - watch session recordings 2–3x/week to spot friction and user behavior patterns UX friction diagnosis – combine session data, heatmaps, and GA4 to build a prioritized list of improvements A/B test variant design – sketch solutions in Figma based on your findings; collaborate with the product and design teams on testing strategy Design system maintenance — collaborate with the design strategy team to document components and ensure consistency across the website Insight reporting – weekly conversion updates to the team; monthly deep dives on major findings Tool evaluation – research and recommend new UX testing tools (UserTesting, Maze, etc.) as you identify gaps in our workflow You'll collaborate closely with the product and engineering teams to drive user-centric improvements across the platform. Technical Capabilities Required Design Tools & Prototyping: Figma proficiency (non-negotiable) – component-based design, design systems, interactive prototypes Ability to create A/B test variants quickly and hand off clean specs to engineering Understanding of mobile-first design Analytics & Data Tools( good to have): GA4 –funnel visualization, event tracking, custom reports (not deep SQL, but comfortable navigating the tool) Session recording tools – session recording, heatmaps, and user behavior identification Ability to interpret data and translate findings into design improvements Basic statistical thinking (correlation vs. causation, sample size matters) Platform & E-Commerce Context: Familiarity of e-commerce platforms – enough to know what's possible and what's a technical constraint Familiarity with conversion funnel – browse → add-to-cart → checkout → payment → confirmation Tools You Can Learn & Suggest: You're encouraged to research and recommend new tools that fit your workflow – UserTesting, Maze, Hotjar, Pendo , etc. You should stay current on UX testing and session recording tools Functional Capabilities Required Conversion Psychology: Understand micro-interactions that drive decision-making (button color, copy, social proof, urgency) Know how to reduce friction (form fields, payment options, trust signals) Apply JTBD (Jobs to Be Done) thinking – what job is the customer hiring this product for? UX Research & Data Literacy: Can read a session recording and identify 3–5 UX issues Can spot patterns in heatmap data (click clusters, scroll depth, attention areas) Comfortable asking "why" – always validate assumptions with data before designing A/B Testing & Iteration: Design test variants based on hypothesis, not guesswork Understand statistical rigor (sample size, test duration, confidence levels) Iterate based on results – learn from losses, compound wins Communication & Collaboration: Sketch ideas quickly in Figma and get feedback early Present findings to product and design teams in a structured way Comfortable with ambiguity — you'll be expected to own problems, not just execute specs Required Skills & Experience 2–3 years of UX/UI design or product analytics experience (agency, SaaS, e-commerce, or D2C preferred) Figma expertise - can create designs, components, and interactive prototypes; not a designer by training, but by fluency Conversion psychology – understand how small UX changes impact user behavior Data literacy – comfortable with GA4 funnels, segment analysis, and session recording tools Mobile-first thinking – design for phones first, then desktop India D2C context – nice-to-have but not mandatory. Understanding of Indian customer behavior, payment methods, and logistics is valuable Written communication — can document findings clearly and present to non-designers Request you to share the assignment link while applying. Assignment: Task 1 Description: Audit The Whole Truth Foods' website (thewholetruthfoods.com), specifically the product browse → add-to-cart → checkout flow . Identify 4-5 friction points or UX issues that could impact conversion rate. For 2 of these issues, design a proposed improvement in Figma or any free design tool (Penpot, Excalidraw, Figma free tier). Include a written analysis explaining: What friction you identified (and why it matters) How you'd measure the impact of your proposed change Hypothesis for what conversion lift you'd expect Task 2 Description: Your GA4 shows that 42% of users land on the homepage, but only 18% click into a category page. Of those who do, only 8% complete a purchase. Heatmap data shows the category navigation menu has low click-through - users instead using the search bar. Session recordings reveal users are confused about the difference between similar products (e.g., Whey Protein vs. Plant Protein, or different protein bar flavors). The exit rate on category pages is 35%." Candidate's Task: Diagnose the issue – Write 150–200 words on why category navigation is underperforming and how it impacts the funnel (consider: information overload, product differentiation, filtering options, trust signals) Propose 3 design/UX changes — Could include: improved category page layout, better filtering, comparison tools, simplified navigation, product badge/labeling, etc. Design 1 variant – Redesigned category page or navigation menu in Figma/free tool Testing & insights plan – How would you test? What secondary metrics matter (e.g., time on category page, filter usage, comparison tool clicks)? Note : Please attach the assignment link in the assignment submission tab mentioned in the application form

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative  Lead

jobs.title: Merchant Offers Operations Executive
jobs.text: About Xoxoday Xoxoday is a global rewards, incentives, and loyalty platform helping enterprises engage employees, customers, and channel partners through rewards, recognition, incentives, and loyalty programs. With a presence across multiple geographies and a diverse rewards marketplace, Xoxoday powers reward experiences for thousands of enterprises globally. Our marketplace spans Gift Vouchers, Merchant Offers, Merchandise, Mobile Top-ups, Airmiles, Flights, Hotels, Lounge Access, Experiences, Charity, Prepaid Cards, Sports & Events, and other digital and lifestyle rewards across multiple countries. About the Role We are looking for a Merchant Offers Operations Executive to support our Merchant Partnerships team in delivering high-quality merchant-funded offer programs across India, UAE, and Southeast Asia. This role is the operational backbone of the Merchant Offers team, ensuring seamless execution of merchant onboarding, offer launches, catalog quality, client deliverables, reporting, and operational governance. You will work closely with Partnerships Managers, Product, Engineering, Operations, Growth, Client Success, and supplier partners to ensure offers are launched accurately, delivered on time, and maintained to the highest quality standards. This is not a traditional operations role. We are building an AI-first Merchant Operations function and are looking for someone who enjoys automating repetitive work, improving operational processes, leveraging AI tools, and building scalable workflows that enhance team productivity. Key Responsibilities 1. Merchant Offer Operations Support Partnerships Managers in onboarding and launching merchant-funded offers across multiple markets. Upload and maintain merchant offers, campaign information, images, terms & conditions, redemption instructions, and offer mechanics across internal platforms. Coordinate with merchants and internal stakeholders to collect onboarding documents and operational information. Maintain offer catalogs by updating expired, modified, or seasonal campaigns. Ensure timely execution of offer launches, renewals, and campaign updates. 2. Catalog Quality & Validation Perform detailed quality checks before and after merchant offer launches. Validate offer content, pricing, eligibility, campaign validity, merchant information, categories, locations, redemption channels, and offer mechanics. Ensure marketplace content complies with internal quality standards and client requirements. Identify and resolve duplicate, inaccurate, or incomplete offer listings. Maintain quality checklists, SOPs, and validation processes. 3. Client Deliveries & Marketplace Support Prepare customized merchant offer catalogs for enterprise clients and banking partners. Support client-specific offer requests, campaign documentation, and operational deliverables. Coordinate with Client Success teams to ensure timely delivery of merchant offers. Track client requests and delivery timelines while maintaining defined SLAs. Assist in resolving operational issues and client-reported content discrepancies. 4. Reporting & Business Operations Maintain merchant onboarding trackers, campaign trackers, and operational dashboards. Generate daily, weekly, and monthly reports covering onboarding progress, offer launches, merchant coverage, campaign performance, and operational KPIs. Support Partnerships Managers with merchant performance reports and business reviews. Analyze operational data to identify bottlenecks, quality issues, and improvement opportunities. Ensure accuracy and consistency of operational data across systems. 5. AI & Process Automation Identify repetitive operational activities that can be automated. Leverage AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and similar platforms to improve operational productivity. Build AI-assisted workflows for report generation, spreadsheet management, content validation, documentation, and routine operational tasks. Support implementation of workflow automation initiatives using no-code and low-code platforms. Continuously explore emerging AI tools to improve team efficiency and reduce manual effort. 6. Operational Governance Maintain documentation for merchant onboarding, offer launches, approvals, and campaign execution. Ensure compliance with internal operational processes and governance standards. Coordinate issue tracking and follow-ups with internal stakeholders. Support audit activities and maintain operational documentation. Monitor SLA adherence and operational turnaround times. 7. Cross-Functional Coordination Work closely with Partnerships Managers to support merchant onboarding and campaign execution. Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Operations, Growth, and Client Success teams for timely delivery. Follow up with merchants and internal stakeholders to ensure timely completion of operational activities. Support process improvement initiatives across the Merchant Offers function. Required Skills & Competencies Marketplace Operations Strong understanding of operations, marketplace management, catalog operations, sales operations, merchant operations, or business operations. Excellent attention to detail with a strong quality-first mindset. Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Reporting & Data Management Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets. Comfortable working with large datasets, CSV files, and operational trackers. Strong analytical and reporting skills. Ability to prepare dashboards, operational reports, and business summaries. AI & Automation Strong interest in AI and operational automation. Hands-on experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, or Perplexity. Familiarity with Google Apps Script, APIs, Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar automation platforms is an advantage. Ability to identify automation opportunities and improve operational efficiency. Communication & Collaboration Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple stakeholders across functions. High ownership and execution-oriented mindset. Strong follow-up and stakeholder management capabilities. Experience & Qualifications 2–4 years of experience in Marketplace Operations, Merchant Operations, Business Operations, Sales Operations, Catalog Operations, Program Management, or similar roles. Experience supporting merchant onboarding, offer management, or marketplace operations is preferred. Experience in loyalty, rewards, fintech, banking, travel, e-commerce, or digital commerce businesses is an added advantage. Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Engineering, Operations, or a related field. What Success Looks Like Accurate and timely onboarding of merchant partners and offer campaigns. 99%+ accuracy in merchant offer uploads and marketplace content. Consistent adherence to client delivery and campaign launch SLAs. High-quality reporting with accurate operational insights. Significant reduction in manual operational effort through AI and automation. Faster turnaround times for merchant onboarding and offer launches. Strong operational support enabling Partnerships Managers to focus on merchant acquisition and commercial growth. Contribution towards building a scalable, AI-powered Merchant Offers Operations function. Why Join Xoxoday? Be part of one of the world's fastest-growing rewards and loyalty marketplaces. Work with leading merchants, banks, card networks, and enterprise clients across multiple countries. Gain exposure to global merchant-funded offer programs and marketplace operations. Learn and implement cutting-edge AI tools and workflow automation technologies. Collaborate with experienced partnerships, product, and operations leaders. Enjoy high ownership, continuous learning, and excellent career growth opportunities within a rapidly scaling global organization.

jobs.title: Senior Manager – Business & Commercial Intelligence
jobs.text: About the Role Xoxoday processes millions of transactions every year — across APIs, digital gift cards, rewards, payments, ecommerce storefronts, and global merchant partners. This role owns the intelligence layer behind that scale: making sure pricing, margins, catalog data, payment flows, settlement, and transaction success rates stay accurate, healthy, and continuously improving. This is not a reporting or dashboard role. You'll work directly with Product, Finance, and the CXO office to catch issues before customers do, and turn data into measurable business outcomes. What You'll Own Transaction Intelligence Understand the complete lifecycle of every transaction type on the platform — API orders, ecommerce storefront orders, gift cards, rewards redemption, payment gateway transactions, refunds, cancellations, settlement, and vendor fulfilment. Identify where and why transactions fail, and drive fixes. Commerce Analytics Continuously monitor transaction success rates, payment failures, and performance by vendor, merchant, category, country, currency, and partner. Convert patterns into insights that improve customer experience and profitability. Pricing & Margin Intelligence Own commercial visibility across the catalog — merchant margins, pricing inconsistencies, discount leakage, FX impact, and profitability trends. Recommend pricing and sourcing improvements. Revenue Assurance Track down revenue leakage from incorrect pricing, wrong commissions, settlement issues, catalog errors, data inconsistencies, workflow gaps, system defects, or operational misses — and stay on each issue with Product and Finance until it's permanently closed. Catalog Intelligence Keep the catalog commercially healthy: flag incorrect pricing, duplicate SKUs, invalid denominations, expired products, incorrect tax treatment, currency mismatches, and merchant onboarding gaps. Business Controls Build validations across critical transaction journeys to proactively catch anomalies, fraud patterns, margin erosion, vendor issues, and customer-impacting defects. AI-driven Analytics Use AI to detect anomalies, surface hidden trends, automate repetitive analysis, and accelerate investigations — building monitoring that scales beyond manual review. What We're Looking For 4–10 years in FinTech, Ecommerce, Payments, or Marketplace businesses Strong grasp of transaction-heavy platforms and commercial mechanics Comfortable working with millions of transaction records Genuinely curious — the kind of person who can't leave an unexplained metric alone Able to translate data into product and operational action, not just insight Strong SQL and Excel; Python is a plus Experience with BI tools like Looker, Tableau, or Power BI Hands-on with modern AI tools for analytics and productivity You'll Love This Role If You Enjoy finding hidden revenue leakage Like solving complex, ambiguous business puzzles Get satisfaction from improving margins through data Want to understand how commerce systems work end-to-end Prefer working directly with Product Heads, Finance, and leadership Would rather drive action than produce reports What Success Looks Like in Year One End-to-end visibility across the transaction lifecycle Measurable improvement in transaction success rates Fewer pricing and catalog errors Stronger payment and settlement controls Identified and eliminated revenue leakage Improved merchant profitability Automated monitoring in place for key commerce health metrics Recognized as the go-to source for commercial insight across the org

jobs.title: Catalog Quality & AI Automation Manager
