This is not a traditional catalog operations role. At Xoxoday, we are building an AI-first Marketplace Operations function and are looking for someone who can leverage AI tools, automation platforms, and emerging technologies to transform how catalog quality is managed at scale. The ideal candidate is someone who constantly experiments with AI tools, automation workflows, and operational efficiencies. You should be equally comfortable conducting quality audits, analyzing large datasets, building AI-powered workflows, and collaborating with product and engineering teams to automate quality assurance processes. You will work closely with Category Managers, Supplier Partners, Product, Engineering, Operations, Growth, and Client Success teams to ensure world-class catalog quality across global markets. Key Responsibilities 1. Catalog Quality Ownership & Governance Own end-to-end catalog quality across all marketplace categories globally. Define and maintain catalog quality standards, SOPs, governance frameworks, and audit mechanisms. Establish quality benchmarks across Product Names, Product Descriptions, Images, Pricing & Denominations, Redemption Instructions, Terms & Conditions Etc Ensure consistency and quality across all supplier catalogs and geographies. Drive continuous improvement in catalog quality KPIs. 2. Catalog Audits & Quality Control Lead periodic catalog audits across Gift Vouchers, Merchandise, Top-ups, Airmiles, Flights, Hotels, Lounge Access, Experiences, and other marketplace categories. Identify and resolve Content inaccuracies, Incorrect category mappings, Pricing discrepancies, Missing product information, Duplicate products Etc Conduct pre-launch and post-launch quality reviews for all new products and suppliers. Build quality scorecards and audit frameworks for suppliers and categories. Ensure timely closure of catalog issues through cross-functional collaboration. 3. AI-Powered Catalog Automation Drive Xoxoday's AI-first approach to catalog quality management. Identify repetitive manual tasks and automate them using AI and workflow automation platforms. Design and implement scalable AI-powered catalog validation systems. Leverage tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini Etc Build automated workflows for: Product Naming Validation Description Quality Checks Terms & Conditions Verification Taxonomy Mapping Etc Continuously evaluate new AI technologies and implement solutions that improve efficiency and quality. 4. Taxonomy & Catalog Architecture Own category hierarchy, taxonomy standards, metadata governance, and catalog structure. Ensure standardization across global supplier catalogs. Define category mapping frameworks and naming conventions. Improve product discoverability through better taxonomy design. Collaborate with Product teams to enhance marketplace search, filtering, and navigation experiences. 5. Supplier Onboarding & Quality Validation Establish quality validation processes for all supplier onboarding activities. Review supplier catalogs before launch to ensure compliance with marketplace standards. Work with Category Managers and supplier teams to resolve onboarding issues. Develop onboarding playbooks, templates, and quality checklists. Ensure suppliers meet content and operational quality requirements. 6. Process Excellence & Automation Build scalable quality assurance processes that can support rapid marketplace growth. Partner with Product and Engineering teams to automate quality control workflows. Reduce manual effort through intelligent automation initiatives. Define and monitor operational SLAs related to catalog quality and issue resolution. Create internal quality management frameworks and best practices. 7. Data Analytics & Reporting Build and maintain catalog health dashboards and quality KPIs. Analyze quality trends, issue patterns, supplier performance, and operational bottlenecks. Generate actionable insights to improve catalog quality and customer experience. Present quality reviews and improvement recommendations to leadership teams. Measure automation impact and quality improvement outcomes. 8. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Category Managers to ensure category readiness and catalog health. Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to implement automation and quality improvements. Work with Operations and Client Success teams to resolve customer-facing catalog issues. Support Growth and Sales teams with accurate marketplace content and product information. Act as the central owner of catalog governance and quality across the organization. Required Skills & Competencies Catalog & Marketplace Expertise Strong understanding of catalog management, marketplace operations, quality assurance, e-commerce operations, or product operations. Experience managing large-scale product catalogs and supplier ecosystems. Strong understanding of taxonomy management, product content, metadata, and catalog governance. AI & Automation Expertise Strong passion for AI, automation, and operational excellence. Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, Perplexity etc Strong prompt engineering and AI workflow design capabilities. Ability to rapidly prototype and deploy automation solutions with minimal engineering dependency. Familiarity with APIs, CSV processing, Google Sheets automation, data validation workflows, and no-code/low-code platforms. Analytical & Problem Solving Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, root causes, and process gaps. Data-driven decision-making capabilities. Excellent attention to detail and quality-focused mindset. Stakeholder Management Strong communication and presentation skills. Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across business, product, engineering, and operations teams. Proven ability to drive projects independently in a fast-paced environment. Experience & Qualifications 5–6 years of experience in Catalog Management, Marketplace Operations, Product Operations, Quality Assurance, E-commerce Operations, or related functions. Experience managing large product catalogs and supplier ecosystems. Exposure to categories such as Gift Cards, Merchandise, Travel, Hospitality, Top-ups, Airmiles, Loyalty, Experiences, or Digital Commerce is preferred. Experience working across multiple international markets is an added advantage. Prior experience in loyalty, rewards, fintech, travel-tech, e-commerce, or marketplace businesses is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience using AI tools to improve operational efficiency, quality, or scalability is strongly preferred. What Success Looks Like Industry-leading catalog quality across all marketplace categories. 60%+ reduction in manual catalog review effort through AI and automation. Significant reduction in customer-facing catalog issues and operational escalations. Faster supplier onboarding and catalog launch timelines. Automated quality validation across major marketplace categories. High accuracy, consistency, and completeness of product information globally. Strong governance and standardization across categories and geographies. Establishment of Xoxoday as an AI-first marketplace operations organization. Contribution towards making Xoxoday's marketplace the most trusted rewards and loyalty marketplace globally. Why Join Xoxoday? Opportunity to lead quality and automation for one of the world's fastest-growing rewards marketplaces. Build AI-powered operational systems from the ground up. Work with cutting-edge AI tools and automation technologies. Collaborate with global suppliers, category leaders, and product teams. High ownership, visibility, and growth opportunities.

jobs.title: Sales & GTM Analyst
jobs.text: About Xoxoday Xoxoday is a global SaaS company building the infrastructure for people-first workplaces. Xoxoday serves thousands of businesses worldwide, from growth-stage startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, across HR, sales, and marketing functions. Empuls is Xoxoday’s employee engagement product. It helps companies build a culture of recognition and belonging — through peer-to-peer appreciation, milestone celebrations, rewards, surveys, and more. What sets Empuls apart is its own global rewards catalog: not a reseller, but a builder. From France and Germany to Canada, the US, Singapore, Australia, India, and 100+ other markets, every employee gets the same quality of recognition experience — fulfilled locally, in local currency, on one unified workflow. Automated where it should be, human where it matters. About this role We’re looking for a sharp, execution-driven Junior Associate to work directly out of the Founder’s Office, supporting the US go-to-market motion for Empuls. You’ll sit at the intersection of outreach, pipeline hygiene, and operational coordination — making sure nothing slips through the cracks as the US team scales. This is a high-visibility, high-accountability role. You’ll operate from the founding team’s handles, engage directly with prospects, and keep the sales engine running smoothly behind the scenes. What you’ll do Run consistent, high-quality outreach on behalf of the Founder via email and LinkedIn — owning the cadence and ensuring no prospect falls through without a proper follow-up. Monitor and track pipeline movement alongside the US sales team, flagging stalled deals and resolving blockers proactively. Maintain HubSpot hygiene — logging activities, cleaning records, and ensuring data accuracy across the pipeline. Conduct targeted data research to identify and enrich prospect lists for the US GTM motion. Collate and organise marketing resources, enablement materials, and campaign assets for the US team. Coordinate with internal stakeholders — the Founder, Pranshu Sharma, the US team, and external prospects — to keep execution on track. Why this role matters The US is one of Empuls’s most critical growth markets, and this role sits right at the centre of that push. The Founder’s Office is where strategy meets execution — and without tight outreach discipline, clean pipeline data, and sharp coordination, opportunities stall and momentum is lost. This role isn’t administrative support. It is the connective tissue between the Founder’s vision, the sales team’s pipeline, and the prospects we’re trying to win. You will directly influence how fast the US GTM machine moves, how many conversations turn into qualified opportunities, and how well the team operates under pressure. If you do this well, the impact is visible — to the Founder, to the US team, and to the business. What we’re looking for Must-haves Strong written communication skills — you write crisp, professional outreach that gets replies. Solid Excel skills — comfortable with data cleanup, lookups, and organising large datasets. 1–3 years of experience in a GTM, SDR, operations, or Founder’s Office environment. Ability to work the US-aligned shift (3 PM – 1 AM IST) consistently. High attention to detail and ownership mindset — things don’t fall through on your watch. Nice-to-haves Prior experience in a Founder’s Office or early-stage startup GTM role. Familiarity with HubSpot or any CRM tool. Exposure to US market outreach or US-based SDR workflows. Experience with data research tools (Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar). Qualifications Undergraduate degree in any discipline. What matters more: how you think, how you write, and how you get things done. Why join us At Xoxoday, you’re not a cog in a large machine. You’re close to the decision-makers, the product, and the customers from day one. Here’s what that means in practice: Front-row seat to scaling a global SaaS product in one of the most competitive markets in the world. Direct mentorship from the Founder — you’ll understand how a GTM motion is built, not just execute tasks within one. Work that ships. Ideas and improvements here move fast; there’s no six-month approval chain. A culture that rewards ownership. If you take something and run with it, you’ll be recognised for it — not just managed through it. Real exposure to global GTM — US outreach, international pipeline, and cross-functional collaboration across time zones. A product that genuinely makes people feel valued at work. That’s what Empuls does, and it’s what we try to practise internally too.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.text: About This Role We’re looking for a Project Manager to lead enterprise-scale project delivery for Xoxoday’s loyalty platform. This role exists to bring structure, governance, and predictable execution to complex customer programs involving multiple stakeholders and workstreams. You’ll operate as a senior individual contributor with a strong Project Manager mindset—owning planning, coordination, and delivery oversight rather than hands-on configuration. You’ll work closely with enterprise customers and internal teams to ensure loyalty programs are delivered reliably across both cloud and on-premise environments. What You’ll Do Enterprise Project Ownership Own end-to-end project management for enterprise loyalty programs from initiation through closure. Define project scope, plans, milestones, and dependencies across multiple teams. Ensure delivery commitments are met through disciplined execution and governance. Stakeholder & Customer Management Act as the primary project owner for enterprise customers during delivery. Drive structured communication with customer stakeholders, including regular status updates and alignment discussions. Manage risks, issues, and escalations to resolution while maintaining customer confidence. Project Management & Delivery Governance Establish and maintain project governance, reporting, and documentation standards. Track project health across timelines, scope, risks, and dependencies. Ensure adherence to agreed delivery processes and quality expectations. Cross-Functional Coordination Partner closely with Loyalife and Custom Storefront teams to align execution plans. Coordinate with internal product, engineering, and delivery teams across workstreams. Enable smooth handoffs and accountability across phases of delivery. Continuous Improvement Capture delivery learnings and contribute to improving project management practices. Support standardization of templates, workflows, and reporting mechanisms for enterprise delivery. What We’re Looking For 3+ years of experience in project management roles, operating in a Project Manager or enterprise delivery context. Strong experience delivering loyalty platforms for enterprise customers. Proven track record managing large, multi-stakeholder enterprise programs. Experience managing software delivery projects across cloud and on-premise deployments. Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in parallel. Strong communication skills with experience working with global clients. Experience in combination of technology service provider leading client projects Nice to Have Experience working with global enterprise customers across regions. Exposure to structured project management frameworks or governance models. What Makes You a Strong Fit You bring a project management-first mindset with a focus on planning, governance, and execution discipline. You’ve successfully delivered enterprise loyalty programs and understand their complexity. You communicate clearly, manage expectations effectively, and handle escalations calmly. You’re comfortable owning outcomes and driving alignment without direct authority. Why This Role Matters Enterprise loyalty programs are complex, high-visibility initiatives. This role ensures these programs are delivered with structure, predictability, and clarity—directly impacting customer trust, long-term relationships, and platform success. Why Join Us Lead high-impact enterprise loyalty programs. Work closely with experienced teams across delivery and product. Take ownership of complex, visible customer initiatives. Grow as a senior project management professional in a focused IC role. Be part of a team that values clarity, accountability, and execution.

jobs.text: Why Xogene? At Xogene, we’re revolutionizing the future of clinical trial transparency through AI-powered solutions. As we continue to expand, we are seeking a highly motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business growth within the pharmaceutical and biotech sectors. internal teams (e.g., product, delivery, client success) to ensure smooth handoff post-sale Maintain accurate pipeline tracking, forecasting, and reporting of sales activities Monitor industry trends, competitive landscape, and market dynamics to inform sales strategy Represent Xogene at industry conferences and events to build brand awareness and generate leads Interest in emerging technologies, including AI-driven solutions that improve efficiency, compliance, and decision-making in life sciences Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, life sciences, or related field preferred Minimum 2+ years of experience in direct sales or business development within software, cloud, or SaaS environments Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets, particularly in net-new business acquisition Experience selling into mid-market and enterprise pharmaceutical and biotech organizations is strongly preferred Strong ability to communicate, present, and influence stakeholders at all organizational levels, including executive leadership Demonstrated success managing complex, consultative sales cycles Excellent negotiation, presentation, and closing skills Strong verbal and written communication skills Self-starter with a results-driven mindset and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment What We Offer Mentorship from industry experts working at the intersection of AI technology and business strategy Clear career progression path with increasing responsibility as skills develop Exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies including LLMs and conversational systems Competitive compensation package including comprehensive benefits A results-oriented culture that values innovation, responsibility, and professional excellence Equal Opportunity Employer Xogene is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of any kind. All employment decisions at Xogene are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, gender identity, military service, or any other basis prohibited by federal, state or local law. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application process and to perform essential job functions. Please contact us to discuss any accommodation you think you may need. Location This is a New York City based role with an expectation of active engagement in-market, including networking, industry events, and relationship-building within the life sciences ecosystem. Compensation and Benefits The anticipated base salary range for this position is $70,000 – $90,000, depending on experience, skills, and demonstrated track record in enterprise SaaS sales. Competitive variable compensation based on experience and performance is also available for this role. jobs.title: Technical Project Manager-(CCAAS & Voice BOT Delivery)
jobs.text: About Exotel Exotel is the emerging market’s leading AI-powered Customer Engagement Platform, enabling enterprises to engage customers seamlessly across Voice, Messaging, Video, Contact Centre and Conversational AI. Trusted by over 6,000 businesses across 60+ countries—including Ola, Swiggy, Flipkart, HDFC Bank and Zomato—Exotel powers more than 50 million customer interactions every day. As enterprises increasingly adopt AI-first customer engagement solutions, Exotel is at the forefront of delivering highly scalable, secure and enterprise-grade deployments across Contact Centre, CPaaS and Conversational AI. Location: Bangalore or Gurgaon About the Role We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of complex enterprise implementations across Exotel’s Customer Engagement portfolio. You will operate as the single-threaded owner for customer deployments, driving projects from kickoff through production go-live, hypercare and operational handover. This is not a traditional project management role. You will be responsible for ensuring successful delivery of technically complex, integration-heavy implementations while maintaining governance across timelines, scope, risks, commercial milestones and customer expectations. Working closely with customers and cross-functional teams—including Sales, Pre-Sales, Solution Architecture, Product, Engineering, Support, Customer Success and Finance—you will ensure every deployment is delivered on time, within scope and to the highest quality standards. The ideal candidate combines strong project management discipline with technical aptitude, thrives in ambiguous environments, and has a proven ability to drive execution across multiple enterprise projects simultaneously. Key Responsibilities Program & Project Governance Own the complete project lifecycle for multiple concurrent enterprise implementations from project initiation through production handover. Build and maintain detailed project plans, milestones, RAID logs, dependency trackers and governance dashboards. Define and enforce stage gates and entry/exit criteria across Kickoff, Solution Design, Development, UAT, Go-Live, Hypercare and Handover. Drive regular governance reviews and provide accurate project health updates to customer and executive stakeholders. End-to-End Delivery Execution Lead enterprise implementations across Contact Centre, Voice, Conversational AI and customer engagement solutions. Drive execution against committed timelines while balancing scope, quality and customer expectations. Coordinate implementation activities across internal teams and external customer stakeholders to ensure timely project delivery. Ensure all commercial, technical and operational milestones are achieved before project closure. Customer & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary customer-facing delivery lead throughout the implementation lifecycle. Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers and manage communication across business and technical stakeholders. Lead project governance meetings, steering committees, technical workshops and executive status reviews. Communicate risks, dependencies and delivery updates with clarity and confidence. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate closely with Solution Architects, Engineering and Product teams to translate customer requirements into scalable technical solutions. Coordinate activities across Sales, Customer Success, Support and Finance to ensure smooth project execution. Build solution documentation, Low-Level Designs (LLDs), implementation plans and Scope of Work (SOW) documents. Drive alignment across teams to resolve blockers and accelerate project delivery. Technical Delivery & Enterprise Readiness Coordinate complex enterprise integrations involving REST APIs, Webhooks, CRM platforms (Salesforce, Zendesk, Freshdesk), authentication systems, databases and third-party applications. Manage enterprise deployment requirements including maintenance windows, change management processes and production readiness. Coordinate customer Information Security reviews, compliance questionnaires, architecture reviews and deployment approvals. Ensure customer environments are fully prepared for successful production deployments. Risk, Scope & Escalation Management Proactively identify project risks, technical challenges and execution bottlenecks before they impact delivery. Manage project scope through structured change management and prevent uncontrolled scope creep. Drive timely resolution of customer and internal escalations through effective stakeholder management. Maintain clear visibility into dependencies and ensure mitigation plans are actively tracked. UAT, Go-Live, Hypercare & Handover Own User Acceptance Testing (UAT) planning, execution and customer sign-offs. Coordinate production readiness assessments and Go-Live activities. Lead post-production hypercare until solution stabilisation. Ensure seamless transition to Customer Success and Support teams with complete operational documentation. Qualifications Experience 6–8 years of experience in Technical Project Management, Program Management or Enterprise Delivery. Proven experience delivering customer-facing enterprise software implementations in SaaS, CPaaS, CCaaS, Telecom or Cloud technology environments. Strong track record of managing multiple concurrent enterprise deployments. Technical Knowledge Good understanding of enterprise software implementations involving APIs, REST integrations, Webhooks and cloud-based applications. Working knowledge of Linux, networking fundamentals and SIP-based telephony is highly desirable. Familiarity with Voice infrastructure, RTP streams, codecs and enterprise communication platforms is a plus. Exposure to enterprise Information Security processes, SOC 2, architecture reviews and data privacy standards is desirable. Project Management Strong experience managing project plans, RAID logs, dependency tracking and governance frameworks. Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, Salesforce or similar project management tools. Ability to execute projects using Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery methodologies depending on customer requirements. Leadership & Communication Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and executive stakeholders. Strong stakeholder management, negotiation and conflict resolution skills. Demonstrated ability to drive outcomes in ambiguous, fast-paced and cross-functional environments. High ownership, accountability and bias for execution.

jobs.title: Senior Executive - Legal
jobs.text: Job Description: Senior Executive – Legal About Exotel Exotel is a leading full-stack customer engagement platform and business-focused virtual telecom provider. Founded in 2011, Exotel enables more than 25 billion customer conversations annually for over 7,000 businesses across voice, chat, bots and contact centres, serving customers in over 60 countries. To learn more, visit https://exotel.com . Role Details Designation: Senior Executive – Legal Location: Bengaluru Experience: 3–4 years of relevant post-qualification experience Role Overview The Senior Executive – Legal will support the Exotel Legal team on commercial contracting, technology contracts, product terms and conditions, contract standardization and business advisory. The role requires a lawyer with broad commercial-contracting experience who can draft and review agreements, identify material risks and work closely with business teams. The successful candidate should be comfortable working in a startup or high-growth environment, managing changing priorities and taking ownership of assigned matters. Key Responsibilities Commercial and Technology Contracts Draft, review and negotiate domestic and international commercial contracts, including master services agreements, SaaS and subscription agreements, service agreements, statements of work, order forms, non-disclosure agreements, addenda, reseller and partnership agreements, and procurement contracts. Independently handle standard and repeat transactions and support senior members of the Legal team on complex contracts and negotiations. Identify and escalate material legal and commercial risks in accordance with Exotel’s contracting standards, playbooks and approved positions. Assist in creating, standardizing and periodically revising agreement templates, clause libraries, negotiation playbooks and contracting guidance. Draft and update product and platform documentation, including online and clickwrap terms and conditions. Support contract execution, repository maintenance and other contracting workflows. Business and International Advisory Provide clear and practical contractual guidance to business stakeholders under the supervision of senior members of the Legal team, where required. Support cross-border contracts and coordinate with local counsel or external advisers where jurisdiction-specific advice is required. Conduct legal research and communicate findings in clear and concise language. Dispute Support Assist the Legal team, where required, with document collection, factual review and coordination relating to legal notices, contractual disputes or proceedings. Candidate Profile Mandatory Requirements LL.B. from a recognized university. 3–4 years of relevant post-qualification experience, with broad exposure to commercial contracts. Prior in-house experience in a startup or other high-growth environment. Experience drafting and reviewing commercial agreements, with the ability to independently handle standard contracts. Exposure to technology contracts, including SaaS, subscription, software, platform or technology-services agreements. Experience assisting with the creation or revision of contract templates, playbooks or online terms and conditions. Strong drafting, communication, organizational and legal-research skills. Preferred Requirements LL.M. or another relevant postgraduate legal qualification. Experience in a B2B technology, SaaS, telecommunications, CPaaS, CCaaS or services business. Exposure to international commercial contracts. Buy-side or procurement-contracting experience. Exposure to litigation, contractual disputes or external-counsel coordination. This is an added advantage and not a mandatory requirement.

jobs.title: Integration & Customisation Engineer (PHP + React.JS)
jobs.text: About Us Exotel is the emerging market’s leading full-stack customer engagement platform and business-focused virtual telecom operator. Trusted by 6,000+ companies across 60+ countries—including India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa—Exotel enables unified customer engagement for leading businesses such as Ola, Swiggy, Flipkart, GoJek, Byju’s, HDFC Bank, Zomato, and Urban Company. Our engineering solves infrastructure-level problems to ensure no one misses a call or an SMS, even in highly customized enterprise environments. We focus on building fault-tolerant, scalable, and real-time distributed systems that integrate seamlessly with complex enterprise ecosystems. Our stack is diverse—built on PHP, Python, Golang, and Node.js—and we emphasize clean abstractions and loosely coupled services. We leverage MySQL, NoSQL stores, Elasticsearch for discovery, and Grafana/Kibana for deep observability. We are firm believers in "You build it, you own it!"—operating a distributed system in a customization-heavy environment requires a true DevOps mindset. Roles & Responsibilities: As a Integration and Customization Engineer - 2, in the Professional Services team, you will be the technical anchor for complex ECC (Enterprise Contact Center) project customizations. Your role is a blend of deep engineering, architectural solutioning, and high-impact delivery. Engineering Excellence: Design and develop high-complexity customizations, integrations, and automation modules for large-scale enterprise customers. Technical Leadership: Independently deliver complex modules and take ownership of the end-to-end execution of internal projects. Mentorship: Guide and unblock L1 engineers, ensuring the team maintains high coding standards and best practices. System Ownership: Navigate and optimize forked, legacy, or complex codebases to ensure high performance and reliability. Stakeholder Management: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Infosec, and Customer-facing teams to translate enterprise requirements into executable technical roadmaps. Quality Assurance: Ensure uncompromising quality through rigorous code reviews, comprehensive test plans, and flawless deployment execution. Operational Health: Track and report engineering health metrics, ensuring that production incidents are minimized and resolution is swift. Must-haves 1–2 years of software engineering experience with a Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science. Advanced proficiency in PHP and expert knowledge of HTML, CSS, and React.JS Deep mastery of Data Structures, Algorithms (DSA), Concurrency, and Multithreading. Practical experience with 3-Tier and Microservices architectures, RESTful services, and HTTP protocols. Expert in SQL/NoSQL data modeling, caching layers, and building/deploying Linux-based applications. Understanding of TCP/IP networks and Linux OS configuration. A proven track record of taking end-to-end ownership of complex delivery cycles and production quality. Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while handling the maturity required for enterprise stakeholder interaction. General Skills Ability to translate deep technical hurdles into clear, actionable roadmaps for Product, Infosec, and enterprise clients. Mastery of the SDLC and project management tools like Jira/Confluence to ensure transparency and timeline alignment. Strong capability in creating technical diagrams, flowcharts, and project scope documents to maintain system clarity. Leadership: Proactive in unblocking peers and collaborating across cross-functional units (Development, Vendors, Partners). Good-to-haves Experience with GenAI technologies and their practical applications in enterprise workflows. Familiarity with visualization tools like Grafana and Kibana. Experience with cloud deployments (AWS/GCP/Azure) and a strong affinity for DevOps culture. Experience working in customization-heavy environments or managing "forked" codebases. What differentiates a successful candidate? The Average Candidate: Can write code to a specification but struggles when the documentation is missing, or the codebase is "messy." The A-Player: Sees a complex legacy codebase as a challenge to be mastered. They don't just fix bugs; they refactor for scale, mentor those around them, and anticipate enterprise needs before they become bottlenecks. They possess the technical depth to code and the maturity to navigate a high-pressure production environment. What success looks like (first 90 days) In this role, success is measured by your ability to move from code fluency to system-ownership. We expect high-impact contributions in two key areas: End-to-End Ownership of Complexity: Within 90 days, you will have taken full responsibility for the design, implementation, and production stabilization of a high-complexity enterprise customization. You aren't just writing code; you are operating with a "you build it, you own it" mindset, ensuring that your modules are fault-tolerant, scalable, and meet all engineering health metrics. Technical Leadership & Unblocking: You will be a recognized technical anchor who independently identifies and resolves architectural challenges within legacy or forked codebases. Success means you are effectively guiding L1 engineers through rigorous code reviews and test plans, while confidently managing technical trade-offs in discussions with enterprise stakeholders.

jobs.title: Lead - Business Operations
jobs.text: About Us Exotel is a customer conversation platform that believes in the power of exceptional customer experience. Our omnichannel contact center, Communication API suite, and Conversational AI come together to create a platform that delivers Connected Customer Conversations at unprecedented scale, speed, and ubiquity. We believe that customer experience is not just a number, but a feeling. That's why we're dedicated to helping businesses engage with their customers with greater trust, personalization, and empathy. With Exotel, you can listen to your customers, remember every conversation, and provide rich insights to create truly meaningful interactions. Exotel is the emerging market's leading full-stack platform and virtual telecom operator. Our cloud-based product suite drives 70+ million conversations every day for over 7100 businesses across India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. And with our recent license to offer cost-effective end-to-end VoIP telephony services, we're proud to be a 100% compliant cloud calling operator. 1. Role Summary Owns end-to-end procurement, commercial negotiation, and vendor governance for SaaS/software, AI/model infrastructure, and hardware/data-center procurement across the business. Acts as the single point of accountability for procurement strategy, contract structuring, and negotiation leverage — partnering with Legal, InfoSec, Finance, and Engineering to drive budget accountability, risk reduction, and measurable cost savings. Operates with full ownership: identifies the right products/vendors from minimal requirement input, structures the commercial approach, and closes it end-to-end within internal financial controls. 2. Key Responsibilities Identify vendors & lead commercial negotiations end-to-end for SaaS, AI Infra, IT/Infosec, Data Centre, Virtualization infra, SBC etc - securing rate reductions, improved payment terms, and SLA/warranty commitments - Including both capex and subscription SKU’s Structure RFPs across commitment terms and volume tiers to benchmark rate-vs-lock-in trade-offs; negotiate take-or-pay/minimum-commitment exposure, overage structures, and SLA/latency terms for real-time production workloads. Coordinate cross-functional MSA redlines with Legal, InfoSec, and Data Privacy through to signature. Identify and flag vendor risk (e.g., single-vendor concentration on security-critical tools, reseller stability, contract auto-renewal traps) and drive consolidation opportunities across the portfolio. Own vendor SLA and warranty due diligence — extracting binding RMA/DOA turnaround times, support escalation paths, and license-tier confirmations and PO release. Own Post-contract activities - License audit / true-up risk (SaaS) / consumption audits, Invoice vs contract reconciliation, Warranty/RMA claim ownership through resolution, Asset / entitlement inventory (SaaS seats, SBC capacity etc) Build and maintain a renewal tracker covering owner, cost center, PO status, renewal date, and savings realized and build budget vs. actuals, realized vs. negotiated savings, and forecast pipeline for leadership review 3. Skills & Behaviours Ability to translate minimal, ambiguous requirement input from a stakeholder into a shortlist of relevant products/vendors — asking the right clarifying questions rather than waiting for a fully-formed spec. SaaS commercial models: fluent in seat-based, usage-based, tiered, and committed-volume pricing; able to model total cost of ownership across renewal cycles. AMC / warranty / support constructs: working knowledge of AMC structuring, RMA, SLAs, escalation matrices, and license-tier mechanics for hardware and infrastructure contracts. Contract and legal literacy: comfortable reading and red-lining MSAs/SOWs for auto-renewal clauses, liability caps, indemnity, data protection, and termination-for-convenience terms — in coordination with Legal, not as a substitute for it. Cross-border commercial mechanics: working knowledge of TDS, gross-up, and DTAA implications on vendor payments. Financial control fluency: operates within, and helps strengthen, internal PO/procurement approval workflows, budget-vs-actuals tracking, and audit-ready documentation. High-stakes negotiation: holds firm and structured in high-value, high-pressure commercial discussions; separates positions from underlying interests; knows when to escalate vs. close. Ownership mindset: treats every renewal, RFP, and vendor risk as owned end-to-end — does not wait for direction to flag an issue, propose a structure, or drive a decision to closure. Process discipline with judgment: deploys the right level of process for the situation (full RFP vs. lightweight benchmarking) rather than applying a single template regardless of stakes. Cross-functional fluency: works simultaneously and credibly with Legal, Finance, InfoSec, Engineering, and CXO stakeholders, translating technical/legal detail into commercial trade-offs for leadership. Executive communication: presents budget-vs-actuals and savings narratives in a form senior leadership can act on directly, with weaknesses and risks flagged rather than smoothed over. Independent operating style: comfortable owning a high line-item volume as an individual contributor with direct senior leadership visibility, without needing a large team structure underneath. 4. Ideal Candidate Profile 2+ years in procurement, vendor management, or business operations, ideally in a technology/SaaS or telecom/CPaaS environment. Demonstrated experience independently owning commercial negotiations end-to-end — not just processing renewals, but structuring RFPs, running competitive benchmarks, and closing MSAs. Comfortable operating as an independent contributor across a high line-item volume with direct senior leadership visibility. Working knowledge of contract risk areas (auto-renewal, liability caps, SLAs) and cross-border commercial/tax mechanics (TDS, gross-up, DTAA) is a strong plus. Exposure to AI/ML vendor commercial models (usage-based, committed-volume, take-or-pay) is a differentiator given the growing AI vendor footprint. Excellent stakeholder management — able to work fluently with Legal, Finance, InfoSec, Engineering, and CXO stakeholders simultaneously.

jobs.title: AI Engineer - 2

What You Bring Must-have Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent. 5-8 years of software engineering experience. Proficiency in at least one backend language (Python, Java, Go, or similar). Ability to pick up new languages quickly; the language matters less than the engineering thinking behind it. Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, multi-threading, and concurrency. Good understanding of software engineering concepts : design patterns, modularity, scalability. Experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems : designing, building, and operating them. Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and async job-processing architectures. If you haven't worked with LLMs yet but have strong engineering fundamentals and a willingness to learn, that works too. Experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Team player, comfortable working across teams (product, data, infrastructure) in a fast-paced environment. Good-to-have Understanding of RAG patterns : embeddings, vector stores, retrieval strategies. Comfortable with Linux , shell scripting, and developing Linux-based applications. Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Kibana, Elasticsearch. Strong networking fundamentals : DNS, load balancing, proxies, firewalls. Experience with ASR/TTS engines : Whisper-family models, VAD, speaker diarization, alignment, and common failure modes. Experience working with audio pipelines: IP streaming, format handling, noise reduction, streaming vs. batch processing. Experience with graph databases and graph query languages. Familiarity with columnar analytics stores for large-scale analytical queries. Experience building multi-tenant SaaS with tenant isolation and per-tenant configuration. Exposure to LLM observability and cost tracking tooling. Experience self-hosting or fine-tuning open-weight models. How We Work You own it . Design, code, deploy, monitor. DevOps is a culture, not a separate team. You lead . Mentor and own the output of a team of 4-6 engineers. Code reviews, design reviews, and growing people are part of the job. You collaborate . You'll work closely with product, data, and platform teams. Good ideas win, regardless of where they come from. You stay curious . New models, tools, and techniques emerge constantly. We expect you to evaluate and benchmark; staying ahead is part of the role. Why Exotel Work on AI problems at real scale: billions of conversations, thousands of enterprise clients. High autonomy and ownership. Your decisions shape the product. A team that values engineering depth, not just shipping fast. Opportunity to work across the full AI stack: LLMs, speech, agents, infrastructure.

jobs.text: Product Manager 2 About Exotel Exotel is the emerging market’s leading full-stack customer engagement platform and business-focused virtual telecom operator. Incorporated in 2011, Exotel’s cloud-based product suite powers 50 million daily engagements across voice, video and messaging channels. Exotel powers unified customer engagement to over 6000 companies in 60+ countries, including India, SE Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Today, some of the fastest-growing companies in the emerging markets (Ola, Swiggy, Flipkart, GoJek, Urban Company, HDFC Bank, Zomato, Oyo, etc.) manage their customer engagement with Exotel’s suite of communication APIs, Ameyo’s omnichannel contact centre (merger), and Cogno AI‘s conversational AI platform (acquisition) over the cloud. We are a $100 million Series D funded company with $60 million in ARR. Role Overview As a Product Manager 2, you will own the media and channel transport infrastructure that powers every customer conversation flowing through Exotel — from a live voice call hitting a voicebot, to a customer DMing a brand on Instagram or WhatsApp. This is a deeply technical PM role sitting at the intersection of telephony infrastructure, real-time media, and digital messaging protocols. You will be the bridge between the CX/voicebot interface and the underlying SIP/RTP/physical media stack on one side, and the Exotel Messaging Framework (XMF) that unifies social and messaging DMs on the other. This role demands a strategic thinker, a meticulous planner, and an effective team leader who can align product development with organizational goals — while being comfortable going deep into telco and media protocol detail when needed. Scope of Ownership Voice Media & CX-to-Voicebot Interface: Own the product surface connecting the Customer Experience layer to voicebots — call setup/teardown, audio routing, media negotiation, and real-time signal quality. Working knowledge of SIP (signaling), RTP (media transport), codecs, jitter/packet loss, and physical media/PRI-SIP trunking is expected Digital Messaging via XMF: Own the Exotel Messaging Framework (XMF) — the digital counterpart to voice — that abstracts and unifies inbound/outbound DMs across social and messaging channels (WhatsApp, Instagram, etc.) into a common conversational construct, enabling parity of bot/agent experience across voice and digital. Product Life Cycle Management Strategy, Planning, and Development Develop and execute a strategic product roadmap for the module that aligns with organizational goals across both voice and digital channels. Ensure timely delivery of features and releases (e.g., new channel integrations on XMF, SIP/RTP enhancements for quality) meeting or exceeding customer expectations. Conduct revenue impact analysis for each product enhancement, targeting a percentage increase in revenue. Platform Reliability & Media Quality Define and own SLAs/SLOs for call setup success rate, media quality (MOS, jitter, packet loss), and message delivery reliability across XMF channels. Partner with telco/network engineering to reduce latency and improve barge-in/turn-taking accuracy, both of which are directly governed by underlying SIP/RTP behavior. Customer Satisfaction and Engagement NPS (Net Promoter Score) Objectively increase NPS for customers. Efficiency in Addressing Customer Product Requests Improve efficiency in addressing customer product requests (e.g., new channel asks, call quality escalations) within SLA. Monthly Active Users (MAU) / Active Conversations Increase MAU and active-conversation volume across voice and XMF-enabled digital channels through customer/sales engagement and product strategies. Onboarding Optimization Reduce the cost and time for customer onboarding onto new channels (voice trunking setup, new DM channel activation on XMF) for the self-served product. Market Research and Innovation Stay updated on telco/CPaaS and conversational-AI market trends (SIP trunking providers, CCaaS players, messaging API ecosystems like WhatsApp Business Platform, Meta Messaging) and conduct regular competitive analysis. Innovative Business Ideas/Features Propose and implement innovative features that improve voicebot media quality (e.g., adaptive codec selection, edge media routing) and expand XMF's channel coverage. Pricing and Competition Research Conduct thorough pricing and competition research for voice media and messaging/DM modules, including telco/carrier cost structures and per-channel messaging economics. Must-Have Skills & Experience Working understanding of SIP (call signaling, INVITE/ACK/BYE flows, trunking), RTP/RTCP (real-time media transport, codecs, jitter buffers), and basic physical media/telco concepts (PRI, PSTN interconnects, carrier routing). Familiarity with how media consumers work (speech-to-text streaming, barge-in) and how SIP/RTP behavior impacts responsiveness. Exposure to messaging/social APIs (WhatsApp, Instagram/Facebook Messaging) and how a unifying framework like XMF abstracts these into a single conversational construct. 4–7 years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in telephony, CPaaS, CCaaS, or messaging infrastructure products. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — this role works closely with telco/network engineering, voicebot/AI teams, and digital channel/messaging engineering simultaneously. Comfortable reading protocol-level logs/traces (SIP ladder diagrams, packet captures) when triaging quality issues, even if not writing the fixes yourself. Nice-to-Have Prior experience with WebRTC, media servers (FreeSWITCH, Asterisk, Kamailio), or CPaaS platforms. Experience building or managing a messaging abstraction layer across multiple social/DM channels.

jobs.title: GTM Engineer(Market Automation)
jobs.text: About Exotel At Exotel, we build technologies that make communication more human. Every time someone orders food on Swiggy, manages money with Slice, finds care through Redcliffe Labs or books a ride on Uber, chances are Exotel is powering that interaction in the background. In 2011, our founders saw how hard it was for businesses to talk to their customers. Setting up phone lines, IVRs, and call centres meant hardware, engineers, and a lot of money. They imagined a simpler world, where any company could build customer conversations using just the cloud. That belief became Exotel. From the first few calls routed through our servers in Bengaluru to thousands of startups and enterprises relying on us every day, our mission was clear: make business communication simple, reliable, and scalable. Not fancy. Not expensive. Just something that worked every single time. The company builds the invisible backbone of communication for some of the most loved brands across India and beyond, enabling 25 billion+ conversations a year for 7,000+ businesses across voice, chat, bots, and contact centres, all with 100% uptime. About the Role Marketing at Exotel is moving from campaign-led to systems-led. Fewer one-off pushes, more replicable, instrumented flows that compound over quarters. The buying motion we serve is complex: enterprise CX, BFSI, mobility, healthcare, e-commerce, and global expansion across India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. The GTM stack that supports it has to be just as deliberate. We are hiring a GTM Engineer to be the builder behind that shift. You will design and ship the systems that take a lead from first signal to closed opportunity, across marketing automation, outbound plumbing, signal capture, enrichment, and the AI workflows that sit on top of all of it. You report into the Head of Digital & Performance Marketing, and you partner deeply with the SDR Manager, RevOps, and Sales Leadership. This is a low-code-first role. Your default toolbox is n8n, Clay, Pardot Engagement Studio, Salesforce Flows, and an LLM API, not a Python repo. But when a workflow needs a small custom script, a webhook handler, or a data transformation that no GUI tool can do cleanly, you write it without flinching. We expect you to ship things, not maintain them. The system you build should free three other people up to do their actual jobs. What a GTM Engineer Does at Exotel Borrowing the shape of the role as it exists at companies like Clay, Default, and Common Room, and bending it to a CPaaS B2B context, the job at Exotel breaks into five surfaces: 1. Marketing Automation Backbone Own Pardot / MCAE end-to-end: Engagement Studio programs, Dynamic Lists, Scoring & Grading, Completion Actions, forms, form handlers, custom redirects. Own the Pardot–Salesforce sync model: connector health, dedup logic, prospect-database hygiene, and staying under the platform’s prospect ceiling. Maintain the Lead → MQL → SAL → SQL → Closed lifecycle as code-as-config: documented stage rules, entry/exit criteria, and re-entry logic. Build replicable nurture frameworks (cold outreach, event invite, ABM multi-touch, post-MQL nurture, re-engagement, win-back) as templates that segment owners can clone, customise, and launch within 24 hours. 2. Demand Generation & SDR Plumbing Partner with the SDR Manager to engineer the outbound motion: list-build, contact discovery, enrichment, sequencer hand-off, reply routing, meeting capture, and SDR-to-AE handover, all instrumented and observable. Build the SDR-side automations that remove rote work: auto-research briefs at the moment of dial, intent-signal triage into tasks, account ownership conflict checks, and calendar-link generation with context. Stand up signal capture and routing across website behaviour, form intent, event attendance, community activity, and ad engagement, into either a sequence, a task, or a nurture, with no signal left orphaned. Close the loop with Sales: every meeting booked, every SQL accepted, every closed-won has a clean attribution trail back to its source touch. 3. Data, Enrichment & Hygiene Build and maintain orchestration flows (n8n, Clay, Zapier) that connect Apollo, Lusha, NeverBounce/ZeroBounce, Salesforce, Pardot, ad platforms, and the SDR sequencer. Operate enrichment and verification pipelines with credit governance: coverage targets, gap-account logic, re-verification cadences (e.g., 30/90-day rules). Maintain canonical field definitions across Lead, Contact, Account, and Opportunity. One Job Title field. One Email field. One Mobile field. No shadow fields. Define and enforce list management standards: dynamic lists over static, suppression logic, frequency capping, and consent/compliance flags (DPDPA, GDPR-aware). Run monthly hygiene cycles and quarterly audits on prospect, account, and contact data. 4. AI-Augmented Workflows Build internal AI agents that take rote work off humans: contact enrichment summaries, account research briefs, ad-copy QA, ICP fit scoring, intent-signal triage, post-event lead processing, and SDR call-prep notes. Wire LLM calls into n8n / Clay / Zapier flows that read from Salesforce or Pardot, reason over the data, and write back enriched fields, scores, or routing decisions. Ship at least two production-grade AI workflows per quarter, each with measurable time saved or quality lift over the manual baseline. Stay current on the agent/automation tooling landscape (Clay, n8n, Lindy, Make, Relay, Common Room, Apollo Workflows, Default, etc.) and recommend buy-vs-build calls. 5. Reporting, Attribution & Decision Surfaces Own the marketing reporting stack: pipeline source, multi-touch attribution, cluster-wise pipeline targets vs actuals, CPL, MQL→SAL→SQL conversion, velocity, MROI. Build and maintain dashboards in Looker Studio / equivalent, fed by BigQuery or direct connectors, that surface insight without manual exports. Translate raw funnel data into weekly anomaly alerts and monthly narratives for leadership. Make sure every new campaign goes live with its measurement plan already wired in. No orphan campaigns. 6. Website Vendor & Tracking Integrity Website build and maintenance is handled by an external vendor. Your job is the marketing-side counterpart: brief the vendor well, sanity-check what ships, and own the layer the vendor does not touch. Run the working relationship with the website vendor: brief landing page requirements, review staging builds, sign off on go-live, and hold the SLA on bug resolution and change requests. Own the tracking and analytics layer end-to-end: GTM containers, GA4 events, form-handler integrity, conversion definitions, UTM hygiene. The vendor builds the page; you make sure every interaction on it is captured correctly. Own marketing’s side of consent management, cookie banners, and DPDPA / GDPR-aware tracking flags. Drive the experimentation roadmap. You decide what to test (CTAs, form length, hero copy, social proof placement) and brief it to the vendor; you read the results and decide what ships permanently. Familiarity with CMS / landing-page builders (Lovable, Webflow, Unbounce) and tag management (GTM, MS Clarity) is welcome. You will not be coding pages, but you should be able to read what the vendor ships and call out a tracking bug or a missing event. Must-Have Profile 5–8 years of hands-on marketing operations, MarkOps, or growth-engineering experience in B2B SaaS, ideally serving mid-market and enterprise buyers. Deep working knowledge of Salesforce (Lead, Contact, Account, Opportunity, Campaign objects, Flow Builder, reports) and Pardot / MCAE (Engagement Studio, Dynamic Lists, Scoring, Forms, Connector). Demonstrated experience building automations across an orchestration layer (n8n, Clay, Zapier, Make, or Workato) at a level where you have shipped multi-step, branching workflows with error handling, not just two-step Zaps. Comfort with APIs and webhooks: REST, JSON, basic auth/OAuth, and the discipline to read API documentation and debug a failing call. Experience designing lead lifecycle, scoring, and routing models, and the discipline to maintain them. Strong analytical sense. Comfortable with funnel maths, attribution debates, and translating data into a weekly narrative. Proven ownership. At least one MarTech / RevOps system you designed end-to-end and operated through real campaigns. AI Engineering Bent: What This Means at Exotel We use this phrase deliberately. We are not asking for an ML engineer or a Python full-timer. We are asking for an operator who treats LLMs and APIs as building blocks the way a senior MarTech professional treats triggers and webhooks. Concretely: You have built at least one workflow that uses an LLM API (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) inside a production automation, not a one-off script. You can read and modify someone else’s n8n / Clay / Zapier workflow without breaking it. You have used Claude Code, Cursor, or a similar AI coding assistant to build internal tools, parsers, or quick dashboards. You have opinions on agentic patterns: when to use a single LLM call, when to use tool-calling, when to use a multi-step agent, and when not to use AI at all. You can sketch a buy-vs-build decision for an AI capability with cost, maintenance, and risk on the same page.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - 3 (Gen AI & Speech)
jobs.text: Software Engineer 3 - Gen AI & Speech Bangalore · Full-time · 5-8 years About Us Exotel is a leading provider of AI transformation to enterprises for customer engagement and experience. With over 20 billion annual conversations across Omni channel, voice, agents and bots, Exotel is trusted by more than 7000 clients worldwide, spanning industries such as BFSI, Logistics, Consumer Durables, E-commerce, Healthcare and Education. Customer expectations are evolving and businesses face the challenge of balancing the need for increased revenue, optimized costs, and exceptional customer experience (CX). Exotel steps forward as your transformative partner, offering an AI-powered communication solution to address all three! Tech @ Exotel Exotel engineering solves some really cool infrastructure level problems with the goal of ensuring no one misses a call or an SMS. Our focus is on building very fault-tolerant, loosely coupled, scalable and real-time distributed systems We emphasize a lot on clean abstractions of code, loosely coupled services and good coding practices We are very strong believers in "you built it, you own it!". And running a distributed system is very different from just building one! We are crazy about high availability The Role You'll be part of the team building Exotel's AI and speech platform, powering products like Conversation Quality Analysis, AI Voice Agents, and AI Chat Agents. This means working across large language models, speech processing, and distributed backend systems to process and understand millions of enterprise conversations at scale. This is an engineering role first. You'll design, build, deploy, and operate production services, and own them end-to-end. What You'll Do Build and optimize LLM-powered pipelines for analyzing conversations at scale, managing cost, latency, and quality tradeoffs across model providers. Work on speech processing: improving transcription accuracy, handling multilingual audio, and solving real-world audio quality challenges. Design and build AI agents that reason over enterprise data and deliver actionable answers with appropriate guardrails. Develop and scale high-throughput, multi-tenant backend services with focus on reliability and performance. Own cost and observability for AI workloads: usage tracking, cost attribution, and quality monitoring. Model optimization and self-hosting are active areas of investment. Take end-to-end ownership of the software development lifecycle: requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and monitoring. What You Bring Must-have Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent. 5-8 years of software engineering experience. Proficiency in at least one backend language (Python, Java, Go, or similar). Ability to pick up new languages quickly; the language matters less than the engineering thinking behind it. Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, multi-threading, and concurrency. Good understanding of software engineering concepts : design patterns, modularity, scalability. Experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems : designing, building, and operating them. Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and async job-processing architectures. Production experience with databases, caching layers, message brokers, and search/analytics systems , including data modeling and scaling. Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Azure, or similar): prompt engineering, structured output, cost management. If you haven't worked with LLMs yet but have strong engineering fundamentals and a willingness to learn, that works too. Experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Team player, comfortable working across teams (product, data, infrastructure) in a fast-paced environment. Good-to-have Understanding of RAG patterns : embeddings, vector stores, retrieval strategies. Comfortable with Linux , shell scripting, and developing Linux-based applications. Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Kibana, Elasticsearch. Strong networking fundamentals : DNS, load balancing, proxies, firewalls. Experience with ASR/TTS engines : Whisper-family models, VAD, speaker diarization, alignment, and common failure modes. Experience working with audio pipelines: IP streaming, format handling, noise reduction, streaming vs. batch processing. Experience with graph databases and graph query languages. Familiarity with columnar analytics stores for large-scale analytical queries. Experience building multi-tenant SaaS with tenant isolation and per-tenant configuration. Exposure to LLM observability and cost tracking tooling. Experience self-hosting or fine-tuning open-weight models. How We Work You own it . Design, code, deploy, monitor. DevOps is a culture, not a separate team. You lead . Mentor and own the output of a team of 4-6 engineers. Code reviews, design reviews, and growing people are part of the job. You collaborate . You'll work closely with product, data, and platform teams. Good ideas win, regardless of where they come from. You stay curious . New models, tools, and techniques emerge constantly. We expect you to evaluate and benchmark; staying ahead is part of the role. Why Exotel Work on AI problems at real scale: billions of conversations, thousands of enterprise clients. High autonomy and ownership. Your decisions shape the product. A team that values engineering depth, not just shipping fast. Opportunity to work across the full AI stack: LLMs, speech, agents, infrastructure.

jobs.text: Organic Growth Lead (SEO / AEO) Everstage is hiring a Discoverability Lead to own how buyers find us through search and AI. A growing share of our buyers research sales compensation software through AI assistants like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews before they ever visit a website. This role owns Everstage's visibility across both traditional search and these AI answer engines, and builds the AI-driven systems that let a small team do it at scale. Why this role, and why now Everstage is an AI-first revenue execution platform that brings together Incentives, Planning, and CPQ for RevOps, Finance, and Sales leaders. We are a G2 Leader in Sales Compensation (Summer 2026) and the only sales compensation software in G2's Top 20 Software for Sales 2026. We were recognized as a Strong Performer in the 2025 Forrester Wave and a Gartner Customers' Choice in 2024. Today, Everstage is trusted by hundreds of global enterprises including Notion, Trimble, Zuora, Glean, and Thoughtworks. What you'll own Build the systems that let a lean team punch above its size. This is the core of the role: an agentic content workflow that uses AI for research, drafting, and publishing prep, and automated AEO monitoring that tracks citations and share of answer across AI engines. The answer-space strategy: which search queries and AI prompts we target, prioritized by fit with our RevOps and Finance buyers and informed by your monitoring data and competitive benchmarking. The content and technical work that earns this visibility: top-funnel to bottom-funnel pages, schema and structured data, and the entity relationships that help AI engines understand and cite Everstage. The execution model: you’ll work with our external website and content partner, who supports delivery today, and shape how work is split between in-house and partner as the function grows. A roadmap you set, measure against clear KPIs, and align with the sales and content teams. What success looks like Success is measured at three levels: Primary: growth in Everstage's citation rate and share of answer across AI engines for the queries our RevOps and Finance buyers ask. This is the clearest signal that the right audience is discovering us. Supporting: the volume and quality of non-paid demand - organic and AI-sourced sessions, leads, and content downloads. Outcome: the non-paid pipeline and SQLs this visibility generates over time. You’ll own the first level directly, contribute heavily to the second, and share the third with BD and sales. This role is a great fit for you if you Bring product-management instincts to growth work: you start from the problem behind a search query and the buyer behind it. Understand how LLMs retrieve, rank, and cite sources, and can design content and structure around how they work. Have built or orchestrated agentic and automated workflows with modern AI tooling - agent frameworks, workflow automation (for example n8n or Zapier), and LLM APIs. You create leverage by building systems, not only by executing tasks. Can build and run an AEO measurement program: define a tracked prompt set, measure citation and share of answer across AI engines, and use the results to guide the roadmap. Can read a Search Console or LLM-visibility export and turn it into a prioritized plan. Are hands-on and comfortable owning strategy through execution in a lean setup. Bring 5-7 years in SEO or organic growth, ideally in B2B SaaS. Work cross-functionally to get content, pages, and technical changes shipped. Understand, or can quickly learn, a technical buyer (For Everstage, that’s the RevOps and Finance leaders who own the comp number and the audit). Nice to have Hands-on experience with AEO and LLM-visibility tools such as Profound/Otterly/Slate Experience implementing schema and structured data. Familiarity with the RevOps, sales comp, or ICM category. A track record of running and honestly evaluating SEO or AEO experiments.

Integrate payment, finance, reporting, case-management, and data platforms through APIs, events, queues, and data pipelines. Required Experience 5-8 years of software engineering, backend development( Java), integration engineering, or automation experience. At least 2 years building LLM, Generative AI, machine-learning, or agentic applications. Experience taking AI solutions beyond proof-of-concept into controlled production environments. Experience integrating multiple enterprise systems through APIs, events, messaging, or workflow engines. Experience designing exception handling, approval workflows, and operational controls. Mandatory Technical Skills Programming: Java with Spring Boot/Spring AI and/or Python with FastAPI or equivalent frameworks. Generative AI: Claude/Anthropic APIs, OpenAI APIs, or equivalent; prompt design; tool/function calling; structured outputs. Agentic frameworks: LangGraph, LangChain, Spring AI, MCP, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalent. Workflow automation: n8n, Temporal, Camunda, Airflow, or comparable orchestration technology. Integration: REST APIs, event-driven integration, Kafka or RabbitMQ, API gateways, SQL, and data pipelines. Engineering: Docker, Kubernetes, Git, automated testing, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and secure configuration management. Quality and control: unit/integration testing, LLM evaluation, prompt/version management, validation, fallback, retry, and audit logging. jobs.text: Position Summary We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer / AI Solution Architect to own the architecture and evolution of an AI-native Payments Operating System. This role will map end-to-end payment operations, identify automation opportunities and capability gaps, define the target architecture, and establish a pragmatic roadmap that delivers near-term value while enabling long-term platform modernization. The role requires a strong combination of Payments domain knowledge, enterprise architecture, AI platform design, integration strategy, governance, and stakeholder leadership. Key Responsibilities Assess end-to-end Payments operations, including reconciliation, routing, settlement, reporting, controls, audit, exceptions, and incident management. Identify manual effort, operational bottlenecks, control weaknesses, integration failures, data gaps, and architecture complexity. Define a prioritized Payments AI and automation roadmap based on business value, risk, feasibility, scalability, and ROI. Design the target AI-native Payments Operating System, including agent architecture, orchestration, data pipelines, model access, integration, controls, reporting, and observability. Design an agentic Payments layer that operates alongside the current technology stack and supports gradual migration toward a future-state platform. Define patterns for AI gateways, model selection, prompt and agent registries, RAG/knowledge services, workflow engines, human approval, and auditability. Evaluate and simplify the existing Payments technology landscape, reducing duplication and improving interoperability. Ensure architecture incorporates security, data governance, model risk, explainability, resilience, privacy, and regulatory controls by design. Lead architecture reviews, proof-of-value initiatives, technical standards, reusable frameworks, and platform capability development. Represent Payments within the AI Center of Excellence and align with enterprise AI, data, cloud, security, and governance strategies. Communicate architecture, investment choices, risks, and roadmaps to engineering leaders, business stakeholders, risk, compliance, and executives. Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership from discovery through production optimization. Required Experience 10+ years of software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise architecture, or platform engineering experience. At least 3 years designing Generative AI, LLM, machine-learning, or intelligent automation solutions. Demonstrated experience leading architecture for enterprise-scale transformation programs. Strong Payments or Financial Services experience, ideally involving payment processing, reconciliation, settlement, ledgers, routing, or operational controls. Experience defining target-state architecture, transition architecture, technology roadmaps, and implementation governance. Experience engaging senior business, engineering, risk, compliance, audit, and executive stakeholders. Mandatory Technical and Architecture Skills AI architecture: LLM platforms, multi-agent systems, tool calling, RAG, embeddings, vector stores, model gateways, evaluation, and guardrails. Platform architecture: Kubernetes, cloud platforms, Kafka/event streaming, API gateways, CI/CD, observability, security, IAM, and data pipelines. Governance: risk tiering, data classification, model risk, access control, traceability, explainability, human oversight, and audit logging. Roadmapping: value assessment, architectural trade-offs, dependency management, phased migration, cost modeling, and ROI measurement. Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills ISO 20022, SWIFT, ACH, real-time payments, card networks, merchant acquiring, payment gateways, or treasury operations. PCI DSS, SOC 2, model risk management, responsible AI, privacy regulations, and banking control frameworks. TOGAF, cloud architecture, security, or payments-related certifications. Experience establishing AI Centers of Excellence, engineering standards, reference architectures, or reusable platform services. Experience balancing legacy modernization with incremental delivery and measurable business outcomes.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Experience Designer
jobs.text: About the Role Icreon is looking for a Senior Digital Experience Designer who operates at the intersection of design, technology, and AI. You will define how new digital experiences are designed and built, working closely with engineers and directly with clients across both new business pursuits and existing accounts. At a Glance Reports To: CXO Location: New York, NY (Hybrid) Split: 50% new business pursuits / 50% existing client accounts Type: Full-Time What You Will Do Concept and Design Next-Gen Experiences — Translate product ideas and emerging technologies into novel interaction models. Work early in the product lifecycle to define experience direction, not just screens. Design Through Prototypes — Move beyond static mockups. Rapidly iterate using Figma, Framer, and AI-assisted tools. Evolve prototypes into production-ready artifacts alongside engineering. Engineer Collaboration — Pair with engineers to design through code. Co-create experiences that balance design thinking with technical feasibility and shorten the design-to-build loop. Platform Experience — Design digital experiences for Sitecore and Optimizely platforms, as well as custom digital products. Client Communication — Translate complexity into clear narratives for CMOs, CTOs, and C-suite stakeholders in B2B environments. Contribute to product thinking and roadmap discussions. What We Are Looking For Experience 5+ years in UX, product, service, or interaction design Portfolio demonstrating strong conceptual thinking and complex interaction design — not just polish Proven experience working side-by-side with engineers in product teams Familiarity with design systems, front-end constraints, and technical workflows Capabilities Systems thinker — you design behaviors and product logic, not just individual screens Fast, iterative operator — you prototype to think, not just to present Strong communicator — you can tell the story of a design decision to both engineers and C-suite stakeholders Mastery of modern prototyping platforms AI Fluency Icreon is seeing significant gains in leveraging AI across our team from autonomous engineering to agentic process re-architecture. Someone in this role is expected to get their hands dirty day-in and day-out and staying at the vanguard of where this industry is moving. Ways in which we're expecting this role to incorporate AI into the department Workflow integration — Uses AI tools (Claude Code, Design, Runway, Higgsfield, Krea, ComfyUI, Pencil, or equivalent) as active parts of the design process, not occasional experiments AI-enabled experience design — Has a point of view on how AI reshapes interaction models and interface patterns — and can prototype that thinking, not just describe it Ideation and generation — Uses AI to accelerate concept exploration: generating visual directions, interaction variants, copy, and motion references faster than traditional methods allow Tooling and automation — Has built or contributed to custom AI workflows that reduce repetitive design work — template generation, asset creation, annotation, handoff documentation Emerging interface patterns — Actively explores what AI-native product experiences look like and can bring that perspective into client conversations credibly The bar is not curiosity. It's demonstrated, habitual use with a track record of it showing up in the work. About Icreon Icreon is a digital consulting firm working across strategy, design, and engineering for enterprise clients. Our design team operates at the frontier of what digital products can be — this role is central to how we push that forward.
