jobs.title: GTM Engineer(Market Automation)
jobs.text: About Exotel At Exotel, we build technologies that make communication more human. Every time someone orders food on Swiggy, manages money with Slice, finds care through Redcliffe Labs or books a ride on Uber, chances are Exotel is powering that interaction in the background. In 2011, our founders saw how hard it was for businesses to talk to their customers. Setting up phone lines, IVRs, and call centres meant hardware, engineers, and a lot of money. They imagined a simpler world, where any company could build customer conversations using just the cloud. That belief became Exotel. From the first few calls routed through our servers in Bengaluru to thousands of startups and enterprises relying on us every day, our mission was clear: make business communication simple, reliable, and scalable. Not fancy. Not expensive. Just something that worked every single time. The company builds the invisible backbone of communication for some of the most loved brands across India and beyond, enabling 25 billion+ conversations a year for 7,000+ businesses across voice, chat, bots, and contact centres, all with 100% uptime. About the Role Marketing at Exotel is moving from campaign-led to systems-led. Fewer one-off pushes, more replicable, instrumented flows that compound over quarters. The buying motion we serve is complex: enterprise CX, BFSI, mobility, healthcare, e-commerce, and global expansion across India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. The GTM stack that supports it has to be just as deliberate. We are hiring a GTM Engineer to be the builder behind that shift. You will design and ship the systems that take a lead from first signal to closed opportunity, across marketing automation, outbound plumbing, signal capture, enrichment, and the AI workflows that sit on top of all of it. You report into the Head of Digital & Performance Marketing, and you partner deeply with the SDR Manager, RevOps, and Sales Leadership. This is a low-code-first role. Your default toolbox is n8n, Clay, Pardot Engagement Studio, Salesforce Flows, and an LLM API, not a Python repo. But when a workflow needs a small custom script, a webhook handler, or a data transformation that no GUI tool can do cleanly, you write it without flinching. We expect you to ship things, not maintain them. The system you build should free three other people up to do their actual jobs. What a GTM Engineer Does at Exotel Borrowing the shape of the role as it exists at companies like Clay, Default, and Common Room, and bending it to a CPaaS B2B context, the job at Exotel breaks into five surfaces: 1. Marketing Automation Backbone Own Pardot / MCAE end-to-end: Engagement Studio programs, Dynamic Lists, Scoring & Grading, Completion Actions, forms, form handlers, custom redirects. Own the Pardot–Salesforce sync model: connector health, dedup logic, prospect-database hygiene, and staying under the platform’s prospect ceiling. Maintain the Lead → MQL → SAL → SQL → Closed lifecycle as code-as-config: documented stage rules, entry/exit criteria, and re-entry logic. Build replicable nurture frameworks (cold outreach, event invite, ABM multi-touch, post-MQL nurture, re-engagement, win-back) as templates that segment owners can clone, customise, and launch within 24 hours. 2. Demand Generation & SDR Plumbing Partner with the SDR Manager to engineer the outbound motion: list-build, contact discovery, enrichment, sequencer hand-off, reply routing, meeting capture, and SDR-to-AE handover, all instrumented and observable. Build the SDR-side automations that remove rote work: auto-research briefs at the moment of dial, intent-signal triage into tasks, account ownership conflict checks, and calendar-link generation with context. Stand up signal capture and routing across website behaviour, form intent, event attendance, community activity, and ad engagement, into either a sequence, a task, or a nurture, with no signal left orphaned. Close the loop with Sales: every meeting booked, every SQL accepted, every closed-won has a clean attribution trail back to its source touch. 3. Data, Enrichment & Hygiene Build and maintain orchestration flows (n8n, Clay, Zapier) that connect Apollo, Lusha, NeverBounce/ZeroBounce, Salesforce, Pardot, ad platforms, and the SDR sequencer. Operate enrichment and verification pipelines with credit governance: coverage targets, gap-account logic, re-verification cadences (e.g., 30/90-day rules). Maintain canonical field definitions across Lead, Contact, Account, and Opportunity. One Job Title field. One Email field. One Mobile field. No shadow fields. Define and enforce list management standards: dynamic lists over static, suppression logic, frequency capping, and consent/compliance flags (DPDPA, GDPR-aware). Run monthly hygiene cycles and quarterly audits on prospect, account, and contact data. 4. AI-Augmented Workflows Build internal AI agents that take rote work off humans: contact enrichment summaries, account research briefs, ad-copy QA, ICP fit scoring, intent-signal triage, post-event lead processing, and SDR call-prep notes. Wire LLM calls into n8n / Clay / Zapier flows that read from Salesforce or Pardot, reason over the data, and write back enriched fields, scores, or routing decisions. Ship at least two production-grade AI workflows per quarter, each with measurable time saved or quality lift over the manual baseline. Stay current on the agent/automation tooling landscape (Clay, n8n, Lindy, Make, Relay, Common Room, Apollo Workflows, Default, etc.) and recommend buy-vs-build calls. 5. Reporting, Attribution & Decision Surfaces Own the marketing reporting stack: pipeline source, multi-touch attribution, cluster-wise pipeline targets vs actuals, CPL, MQL→SAL→SQL conversion, velocity, MROI. Build and maintain dashboards in Looker Studio / equivalent, fed by BigQuery or direct connectors, that surface insight without manual exports. Translate raw funnel data into weekly anomaly alerts and monthly narratives for leadership. Make sure every new campaign goes live with its measurement plan already wired in. No orphan campaigns. 6. Website Vendor & Tracking Integrity Website build and maintenance is handled by an external vendor. Your job is the marketing-side counterpart: brief the vendor well, sanity-check what ships, and own the layer the vendor does not touch. Run the working relationship with the website vendor: brief landing page requirements, review staging builds, sign off on go-live, and hold the SLA on bug resolution and change requests. Own the tracking and analytics layer end-to-end: GTM containers, GA4 events, form-handler integrity, conversion definitions, UTM hygiene. The vendor builds the page; you make sure every interaction on it is captured correctly. Own marketing’s side of consent management, cookie banners, and DPDPA / GDPR-aware tracking flags. Drive the experimentation roadmap. You decide what to test (CTAs, form length, hero copy, social proof placement) and brief it to the vendor; you read the results and decide what ships permanently. Familiarity with CMS / landing-page builders (Lovable, Webflow, Unbounce) and tag management (GTM, MS Clarity) is welcome. You will not be coding pages, but you should be able to read what the vendor ships and call out a tracking bug or a missing event. Must-Have Profile 5–8 years of hands-on marketing operations, MarkOps, or growth-engineering experience in B2B SaaS, ideally serving mid-market and enterprise buyers. Deep working knowledge of Salesforce (Lead, Contact, Account, Opportunity, Campaign objects, Flow Builder, reports) and Pardot / MCAE (Engagement Studio, Dynamic Lists, Scoring, Forms, Connector). Demonstrated experience building automations across an orchestration layer (n8n, Clay, Zapier, Make, or Workato) at a level where you have shipped multi-step, branching workflows with error handling, not just two-step Zaps. Comfort with APIs and webhooks: REST, JSON, basic auth/OAuth, and the discipline to read API documentation and debug a failing call. Experience designing lead lifecycle, scoring, and routing models, and the discipline to maintain them. Strong analytical sense. Comfortable with funnel maths, attribution debates, and translating data into a weekly narrative. Proven ownership. At least one MarTech / RevOps system you designed end-to-end and operated through real campaigns. AI Engineering Bent: What This Means at Exotel We use this phrase deliberately. We are not asking for an ML engineer or a Python full-timer. We are asking for an operator who treats LLMs and APIs as building blocks the way a senior MarTech professional treats triggers and webhooks. Concretely: You have built at least one workflow that uses an LLM API (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) inside a production automation, not a one-off script. You can read and modify someone else’s n8n / Clay / Zapier workflow without breaking it. You have used Claude Code, Cursor, or a similar AI coding assistant to build internal tools, parsers, or quick dashboards. You have opinions on agentic patterns: when to use a single LLM call, when to use tool-calling, when to use a multi-step agent, and when not to use AI at all. You can sketch a buy-vs-build decision for an AI capability with cost, maintenance, and risk on the same page.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - 3 (Gen AI & Speech)
jobs.text: Software Engineer 3 - Gen AI & Speech Bangalore · Full-time · 5-8 years About Us Exotel is a leading provider of AI transformation to enterprises for customer engagement and experience. With over 20 billion annual conversations across Omni channel, voice, agents and bots, Exotel is trusted by more than 7000 clients worldwide, spanning industries such as BFSI, Logistics, Consumer Durables, E-commerce, Healthcare and Education. Customer expectations are evolving and businesses face the challenge of balancing the need for increased revenue, optimized costs, and exceptional customer experience (CX). Exotel steps forward as your transformative partner, offering an AI-powered communication solution to address all three! Tech @ Exotel Exotel engineering solves some really cool infrastructure level problems with the goal of ensuring no one misses a call or an SMS. Our focus is on building very fault-tolerant, loosely coupled, scalable and real-time distributed systems We emphasize a lot on clean abstractions of code, loosely coupled services and good coding practices We are very strong believers in "you built it, you own it!". And running a distributed system is very different from just building one! We are crazy about high availability The Role You'll be part of the team building Exotel's AI and speech platform, powering products like Conversation Quality Analysis, AI Voice Agents, and AI Chat Agents. This means working across large language models, speech processing, and distributed backend systems to process and understand millions of enterprise conversations at scale. This is an engineering role first. You'll design, build, deploy, and operate production services, and own them end-to-end. What You'll Do Build and optimize LLM-powered pipelines for analyzing conversations at scale, managing cost, latency, and quality tradeoffs across model providers. Work on speech processing: improving transcription accuracy, handling multilingual audio, and solving real-world audio quality challenges. Design and build AI agents that reason over enterprise data and deliver actionable answers with appropriate guardrails. Develop and scale high-throughput, multi-tenant backend services with focus on reliability and performance. Own cost and observability for AI workloads: usage tracking, cost attribution, and quality monitoring. Model optimization and self-hosting are active areas of investment. Take end-to-end ownership of the software development lifecycle: requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and monitoring. What You Bring Must-have Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent. 5-8 years of software engineering experience. Proficiency in at least one backend language (Python, Java, Go, or similar). Ability to pick up new languages quickly; the language matters less than the engineering thinking behind it. Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, multi-threading, and concurrency. Good understanding of software engineering concepts : design patterns, modularity, scalability. Experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems : designing, building, and operating them. Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and async job-processing architectures. Production experience with databases, caching layers, message brokers, and search/analytics systems , including data modeling and scaling. Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Azure, or similar): prompt engineering, structured output, cost management. If you haven't worked with LLMs yet but have strong engineering fundamentals and a willingness to learn, that works too. Experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Team player, comfortable working across teams (product, data, infrastructure) in a fast-paced environment. Good-to-have Understanding of RAG patterns : embeddings, vector stores, retrieval strategies. Comfortable with Linux , shell scripting, and developing Linux-based applications. Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Kibana, Elasticsearch. Strong networking fundamentals : DNS, load balancing, proxies, firewalls. Experience with ASR/TTS engines : Whisper-family models, VAD, speaker diarization, alignment, and common failure modes. Experience working with audio pipelines: IP streaming, format handling, noise reduction, streaming vs. batch processing. Experience with graph databases and graph query languages. Familiarity with columnar analytics stores for large-scale analytical queries. Experience building multi-tenant SaaS with tenant isolation and per-tenant configuration. Exposure to LLM observability and cost tracking tooling. Experience self-hosting or fine-tuning open-weight models. How We Work You own it . Design, code, deploy, monitor. DevOps is a culture, not a separate team. You lead . Mentor and own the output of a team of 4-6 engineers. Code reviews, design reviews, and growing people are part of the job. You collaborate . You'll work closely with product, data, and platform teams. Good ideas win, regardless of where they come from. You stay curious . New models, tools, and techniques emerge constantly. We expect you to evaluate and benchmark; staying ahead is part of the role. Why Exotel Work on AI problems at real scale: billions of conversations, thousands of enterprise clients. High autonomy and ownership. Your decisions shape the product. A team that values engineering depth, not just shipping fast. Opportunity to work across the full AI stack: LLMs, speech, agents, infrastructure.

Collaboration: Skilled at working with engineering, finance, and operations teams to reach aligned outcomes. Communication: Exceptional clarity and communication skills, able to explain complex ideas simply and influence diverse stakeholder groups. Bonus points Experience building or scaling revenue, billing, or financial systems at a SaaS or platform company. Ability to learn revenue operations, contract terms, regulatory constraints, and financial reporting impacts of product decisions. Exposure to usage-based pricing, metering logic, subscription billing, or ERP integrations. Prior experience in high-growth environments or preparing core systems for external audit/IPO. Why Join Us Play a pivotal role in shaping Exotel’s core financial operations, a mission critical function as we scale. High autonomy and leadership responsibility in a growing product org. Solve meaningful problems that impact our customers and the company’s long-term success. A culture that rewards ownership, curiosity, and impact.

jobs.text: Organic Growth Lead (SEO / AEO) Everstage is hiring a Discoverability Lead to own how buyers find us through search and AI. This role owns Everstage's visibility across both traditional search and these AI answer engines, and builds the AI-driven systems that let a small team do it at scale. Why this role, and why now Everstage is an AI-first revenue execution platform that brings together Incentives, Planning, and CPQ for RevOps, Finance, and Sales leaders. We are a G2 Leader in Sales Compensation (Summer 2026) and the only sales compensation software in G2's Top 20 Software for Sales 2026. We were recognized as a Strong Performer in the 2025 Forrester Wave and a Gartner Customers' Choice in 2024. Today, Everstage is trusted by hundreds of global enterprises including Notion, Trimble, Zuora, Glean, and Thoughtworks. What you'll own Build the systems that let a lean team punch above its size. This is the core of the role: an agentic content workflow that uses AI for research, drafting, and publishing prep, and automated AEO monitoring that tracks citations and share of answer across AI engines. The answer-space strategy: which search queries and AI prompts we target, prioritized by fit with our RevOps and Finance buyers and informed by your monitoring data and competitive benchmarking. The content and technical work that earns this visibility: top-funnel to bottom-funnel pages, schema and structured data, and the entity relationships that help AI engines understand and cite Everstage. The execution model: you’ll work with our external website and content partner, who supports delivery today, and shape how work is split between in-house and partner as the function grows. A roadmap you set, measure against clear KPIs, and align with the sales and content teams. What success looks like Success is measured at three levels: Primary: growth in Everstage's citation rate and share of answer across AI engines for the queries our RevOps and Finance buyers ask. This is the clearest signal that the right audience is discovering us. Supporting: the volume and quality of non-paid demand - organic and AI-sourced sessions, leads, and content downloads. Outcome: the non-paid pipeline and SQLs this visibility generates over time. You’ll own the first level directly, contribute heavily to the second, and share the third with BD and sales. This role is a great fit for you if you Bring product-management instincts to growth work: you start from the problem behind a search query and the buyer behind it. Understand how LLMs retrieve, rank, and cite sources, and can design content and structure around how they work. Have built or orchestrated agentic and automated workflows with modern AI tooling - agent frameworks, workflow automation (for example n8n or Zapier), and LLM APIs. You create leverage by building systems, not only by executing tasks. Can build and run an AEO measurement program: define a tracked prompt set, measure citation and share of answer across AI engines, and use the results to guide the roadmap. Can read a Search Console or LLM-visibility export and turn it into a prioritized plan. Are hands-on and comfortable owning strategy through execution in a lean setup. Bring 5-7 years in SEO or organic growth, ideally in B2B SaaS. Work cross-functionally to get content, pages, and technical changes shipped. jobs.text: Senior Product Marketing Manager About greytHR greytHR is India's leading HR & Payroll SaaS platform, trusted by over 30,000 businesses and 3 million+ users across India, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. Our mission is to simplify HR, payroll, and compliance for growing businesses through easy-to-use, reliable, and compliant software. As we continue to expand across India and global markets, we're growing our Product Marketing team to support this next phase of growth. About the Role We are looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own go-to-market strategy for a defined product area within greytHR's portfolio. This role will report to a Product Marketing leader and will work closely with Product, Sales, Digital Marketing, and Customer Success teams to plan and execute positioning, launches, and enablement that drive measurable business outcomes. Key Responsibilities Positioning & Strategy ● Own positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy for a defined product area. ● Partner with Sales and Digital Marketing teams to ensure messaging translates into pipeline and adoption outcomes. ● Own competitive intelligence for the assigned area, including regular updates based on field feedback. ● Provide input into pricing and packaging decisions for the assigned product area. Go-to-Market Execution & Enablement ● Lead cross-functional product launches, coordinating with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing. ● Build and deliver sales enablement content and training. ● Identify and build AI-assisted workflows or tools that improve team efficiency and output. ● Mentor junior product marketers and contribute to raising the team's overall craft. Qualifications and Skills ● 5–8 years of experience in product marketing, with a track record of owning go-to-market strategy end-to-end. ● Strong analytical skills, with the ability to connect marketing initiatives to business outcomes. ● Experience mentoring or guiding junior team members. ● Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. ● Bachelor's degree required; MBA is a plus. Mandatory Requirements Demonstrated, hands-on experience building an AI-powered workflow, tool, or automation — beyond using AI tools for personal productivity. Experience owning both positioning/messaging and campaign/distribution work for the same product or business area. Experience marketing HRMS, payroll, HR tech, or a similar regulated B2B SaaS product, across India and at least one global market. Why Join greytHR Opportunity to work on a market-leading HR & Payroll platform used across India and international markets. Opportunity to shape go-to-market strategy for a growing product portfolio. A collaborative, fast-paced team environment with real ownership from day one. Competitive compensation and benefits package. A culture that values learning, innovation, and cross-functional collaboration.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Application Platform & AI
jobs.text: Product Manager – Application Platform & AI About the Role We are looking for a seasoned Product Manager to own product-led growth (PLG) and platform-level features across our application, while also leading AI initiatives for our flagship AI layer — the agentic, natural-language execution layer that spans our product suite. This is a dual mandate: you'll drive adoption and expansion through platform-wide PLG mechanics, and you'll set the product direction for how AI and natural language interaction reshape the way users work across the application. This role demands strong product instincts for growth loops, a deep understanding of applied AI/LLM product design, and the ability to build and defend a roadmap backed by clear business cases. Key Responsibilities Application Platform & PLG Ownership Own the product roadmap for platform-level features — onboarding flows, in-app activation and adoption mechanics, cross-module dashboards, and shared platform tooling Design and drive PLG loops (self-serve onboarding, in-product upsell/expansion signals, usage-driven activation) that increase adoption and reduce time-to-value across the application Write PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria grounded in real usage patterns and funnel data — not assumptions Maintain a living, prioritized backlog that reflects both stakeholder input and measurable business/growth value AI Initiative Leadership Own the product vision and roadmap for the flagship AI/agent layer, driving the shift from traditional UI-driven workflows to natural-language and conversational interaction across modules Define and prioritize new AI agent capabilities (e.g., conversational search, chat-based workflows, natural language reporting, and task-specific agents) in partnership with engineering and applied AI teams Establish a repeatable framework for identifying, scoping, and shipping new agent use cases — from discovery through prompt/response design, grounding sources, evaluation, and rollout Define and track AI-specific success metrics: agent adoption, task completion/resolution rate, deflection from traditional UI flows, accuracy/groundedness, and user trust Partner with Marketing, OPS/Training, and Leadership to drive internal and external communication, training, and change management around AI adoption Stakeholder Engagement & Requirements Serve as the primary product partner across functions — Product & Engineering, Marketing, OPS/Training, Customer Success, and Leadership Facilitate requirement-gathering sessions, workflow audits, and AI use-case discovery to build a ground-level understanding of user needs across modules Translate platform and AI requirements into specifications that engineering and design can act on Manage stakeholder expectations through clear communication on timelines, trade-offs, and scope decisions Business Case & Roadmap Development Build and present business cases for platform and AI initiatives — quantifying adoption impact, productivity gains, cost-to-serve reduction, and ROI Develop a rolling 2–3 quarter roadmap, sequenced by growth impact, AI feasibility, and cross-module dependency Align roadmap priorities with leadership and key stakeholders through structured reviews Proactively identify where AI and platform-level improvements can reduce manual effort, friction, or support load Data & Execution Define KPIs and success metrics for every initiative — activation rate, adoption rate, agent usage/resolution rate, process cycle time, and time saved Use data (funnel, usage, and AI interaction data) to validate hypotheses, measure outcomes post-launch, and inform iteration Drive sprint planning, backlog grooming, and cross-functional alignment with engineering, design, and applied AI teams Requirements Must Have 4–6 years of Product Management experience, with meaningful focus on platform-level product ownership, PLG, or B2B SaaS growth Direct experience shipping AI/LLM-powered features — conversational interfaces, AI agents, copilots, or natural-language driven product experiences Demonstrated ability to design and iterate on PLG loops (onboarding, activation, expansion) using funnel and usage data Experience building business cases and defending roadmap priorities with data and business rationale Strong command of product discovery, information architecture, and workflow design across multiple product modules Proficiency in Jira, Confluence, Figma, and web/product analytics tools Solid Agile/Scrum experience as a Product Owner in cross-functional teams Comfortable working with funnel data, AI interaction metrics, and operational KPIs Good to Have Background in multi-tenant SaaS platforms or enterprise tooling environments Hands-on exposure to LLM application design — prompt design, RAG/grounding, agent orchestration, or evaluation frameworks Familiarity with growth/analytics tools such as Amplitude, Custify, or similar Exposure to change management or platform-wide adoption strategies What Success Looks Like (12 Months) A clear, business-case-backed roadmap spanning platform PLG and AI initiatives — bought in by leadership and actively shipped against Measurable improvement in platform-wide activation/adoption metrics driven by PLG initiatives At least two new AI agent capabilities or natural-language features shipped, with measurable adoption and task-resolution impact Deep working relationships established with Product & Engineering, Marketing, OPS/Training, and Leadership A consistent cadence of stakeholder reviews, roadmap updates, and post-launch retrospectives in place

jobs.text: Agentic AI Engineer | AI Labs | Founder's Office yoe: [1, 3] // inclusive on both ends, yes we mean it mode: on-site // we'll get to why status: open until we find 3 of you ``` > if you had to look up the coordinates, that's fine. if you had to look up why we wrote the role this way, this probably isn't the role for you. --- ## the work We're building agents that do actual work. Not chat features. Not "AI-powered" anything. Agents with budgets, latency targets, and on-call rotations for when they break. If you've ever stared at a `tool_use` block that hallucinated a function name and felt that specific kind of shame, you already know the job. AI Labs is a small, deliberate team. The charter is broad on purpose: coding agents, copilots, workflow automation, retrieval-heavy systems, multi-agent orchestration, and the eval harnesses that catch a frontier model release silently regressing your production loop on a Tuesday. The "will agents reshape software" debate is over. We've decided. We need people who can ship. --- ## the first 90 days, probably You'll touch most of these. Some go to prod. Some get killed at week 2. That's the job. * take an agent end to end. problem framing, tool design, eval, rollout, and actually measuring whether it moved a metric. not a demo. a loop that runs while you sleep. * build the orchestration layer that routes work across `Codex` for codegen, Claude for the hard reasoning, a small model for high-volume classification. with explicit budget, latency, and accuracy SLAs per task. cost matters. latency matters. we track both. * stand up evals that catch regressions when you swap a model, rewrite a prompt, or rewire a tool chain. not a notebook. a pipeline. with assertions, not vibes. * replace a process. pick a manual loop (ops, support triage, code review, anything). end it. we'll measure the hours saved and put it on a leaderboard. * make a stupid problem and a smart model useful to each other, which is honestly most of this job. Beyond that, you tell us what to build. The roadmap is not a menu we hand you. --- ## must-haves (we mean it) * **1 to 3 years of professional experience.** not interns. not seniors pivoting in. the role is calibrated for early-career builders already shipping. * **you live in or are moving to `17.3850° N, 78.4867° E`.** on-site. we don't believe great agentic systems get built in async slack threads, and we're not pretending otherwise. * **hands-on, opinionated experience with all of these:** `Codex`, `Cursor`, `Claude Code`, `Claude Cowork`, `Antigravity`. hands-on means you have a take on which one wins for which workflow. not "i watched a YouTube demo". * **multi-LLM fluency.** you've shipped against at least three of: Claude (Sonnet, Opus, Haiku), GPT (4o, 4.1, the o-series), Gemini, DeepSeek, Llama, Mistral. you know which one to reach for to extract structured data out of a soup of HTML, and which to reach for to write a 2000-word doc. and you know why. * **real agentic work.** you've built something that plans, calls tools, recovers from failure, and produces an outcome. you can describe the loop architecture, the eval, and what broke first. (it's always the JSON parsing. it's always the JSON parsing.) --- ## things you'll nod at if you're our person read these. if four or more land for you, please apply. 1. you've watched a context window slowly collapse under its own weight at step 30 of a 50-step plan 2. you've debugged a loop that wouldn't terminate and you knew, in your soul, that it was your fault and not the model's 3. you have an opinion on `temperature=0` that takes more than one sentence to explain 4. you've felt the specific 3am dread of an agent burning through your token budget on a task it can't complete 5. you've shipped a prompt that worked perfectly on Friday and was quietly broken by a provider update on Tuesday 6. you know the difference between an eval and a vibe check. you also know that most teams ship the second. 7. you've reached for MCP and then reached past it 8. you've put two agents in a room together, regretted it, and then done it again because it was the right call 9. you read provider changelogs the way other people read sports headlines 10. you've felt smug for ten minutes after replacing a 400-line prompt with a 40-line one that scored higher --- ## bonus signals * you've shipped a coding agent or dev productivity tool. even small. even just for you. * your last role was at a startup or product company. not services. not "we did some PoCs for a client". * a public footprint: GitHub, blog, X, a discord where you're known. we will read it. --- ## you're probably not our person if * your AI experience is "i added an OpenAI call to a Django app" * you're an ML engineer whose last three years were training pipelines and feature stores. real respect, but this isn't that role. * you list one provider on your CV. that signals you haven't compared. * you want a research role with whitepapers as the output. we ship to prod. every week. * you need a spec'd ticket to start working. --- ## how to apply skip the cover letter. send us this instead. 1. **one agent you've built.** a repo, a Loom, a deployed URL, anything. if IP stops you sharing, write 300 words on the most interesting agent design decision you've made and what you'd change next time. 2. **one opinion.** pick any two from `Codex`, `Cursor`, `Claude Code`, `Claude Cowork`, `Antigravity`. in three paragraphs, tell us which one you'd build a $10M production system on, and why. (this question is partly a rorschach. that's fine.) 3. your resume. separately. ``` to: careers@grabon.in subject: tool_use: { "name": "apply", "input": { "candidate": "[Your Name]" } } ``` we read every application. interesting work gets a reply within 5 business days. uninteresting work gets a reply too. we know some of you will use an LLM to help write this. we'd be hypocrites to mind. just don't let it sand off your voice. we can tell. --- ``` # TODO: take this posting down once we've hired 3. # if you can still see this, the seat is still open. ```

jobs.text: Creative Marketing Manager – Gen AI (6-Month Internship) Gameberry Labs | Bangalore | Flagship Games: Ludo STAR & Parchisi STAR Who We Are: Gameberry Labs, a thriving mobile games studio established in 2017 and headquartered in Bangalore, has aimed for an extraordinary vision – to become the premier game development company on a global scale. As a bootstrapped and profitable startup, Gameberry Labs has taken the mobile gaming scene by storm. We see them as personal buddies that boost our brains, melt away stress, and keep spirits high - anytime, anywhere. Our Mission: We want to make millions of people happy with games that they would love to grow old with. We are driven by a passion for creating exceptional gaming experiences that people will cherish for years to come. With our fearless team of dreamers and innovators, we are constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the world of mobile gaming. Highlight Reel: We’ve smashed through 300M+ game downloads — and counting! Our games have pulled in a whopping $275M+ in lifetime revenue. Over 15M+ players jump into our worlds every single month Both Parchisi STAR and Ludo STAR have each crossed the 120M+ download mark — absolute legends in their own right. Crowned Bootstrap Champ at the ET Startups Awards 2023 Dropped our latest hit “Sorry World” in Oct 2025 — hit #1 on the US Play Store in just 2 weeks! Oh, and yes — we’ve handled 1M+ players online at once without breaking a sweat. Cool Tidbits: Our games attract a monthly player base equivalent to the population of Australia, with over 20M players engaging each month! Players spend an astronomical 297.6 Mars round trips' worth of time on our games daily!!! About the Role We're creating a new kind of role at the intersection of UA creative strategy and hands-on Gen AI asset production. Traditionally, a Creative Marketing Manager researches what ads should say and look like, then briefs a design team to build them. This role collapses that gap: you will do both — research and hypothesise what creative concepts will move the needle for Ludo STAR and Parchisi STAR, and then personally generate the static ad assets at scale using AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, ComfyUI, Freepik, and Midjourney. This is a 6-month internship built for freshers — we're not looking for a finished creative director. We're looking for someone with a sharp analytical mind, a genuine eye for design, and real curiosity about generative AI tools, who wants to learn the UA creative process end-to-end on live, high-scale games. What You'll Do Research & Strategy Study what's working in our own top creatives and in competitor UA ads (board games and casual titles) across Google and Meta. Keep a pulse on creative ad trends, seasonal/cultural moments, and emerging ad formats relevant to our core markets. Translate performance data (CTR, CPI, IPM, ROAS by creative) into clear hypotheses for what to test next. Creative Briefing & Ideation Write detailed, structured creative briefs for new static concepts — audience, hook, message, visual direction. Come up with creative angles rooted in game mechanics, player motivations, and regional/cultural nuances (e.g. festival themes, local aesthetics, board-game nostalgia). Gen AI Production (the core of the role) Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, ComfyUI, Freepik, Midjourney, or similar) to produce static ad creatives at volume — both brand-new concepts and rapid versioning of currently winning creatives (new colorways, headline swaps, localized variants, festival/seasonal reskins). Maintain visual consistency with the Ludo STAR / Parchisi STAR brand identity across every asset. Iterate quickly based on early performance signals — this role is about volume and speed of testing, not one-off polished pieces. Workflow & Analysis Maintain trackers for creative requests, test status, and learnings. Partner closely with the UA/performance marketing team to close the loop between what's tested and what's learned. What We're Looking For A fresher or someone with up to ~1 year of experience — Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communication, Design, or a related field (or equivalent demonstrable skill). Genuine hands-on comfort with Gen AI image tools (ChatGPT/DALL·E, Midjourney, Freepik, ComfyUI, or similar) — you've made things with them, not just talked about them. Strong prompting instincts: you know how to iterate on a prompt to get a specific, consistent visual result. A solid design eye — composition, color, typography, and knowing when something "looks like an ad that would stop a scroll." Comfort with data: you can look at creative performance numbers and form an opinion about what to try next. Excellent written communication — you'll be writing briefs and defending creative choices. Self-directed and fast — comfortable with ambiguity and a high-volume, iterative way of working. Nice to Have Experience with node-based workflows (ComfyUI), LoRA training, or ControlNet/IPAdapter for style consistency at scale. Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, Google UAC, or app store creative requirements. Prior exposure to mobile gaming, UA, or performance marketing. Basic Photoshop/Figma/Canva skills for cleanup and finishing. What to Include in Your Application A short portfolio or sample set of any AI-generated visual work (any tool, any subject). A brief note on one project where you had to figure out a visual or communication problem — the brief, your approach, and what you'd change with more time. jobs.title: PostgreSQL Developer
jobs.text: About HabileLabs HabileLabs is a premier software development and consulting company dedicated to delivering high-quality technical solutions. We pride ourselves on engineering excellence and a culture that fosters innovation and continuous learning. We are looking for a disciplined PostgreSQL Developer who is passionate about database performance and scalable architecture. Role Objective As a PostgreSQL Developer, you will be the backbone of our data layer. You will design, develop, and optimize complex database systems that support high-traffic applications. Your goal is to ensure data integrity, security, and peak performance across all our PostgreSQL environments. Key Responsibilities Database Development: Design and implement robust database schemas, tables, and dictionary structures. Programming: Write and maintain high-performance PL/pgSQL, including complex stored procedures, triggers, and views. Performance Engineering: Analyze query execution plans using EXPLAIN ANALYZE and implement optimizations such as indexing (B-tree, GIN, GiST) and partitioning. Data Integrity: Ensure the consistency and reliability of data through proper normalization and constraint management. Maintenance: Monitor database performance, perform regular vacuuming, and manage bloating issues. Collaboration: Work closely with Backend Engineers and PMO to translate business requirements into efficient data models. Migration: Manage data migration, transformation, and scripting using Git for version control. Technical Skills & Requirements Education: B.Tech or M.Tech in Computer Science, IT, or a related Engineering discipline. Core Experience: 3 to 5 years of dedicated experience in PostgreSQL development and administration. SQL Mastery: Expert-level knowledge of SQL, including window functions, CTEs, and complex joins. Optimization: Strong experience in tuning slow queries and understanding PostgreSQL internals (WAL, Buffer Cache). Tools: Proficiency with pgAdmin, DBeaver, and command-line psql . Security: Knowledge of Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and data encryption practices. Advantageous: Experience with cloud databases (AWS RDS/Aurora) or NoSQL features within PostgreSQL (JSONB). Preferred Attributes Immediate Availability: Candidates who can join immediately or within 15 days. Analytical Mindset: Ability to troubleshoot complex data issues and provide scalable solutions. Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills for internal team coordination. Why Join Us? Engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse project domains. A transparent work culture focused on objective performance and growth. Competitive compensation package and employee-centric benefits.

Over the past few years there has been an explosion in unstructured data across industry driven by affordable sensing technologies and adoption of analytical instrumentation. This sudden increase in data has resulted in industries spending significant amounts of time collecting, organizing and analyzing content and very little time driving value with the data. HABER is focused on reversing this trend by helping our customers spend less time collecting and analyzing data and more time using HABER’s platform to drive efficiency, identify issues before they happen and uncover hidden potential. Role Overview: We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager who can translate complex industrial AI technology into clear, compelling narratives that drive product adoption. You will work closely with product teams, engineers, and leadership to turn technical capabilities into customer-focused stories, use cases, and sales assets. Responsibilities:  Develop clear product positioning and messaging for Haber’s software platforms and solutions.  Own website messaging and narrative for product pages, ensuring the value proposition, use cases, and differentiation are clearly communicated.  Create and maintain sales enablement assets including pitch decks, solution briefs, product explainers, and case studies.  Support go-to-market launches for new products, features, and industry solutions.  Work closely with product and engineering teams to translate technical capabilities into customer-focused value propositions.  Build industry-specific narratives and use cases for sectors such as pulp & paper, chemicals, and manufacturing.  Conduct competitive analysis and market research to identify differentiation opportunities.  Support marketing campaigns by creating product-led content such as webinars, white papers, and solution explainers.  Gather customer insights and feedback to help refine product messaging and positioning.  Partner with the sales team to articulate business impact and ROI narratives for enterprise customers. Qualifications:  Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.  2–3 years of experience in Product Marketing, B2B Marketing, Product Management, or SaaS marketing.  Strong ability to translate technical concepts into simple business value messaging.  Experience creating product marketing assets such as pitch decks, case studies, and product documentation.  Strong storytelling, communication, and presentation skills.  Ability to work in cross-functional environments with product, engineering, and sales teams.  Understanding of B2B marketing, SaaS products, and enterprise sales cycles

jobs.title: Assistant Manager – Business Development (Builders & Developers)

Strategic Partnerships • Build and nurture long-term relationships with top builders, developers, construction companies, co-working operators, and property management firms. • Present Kazam’s EV charging solutions, pricing models, and value proposition to senior decision-makers and CXOs. • Collaborate with marketing and product teams to create compelling collateral and pitch decks tailored to the real estate audience. 3. Consultative Selling & Solutioning • Deeply understand customer requirements—site layout, power availability, user profiles—and propose the right charging configuration. • Deliver ROI analyses, business proposals, and feasibility assessments to help clients make confident investment decisions. • Navigate technical and commercial discussions, aligning on scope, pricing, timelines, and implementation milestones. 4. Deal Closure & Execution • Convert qualified leads into signed contracts through a structured BD cycle. • Ensure all documentation—POs, agreements, payment terms—is aligned and processed on time. • Coordinate with operations and installation teams to deliver successful site deployments and maintain client satisfaction post-install. 5. Market Intelligence & GTM Input • Track trends in real estate EV-readiness, competitor activity, government EV policies, and green-building mandates. • Feed actionable insights to leadership for strategic planning, GTM refinement, and new segment prioritisation. What You Bring • 3–5 years of experience in B2B Sales or Business Development, preferably with exposure to real estate, proptech, or infrastructure sectors. • Strong working knowledge of the real estate ecosystem—builders, developers, facility managers, and property management workflows. • Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding aggressive revenue targets in a fast-paced environment. • Experience selling to CXOs, VPs, Directors, and Facility Heads; comfortable in boardroom conversations. • Strong negotiation, deal-structuring, and closing abilities. • Ownership mindset—you thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and hold yourself accountable for outcomes. • Cross-functional agility: ability to work closely with product, operations, marketing, and leadership teams. • Bonus: Experience or knowledge of EV charging, energy management, sustainability solutions, or government compliance frameworks. jobs.title: Manager Electronic Procurement
jobs.text: About Kazam Kazam is on a mission to enable the transition to sustainable transportation by building the operating system for EV charging. As a fast-scaling startup, we believe in leveraging cutting-edge technology and data to drive efficiencies and intelligent decision-making across all facets of our business — including procurement. Role Summary As the Manager Electronic Procurement, you will lead the digital transformation of Kazam’s procurement function. This is a strategic leadership role that combines supply chain expertise, procurement operations, and digital innovation to build scalable, transparent, and cost-effective sourcing and supplier management practices. You’ll oversee the design, implementation, and continuous optimization of e-Procurement platforms and workflows to support Kazam’s rapid growth and global ambitions. Key Responsibilities Strategic Leadership & Transformation ● Develop and execute a long-term vision for e-Procurement aligned with Kazam’s overall business and operational strategy. ● Lead the digitalization of procurement operations, driving automation, transparency, and scalability. ● Define and monitor procurement KPIs, ensuring alignment with cost, quality, delivery, and sustainability targets. Digital Systems & Technology Enablement ● Lead the selection, deployment, and integration of e-Procurement platforms (e.g., SAP Ariba, Coupa, Oracle, or custom solutions). ● Ensure seamless integration between procurement systems and other enterprise platforms (ERP, finance, inventory, etc.). ● Drive adoption of procurement tech across the organization through change management and user training. Supplier Management & Sourcing Excellence ● Oversee strategic sourcing, electronic tendering (RFPs, RFQs), e-auctions, and contract lifecycle management. ● Build a robust, agile supplier ecosystem that supports innovation, cost efficiency, and ESG goals. ● Implement digital supplier performance monitoring and risk assessment tools. Governance, Compliance & Risk Management ● Establish procurement governance policies, ensuring regulatory and ethical compliance across all sourcing activities. ● Proactively manage procurement risks, especially in relation to supply disruptions and digital system vulnerabilities. Team Leadership & Cross-functional Collaboration ● Lead and mentor a high-performing procurement team, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. ● Work cross-functionally with Engineering, Finance, Product, and Operations to understand sourcing needs and support business priorities. Qualifications & Experience -Must-Haves ● 5+ years of experience in electronic procurement/supply chain ● Proven success implementing and scaling e-Procurement systems in high-growth or tech-driven environments. ● Strong understanding of electronic parts , manufacturers. ● Strong understanding of procurement best practices, digital tools, and contract management. ● Excellent leadership, stakeholder engagement, and strategic thinking skills. Preferred ● Prior experience in EV , Automotive , Clean tech or Electronics Manufacturing sectors ● Working knowledge of sustainable procurement practices and ESG frameworks. ● Advanced degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or related field. ● Certifications: CPSM, CIPS, PMP, or equivalent. What You’ll Love at Kazam ● Be part of a mission-driven company at the forefront of the EV revolution. ● Drive digital transformation in a critical operational function. ● Work in a flat, agile, and innovative culture that values bold ideas. ● Collaborate with cross-functional teams that are passionate about impact and sustainability. Join Us If you're a tech-savvy procurement leader who thrives on building scalable systems, challenging the status quo, and delivering impact at speed — we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Buyer 1-3, Machining & Forging
jobs.text: Position Summary: Manage the supply base to meet the strategic objectives of Global Procurement and the needs of internal and external customers, product groups, and manufacturing in terms of quality, cost, delivery, and commercial terms. Independently manage assigned commodities and suppliers, execute sourcing strategies, lead negotiations, drive cost reduction and supplier performance improvement initiatives, and support more complex cross-functional procurement activities. Essential Functions: Develop, implement, and manage commodity strategies for assigned categories; evaluate and select suppliers, assess global sourcing opportunities, negotiate supply agreements, and support supply base rationalization. Assist with supplier management activities for assigned lower-complexity commodities, with development toward independently managing selected suppliers and standard components over time. Collect and analyze supplier quotations, pricing changes, delivery information, and basic cost drivers to support sourcing decisions and negotiations. Coordinate with engineering, quality, operations, planning, finance, and suppliers to support part changes, supplier performance follow-up, launch readiness, and continuity of supply. Support cost reduction, productivity, and supplier improvement initiatives by preparing data, tracking actions, following up on open items, and documenting savings or avoidance opportunities. Learn and apply procurement processes, ERP/SAP transactions, supplier communication practices, and internal approval workflows under guidance from the category team. Develop capability to manage supplier issues, escalate risks, support recovery actions, and contribute to long-term supply base strategy as experience grows. Knowledge: Foundational understanding of purchasing, supply chain, supplier management, and basic business processes, with willingness and ability to learn procurement practices quickly. Basic knowledge of manufacturing environments, supplier performance measures, and quality, delivery, cost, and responsiveness expectations. Developing understanding of how business, engineering, operations, manufacturing, and purchasing priorities connect. Basic familiarity with ERP/MRP concepts and purchasing systems; SAP experience or exposure preferred but not required. Experience: 1-3 years of purchasing, supply chain, operations, manufacturing, engineering, or related experience; strong co-op, internship, or rotational program experience will be considered. Preferred experience or exposure managing, supporting, or purchasing C-class components, including nuts, bolts, washers, labels, fasteners, or other standard components. Nice to have basic exposure to stampings, machining, forgings, special components, supplier quotations, part drawings, bills of material, or manufacturing cost drivers. Experience working with ERP or purchasing systems preferred; SAP exposure is a plus. Exposure to quote analysis, supplier follow-up, cost reduction support, negotiation preparation, or project tracking is preferred but not required. Skills: High learning agility with a strong interest in procurement, supplier management, manufacturing, and commercial problem solving. Strong attention to detail, follow-through, organization, and ability to manage multiple priorities with guidance. Analytical mindset with ability to review quotes, pricing data, supplier information, part details, and basic cost drivers. Effective communication skills with ability to interact professionally with suppliers and internal stakeholders across engineering, quality, operations, planning, and finance. Problem-solving capability, including active listening, issue identification, data review, escalation, and timely follow-up. Comfort working in a fast-paced, matrixed environment with willingness to learn global and regional procurement processes. Basic negotiation awareness preferred, including preparation, data gathering, supplier communication, and support for commercial discussions. Education: Bachelor's degree required; Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, or related field preferred. Co-op, internship, or academic project experience in Purchasing, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Engineering, or Operations is strongly preferred. Position Requirements: The demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Technician, Service- Packaging- 2nd shift
jobs.text: Mon - Fri 3 PM - 11 PM, $20.88/hr + $1/hr differential + mandatory overtime (2 hours earlier/ day + Saturdays on occasion) Benefits start day one! General: Responsible for ensuring products are packaged safely and accurately for shipment in accordance with company standards and customer specifications. This role includes inspecting, labeling, sealing, and packing items, as well as operating various equipment and machinery as needed. Workers are expected to perform thorough quality inspections to maintain accuracy and product integrity, while also completing all required documentation in a timely and accurate manner. Key Duties Inspect products for quality and accuracy prior to packaging Label, seal, and pack items according to specifications Operate packaging equipment and machinery safely and efficiently Maintain compliance with company standards and customer requirements Assist with inventory management as needed Work Environment & Expectations Work in a fast-paced environment requiring prolonged standing Perform frequent lifting and handling of parts Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area Follow all safety procedures and guidelines at all times Workers will be cross trained on multiple stations within the department, with the first day consisting of observational training. Work Location: BDC (Bendix Distribution Center) Additional Duties: Other responsibilities may be assigned as needed. Packaging Workstation: Auto Bagger – The worker will enter production order information into the system, retrieve parts from the presentation area, and transport them to the workstation. Based on the production order, parts will be placed into automated bowls that feed items into bags and/or manually fed into bags as required. A first-piece inspection must be completed at the start of each order. Once a full tote of packaged parts is completed, it will be transferred to a pallet box. Hand Bagger – The worker will input production order information into the system, retrieve parts from the presentation area, and transport them to the workstation. In accordance with the production order, parts will be packaged manually into bags. A first-piece inspection is required. Completed totes of bagged parts will then be loaded into a pallet box. Jones Machine – The worker will enter production order information into the system, retrieve parts from the presentation area, and transport them to the workstation. Based on the production order, parts will be manually placed into boxes supplied via conveyor. A first-piece inspection must be completed. Once a tote is filled, it will be loaded into a pallet box. Hand Pack – The worker will input production order information into the system, retrieve parts from the presentation area, and move them to the workstation. Per production order requirements, parts will be manually packed into boxes. A first-piece inspection must be completed. Depending on job specifications, parts may be packed individually or as full totes, then loaded into a pallet box or placed individually on a pallet. Taper Line – The worker will enter production order information into the system, retrieve parts from the presentation area, and transport them to the workstation. Parts will be manually packed into boxes according to production order requirements. A first-piece inspection is required. Depending on specifications, parts may be packed individually or as full totes, then loaded into pallet boxes or placed individually on pallets. This role involves higher production volume compared to the Hand Pack position. Hoist Line – The worker will input production order information into the system, retrieve parts from the presentation area, and move them to the workstation. Per production order requirements, parts will be manually packed and placed individually onto pallets using a hoist or lift-assist device. A first-piece inspection must be completed. Spider – The material handler is responsible for supporting all production areas by supplying raw materials to bagging stations, production lines, and machinery to ensure continuous workflow. This position requires forklift operation and maintaining efficient material flow. Tools: Staple gun, shipping tape gun, utility knives, RF scanner computer/software, printers, pallet jack, forklift, and hoist apparatus. Protective Personal Equipment: Steel toe shoes, anti-fatigue mats, and anti-cut gloves are optional. Environment: The work environment is climate-controlled but can be noisy, with frequent heavy forklift traffic. Workers work collaboratively with others to ensure production is maintained at the required pace throughout the shift. Essential Job Requirements Must be able to maintain good attendance including working overtime as required Must be able to safely and effectively operate in an industrial environment Must be able to read, write and comprehend work instructions, communications, policies, job safety analysis, etc. Must be able to perform basic mathematical calculations Must be able to communicate effectively, verbally and in writing Must be able to reason, analyze and trouble shoot issues on the job Must be able to work as a team member, including but not limited to resolving issues as part of a team, and get along with co-workers Must be able to consistently meet production, safety and quality standards Must be able to safely and effectively perform all functions of the job as described in the physical job analysis listed below Must be willing to participate in daily pre-work stretching program Must be willing to assume other duties as assigned Must be able to wear required personal protective equipment as described in the standardized work instructions Must be able to comply with customer requirements (ex. Shipping instructions, packaging requirements, etc.) Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds Must be able to stand for long periods of time

jobs.title: Facilities Technician- 1st shift
jobs.text: Facilities Technician Position Summary The Facilities Technician B performs skilled maintenance, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance independently. This role is responsible for diagnosing issues, maintaining facility systems, and ensuring reliable building operations. Key Responsibilities Maintenance & Troubleshooting Troubleshoot and repair HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and mechanical systems. Diagnose equipment malfunctions and implement corrective actions. Install and replace building components and equipment. Interpret basic blueprints, manuals, and schematics. Coordinate with vendors as needed. Preventive Maintenance Perform and document scheduled preventive maintenance on: HVAC systems (motors, belts, filters, coils). Pumps, compressors, and mechanical equipment. Electrical panels and distribution components (as permitted). Plumbing systems and fixtures. Conduct operational testing and performance checks. Identify trends and recommend PM improvements. Assist in maintaining computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) records. Support development of improved maintenance schedules. Team Support Mentor Technician C employees. Assist Technician A on major repairs and system upgrades. Ensure work areas remain clean and organized. Skills & Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent; trade certification preferred. 3–5 years of maintenance or skilled trade experience. Working knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, and electrical systems. Strong troubleshooting ability. Ability to read technical manuals and schematics. Strong documentation skills. Level of Autonomy Works independently on most assignments. Escalates highly complex issues. May lead small maintenance projects.

jobs.title: Facilities Maintenance Technician- Commercial HVAC Journeyman
jobs.text: POSITION SUMMARY: The Facilities Department is responsible for repairs, maintenance, and modifications to the site, building, and production supports systems (e.g. HVAC, electricity, compressed air, plumbing, etc.). To perform the tasks related to these responsibilities, Bendix utilizes a mixture of contractors and in-house labor. The in-house labor, being the Facilities Department Technician (technician) will usually be assigned tasks via the computerized maintenance management system (CMMS), then complete the assigned tasks, either solo, part of a team, and or by working with a designated contractor. We are looking for a Licensed Commercial HVAC Journeyman in Kentucky with a Valid EPA Certification. Upon assignment of a repair, the technician will investigate and perform a root cause analysis, then work to make immediate repairs, as well as develop and communicate countermeasures that will prevent the failure in the future. If parts are needed, the technician will either utilize the onsite spare parts inventory, or research to determine what resource outside of Bendix has the necessary materials. The technician will communicate with the appropriate parties to schedule the work, go about the activities to complete the work, then complete the necessary Return to Service documents, and document all the labor, parts, and materials in the CMMS with closure of the work order. Upon assignment of preventive maintenance activities, the technician will review the job plan, gather the indicated tools, and materials, adhere to the indicated safety plan then complete the indicated tasks to the best of his ability. Upon completion of the PM activities, the technician is expected to test the machine or system, replace all panels and applicable fasteners, clean up the work area, return tools and unused materials to appropriate locations, and document all the labor and materials used in the CMMS. When assigned a modification, the technician could be expected to work with the designer to prepare for the modification in a variety of ways. Either by assisting with data gathering, selection of parts and materials, layout of piping and components, planning or scheduling of the work, or other assignments as necessary. As the Bendix culture supports continuous improvement, the technician is expected to look for, and report, recommendations for the improvement of job plans, spare parts inventory, tools used, communication methods, planning, etc. The technician may be asked to analyze failure frequency, or failure modes, or other available information necessary to determine an improvement to one of the areas of responsibility. ESSENTIAL DUTIES: Use the CMMS to receive work assignments, look up parts, materials, and tools in advance of the actual work. Use the CMMS to record readings, conditions found, time, date, and other triggers for maintenance activity Use the CMMS to document activity information, to capture labor information, and to close out the assignment. Utilize checklists to perform Autonomous Maintenance walks on the Facilities Department areas of responsibility, and report anomalies found. Provide and utilize basic hand tools to complete the assigned repairs, maintenance, and modifications Keep tool boxes, storage cabinets, work areas, machines, and systems clean, clear of trash, and well organized (i.e. 5S) Perform repairs, maintenance, and modifications in safe, efficient, and high-quality manner with little or minimal disruption to operations Perform root cause analysis of failures to determine necessary repairs and countermeasures Complete required trainings and on schedule Participate in meetings related to the department and training QUALIFICATIONS: Licensed Commercial HVAC Journeyman with Valid EPA certification required. Possess and provide basic hand tools, chest, box, and or bag, needed to perform the work, large and common tools will be provided by Bendix Must be able to fluently communicate in English, with writing, reading, and speaking Must be able to perform basic math and arithmetic functions Must hold a diploma from an accredited high school, or an approved equivalent (e.g. GED); prefer candidate to have successfully completed some type of technical degree (e.g. engineering, physics, mathematics, etc.) Understands and can teach the refrigeration cycle Possess a current license, preferably Universal level, to procure and handle chlorinated fluorocarbon refrigerants Must be able to read and understand wiring schematics and diagrams Experienced in an industrial facilities maintenance role, incorporating HVAC, pneumatics, hydraulics, electrical, and controls. Knowledgeable of a computerized maintenance management system of some variety, preferably SAP-Plant Maintenance Module. Able to search and utilize the internet as a resource for maintenance needs. Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, or some other spreadsheet software Basic knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, or some other email software Knowledgeable of, and experience with, root cause analysis tools, such as 5 Whys, A self-starter, with high quality and performance values. Willing and able to work on all assignments from restroom to roof PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: Able to perform physical activities such as walking, kneeling, squatting, lifting, pushing and pulling for extended periods Able to carry tools, parts, refrigerant etc. Able to work atop roof, ladders, and lifts Able to operate various types of powered industrial trucks and personnel lifts Able to discern colors In performing the essential elements of this position the following physical activities are required. The activities are measured in the amount of on-the-job time that is spent performing these activities. jobs.text: Position Summary : The production planner is responsible for translating customer demand and business forecasts into executable production and material plans that support on-time delivery, inventory optimization, and operational efficiency. This role serves as a critical link between Customer Service, Production, Purchasing, Engineering, Logistics, and Suppliers to ensure material availability, schedule adherence, and achievement of service level objectives. Develop and maintain short-, medium-, and long-term production schedules aligned with customer demand, capacity constraints, and inventory targets. Convert demand requirements into executable production plans and manufacturing orders. Balance customer requirements, production capacity, labor availability, and material constraints to optimize plant performance. Drive schedule adherence and production order fill rate performance. Monitor capacity utilization and identify opportunities to improve throughput and resource efficiency. Support SIOP, forecasting, and demand review processes Monitor inventory levels, safety stock strategies, excess and obsolete inventory, and inventory turns Review component shortages and develop mitigation plans to avoid production disruptions. Manage production order releases, prioritization, and scheduling activities within SAP. Perform ATP reviews, shortage analysis, and production readiness assessments. Analyze and resolve system exceptions including COGI and planning errors. Coordinate engineering changes, PPAP implementation, prototype launches, and BOM updates. Ensure proper execution of production labeling and manufacturing documentation processes. Act as a primary planning liaison between Manufacturing, Purchasing, Customer Service, Logistics, Engineering, Quality, and Suppliers Analyze planning performance metrics and identify improvement opportunities. Lead root cause investigations for shortages, backlog, inventory discrepancies, schedule misses, and delivery failures. Develop corrective and preventive actions to improve planning effectiveness. Support digital planning initiatives, process standardization, and automation projects Support PSA Activities and procedures with team members. Perform all those activities that by the nature of the position are required. Management & Supervisory Responsibilities: N/A Experience: 5+ years of experience in production planning, supply planning, scheduling, materials management, or supply chain operations. Experience in a manufacturing environment required. Experience supporting SIOP processes preferred. Experience managing supplier-related material constraints and recovery plans preferred. Skills: Advanced SAP ERP/MRP knowledge. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Production scheduling and capacity planning. Inventory management and optimization. Material Requirements Planning (MRP) Data analysis and reporting. Forecasting and demand planning principles. 100% Bilingual (English/Spanish) Education/Certifications: Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or related field. APICS/ASCM certification preferred

jobs.title: Komponentmontör
jobs.text: Komponentmontör till Knorr-Bremse – Gör skillnad varje dag Vill du ha ett arbete där du gör verklig skillnad? I vår serviceverksamhet handlar jobbet om mer än demontering och montering, det handlar om att säkerställa att våra kunders tåg hålls rullande och bidra till säkra transporter i hela Europa. Som en del av vårt team blir du en viktig länk i ett flöde som påverkar tusentals resenärer och godstransporter. Här får du möjlighet att kombinera praktiskt arbete med tekniska moment, utveckla din kompetens och arbeta i en miljö där samarbete och ansvar är centrala värden. Om du uppskattar att ta ansvar, arbeta tillsammans med andra och se konkreta resultat av ditt arbete, då är du rätt person för oss på Knorr-Bremse. Vi söker nu komponentmontörer till vår serviceverksamhet i Lund. Hos oss får du lära dig hur bromssystemen på tåg är uppbyggda och bidra till att skapa säkra och hållbara transportlösningar. Du kommer att arbeta med demontering, montering och slutprovning av bromskomponenter i olika produktionslinjer. Arbetet kräver att du kan läsa ritningar och att du är noggrann med en stark känsla för kvalitet. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från montering och underhållsarbete, gärna inom pneumatik eller hydraulik, samt om du har arbetat i team tidigare. Vana vid momentdragning och användning av limmet Loctite är också önskvärt. Som person är du positiv, flexibel och ordningsam. Du motiveras av att lära dig nya saker och har en god samarbetsförmåga. Du vågar fråga när du behöver stöd och bidrar med ditt bästa för att uppnå produktionens mål. Vi värdesätter serviceinriktning, struktur och initiativförmåga, och vi tror att du trivs med att arbeta i team där alla hjälps åt för att nå gemensamma resultat. Hos Knorr-Bremse blir du en del av ett engagerat team där vi värdesätter kvalitet, samarbete och utveckling. Vi erbjuder både visstidsanställning till ett längre projekt men också tillsvidareanställning. Vi har kollektivavtal Teknikavtalet - IF Metall. Till vår verksamhet i Lund finns det möjlighet att åka med kollektivtrafik. Vidare erbjuds du friskvårdsbidrag, frukost varje morgon och stora utvecklingsmöjligheter. Arbetet är förlagt på dagtid, måndag till fredag, med möjlighet till flextid. Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan via vår hemsida redan idag! Vi arbetar med löpande urval och ser gärna att du ansöker snarast, dock senast söndag 23 augusti 2026. Vänligen notera att under sommarperioden hanteras ansökningar i begränsad utsträckning, vilket kan innebära längre återkopplingstid än vanligt. Vi har inte heller någon möjlighet att ta emot ansökningar via e-post. Har du frågor är du välkommen att kontakta Frida Dahlqvist, HR Generalist, på frida.dahlqvist@knorr-bremse.com.

jobs.title: TACTICAL PLANNER
jobs.text: Position Summary: Tactical Planner is an entry-level, tactical role responsible for executing foundational SAP transactions and clerical activities in support of Central Planner 2, Central Planner 3, and Supplier Integrators. This position focuses on transactional accuracy, documentation discipline, foundational SAP execution and maintenance, and report distribution. The role does not include planning decisions, shortage management, or decision-making. Essential Functions: • Create, adjust, and maintain purchase orders for externally sourced components • Update purchase orders with supplier-acknowledged ship dates and quantities • Confirm purchase order pricing and quantities, support invoice matching • Input and maintain customer and supplier order data within ERP systems • Transmit releases to suppliers and track acknowledgements • Assist in monitoring inventory levels and inventory accuracy for purchased components • Maintain material master, purchasing info records, and planning parameters as directed • Ensure FIFO compliance through data accuracy and transaction timing (no physical handling) • Track inbound shipments and verify receipt or non-receipt for purchased materials • Communicate with freight carriers, customs brokers, and logistics partners as needed • Support expediting activities by tracking delivery risks and hot parts • Maintain documentation related to compliance (packing slips) • Refresh and distribute standard purchasing and inventory reports • Document discrepancies, corrective actions, and transaction changes • Maintain filing and audit documentation for orders and receipts • Interface with Purchasing, Supplier Integration, Quality, and Finance teams • Participate in cross-functional meetings to build supply chain knowledge • Follow EHS and system governance requirements Knowledge: • SAP navigation and data entry; detail orientation; documentation discipline; basic Excel/report refresh; clear written communication. •Basic knowledge of MRP/ERP systems (SAP preferred). •Understanding of data integrity and system alignments, supplier risk management, escalation processes, and compliance frameworks. Experience: • 0–2 years in supply chain/operations (SAP exposure preferred). Skills: • Ability to establish credibility and trust. • Ability to manage projects and assignments with little guidance. • Basic interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills. • Possesses good analytical skills. • Ability to influence and persuade to inspire action. • Self-starter who is action oriented and possesses a strong sense of urgency. • Capable of performing in a customer-focused, team-based matrix organization is essential. • Capable of successfully performing independently as well as in a team setting. • Possesses advanced planning and organizational skills. • Results oriented with demonstrated capability of meeting tight deadlines. • Basic systems and data management skills required. • Proficient in Microsoft Office products. • Possesses the skills to extract data from system queries to create management reports. Education: • Bachelor’s degree in operations, Supply Chain Management, or Business Administration preferred.
