jobs.title: Site Engineer 1 (Base in Singapore)
jobs.text: Location: Singapore Full-Time. Initial 3-Year Contract (Renewable) Reporting To: Project Manager/Project Engineer Position Summary We are seeking a proactive Site Engineer to join our team for a long-term Land Transport Authority (LTA) project focused on Platform Screen Door (PSD) systems. This role involves supervising and coordinating site activities including replacement, upgrading, testing, commissioning, and lifecycle management of PSD electronic and mechanical components. You will play a key role in ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant execution of works in a live railway environment. Key Responsibilities Site Supervision: Coordinate and supervise daily site activities for PSD component replacement and installation. Installation & Testing: Coordinate dismantling, alignment, adjustment, fault rectification & Troubleshooting, testing and commissioning works. Quality & Safety: Ensure compliance with LTA, SMRT, and railway safety standards. Stakeholder Coordination: Liaise with subcontractors, planning teams, and site personnel to ensure smooth execution. Reporting: Prepare daily site reports, inspection records, and work progress updates. Technical Support: Assist in troubleshooting, fault rectification, risk assessments, and method statement preparation. Standby for Defect Liability Support What We’re Looking For Diploma/Degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related discipline. 3–5 years of experience in railway, MRT, E&M, or infrastructure projects. Experience in LTA/MRT-related projects in Singapore preferred. Familiarity with Platform Screen Door systems, CANbus networks, and railway operational constraints. Ability to interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, and specifications. Strong coordination, communication, and problem-solving skills. Preferred Extras Experience in live operational railway environments. Familiarity with LTA, SMRT, or SBS Transit procedures. Knowledge of permit-to-work systems and railway safety requirements. If you’re hands-on, detail-oriented, and ready to take on a dynamic role in Singapore’s railway projects, we’d love to hear from you. Interested candidates, please apply here with upload your CV and cover letter. Personal Data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.

jobs.title: Service Center Engineer (Base in Singapore)
jobs.text: Location: Singapore Report to: Service Center Manager Position type: Permanent Job Summary The Service Center Engineer is responsible for servicing, troubleshooting, repair, overhaul, testing, and maintenance of railway control systems and related components in the service center. The role also supports the Service Center Manager in daily operations, including maintaining equipment and tools, managing spare parts and inventory, and ensuring the workshop is safe, clean, and well-organized. This includes coordinating timely availability of parts, resolving non-conformances, and supporting continuous improvement of service center activities. Key Roles & Responsibilities Service Repair & Overhaul Perform inspection, troubleshooting, repair, overhaul, and functional testing brake control systems and components. Diagnose electrical, pneumatic, and mechanical faults in brake equipment. Disassemble, clean, inspect, repair, and reassemble brake control units and assemblies. Replace defective parts and perform adjustment and calibration activities. Conduct overhaul activities according to OEM manuals, maintenance procedures, and customer requirements. Perform pressure, leakage, and functional tests after repair and overhaul. Ensure repaired units meet technical performance and safety standards. Technical Support & Troubleshooting Analyze failure modes and support root cause investigation. Prepare technical findings and repair reports. Support field service teams on technical escalations when required. Assist engineering team in reliability improvement initiatives. Support warranty and failure analysis activities. Workshop & Service Center Operations Maintain accurate repair and overhaul records. Update service status in SAP systems. Support spare parts tracking and inventory control. Ensure special tools and testing equipment are properly maintained and calibrated. Support continuous improvement and productivity initiatives. Quality, Safety & Compliance Follow railway safety standards, workshop SOPs, and quality procedures. Maintain proper housekeeping and 5S standards in the workshop. Support internal and external quality audits. Requirements: Qualification and Experience Bachelor’s Degree / Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related discipline. At least 3-5years of relevant experience in railway, MRT, E&M, or infrastructure projects. Experience in LTA or MRT-related projects in Singapore is preferred and experience in installation, testing and maintenance is an advantage Familiarity with LTA, SMRT or SBS Transit engineering procedures and safety requirements. Preferred skills and technical competencies Knowledge of permit-to-work systems and railway safety procedures. Ability to interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, and engineering specifications. Knowledge of testing, troubleshooting, and site coordination practices. Proficient in Microsoft Office and basic reporting tools. Strong communication skills, stakeholder coordination and good teamwork Personal Data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.

jobs.title: Quality Manager (Base in Singapore)
jobs.text: Location: Singapore Full-Time. Initial 3-Year Contract (Renewable) Reporting to: General Manager, Singapore Branch Office Position Summary We’re looking for a Quality Specialist/Manager to champion excellence across railway projects, service center repairs, and overhaul operations. You will act as the primary focal point for quality assurance, investigations, corrective actions, and customer communication, driving excellence and continuous improvement across the organization. Key Responsibilities Quality Management : Develop, implement, and maintain the Quality Management System (QMS) in line with ISO 9001, LTA, SMRT, and railway standards. ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification. At least 8 years’ experience in railway/MRT/infrastructure quality management. Strong knowledge of QMS, railway standards, and inspection/testing procedures. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage multiple quality issues in a fast-paced railway environment. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and quality reporting/document control systems. Preferred Extras Experience with Platform Screen Door systems. Familiarity with LTA, SMRT, SBS Transit procedures. Background in railway asset renewal or lifecycle projects. This is a unique opportunity to play a critical role in ensuring the safety, reliability, and compliance of Singapore’s railway projects. You’ll work closely with engineering teams, service centers, and customers to uphold the highest standards of quality and operational excellence. We offer stability, growth, and the chance to make a lasting impact on Singapore’s rail infrastructure. Personal Data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.

jobs.title: Lagermedarbetare
jobs.text: Lagermedarbetare till Knorr-Bremse Rail Systems Sweden AB i Lund! Vill du ha ett jobb där du gör verklig skillnad, varje dag? Hos oss handlar jobbet om mer än lager och logistik. Du blir en del av ett flöde som håller tågen rullande och bidrar till säkra transporter i hela Europa. Här får du arbeta praktiskt, utveckla din kompetens och arbeta i ett team som stöttar varandra. Om du gillar ansvar, samarbete och att se resultat av ditt arbete, och har möjlighet att börja omgående, då är du rätt person för oss! Som lagermedarbetare hos Knorr-Bremse får du en varierad arbetsdag där du arbetar med plockning och packning både för hand och med truck, lastning och lossning av lastbilar samt inleverans av gods. I rollen kan det också förekomma utkörning och transporter av mindre gods, vilket innebär att B-körkort är ett krav. En del av ditt arbete kommer också innebära avsyning, registrering och hantering av både serviceprodukter och reklamationer. Du kommer att ha tät kontakt med kollegor i såväl Sverige som Europa och världen samt kunder och transportörer. En stor del av vårt dagliga arbete sker i SAP, där vi hanterar hela flödet – från ankomstregistrering och utleveranser till fakturering. Vi arbetar kontinuerligt för att säkerställa att rätt produkter finns i lager och att kvaliteten uppfyller gällande standarder. Dagliga inventeringar och interna kvalitetskontroller, både i SAP och i externa system, är en naturlig del av arbetet. För att lyckas i rollen krävs god förmåga att hantera digitala lösningar och affärssystem. Vi söker dig som är serviceinriktad, strukturerad och initiativtagande, och som trivs med att arbeta i team. Som person är du positiv, flexibel och ordningsam, och du motiveras av att lära dig nya saker. Det är viktigt att du har en god samarbetsförmåga, vågar fråga om hjälp och har en stark vilja att bidra med ditt bästa för att uppnå produktionens mål. Hos oss är din personlighet och din vilja att utvecklas viktigare än tidigare erfarenhet. Vi tror på att rätt inställning och engagemang är nyckeln till framgång, resten lär vi dig på vägen. Hos Knorr-Bremse blir du en del av ett engagerat team på 10 personer där vi värdesätter kvalitet, samarbete och utveckling. Hos oss har du många bollar i luften, jobbar med alla typer av arbetsuppgifter och hoppar in där det behövs. Ingen dag är den andra lik, vi hjälps åt och ser till att jobbet blir gjort tillsammans. Vi erbjuder en visstidsanställning på 6 månader enligt kollektivavtal Teknikavtalet – IF Metall. Start önskas omgående. Arbetet är förlagt på dagtid, måndag till fredag, med möjlighet till flextid. Krav: B-körkort Truckkort A1-4, B1 och B2 Svenska och engelska flytande Meriterande: Erfarenhet i SAP Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag och bli en del av vårt team. Kontakt och ansökan: Vi arbetar med löpande urval och ser gärna att ansöker via hemsidan snarast, dock senast söndag den 2026-08-23. Vänligen notera att under sommarperioden hanteras ansökningar i begränsad utsträckning, vilket kan innebära längre återkopplingstid än vanligt. Frågor besvaras av Kristoffer Jensen, Teamleader lager på kristoffer.jensen@knorr-bremse.com eller Frida Dahlqvist, HR Generalist på frida.dahlqvist@knorr-bremse.com . Om Knorr-Bremse: Knorr-Bremse har haft ett enda uppdrag i över 110 år: att göra mobilitet på vägar och järnvägar säker, hållbar och miljövänlig. Idag är Knorr-Bremse-koncernen, med huvudkontor i München, Tyskland, världens ledande tillverkare av bromssystem och en ledande leverantör av säkerhetskritiska delsystem för järnvägs- och nyttofordon. Vi ser oss själva som en innovatör inom våra områden som driver mobilitets- och transporttekniken framåt. Den grundläggande omvandlingen av rörligheten öppnar nya möjligheter för Knorr-Bremse. Globala megatrender som urbanisering, ekoeffektivitet, digitalisering och automatiserad körning definierar dessa förändringar. Vi är idealiskt positionerade för att hjälpa till att forma en ny värld av rörlighet. Mer än 30 000 anställda ägnar all sin expertis och passion åt våra kunder och partners – på över 100 platser i mer än 30 länder runt om i världen Besök https://www.knorr-bremse.com/en/ för mer information om företaget

jobs.title: Category Lead
jobs.text: About Lenskart Twelve years ago, Lenskart started with a simple mission—to eliminate preventable blindness. What began as a small startup has now become Asia’s largest eyewear company , having served over 40 million customers globally. With 10,000+ Lenskartians, 2000+ omnichannel stores across 175+ cities in India, Singapore, Dubai, and beyond, we now ship a pair of eyewear every 2.5 seconds—powered by one of the world’s most automated eyewear factories. Investors include Softbank, ADIA, Temasek, Kedaara Capital, Premji Invest, KKR, Alpha Wave, Bay Capital. Our Next Chapter We’re on an ambitious mission to serve 1 billion eyes in 2025 . And we’re going beyond vision correction—to transform how people see and experience the world. This requires cutting-edge technology, unmatched customer experience, and exceptional people. Our strategic priorities over the next three years include tech innovation, global expansion, manufacturing scale-up, and building a deep bench of entrepreneurial talent. We’re growing existing categories, entering new ones, and scaling across geographies and channels. The Role: Category Head As Category Head, you will be the business owner of your category—responsible for driving exponential growth through product strategy, assortment, pricing, and margin management. You will own the entire P&L , playing a critical role in shaping customer experience, influencing repeat behaviour, and transforming eyewear from a utility to a fashion-first, high-frequency purchase. Key Responsibilities P&L and Business Ownership Full ownership of category P&L: revenue, margins, inventory turns and working capital. Drive top-line growth and bottom-line profitability across all channels (online, offline, home). 2. Strategic Category Management Build and execute the category growth roadmap. Lead assortment planning: width, depth, OTB, category gaps, and range rationalization. Define the right mix of core vs. fashion, trend-led vs. evergreen. 3. Buying & Merchandising Lead seasonal buying across geographies and channels. Partner with vendors and in-house design teams to drive trend-forward innovation. Reorder high-performing styles and ensure sufficient stock (DOH) on bestsellers. 4. Launches & Channel Execution Plan successful collection launches with targeted store assortments. Collaborate with Marketing, VM, and Training teams to drive GTM success. Avoid over-spread by tailoring assortments by store type, geography, and consumer profile. 5. Daily Trade & Lifecycle Management Monitor ROS and manage the product lifecycle: launches, in-season moves, and exits. Optimize store and warehouse distribution; identify slow movers and take timely actions. Recommend data-led product pricing and discounting strategies. Conduct product trainings for store teams to boost conversions and engagement. 6. Margins, Inventory & Quality Control Own and manage product costing to deliver healthy margins. Maintain inventory discipline with strong turns and minimal ageing. Uphold the Lenskart quality promise —reduce returns and NPS detractors by ensuring consistent product quality. Ideal Candidate 7+ years of relevant experience in category management, buying, or merchandising. Fashion industry experience preferred. Strong commercial acumen with a deep understanding of consumer trends and market insights. Proven track record in P&L ownership and scaling categories. High ownership mindset; collaborative and impact oriented. Data-driven, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Join us to shape the future of eyewear—and how the world sees.

jobs.title: Replineshment Lead
jobs.text: Role Title: AI Replenishment Intelligence Lead Location: Delhi, India | On-site | Full-time Mission Brief: Reinvent How Lenskart Never Runs Out — or Runs Over This is not a replenishment role. This is a product transformation mandate . Lenskart operates one of India's largest and fastest-scaling retail networks — thousands of stores, millions of SKUs, and a supply chain that must move at the speed of fashion and the precision of science. Today, our replenishment function is being fundamentally reimagined: from reactive and rule-based to predictive, intelligent, and productized as a scalable AI platform . You will be the architect of that shift. As the AI Replenishment Intelligence Lead , you will own the end-to-end product vision, design, and deployment of Lenskart's AI-driven replenishment platform — a system that ensures the right product reaches the right store at the right moment, every time. You will operate at the intersection of machine intelligence, product management, and retail operations , converting data into decision systems that directly drive availability, profitability, and customer delight across India and global markets. If you've been waiting for a role where AI is not a feature but the core product , this is it. 🔑 Core Mandate 1. AI Platform Development — Build the Brain Own the product vision, roadmap, and lifecycle of Lenskart's replenishment intelligence platform. Define and evolve the product architecture for real-time inventory visibility, ML-driven demand forecasting, dynamic safety stock models, and system-generated replenishment decisions that eliminate manual intervention. Translate complex retail and supply chain problems into clear product requirements, user stories, and technical specifications for Data Science and Engineering teams. Act as the product owner for all AI/ML capabilities within replenishment, ensuring models are production-ready, scalable, and continuously improving. Drive success through clearly defined product metrics such as forecast accuracy (MAPE/WAPE), fill rates, inventory turns, and system adoption — and own these as core product KPIs. 2. Intelligent Assortment & Inventory Optimization — Drive the Business Build and scale AI-powered product features that solve high-impact commercial problems: assortment optimization (store-wise product mix), demand sensing across fashion cycles, and automated markdown and liquidation intelligence. Design systems that dynamically connect inventory decisions with financial and customer outcomes , influencing working capital efficiency, sell-through, and availability. Transform Open-to-Buy into a real-time, system-led product capability , where buying signals are continuously optimized based on live demand, inventory health, and business goals — moving from static planning to always-on decisioning systems . 3. Cross-Functional Leadership — Drive Adoption Drive product adoption and behavioral change across Merchandising, Supply Chain, Finance, and Retail Operations. Ensure the platform is not just built, but deeply embedded into daily decision-making. Act as the voice of the user , continuously refining the product based on stakeholder feedback, usability insights, and operational realities. Build, mentor, and elevate a team of planners and analysts to operate as product users and contributors , fostering a culture of experimentation, data fluency, and trust in AI-led systems. The Essentials Experience: 5–8 years in product management, inventory planning, supply chain product roles, or merchandise planning , with demonstrable experience building or owning AI/ML-driven products or decision systems — not just using them. Technical Depth: Hands-on familiarity with demand forecasting methodologies (time-series models, statistical and machine learning approaches), replenishment algorithm design, and the ability to translate these into scalable product features and system requirements . Education: Degree in AI/ML, Data Science, Operations Research, Engineering, or a highly quantitative field. Top-tier MBA a strong plus. Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of retail operations, SKU-level planning, supply chain dynamics, and how fashion cycles complicate inventory logic — with the ability to translate these into product constructs and decision frameworks . The Mindset AI-Native Thinking: You don’t add AI to products — you build products around AI capabilities . You understand model strengths and limitations and design systems accordingly. Builder’s Instinct: You treat replenishment as a living product — iterating rapidly, measuring impact, and continuously improving. Analytical Rigor at Speed: You move from ambiguity to clarity fast — translating complex signals into scalable product decisions and features . Transformational Leadership: You drive alignment, build trust in AI systems, and lead product adoption across diverse stakeholders , turning skepticism into advocacy. Equal Opportunity Statement At Lenskart, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and identities — because the best intelligence, human or artificial, comes from many perspectives

jobs.text: Circle Head – Rest of Maharashtra & Goa Own the Region. Build the Future of Tech-Enabled Retail. Mission Brief: Lead Lenskart's Most Exciting Growth Frontier Rest of Maharashtra and Goa (ROMG) is one of Lenskart's fastest-growing and most strategically important markets — and we're looking for the leader who will own it completely. This isn't a management role. This is a founder's mandate: full P&L ownership, a high-performance team to build, and the rare opportunity to shape how an AI-powered, omnichannel retail brand scales in a dynamic, underpenetrated market. You will operate at the intersection of on-ground execution and intelligent retail — using real-time data, AI-assisted selling tools, and technology-driven insights to drive decisions that most retail leaders still make on instinct. If you've been waiting for a role where your actions move markets, this is it. 🎯 Core Mandate 1.Business Performance & P&L Ownership Own topline revenue, profitability, and unit economics across the region — with full accountability for outcomes. AI-First Sales Strategy & Execution Define and execute a sharp, data-informed offline sales strategy — not just on gut feel, but grounded in real-time performance signals. Leverage Lenskart's technology stack including AI-assisted selling tools, demand forecasting at the store level, and live dashboards to drive precision execution across every store in your circle. Build a culture of accountability where numbers are owned, tracked, and acted upon daily. 3. Team Leadership & Capability Building Build and lead a high-performing bench of Area Managers and store teams. Create a culture where goals are clear, ownership is celebrated, and performance is rewarded. Invest in capability development across sales, customer experience, and tech-enabled operations — turning your circle into a talent factory for Lenskart's next generation of leaders. 4. Customer Experience & NPS Own end-to-end in-store experience and NPS for the region. Champion a customer-first operating model through regular store immersion, structured feedback loops, and rapid response to experience gaps. Ensure every touchpoint — from the moment a customer walks in to the moment they leave — reflects Lenskart's promise of premium, accessible, tech-enabled eyecare. 5. Operational Excellence & Intelligent Efficiency Maximize store productivity through smart staffing, AI-supported planning, and continuous operational improvement. Drive inventory discipline, cost efficiency, and process rigor — not through micromanagement, but through systems thinking and data-led decisions. Identify gaps fast and close them faster. 6. Market Intelligence & Expansion Stay deeply embedded in local markets, competition, and consumer behaviour across Rest of Maharashtra and Goa. Translate on-ground intelligence into expansion strategies — identifying where to grow next, how to win faster, and what Lenskart's customers in these markets need before they know it themselves. 7. Brand Custodianship & Tech-Led Retail Be the guardian of Lenskart's brand in the region — premium, accessible, and unmistakably differentiated. Ensure every store delivers a seamless blend of retail and technology: from AI-assisted dispensing and omnichannel journeys to data-driven clienteling. Champion an insight-led, tech-first operating culture across every team you lead. 🧠 The Mindset We're Looking For Owner, Not Manager. You feel the P&L personally. You move fast, take decisions with incomplete information, and course-correct without being told. Data-Led, Ground-Rooted. You love being in stores and markets — and you equally love opening a dashboard to understand what the data is telling you. You don't choose between instinct and intelligence. You use both. Builder at Heart. You're energized by building — teams, systems, culture, markets. You leave places meaningfully better than you found them. Tech-Forward Leader. You're genuinely curious about how AI, data tools, and technology can make your team smarter and faster. You don't wait for tech to be handed to you — you ask for it, learn it, and push for more. High-EQ People Leader. You build trust fast, give honest feedback, and create environments where people grow. Your team's success is your scoreboard. 📋 What You Bring 8–14 years of experience in retail, QSR, or consumer businesses — with a demonstrated track record of managing multi-store, multi-city operations Proven P&L ownership with consistent, measurable growth delivery Experience operating in fast-paced, high-growth environments where ambiguity is the norm Strong commercial instincts combined with comfort using data and digital tools to drive decisions A reputation as a talent builder — someone who grows teams and creates future leaders ⚡ Why This Role — Right Now Lenskart isn’t a conventional retailer dabbling in technology — we are a technology-first company with one of India’s largest and fastest-growing retail footprints. Rest of Maharashtra and Goa sits at a pivotal moment, with strong growth momentum, significant headroom, and rapidly evolving consumer demand. The leader in this role will see a clear, direct impact of their decisions on shaping one of the company’s most compelling growth You won't be executing someone else's playbook. You'll be writing it — with the full backing of Lenskart's proprietary tech stack, AI tools, supply chain infrastructure, and a leadership team that rewards bold thinking and fast action. This is the role for someone who wants to be known for building something remarkable. Lenskart is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Global Projects Lead
jobs.text: Global Projects Lead Lenskart.com · Gurugram, India · On-site · Full-time 🌍 Mission Brief: Set the Global Standard for Retail Excellence Lenskart is on one of the most ambitious retail expansion journeys in the world — scaling across Asia, the Middle East, and beyond. Every store we open is a statement: about our brand, our obsession with customer experience, and our belief that technology can transform even the most physical of spaces. This role is for the person who will own that statement globally. As Global Projects Lead, you will be the architect of Lenskart's physical retail future — defining how our stores are designed, built, and experienced across every market we enter. You will lead with data, build with precision, and raise the bar every single time. Reporting to the Global Head of Projects, you will operate at the intersection of design, engineering, technology, and commercial strategy — driving the execution engine that powers our global store network. This is not a maintenance role. This is a builder's role. 🔑 Core Mandate 1. Set the AI-Powered Global Design Standard Be the custodian of Lenskart's retail brand experience — but go beyond aesthetics. Use data and AI-driven insights to define what a world-class Lenskart store looks, feels, and performs like. Establish design frameworks and specifications that are dynamic, scalable, and informed by real-time market feedback, customer behaviour analytics, and performance data from existing stores. Every new store should be smarter than the last. 2. Build the Intelligent Project Governance Engine Lead end-to-end store design and delivery — governing BOQs, specifications, and quality benchmarks across all markets. Introduce AI-assisted project tracking, predictive risk monitoring, and real-time dashboards to move from reactive problem-solving to proactive portfolio management. Define the processes and governance models that enable speed without sacrificing quality. 3. Own the Global Expansion Roadmap Build and manage a multi-year, multi-country rollout roadmap that is anchored in data — using site analytics, demand modelling, and market intelligence to prioritise where and how we grow. Partner with senior leaders across Retail, Finance, and Supply Chain to ensure every new market entry is strategically timed and operationally ready. 4. Build a World-Class, Tech-Enabled Vendor Ecosystem Develop and govern a high-performance global vendor network spanning construction, fabrication, engineering, and maintenance. Go beyond traditional procurement — use data benchmarking, performance scoring, and AI-assisted vendor evaluation to ensure you're always working with the best partners at the best value. Build systems that make vendor governance scalable across geographies. 5. Lead Commercial Excellence & Value Engineering Champion a culture of intelligent value engineering — using material science, cost analytics, and AI-driven procurement insights to optimise every rupee spent without compromising brand experience. Own all project commercials: contracts, BOQs, procurement workflows, and financial controls. Bring the same rigour to cost as to quality.. 6. Drive Execution Excellence at Global Scale Establish quality standards and audit frameworks that travel across borders. Use technology to enable real-time visibility into project status, quality compliance, and post-handover performance across every market. Build systems that make consistent execution the default, not the exception. 7. Lead, Mentor & Inspire Regional Teams Build and lead a team of high-performing project professionals across regions. Create a culture of ownership, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement. Be the voice of the Projects function at the leadership table — representing the team's work, ambitions, and impact to senior stakeholders globally. ⚡ The Essentials Experience: 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in global retail or consumer brand projects, with a proven track record of leading multi-country expansion programmes for design-led, premium brands. Technical Depth: Strong expertise in design execution, BOQs, contracting, vendor governance, and engineering oversight — combined with a genuine appetite for using data and technology to make project delivery smarter and faster. Scale: Demonstrated experience managing large retail portfolios across multiple geographies, with the ability to balance local nuance with global consistency. Education: Bachelor's degree in Architecture or Civil Engineering. Advanced qualifications in Project Management or Business are a plus. 🧠 The Mindset Technology-Forward: You believe the future of retail project management is AI-assisted, data-driven, and real-time. You actively seek out tools and approaches that make your team faster, smarter, and more consistent — and you build the systems that outlast you. Obsessed with Quality at Scale: You understand that quality cannot be a manual inspection — it has to be designed into the system. You build standards, frameworks, and governance models that make excellence repeatable across every store, in every market. Commercial Sharpness: You think like a business owner. You understand that every design decision, every vendor choice, and every project milestone has a direct line to P&L — and you make decisions accordingly. Builder's Mentality: You are energised by complexity and ambiguity. You don't wait for a playbook — you write it. You see a new market as a canvas and bring the rigour, creativity, and discipline to make it exceptional. Transformational Leadership: You lead by conviction, not just authority. You inspire teams to raise their standards, challenge the status quo, and take ownership of outcomes — not just activities. At Lenskart, we are building a technology company that happens to sell eyewear. If you want to build the retail infrastructure of a global brand that is redefining an industry — this is your role.

jobs.title: Database Reliability Engineer Sql and MongoDB
jobs.text: The Role We are looking for a high‐caliber DataOps / Database Reliability Engineer who brings strong engineering fundamentals and a deep sense of ownership. You will design, build, and operate MySQL, MongoDB, MSSQL, and BigQuery platforms that enable product teams to ship quickly and safely - at scale. This role is hands‐on, impact‐driven, and aligned with top‐tier engineering standards. What You Will Do Database Architecture & Reliability ● Architect and operate highly available MySQL (InnoDB Cluster, Group Replication), MongoDB (Replica Sets, Sharded Clusters), MSSQL, and BigQuery environments. ● Lead migrations (version upgrades, cloud transitions to AWS RDS/Aurora, MongoDB Atlas, BigQuery). ● Define and enforce standards, schema design best practices, and governance policies. ● Drive SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for mission‐critical data services. Performance Engineering ● Optimize queries, indexes, and workloads using advanced profiling tools across MySQL, MongoDB, MSSQL, and BigQuery. ● Tune InnoDB internals, buffer pools, shard keys, working sets, and query execution plans. ● Resolve bottlenecks across CPU, memory, and I/O. ● Implement advanced monitoring and alerting (PMM, Ops Manager, Grafana, Datadog). Operational Excellence & Automation ● Automate backup/recovery (XtraBackup, mysqldump/mysqlpump, Ops Manager, filesystem snapshots, MSSQL native tools). ● Champion Infrastructure‐as‐Code (Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes Operators). ● Implement Change Data Capture (CDC) pipelines using Debezium and integrate with downstream systems. ● Enforce strong security: authentication, authorization, encryption, auditing. ● Conduct DR drills, capacity planning, and maintain clear documentation/runbooks. ● Continuously reduce operational toil through automation and engineering solutions. Collaboration & Incident Response ● Partner with DevOps/SRE teams to integrate DB ops into CI/CD pipelines. ● Mentor engineers on database best practices. ● Participate in on‐call rotations, lead incident response, and write clear, blameless RCAs. ● Work closely with product and platform teams to influence system design through the lens of scale, resilience, and cost efficiency. What We’re Looking For Core Engineering ● Strong foundations in Linux/Unix, networking (DNS, TCP/IP), and distributed systems. ● Proficiency in Python, Bash, or JavaScript for automation and tooling. ● Clean Git practices and strong software engineering discipline. Databases ● Deep expertise in MySQL and MongoDB. ● Proven experience with HA/DR setups, replication, and performance tuning. ● Backup/recovery expertise with XtraBackup, mongodump, Ops Manager, MSSQL native tools. ● Working knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, Cassandra, and BigQuery. ● Experience building and operating CDC pipelines with Debezium. Infrastructure & Tooling ● Infrastructure as Code using Terraform (required). ● Configuration and automation using Ansible/Chef (preferred). ● CI/CD integration with Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions. Observability & Reliability ● Metrics and alerting: PMM, Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager. ● Tracing/APM: Datadog, New Relic, OpenTelemetry. ● Incident management experience (PagerDuty or equivalent). Nice to Have ● Experience with managed database services (AWS RDS/Aurora, MongoDB Atlas, BigQuery). ● Exposure to DevSecOps and cloud security. ● Experience operating high‐traffic, consumer‐facing systems. ● Relevant certifications (MongoDB Certified DBA, Oracle MySQL DBA, MSSQL certifications). ● Strong written communication (design docs, RFCs, runbooks). What Success Looks Like at Lenskart ● Databases that are reliable, scalable, and boring in production. ● Faster delivery with fewer incidents. ● Strong developer trust in the data platform. ● Systems that scale seamlessly with business growth. Why Lenskart ● Real‐world scale with tangible customer impact. ● Strong engineering ownership and autonomy. ● Opportunity to shape data platforms used across the company. ● A culture that values craft, clarity, and engineering excellence.

jobs.title: Plant IT support executive
jobs.text: Role Summary The IT Support Engineer will be responsible for providing end-to-end technical support for all plant-level IT systems including production floor equipment, hardware, network infrastructure, shop-floor applications, and user devices. They will ensure high system uptime, timely troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and adherence to IT standards, while supporting day-to- day operations critical to manufacturing continuity. Key Responsibilities Technical Support - Provide first-line and second-line support for desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, handhelds, PLC-connected systems, and production terminals. - Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network issues raised by plant users. - Install, configure, and maintain Windows OS, industrial applications, and security software. - Manufacturing Systems & Applications - Support MES, SCADA/HMI interfaces, SAP/ERP access, and shop-floor automation devices. - Troubleshoot connectivity between OT (Operational Technology) and IT systems. - Coordinate installation, updates, and patching for plant-critical applications. Network and Infrastructure - Manage LAN/WAN connectivity, Wi-Fi access points, switches, CCTV monitoring, access control systems, and IP telephony. - Coordinate with central IT for firewall policies and network security. Maintenance & Compliance - Perform periodic preventive maintenance across plant systems. - Maintain asset inventory, AMC records, and compliance documentation. - Support IT audits, data backup, antivirus deployment, and patch compliance. User Support & Training - Provide technical guidance to employees on system usage, safety, and best practices. - Conduct basic training sessions for plant and office staff. Vendor & Stakeholder Coordination - Liaise with vendors for equipment servicing, component replacement, and AMC. - Work with cross-functional teams (production, maintenance, quality) to ensure smooth operations. Required Skills and Competencies - Strong knowledge of Windows OS, Active Directory, user management. - Basic understanding of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs). - Experience supporting manufacturing environments, OT/IT integration (preferred). - Hands-on exposure to industrial peripherals, barcode systems, production terminals. - Familiarity with CCTV, access control, printers, handheld devices. - Good analytical and troubleshooting capabilities. - Ability to prioritize and resolve issues under time pressure. Qualifications - Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or related field. - 2 to 5 years of IT support experience, preferably in a manufacturing plant. - Certifications such as CompTIA A+, N+, CCNA, or Microsoft MCP are a plus.

jobs.title: Marketing Lead
jobs.text: This is a high-impact, founder-proximate leadership role focused on one thing: taking Lenskart from a well-known eyewear company to an iconic global brand. You will be the architect responsible for transforming how the world perceives, talks about, and emotionally connects with Lenskart moving us from category leader to cultural phenomenon. Your mission is to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI-powered marketing and exponential global brand growth. You will define and deliver the system that ensures we show up with the right story, in the right format, in the right culture, at the right moment maximising brand love, customer acquisition, and revenue impact across every market we operate in. Lenskart is already a $1 billion revenue company. 2,500+ stores across India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Japan, and the US. 40M+ customers. A vertically integrated, tech-first model that designs, manufactures, and delivers eyewear end-to-end. Now we're going after the next 10x. This role is based in Thailand and owns brand and marketing strategy across all Lenskart markets globally India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Japan, and the US. 🔑 Core Mandate: Brand Transformation & Business Growth 1. Build a Cult Global Brand (The Builder's Focus) Brand Visionary: Own the strategic vision and execution for taking Lenskart from a known eyewear brand to an iconic, cult brand one that creates virality, drives style statements, and makes eyewear a fashion-first category globally. Portfolio Architecture: Define and evolve brand positioning for Lenskart and its portfolio brands (John Jacobs, Aqualens) across every market we operate in ensuring local cultural resonance without sacrificing global brand coherence. Cultural Ownership: Build a brand that doesn't just sell eyewear but owns the conversation around vision, style, and self-expression for the next billion consumers globally. 2. Social-First, Culture-First Content Engine (The Distribution Focus) Platform-Native Creative: Build and scale a content engine natively built for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and whatever platform emerges next, across every market. No repurposed TV ads. No committee-approved creative. Creator Ecosystem: Build creator and influencer ecosystems across every market from mega-influencers to nano-creators, from artists to athletes with a programmatic, data-driven approach to partnerships. Community-Led Growth: Make Lenskart a brand that Gen Z and Millennials don't just buy from they talk about, create with, remix, and feel part of, in every geography. 3. AI-Powered Marketing 10x Faster, 10x Smarter (The Leverage Focus) Non-Negotiable: This is not a role for someone who is "exploring AI." You will leverage AI better than anyone else in the industry and build a marketing function where AI is the operating system, not a tool. AI Creative Engine: Deploy generative AI to produce content at a scale and speed no traditional team can match dynamic creative variants, AI-generated ad copy, personalised visual assets, and simultaneous multi-market campaign launches. Intelligent Targeting & Personalisation: Build AI-powered audience segmentation, predictive targeting, and real-time personalisation systems across markets. AI-Driven Performance Systems: Implement automated bidding strategies, AI-generated creative optimisation loops, and LLM-powered campaign intelligence that continuously learns and improves ROAS without manual intervention. Tech-Enabled Marketing Stack: Own the architecture of a world-class marketing tech stack CDP, AI-native attribution, experimentation platforms, virtual try-on, computer vision for product discovery all wired to a single source of truth. Force Multiplier Mindset: We are not building a 200-person marketing department. We are building a lean, AI-powered marketing machine that operates at the output of one many times its size. 4. Numbers-Driven Performance & Growth (The Business Focus) Marketing P&L Ownership: Own the full marketing P&L and business plan across all markets. You're not just a creative leader you're accountable for CAC, LTV, ROAS, and incrementality across every channel and geography. Experimentation at Scale: Drive a relentless test-and-learn culture. We expect 100+ experiments a quarter, not 10. Omnichannel Integration: Drive integrated online-to-offline marketing that bridges digital channels with 2,500+ physical stores globally, creating a seamless consumer journey from first impression to in-store conversion. 5. Multi-Country Playbook & Global Scale (The Global Focus) Localised GTM: Develop localised go-to-market strategies for each market while maintaining a unified global brand playbook. What works in India won't copy-paste to Dubai, Bangkok, or Tokyo and you get that intuitively. Global Remit, Regional Base: Based in Thailand, you'll set and drive brand strategy across India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Japan, and the US with Southeast Asia as a natural anchor market given your location, while carrying full accountability across the global portfolio. New Product & Category Launches: Own the marketing engine for new product introductions across all markets from category creation moments to viral launch campaigns. The Essentials Experience: 10+ years in marketing, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership role at a high-growth D2C or consumer-tech brand. You've scaled at least one iconic brand something that went viral, became a style statement, and captured cultural attention. AI & Technical Fluency: You've built or managed an AI-native marketing stack. Not experimented with AI for copy actually deployed AI systems at scale for creative, targeting, or personalisation. Multi-Country Track Record: Multi-country experience is non-negotiable. You've led marketing across at least 2–3 international markets and understand the nuance of cultural adaptation vs. global consistency. Experience across Southeast Asia specifically is a strong plus. Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field or equivalent exceptional experience. The Mindset Culture Before Category: Obsessively plugged into global cultural currents K-pop, streetwear drops, gaming culture, regional memes, emerging aesthetics. AI as Superpower, Not Buzzword: You see AI as the most powerful leverage a marketer has ever had. Aesthetic Rigour + Data Rigour: You notice the font, the colour palette, the spacing and back every creative decision with data. Builder, Not Maintainer: You thrive in ambiguity and are energised by 0-to-1 problems as much as scaling what works. 10x Thinker: You don't optimise for 10% improvements you think 10 times better, 10 times faster. Founder-Friendly: Comfortable working closely with a hands-on Founder-CEO, moving fast, and making decisions with imperfect information.

jobs.title: Buying Planning & Merchandise Lead
jobs.text: About Lenskart Lenskart is a tech-led, omni-channel eyewear company with a growing footprint across India and international markets. We operate an integrated value chain across design, manufacturing, retail, and e-commerce. Role Overview The Buying Planning & Merchandise Lead will own the flow of merchandise from vendor to warehouse across all categories and regions. The role is anchored in demand forecasting, OTB, vendor capacity planning, and lead-time reduction — ensuring the right quantity of the right product reaches the right warehouse at the right time, at the right cost. Key Responsibilities Demand Forecasting Own global demand forecasting across categories, channels, and regions. Drive forecast accuracy through structured S&OP cycles, sell-through analysis, and seasonality modelling. Translate top-down financial plans and bottom-up category plans into a single, executable demand view. OTB & Buying Planning Own the Open-to-Buy (OTB) process — building, tracking, and re-forecasting through the season. Manage inflow planning, phasing, and depth-vs-breadth decisions in line with sales, stock, and margin targets. Partner with the buying and category teams to convert assortment plans into actionable buy quantities. Vendor Capacity Planning Lead capacity planning with the vendor base — aligning monthly and weekly production capacity with the demand plan. Work with sourcing and manufacturing partners to lock capacity ahead of peak periods and manage flex during demand swings. Build visibility into vendor performance on capacity, on-time delivery, and fill rates. Lead-Time Reduction & Inflow Drive reduction of lead times across the vendor-to-warehouse cycle through better planning rhythm, order release discipline, and vendor collaboration. Improve PO-to-receipt timelines, in-transit visibility, and warehouse inbound predictability. Work with logistics and warehousing teams to smooth inflow and reduce bullwhip across the network. Inventory & Allocation Own inventory health across warehouses — turns, cover, ageing, and excess. Drive allocation and replenishment models that maintain availability with controlled markdowns. Collaboration & Leadership Work closely with Buying, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Logistics, Retail, E-commerce, and Finance. Build and lead a strong planning and merch supply chain team. Key Requirements Relevant experience in demand planning, merchandise planning, OTB, or merchandise supply chain roles. Strong grounding in demand forecasting, OTB, vendor capacity planning, and lead-time management. Commercial understanding of inventory turns, fill rates, markdowns, and working capital. jobs.title: Android/ iOS - Tech Lead
jobs.text: The Role We are looking for a hands-on Tech Lead to own our Android and iOS app platforms end-to-end, along with the Java-based middleware layer that powers them. What We Are Looking For • Significant hands-on experience owning production Android and iOS applications at scale, with genuine depth in at least one and strong command of the other. • Strong backend engineering ability in Java, including designing services for high availability, handling partial failures, caching correctly in e-commerce paths and managing API versioning for users who cannot be force-upgraded. • A track record of leading engineering teams — setting technical direction, hiring well, handling underperformance, and negotiating scope and timelines credibly with Product. • Practical debugging depth: the ability to diagnose cold-start regressions, ANRs, memory leaks, retain cycles and production incidents using real tooling, not just describe them. • Sound judgment on trade-offs migrations, server-driven configuration, multi-brand and multi-region architecture — with clear reasoning about cost and risk. • Experience with high-scale consumer e-commerce or similarly demanding mobile products is strongly preferred. Why Join Us You will own the technology behind how millions of customers experience Lenskart, at a company scaling aggressively across India and internationally. jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.text: Play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our microservice infrastructure and deployment pipelines, ensuring the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of our applications. Tech stack Expert knowledge in Kubernetes distributions AKS and Azure. Expert knowledge of GitOps principles to manage infrastructure as code, utilizing tools like Helm, ArgoCD, and Terraform. Hands on experience in Linux server management and shell scripting. Good understanding of the client architecture and application integrations to help in designing of solutions and processes. Utilize Python, groovy, and bash scripting for automation and integration tasks. Set up and manage monitoring and alerting using Dynatrace, Prometheus and Grafana to ensure system performance and reliability. Designing and provisioning of new microservices as requested by project team. Good knowledge of Vendor support model for designing microservice environment on Kubernetes. Prepare cost and effort estimation for any infrastructure/microservice provisioning or enhancement. Good knowledge about the requirements of the project team so as to work with the vendors on provisioning. Good knowledge of the project specific application installations such as Azure Kubernetes service, ArgoCD, JDK, Istio, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Dynatrace etc. Prepare runbooks and review with application teams and all stake holders before each release. Support and troubleshoot any Kubernetes cluster, Microservices and CICD platform related issues in production and other instances. Understanding of the external third-party integrations including Akamai, Azure, Apigee, kafka, mysql, redis, Palo alto firewall, etc. and work with production support team and vendors on identifying and fixing the issues. Continuous monitoring of the Microservices even after an incident to ensure the complete recovery. Support QA and Development teams for deploying the applications and if applications are functioning correctly in their environments. Automate the build and deployment processes so as to provide QA team and Dev teams with button clicks for these activities. Add/remove/modify the existing CI/CD jobs to satisfy the requests from QA/Dev teams. Provide solutions to the build/deployment issues faced by QA/Dev teams. Manage all lower environment clusters and CICD systems. Support QA team to data refresh the lower environments with latest production data for the next sprint cycle. Support the Platform team/vendors with application restarts for patching and maintenance activities. Continuous research and improve the build and deployment process using latest frameworks, methodologies, solutions available in market. Prepare cost and effort estimation for any new enhancement by following different FinOps principles. POC with the latest frameworks/solutions to automate the existing process. Eg: Helm charts are introduced for better packaging, versioning and managing of kubernetes manifests for different microservices. Performance analysis and fine tuning for all application/web server instances of the applications deployed. Support the performance testing of production site and be adept at queries, reporting and presenting findings. Work with the performance team in analysing DevOps related tunings needed in the microservice APIs and implementing them from POC to production as needed. Implementations of various performance testing tools/methodologies for microservices. Monitor and timely closing of all work requests raised through JIRA/Service-Now to the satisfaction of the requester. This includes requests from other teams regarding access to the tools that DevOps hold Admin access. All requests from QA team and Dev teams including the stories needed for release come in JIRA and is worked on in the mentioned sprint. In case of clarifications, we need to work with the respective teams and finalize the story/request. People management, Interaction with offshore team. Responsible for the commerce agile squad and drive the team. Provide updates to the management on a regular basis about the tasks. Planning and executing communication plans to stakeholders. Coordinating the DevOps projects and their interdependencies. Daily team management throughout the project life cycle. New technologies and implementations need to be passed on to other teams. Cross skilling among the team with various latest technologies. Grooming of the new members to the team. Writing of wiki pages, blogs and PowerPoint presentations for better understanding of new technologies/tools. Required Skills: Extensive expertise in designing, managing, supporting and building microservices for large enterprise-level web applications consisting of hundreds of API. Strong experience with Kubernetes and Istio for container orchestration and service mesh implementation. Proficiency in Azure services and AKS for cloud infrastructure management. Hands-on experience with GitOps practices and related tools like Helm, Customize and ArgoCD. Proficient in scripting with Python and Bash for automation and tooling. Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, Kiali and Dynatrace for monitoring and observability. Experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Opsera, GitLab CI for automated deployment. Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code principles and tools such as Terraform. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. #LI-AR1

jobs.title: O9 Engineer
jobs.text: Experience - 5 plus years We are hiring an O9 Solutions Engineer to support and evolve the O9 platform for one of the largest retailers in the United States. O9 is the system of record for demand forecasting, supply planning, and allocation decisions across our brands, regions, and channels. This role owns the day-to-day health of the platform — triaging and resolving incidents, maintaining data integrity between O9 and upstream/downstream systems such as Oracle EBS, and partnering with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and Merchandising teams to keep the platform reliable, accurate, and easy to use across a global user base (US, UK, EMEA, and APAC). Responsibilities Serve as a primary point of support for O9 Supply Planning and Demand Planning modules, triaging incidents end-to-end from intake through root-cause and resolution. Investigate and resolve data integrity issues between O9 and connected systems (Oracle EBS, RMA/returns feeds, buy-plan and sourcing extracts), including mismatched quantities, missing style-colors, and forecast data not flowing between planning modules. Diagnose and fix planning logic issues — unmet demand, incorrect season codes, planned orders not grouping correctly, buy dates shifting unexpectedly, and similar planning-engine anomalies. Manage user access and provisioning (new hires, role changes, regional access, ownership transfers) and drive toward self-service or bulk-provisioning workflows to reduce manual ticket volume. Own incident and backlog hygiene: track SLAs, prioritize aging tickets, and ensure nothing sits unresolved for months without visibility to stakeholders. Partner with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and regional business teams (US, UK, China, Japan) to translate business-reported issues into technical root causes. Build and maintain runbooks, root-cause documentation, and knowledge base articles so common issues can be resolved consistently — not just by institutional memory. Support configuration changes, workflow updates, and enhancements within O9 as the retailer's planning processes evolve (new brands, new seasons, new regions). Participate in O9 platform upgrades, testing cycles, and post-implementation review (PIR) processes for major changes. Escalate to and collaborate with O9 Solutions' vendor support team on platform-level defects that require vendor engineering involvement. Skillset 5+ years of hands-on experience supporting or implementing O9. Solid understanding of retail supply chain planning concepts: demand forecasting, supply/buy planning, allocation, assortment, and season/style-color management. Experience integrating planning systems with ERP platforms, ideally Oracle EBS, including familiarity with common data reconciliation issues between planning and execution systems. Strong troubleshooting skills — comfortable reading data flows end-to-end to isolate whether an issue originates in source data, integration, or planning logic. Experience with incident management tools (ServiceNow or similar) and a track record of managing ticket queues, SLAs, and prioritization in a production support environment. Working knowledge of SQL for data investigation and validation. Excellent written communication skills — you'll be documenting root causes and explaining technical issues to non-technical business stakeholders across time zones. Comfortable working with global, cross-regional teams (US, EMEA, APAC) and adjusting communication style accordingly. #LI-NS1

jobs.title: Research Leader
jobs.text: Retail is at a pivotal point, approaching the singularity we envisioned earlier. The convergence of AI, real-time visibility, autonomous operations, and composable commerce is fundamentally reshaping how retailers compete. This isn't incremental disruption; it is a transformation so complete that traditional retail models will become obsolete. Retailers who understand and navigate this inflection will dominate. Those who don't will disappear. You will author the definitive book on this moment. No other work comprehensively addresses retail singularity with the rigor and insight this book demands. It will be the authoritative resource for retail executives and technology leaders navigating this critical transition. While you author this seminal work, you'll simultaneously drive Litmus7's thought leadership, research, and market intelligence strategy. You'll lead a research team, establish proprietary POVs, and generate market insights that fuel sales opportunities. This is a business-critical, multi-dimensional leadership role. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES • Author the Retail Singularity Book: Own intellectual vision, research methodology, and primary authorship. Conduct 40–60 primary interviews with retail C-suite and technology leaders. Deliver publication-ready manuscript with original insights, rigorous sourcing, and compelling narrative. • Sales Enablement & Market Intelligence: Translate research into actionable market insights that directly fuel Litmus7's sales pipeline. Identify emerging opportunities where we can pitch, compete, and differentiate. Provide sales teams with competitive positioning, customer intelligence, and market context that wins deals. • Lead Research Team: Build and manage a team of 3–5 researchers and analysts. Set priorities, establish methodologies, mentor talent. Drive quality, productivity, and intellectual rigor. • Deal Intelligence: Analyze customer engagements, RFPs, and competitive wins/losses. Synthesize into organizational learning. Identify gaps and market opportunities Litmus7 should exploit. Support major deals with research-backed due diligence. • Establish Proprietary POVs: Build 4–6 proprietary points of view on critical retail transformation topics. Author 8–12 thought leadership articles annually for LinkedIn, Forbes Tech Council, industry publications. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Research & Book Authorship • Design and execute multi-modal research: primary interviews, market data analysis, competitive intelligence, trend forecasting, scenario development. • Conduct strategic interviews with retail C-suite (CIOs, CMOs, COOs, CEOs) and technology leaders. Uncover competitive intent, technology investments, business imperatives. • Write publication-ready prose across formats: book chapters, articles, white papers, market briefs. • Create compelling case studies, examples, and frameworks that illuminate complex concepts. Maintain editorial schedules; coordinate with editors and publishers. Sales & Business Impact • Support Quarterly Business Reviews with market insights that can lead to farming opportunities. • Develop market context decks, competitive summaries, battle cards. Support RFP responses and customer engagements with research-backed positioning. Team & Stakeholder • Recruit, onboard, mentor and develop research team members. Establish clear expectations and growth paths. Conduct regular 1-on-1s, performance reviews, career development conversations. • Set research priorities and assign projects. Monitor progress and quality. Provide mentoring and feedback. Foster culture of intellectual rigor. Mandatory Qualifications • Postgraduate in engineering/business/economics with 10–12 years of specialized experience in retail technology research at tier-1 analyst firms. • Deep retail domain expertise: Genuine understanding of retail operations. Know what drives retail technology decisions. Should have spent at least 8-9 years in analyzing the Retail industry. • Writing at scale: Published reports, white papers, monographs, or articles demonstrating analytical depth and publication-ready quality. • Primary research mastery: Design methodologies, recruit and conduct interviews, analyze qualitative data, draw defensible conclusions, transparently address limitations. • C-suite credibility: Engage senior executives as a peer advisor. Conduct strategic interviews that uncover authentic business imperatives. • Sales acumen: Understand how research translates into business opportunities. Experience supporting sales teams and identifying market gaps. • Team leadership: Experience managing or mentoring research teams, analysts, or junior consultants. Demonstrated ability to develop talent and drive quality. • Research rigor: Multi-modal research design. Comfort with ambiguity. Systematically form and test hypotheses. Synthesize disparate data into coherent narratives. Rigor in fact-checking, citation accuracy, quality assurance. • Communication excellence: Publication-ready writing across formats. Articulate speaking. Explain sophisticated concepts accessibly without sacrificing accuracy or nuance. • Collaboration & independence: Work productively with sales, marketing, practice leads without ceding intellectual independence. Transparent about research process and findings. Report honestly even if findings challenge organizational preferences. • Intellectual humility: Willing to update thinking based on evidence. Acknowledge complexity and counterarguments. Resist false certainty. #LI-AC1

Fund Accounting Analyst
jobs.text: Role Overview We are looking for a detail-oriented Fund Accounting Analyst to manage custody operations, reconciliations, fund accounting, client transactions, and operational reporting for our Portfolio Management Services. Key Responsibilities Custody & Reconciliation Monitor daily custodian feeds for trades, holdings, and cash movements. Perform daily reconciliation of securities, cash balances, corporate actions, and fund movements. Resolve reconciliation breaks with custodians, brokers, and counterparties. Ensure timely trade settlements and smooth fund flows. Fund Accounting Validate daily NAV, MTM valuations, expense accruals, and corporate action accounting. Reconcile broker trades, custodian positions, cash balances, and collateral balances. Review brokerage, management fees, statutory charges, and other expense allocations. Investigate discrepancies, perform root cause analysis, and ensure timely closure. Operations & Reporting Process client transactions including top-ups, withdrawals, and strategy switches. Prepare client reports, operational MIS, and regulatory reports. Maintain operational SOPs and drive continuous process improvements. Skills & Qualifications Graduate/Postgraduate in Finance, Commerce, or related field. 2 - 5 years of experience in PMS, AIF, Custodian, Fund Accounting, Mutual Funds, or Capital Market Operations. Strong understanding of custody operations, reconciliations, settlements, and fund accounting. Should be well-versed with Wealth Spectrum Excellent MS Excel skills; experience with fund accounting or portfolio management systems is preferred. Strong analytical ability, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Client Onboarding Analyst
jobs.text: Role Overview We are looking for a detail-oriented Account Opening & Client Onboarding Analyst to manage the end-to-end onboarding process for Portfolio Management Services (PMS) clients, AIFs, ensuring timely account activation, regulatory compliance, and a seamless onboarding experience. Key Responsibilities Client Onboarding & Account Opening Manage end-to-end account opening for PMS investors (Individual, HUF, Corporate, NRI, Trust). Coordinate with Investors, Relationship Managers, and distributors for KYC, CML, FATCA, and onboarding documentation. Review account opening forms for completeness, accuracy, and regulatory compliance. Liaise with custodians, depositories, and internal teams for account setup and strategy allocation. Track onboarding progress and provide regular status updates to stakeholders. Ensure timely activation of investment accounts and resolve onboarding-related queries. Documentation & Compliance Verify investor documentation in line with SEBI, KYC, and AML guidelines. Maintain accurate onboarding records and client documentation. Coordinate with Compliance for any documentation or regulatory clarifications. Ensure adherence to internal SOPs and onboarding timelines. Process Management Maintain onboarding trackers and MIS reports. Identify process bottlenecks and recommend improvements to enhance client experience. Support automation and digitization initiatives within onboarding processes. Skills & Qualifications Graduate/Postgraduate in Finance, Commerce, or related field. 0–2 years of experience in PMS, AIF, Mutual Funds, Custodian, Broking, or Financial Services Operations. Strong understanding of Individual, HUF, NRI, Trust, and Corporate account opening processes. Knowledge of KYC, CML, FATCA, and regulatory documentation. Proficiency in MS Excel. Strong communication, coordination, and organizational skills.

jobs.title: Senior Quantitative Data Engineer
jobs.text: About the Role We are seeking a Senior Quantitative Data Engineer to support and enhance our automated trading infrastructure. You will work closely with researchers, traders, and execution teams to build reliable data pipelines, automate workflows, investigate production issues, and ensure the availability and quality of data powering our live trading systems. This role provides exposure to quantitative research, trading operations, and large-scale financial datasets. You will own critical systems end-to-end and drive improvements in reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency. Responsibilities Data Engineering & Platform Ownership Design, develop, and maintain robust data pipelines and ETL workflows. Build tools for data onboarding, validation, reconciliation, and monitoring. Drive automation to eliminate manual operational processes. Work with large structured and time-series datasets using Python and modern data libraries. Optimize database schemas, storage, and data access patterns. Data Quality & Quantitative Research Support Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of datasets used in research and live trading. Develop automated data quality checks and anomaly detection frameworks. Support researchers in cleaning, enriching, and featurizing datasets. Investigate and resolve discrepancies across multiple data sources. Production Support & Incident Management Own and proactively monitor production data pipelines and critical trading processes. Perform root-cause analysis and implement long-term preventive solutions. Troubleshoot issues involving APIs, brokers, exchanges, and third-party data vendors. Ensure high availability and reliability of mission-critical systems. Participate in production support during market hours and respond to time-sensitive issues. Architecture & Process Improvement Drive improvements in data infrastructure, scalability, and operational efficiency. Establish best practices for monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability. Design fault-tolerant and maintainable systems. Improve deployment and release processes. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with quantitative researchers, traders, and software engineers to deliver reliable solutions. Coordinate with external vendors, brokers, exchanges, and data providers. Document systems, workflows, and operational procedures. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical excellence across the team. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Quantitative Engineering, or Data Operations. Strong Python programming skills and experience with Pandas, Polars, NumPy, and PyArrow. Expertise in SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL) and database design. Strong Linux and shell scripting skills. Experience designing and maintaining ETL and data processing pipelines. Excellent debugging and root-cause analysis skills. Experience working in production environments with high reliability requirements. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, live trading environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience with financial datasets, market data, and corporate actions. Knowledge of equity, futures, and options markets. Experience with Bloomberg, Refinitiv, NSE/BSE, or exchange data. Familiarity with Redis/KeyDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery, or other messaging systems. Experience with Parquet and columnar data formats. Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/GCP). Experience with monitoring and observability tools. Nice-to-Have Experience with FastAPI and REST APIs. Familiarity with ClickHouse or time-series databases. Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines. Knowledge of distributed systems and multiprocessing. Exposure to quantitative trading systems and research workflows. What You'll Get Opportunity to work on mission-critical automated trading systems. High ownership and autonomy. Exposure to quantitative research and live trading operations. Fast-paced environment with direct impact on business outcomes. Opportunity to mentor others and shape the evolution of the firm's data infrastructure.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer — Low-Latency Trading Systems (Python)
jobs.text: About the Role We are a proprietary trading and market-making firm operating across global markets, executing strategies that depend on fast, reliable decision-making and execution. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and optimize the Python-based systems that power our trading operations — from market data processing and order execution to risk and monitoring. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building high-performance, production-grade Python systems for a latency-sensitive trading environment. You'll work closely with quantitative researchers, traders, and infrastructure engineers to keep our systems fast, reliable, and competitive. What You'll Do Design, build, and maintain trading infrastructure in Python, including market data handlers, order execution logic, and strategy runners Optimize Python code paths for low latency and high throughput using techniques such as asyncio, multiprocessing, vectorization (NumPy), and just-in-time compilation (Cython, Numba, or similar) Build and maintain tooling for research-to-production workflows, enabling quants to move strategies into live trading quickly and safely Develop and improve simulation, backtesting, and replay frameworks to validate strategy and infrastructure changes Build robust monitoring, alerting, logging, and risk-control systems for live trading Profile production systems to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks Collaborate with quant researchers to understand strategy logic and ensure efficient, correct production implementations Participate in incident response and on-call rotation for production trading systems Conduct code reviews, mentor junior engineers, and help shape engineering standards and practices Continuously evaluate new tools, libraries, and techniques relevant to high-performance Python systems What We're Looking For 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time spent on performance-sensitive or production trading systems Expert-level Python, including deep familiarity with the asyncio ecosystem, concurrency/parallelism patterns, and performance profiling Experience writing performant Python using NumPy/pandas, and optimizing hot paths with Cython, Numba, or similar tools Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/UDP, multicast) and how they affect latency in trading systems Experience with exchange connectivity or market data protocols (e.g., FIX, WebSocket APIs, REST APIs, proprietary feeds) Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and systems-level performance optimization Comfortable working in a fast-paced, low-latency production environment with high accountability Experience with profiling and performance analysis tools (cProfile, py-spy, line_profiler) Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field (or equivalent experience) Nice to Have Prior experience at an HFT, market-making, or proprietary trading firm Experience interfacing Python with C/C++ extensions (pybind11, ctypes, Cython) Experience with high-performance messaging systems (ZeroMQ, Kafka, Redis pub/sub) Exposure to colocation environments, bare-metal infrastructure, and network tuning Familiarity with futures, options, equities, or crypto market microstructure

jobs.title: Associate - Investor Relations
jobs.text: About the Role We are looking for a dynamic Associate – Investor Relations to engage with prospective investors, convert qualified leads into clients, and build long-term investor relationships. This is a revenue-focused role requiring strong communication, persuasion, and relationship management skills. Key Responsibilities Engage with prospective investors who have expressed interest in Qode's investment offerings. Conduct discovery calls, understand investor requirements, and present relevant investment opportunities. Drive the complete sales cycle from lead qualification to investor onboarding and conversion. Follow up with prospects through calls, emails, and meetings to maximize conversions. Build and maintain strong relationships with investors. Maintain accurate records of leads, interactions, and conversion status in the CRM system. Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a seamless onboarding experience for investors. Achieve monthly and quarterly acquisition and revenue targets. Provide regular updates and reports on lead pipeline and conversion performance. Requirements Bachelor's degree in any discipline. 1–3 years of experience in Sales, Wealth Management, Financial Services, Investor Relations, or Business Development. Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Experience in handling client calls and lead conversions. Familiarity with CRM tools and Microsoft Office. Knowledge of financial markets and investment products will be an added advantage. Preferred Background Candidates from Wealth Management, Mutual Funds, PMS, AIF, Insurance, Banking, Financial Advisory, or Investment Sales backgrounds will be preferred. Benefits Professional Growth: Opportunity to work closely with senior leadership and gain exposure to high-calibre investors, family offices, and institutional clients. jobs.text: About the Role We are seeking an exceptional Low-Latency C++ Software Engineer to join our High-Frequency Trading technology team. You will design and build the core trading infrastructure that executes millions of orders per day at microsecond speeds. This is a highly technical, high-impact role at the intersection of systems programming and quantitative finance. Responsibilities Design, develop, and optimize ultra-low-latency trading systems in modern C++ (C++17/20) Build and maintain order management systems (OMS) , execution engines, and market data handlers Profile and tune code to achieve sub-microsecond latency across the full trading stack Develop kernel bypass networking solutions using DPDK, Solarflare OpenOnload, or similar technologies Collaborate with quant researchers to implement and deploy alpha signals and execution algorithms Optimize for cache efficiency , branch prediction, and CPU pipeline utilization Integrate with exchange co-location environments and FIX/ITCH/OUCH protocols Monitor production systems and participate in on-call rotations Required Qualifications 5+ years of professional C++ development experience (HFT or systems programming preferred) Deep expertise in modern C++ (templates, move semantics, lock-free programming, memory models) Strong understanding of computer architecture : CPU caches, NUMA, branch prediction, vectorization (SIMD/AVX) Experience with lock-free and wait-free data structures (atomic operations, memory ordering) Proficiency with Linux performance tooling : perf, flamegraphs, vtune, valgrind, strace Solid grasp of TCP/IP networking and the Linux network stack Ability to reason about latency at nanosecond granularity Preferred Qualifications Experience with kernel bypass networking (DPDK, RDMA, Solarflare, Exablaze) Knowledge of exchange connectivity protocols : FIX, ITCH, OUCH, SBE Familiarity with FPGA-assisted trading pipelines Experience with co-location environments and cross-connect infrastructure Background in market microstructure or quantitative finance Contributions to open-source performance-critical projects
