jobs.title: Solution Engineer
jobs.text: About Signeasy Contracts run businesses. We are unlocking the intelligence inside them. Signeasy began fifteen years ago with a simple idea. Signing should be effortless. That idea helped the world go paperless. But signatures were only the beginning. Today, contracts define revenue, risk, compliance, and growth. Yet in most companies, they remain scattered across systems, frozen in PDFs, and forgotten after execution. We believe contracts are one of the most valuable and most neglected data assets in a business. 2025 marked our inflection point. While others continued to treat contracts as paperwork, we started turning them into livinxqg, searchable, intelligent systems of record. We shipped over 250 product releases, achieved 21 CFR Part 11 compliance, and built the foundation for Intelligent Contract Management. 2026 will be our biggest year yet. With the launch of Intelligent Contract Management, we are going to market with an AI-powered contract management platform built for modern teams who expect more than storage, signatures, or status quo software. This is the moment. And this is the team building it. If you want to help shape the future of contracts with us, please read on. About the role This is a front row seat to revenue. As a Solutions Engineer at Signeasy, you will work at the intersection of sales, onboarding, expansion, product, and engineering. You will help win deals, deliver customer value, and unlock growth through deeper use cases and feature adoption. This is not a demo only role. You will be hands-on with real customer environments, troubleshooting complex workflows, building simple technical solutions, and finding practical workarounds that keep momentum moving. If seeing deals close, customers go live, and accounts expand gives you a thrill, this role is built for you. You will support all markets and work a global shift from 4 pm to 1 am IST. This timing is intentionally designed to ensure strong overlap with our Product, Engineering, and Go To Market teams, enabling faster decisions, tighter collaboration, and better customer outcomes. What you will do Support sales and win revenue Partner closely with Account Executives to own the technical solution strategy during evaluations and proof of concepts Design engaging, credible solution approaches that align Signeasy’s platform to real business needs and simplify complex ideas Identify risks early, troubleshoot issues quickly, and propose workarounds that unblock deals Maintain a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors, and how to position Signeasy in relation to them Onboard customers and drive time to value Support technical onboarding and early implementations for new customers Help customers configure workflows, integrations, and data models Build simple scripts, API based workflows, or configurations to meet customer-specific requirements Ensure smooth handoffs from sales to customer success with strong technical documentation Drive expansion and product impact Support advanced use cases, new team rollouts, and expansion opportunities Partner with Customer Success on renewals and upsells with strong technical credibility Capture customer feedback, technical gaps, and feature requests and translate them into clear input for Product and Engineering AI first expectations At Signeasy, AI is core to how we build and how we work. As a Solutions Engineer, you are expected to actively use AI to accelerate problem solving, solution design, and execution. This includes using AI tools to prototype workflows, troubleshoot issues, explore integrations, and identify smarter ways to deliver value to customers. Experience building or experimenting with AI powered workflows, automations, or agents is strongly preferred. Curiosity and comfort with learning fast matters as much as prior exposure. What we are looking for Minimum 4+ years of customer-facing experience in a Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or technical consulting role Strong technical foundation with SaaS platforms, APIs, and cloud-based systems Hands-on experience in testing and integrating API-based solutions, working with REST APIs, JSON payloads, webhooks, and API testing tools such as Postman (or equivalent) Ability to independently build simple technical solutions to unblock customer use cases and experience using AI-native tools for rapid prototyping (e.g., Claude, Cursor). Experience in troubleshooting integrations and complex workflows across multiple systems Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly Comfort operating in ambiguity with a bias toward action Motivation to work close to revenue and customer outcomes Willingness to work a global shift from 5 pm to 2 am IST Nice to have Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, experience using LLMs and AI-native IDEs for rapid prototyping (e.g., Claude, Cursor). Experience with contract management, document automation, or workflow platforms Exposure to regulated industries such as healthcare, pharma, or financial services Experience supporting mid market sales motions Why this role matters You will see the full arc of revenue, from first conversation to expansion. You will influence deal success, customer confidence, and long term growth. You will work on an AI native platform at a defining moment in its journey and have real ownership from day one. If you are ambitious, technically curious, and energized by impact, this role will accelerate your career fast. Why work with Signeasy: Signeasy values Accountability, Respect, Integrity, Growth Mindset, and Trust. We operate as a smaller, close-knit, and nimble team. We are opinionated but collaborative. We disagree but commit to a mutual decision. We are modern but do not follow trends blindly. We are easy to work with, but we believe in having difficult conversations. We ask many questions, but try to experiment and fail fast. We are deeply empathetic towards our customers, our colleagues, and ourselves. We are the EasyTribe, and we highly recommend you ask enough questions about our culture and see if there is a job-human connection that can make this a fascinating experience for you and us at Signeasy. Our people are our most significant assets. You will be working alongside some of the smartest, most humble people across the globe who come from diverse backgrounds and have unparalleled experiences. We are a remote-friendly organization that believes in hybrid workplace flexibility, a mix of in-person collaboration at the office, and focused work from home. Meet Signeasy's leadership and core team: https://rb.gy/ftyfkw Read our origin story: https://rb.gy/azsda0 Take a peek at Signeasy's culture: https://rb.gy/nvra6o/ Learn more about growth at Signeasy: https://signeasy.com/jobs/ Signeasy is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Process Engineering Manager
jobs.text: We are looking for a Process Engineering Manager responsible for all process engineering efforts within Lyndhurst Operations to support Sika Corporation product manufacturing. The incumbent shall be a “hands on” leader that is responsible for process design, implementation and operation. The Process Engineering Manager will improve industrial processes in order to maintain efficiency, reduce cost, improve sustainability and maximize profitability. Structure and staff the process engineering department to contain expertise in polyurethane sealant and adhesive manufacturing and continuous improvement. Direct all plant functions of Process Engineering to produce high quality products through equipment process controls and introduction of new raw material and innovative products. Manage other process engineers, and participate in capital expenditure and implement plans to improve process capability. Lead the development of process improvements toward state of the art, commercial compliant processes and reduced COGs. Lead process engineering efforts including lean analysis to improve production, error proofing, and packaging efficiency, process optimization, and implementation. Assist project management to determine engineering activities, timelines and resource needs to meet corporate goals. As necessary, assist corporate developments to support Sika’s goals and objectives, and other legal documents, to execute work plans and projects. jobs.text: This position is tasked with the efficient, safe, and environmentally correct operation and growth of the Sika Lyndhurst, NJ facility. Demonstrated ability to team up with the engineering, maintenance, and quality functions including participating in capital planning, preventative maintenance, and problem solving. A comprehensive knowledge of continuous improvement concepts including statistical process control and lean manufacturing is also required. In addition, the incumbent must have a solid understanding of mechanical engineering with conceptual understanding of chemical and/or electrical engineering. The ability to communicate effectively with all members of the organization including educating them on the importance of continuous improvement as a key element of manufacturing. Attain annual expense budget goals and execute annual capital budget to achieve promised benefits. Select, train and develop professional staff to perform at their own personal best. jobs.text: Senior Purchase Executive – Indirect Sourcing Work Location: Pune Work Mode: In Campus About Us Unbox Robotics is a deep-tech robotics company building the world's most space-efficient warehouse sorting systems. Our swarm robotics platform — UnboxSort — enables e-commerce, retail, and 3PL operators to sort at 3–5× the throughput of conventional systems, in a fraction of the floor space. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Pune, India, we operate across 20+ sites in 9 countries, serving leading customers across e-commerce, retail, CEP, and 3PL industries in India, Europe, and the USA. Backed by leading global investors and recently Series B funded, we are scaling rapidly as we expand our technology, products, and global footprint. At Unbox Robotics, we're building more than robots—we're redefining how warehouses move. If you're excited about solving complex business challenges and creating impact behind the scenes, we'd love to build the future with you. Role Overview As a Procurement Executive – Indirect Sourcing, you will be responsible for managing procurement across indirect spend categories, ensuring timely sourcing, cost optimization, vendor performance, and contract compliance. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including HR, IT, Finance, Admin, Marketing, and Operations to support business requirements while driving procurement excellence and strategic sourcing initiatives. Roles & Responsibilities Strategic Sourcing & Procurement Manage procurement across indirect spend categories including IT equipment, software, office supplies, logistics, marketing services, facilities, and other business services. Identify, evaluate, onboard, and develop vendors for multiple procurement categories. Lead RFQs, RFPs, vendor evaluations, bid analysis, and commercial negotiations. Prepare techno-commercial comparisons and recommend the most suitable sourcing options. Ensure timely procurement and delivery of goods and services aligned with business requirements. Vendor & Contract Management Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and service providers. Manage contracts, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), software renewals, and commercial documentation. Monitor vendor performance against agreed KPIs and SLAs. Resolve vendor-related issues and drive continuous supplier performance improvements. Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies and contractual obligations. Stakeholder Management Partner with HR, IT, Finance, Admin, Marketing, and other business functions to understand procurement requirements. Provide timely updates on sourcing activities, delivery schedules, and procurement status. Ensure stakeholder satisfaction through effective coordination and service delivery. Support budgeting and procurement planning initiatives. Cost Optimization & Process Excellence Identify opportunities for cost savings, supplier consolidation, and procurement efficiencies. Track and optimize spend across indirect procurement categories. Support implementation of procurement best practices and process improvements. Maintain procurement records, vendor databases, and sourcing documentation. Generate procurement reports and spend analysis for management reviews. Requirements Must Have Strong negotiation and commercial acumen. Experience in category management and strategic sourcing. Good communication and stakeholder management skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Knowledge of contract management and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Familiarity with ERP and procurement tools such as SAP or similar platforms. Ability to manage multiple procurement categories simultaneously. Good to Have Experience across multiple indirect procurement categories such as IT, Facilities, Marketing, Logistics, and Corporate Services. Experience working in manufacturing, engineering, robotics, or technology organizations. Knowledge of procurement analytics and spend management. Exposure to supplier performance management and vendor audits. Eligible Candidates Desired Qualification Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Commerce, or a related field. Professional certification in Procurement or Supply Chain Management is an added advantage. Work Experience 2–5 years of experience in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Category Management, or Supply Chain functions. Experience managing indirect procurement categories is preferred. We Value Ownership and accountability. Strong commercial and negotiation skills. Customer-centric stakeholder management. Attention to detail and process discipline. Continuous learning and improvement. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment. Collaboration across functions to drive business outcomes. Why Join Us? At Unbox Robotics, procurement is more than purchasing—it is about building strategic partnerships that enable innovation, operational excellence, and business growth. As a Procurement Executive – Indirect Sourcing, you will play a key role in optimizing spend, strengthening supplier relationships, and ensuring the organization has the resources it needs to build the future of warehouse automation. You won't just procure products and services. You'll help build the ecosystem that powers the future of robotics. Work Location: Pune Work Mode: In Campus Salary Range: Competitive Salary

jobs.title: Solution Design Engineer
jobs.text: Solution Design Engineer (Mechanical) Solutioning Team | Pune, India | In Campus About Unbox Robotics Unbox Robotics builds the world’s most compact, AI-powered mobile robotic sorting and order consolidation systems for warehouses and distribution centers — installing 10X faster, saving 50%+ space, and delivering 3X productivity gains. Backed by marquee investors, we’re scaling our Solutioning team with strong hardware and domain expertise. The Role You will be the hardware backbone of the Solutioning team — translating customer operational requirements into deployable sorting and order consolidation solutions. From defining product specifications and releasing BOMs to planning site layouts and questioning operational processes for optimization, you will own the hardware decision-making that bridges engineering capability with real-world warehouse constraints. Key Responsibilities Design end-to-end solution layouts for parcel sorting and order consolidation systems tailored to customer warehouse environments. Lead BOM (Bill of Materials) — validate component selection, cost optimization, lead times, and vendor alternatives for every solution proposal. Define and refine product specifications by deeply understanding the robotic platform’s mechanical discovery — question existing sorting/consolidation workflows, identify bottlenecks, and propose optimized process designs that leverage robotic capabilities. Create 2D CAD layouts (AutoCAD/SolidEdgelectrical, and electronics subsystems (drives, sensors, power distribution, charging systems, conveyor interfaces). Plan detailed site layouts in collaboration with customers — robot zones, charging stations, induction/discharge points, conveyor routing, buffer areas, and operator workstations etc.. Assess site civil and structural readiness: flooring type, flatness, load-bearing capacity, floor coatings, expansion joints, ramp gradients, and ceiling clearances. Conduct operational process e) and 3D renderings to communicate solution designs to customers and internal teams. Collaborate with Mechanical, Electronics, and Production teams to ensure solution designs are manufacturable, serviceable, and field-deployable. Support Sales and BD with technical sizing, throughput calculations, ROI models, and solution proposals during customer engagements. Run simulations to validate throughput, robot fleet sizing, and system performance against customer SLAs. Requirements B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related engineering discipline. 2–5 years in solution design, product engineering, systems engineering, or industrial/warehouse automation. Strong understanding of mechanical and electrical/electronics systems — motors, sensors, power systems, wiring, enclosures, and safety standards. Proficiency in 2D CAD (AutoCAD) and/or 3D CAD (SolidEdge, SolidWorks) for layout and product design. Hands-on experience with BOM creation, review, and cost analysis across electromechanical assemblies. Ability to read and assess civil/structural drawings, flooring specifications, and site infrastructure readiness. Strong analytical skills for throughput modeling, fleet sizing, and operational process optimization. Excellent communication skills to lead customer workshops, present technical solutions, and drive cross-team alignment. Good to Have Experience with robotic systems, AGVs/AMRs, or conveyor-based automation in warehouse/logistics environments. Exposure to simulation tools (FlexSim, AnyLogic, or similar) for material flow and throughput analysis. Understanding of industrial safety standards (CE, UL, ISO 12100) and electrical compliance (IEC 60204). Familiarity with PLC/SCADA systems and industrial communication protocols (Modbus, Profinet, EtherCAT). Knowledge of warehousing operations: sorting methodologies, wave planning, order consolidation strategies, and SLA frameworks. Prior experience working directly with customer operations and facility teams on-site. We Value A questioning mindset — you challenge assumptions in ops processes and push for better solutions. Strong ownership and end-to-end accountability from concept to deployment. Comfort with ambiguity and fast iteration in a start-up environment. Hands-on attitude — willingness to visit sites, get on the warehouse floor, and validate designs in the real world. Location Pune, India (In Campus) Experience 2–5 Years Compensation Competitive Salary Ready to build the future of warehouse robotics? Apply now!

jobs.title: IT Admin — Function Lead
jobs.text: IT Admin — Function Lead Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India | Work: HQ, Pune | Department: Information Technology | Reporting : CTO | Experience: 8+ years (including team / function leadership) About Unbox Robotics Unbox Robotics builds cutting-edge robotics and automation that is transforming warehousing and logistics. Our systems help some of the fastest-growing supply chains move faster, sort smarter, and scale without limits. As our team and infrastructure grow, reliable and secure IT is foundational to everything we ship — and that is exactly where this role comes in. Role Purpose The IT Admin Function Lead owns and governs IT administration across the organization and all its locations. You will be accountable for reliable, secure, and standardized IT services — end-user systems, servers, endpoints, access, and IT operations — and for the processes, documentation, and controls that keep them audit-ready as the company scales. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role. You will set the standard for how IT administration runs at Unbox: lead and grow the IT Administration team, enforce SOPs and least-privilege access, drive full traceability of changes, and coordinate closely with the Security and Networking / Infrastructure functions. Key Responsibilities 1. IT Administration & Operations Management Own and govern day-to-day IT administration activities across all locations. Ensure the availability and performance of end-user systems, servers, and IT services. Define and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all IT administration tasks. Coordinate with vendors for IT support, licensing, and service delivery. 2. User, Endpoint & Device Management Govern user provisioning and de-provisioning, and set the standard for employee onboarding and offboarding end to end. Define endpoint configuration standards for laptops, desktops, and peripherals. Oversee OS builds, patching, EDR/antivirus deployment, and system hardening. Manage the fleet through MDM / UEM tools such as Jamf, Microsoft Intune, and ManageEngine . Ensure asset tagging, lifecycle management, and disposal compliance. 3. Access Control & Privilege Management Govern administrative access and enforce least-privilege principles across systems. Ensure privileged access is granted only with proper approval and documentation. Run a Privileged Access Management (PAM) program and coordinate with Security on access reviews and audits. Maintain accurate records of admin access, temporary permissions, and approvals. 4. Infrastructure & Application Support Coordinate with infrastructure and networking teams on server, storage, and network dependencies. Ensure availability and support for business applications and internal tools. Manage application installations through approved, controlled processes. Oversee endpoint and application licensing compliance. 5. IT Service Management & Reporting Ensure all IT activity is tracked through ITSM tickets, email trails, and documentation — no ad-hoc or undocumented work. Monitor SLAs and ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests. Maintain daily and weekly status reporting for management review. Keep full traceability across every change and request. 6. Security, Audit & Compliance Maintain audit-ready documentation for IT administration, and support internal and external audits (IT, security, compliance). Drive closure of audit points and corrective actions within defined timelines. Keep IT policies, SOPs, and checklists current. Coordinate with the security team and specialist vendors across DLP, web security (Zero Trust / SSE), Web Application Firewall (WAF), cloud security, server & endpoint backup, and continuous threat exposure management (red teaming). 7. Team Leadership & Coordination Lead and mentor the IT Administration team; assign clear ownership, timelines, and reporting. Review team performance and uphold professional, disciplined work practices. Act as the escalation point for complex IT administration issues. Coordinate closely with the Cyber Security and Networking / Infrastructure leads. 8. Business Continuity & Improvement Support business continuity planning (BCP) and disaster-recovery activities. Identify gaps in IT administration processes and drive continuous improvement. Recommend automation and standardization to improve efficiency and strengthen security posture. Key Accountabilities Stable and secure IT administration operations. Zero undocumented changes or access. Timely incident and request resolution within SLA. Accurate, timely reporting to management. Audit-compliant IT administration processes. Requirements Must Have 8+ years in IT Administration, System Administration, or IT Operations, including 2+ years leading a team or function. Strong Windows and Linux administration. Endpoint management and patching at scale, with hands-on experience across MDM / UEM (Jamf, Microsoft Intune, or ManageEngine) and EDR/antivirus. IT asset management, and application and license management. Hands-on experience with ITSM tools and ticketing systems, and SLA-driven service delivery. Identity and access governance across Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace and SaaS tools, including privileged access management. Proven vendor and stakeholder management. Strong documentation, process discipline, and audit-readiness. Clear leadership, coordination, reporting, and escalation skills. Good to Have ITIL certification and relevant system or security certifications (e.g., Microsoft, Jamf, CompTIA). Experience standing up and scaling IT in a startup, high-growth, or multi-entity (India + overseas) environment. Experience supporting audits in a regulated, high-governance, or pre-IPO context. Exposure to security tooling — DLP, Zero Trust / SSE, WAF, cloud security, PAM, and CTEM / red-teaming programs. Scripting or automation for IT operations. Qualification Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field. Tools & Environment You'll Govern You will own (and coordinate with the Security and Networking functions and specialist vendors on) a modern IT and security stack, including: Device & endpoint: MDM / UEM (Jamf, Intune, ManageEngine), endpoint security / EDR, antivirus, and patch management. Identity & access: Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace, SaaS access management, MFA, and Privileged Access Management (PAM). Service & operations: ITSM / ticketing, infrastructure monitoring and alerting, and server & endpoint backup. Data & network security: Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Web Security (Zero Trust / SSE), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and cloud security. Assurance: continuous threat exposure management / red teaming. Workplace: meeting-room AV and conferencing — screens, cameras, wireless presentation, and room scheduling for Teams, Zoom, Google Meet, and Webex. What We Value Ownership and accountability — leading by example. A strong customer-service mindset across the organization. Process and documentation discipline, and a bias for traceability. Proactive, pragmatic problem-solving. Raising the bar on IT reliability and security posture. Adaptability in a fast-paced environment, and a habit of continuous improvement. Why Join Us? Technology is at the core of everything we do. jobs.text: We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst who can bridge the gap between business stakeholders and engineering teams. You will collaborate with clients, product managers, designers, developers, QA teams, and leadership to deliver scalable digital products while ensuring business objectives are met. Create process flows, UML diagrams, wireframes, journey maps, and workflow documentation. Work closely with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, Developers, and QA teams throughout the SDLC. Prioritize requirements and manage product backlogs in collaboration with stakeholders. Facilitate sprint planning, backlog grooming, UAT, and release planning. Validate delivered features against business requirements and acceptance criteria. Perform gap analysis, impact analysis, and feasibility assessments. Analyze business processes and recommend improvements through automation and digital transformation. Monitor product performance using analytics and recommend enhancements based on user behavior and business metrics. Support change management, implementation, and user adoption. Stay updated with emerging technologies including AI, automation, cloud platforms, blockchain (where applicable), and modern software development practices. Experience working with distributed or international teams Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. 5–7 years of experience as a Business Analyst in software development or IT services. Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile/Scrum methodologies. Hands-on experience preparing: BRD FRD SRS User Stories Acceptance Criteria Use Cases Process Flow Diagrams Wireframes UML Diagrams Experience with requirement gathering, stakeholder management, and client communication. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize effectively. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.text: Roles and Responsibilities: Oversee the entire lifecycle of AI/ML features, ensuring their successful implementation, scalability, and maintenance. Train, evaluate, and fine-tune AI/ML models using the most suitable techniques, architectures, and frameworks. Implement key machine learning strategies across the business and collaborate with stakeholders for effective delivery. Coordinate end-to-end delivery of AI-driven projects, working closely with cross-functional teams including data engineering, product, and DevOps. Stay up-to-date with the latest AI/ML and Generative AI research, frameworks, and tools to contribute to continuous innovation. Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for AI and data science solutions. Develop and maintain APIs and microservices for integrating AI models with other business systems and products. Perform model testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting to ensure accuracy, reliability, and efficiency in production environments. Design, build, and deploy Generative AI components (e.g., large language models, text/image generation, summarization tools) to enhance product capabilities. Leverage frameworks such as LangChain, Hugging Face, and OpenAI APIs to integrate LLM-based features into existing workflows and systems. Experiment with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, and prompt engineering techniques to improve model outputs. Collaborate with cloud and DevOps teams to implement MLOps pipelines for continuous integration, delivery, and monitoring of AI models. Provide technical support and knowledge transfer to clients and internal teams, ensuring smooth adoption of AI technologies. Contribute to AI governance and ethical considerations for responsible AI usage. Mentor junior engineers and foster a culture of experimentation and learning in advanced AI areas, including Generative AI. Qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in designing, developing, and deploying AI/ML solutions. Strong understanding of AI/ML algorithms, deep learning architectures, and frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenCV, and Scikit-learn. Proficient in Python and experienced with frameworks like LangChain, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Hugging Face. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, and Azure, and familiarity with managed AI/ML services (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI). Expertise in Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision, and model deployment workflows. Hands-on experience developing and deploying Generative AI applications, including LLMs, diffusion models, and transformer-based architectures. Familiar with vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma) and embedding-based retrieval systems. Experience with MLOps practices, including CI/CD, model versioning, monitoring, and scaling. Knowledge of Big Data platforms such as Apache Kafka, Hadoop, and Snowflake, and experience using PySpark and Databricks for data engineering tasks. Strong software engineering background with a focus on clean, efficient, and maintainable code. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Familiarity with Generative AI frameworks and APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or Stability AI is an advantage. Experience with distributed systems and model optimization is a plus. Ability to work independently, communicate effectively with clients, and mentor junior team members. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, and innovation-driven environment. Passionate about leveraging AI and Generative AI technologies to drive real-world business growth and innovation

jobs.title: UX Analyst
jobs.text: Title: UI/UX Analyst, D2C Product Reports To: Lead D2C Location: Mumbai (Work from Office) Who we are and Why we exist At The Whole Truth, our mission is to ‘re-build the world’s trust in its food’. Consumers have lost faith in big food companies that hide behind misleading claims. We exist to change that with honesty, simplicity, and unmissable storytelling. We are India’s first (and maybe only) 100% Clean Label food brand. That means we proudly declare every single ingredient on the front of the pack. But that’s not all…We don’t just make products. We build brand love. Loudly, proudly, and consistently through content, community, and creative campaigns that break clutter. And now, we’re ready to scale that brand love even further through smart, memorable, and well-placed media. That’s where you come in. About The Role As UI/UX Analyst, you'll diagnose friction, design better user experiences, and validate improvements through data. You're not a pure designer. You're not a pure analyst. You're the bridge – using session recordings, heatmaps, and funnel data to identify why customers drop off, and designing solutions to test. Key Responsibilities Session recording analysis - watch session recordings 2–3x/week to spot friction and user behavior patterns UX friction diagnosis – combine session data, heatmaps, and GA4 to build a prioritized list of improvements A/B test variant design – sketch solutions in Figma based on your findings; collaborate with the product and design teams on testing strategy Design system maintenance — collaborate with the design strategy team to document components and ensure consistency across the website Insight reporting – weekly conversion updates to the team; monthly deep dives on major findings Tool evaluation – research and recommend new UX testing tools (UserTesting, Maze, etc.) as you identify gaps in our workflow You'll collaborate closely with the product and engineering teams to drive user-centric improvements across the platform. Technical Capabilities Required Design Tools & Prototyping: Figma proficiency (non-negotiable) – component-based design, design systems, interactive prototypes Ability to create A/B test variants quickly and hand off clean specs to engineering Understanding of mobile-first design Analytics & Data Tools( good to have): GA4 –funnel visualization, event tracking, custom reports (not deep SQL, but comfortable navigating the tool) Session recording tools – session recording, heatmaps, and user behavior identification Ability to interpret data and translate findings into design improvements Basic statistical thinking (correlation vs. causation, sample size matters) Platform & E-Commerce Context: Familiarity of e-commerce platforms – enough to know what's possible and what's a technical constraint Familiarity with conversion funnel – browse → add-to-cart → checkout → payment → confirmation Tools You Can Learn & Suggest: You're encouraged to research and recommend new tools that fit your workflow – UserTesting, Maze, Hotjar, Pendo , etc. You should stay current on UX testing and session recording tools Functional Capabilities Required Conversion Psychology: Understand micro-interactions that drive decision-making (button color, copy, social proof, urgency) Know how to reduce friction (form fields, payment options, trust signals) Apply JTBD (Jobs to Be Done) thinking – what job is the customer hiring this product for? UX Research & Data Literacy: Can read a session recording and identify 3–5 UX issues Can spot patterns in heatmap data (click clusters, scroll depth, attention areas) Comfortable asking "why" – always validate assumptions with data before designing A/B Testing & Iteration: Design test variants based on hypothesis, not guesswork Understand statistical rigor (sample size, test duration, confidence levels) Iterate based on results – learn from losses, compound wins Communication & Collaboration: Sketch ideas quickly in Figma and get feedback early Present findings to product and design teams in a structured way Comfortable with ambiguity — you'll be expected to own problems, not just execute specs Required Skills & Experience 2–3 years of UX/UI design or product analytics experience (agency, SaaS, e-commerce, or D2C preferred) Figma expertise - can create designs, components, and interactive prototypes; not a designer by training, but by fluency Conversion psychology – understand how small UX changes impact user behavior Data literacy – comfortable with GA4 funnels, segment analysis, and session recording tools Mobile-first thinking – design for phones first, then desktop India D2C context – nice-to-have but not mandatory. Understanding of Indian customer behavior, payment methods, and logistics is valuable Written communication — can document findings clearly and present to non-designers Request you to share the assignment link while applying. Assignment: Task 1 Description: Audit The Whole Truth Foods' website (thewholetruthfoods.com), specifically the product browse → add-to-cart → checkout flow . Identify 4-5 friction points or UX issues that could impact conversion rate. For 2 of these issues, design a proposed improvement in Figma or any free design tool (Penpot, Excalidraw, Figma free tier). Include a written analysis explaining: What friction you identified (and why it matters) How you'd measure the impact of your proposed change Hypothesis for what conversion lift you'd expect Task 2 Description: Your GA4 shows that 42% of users land on the homepage, but only 18% click into a category page. Of those who do, only 8% complete a purchase. Heatmap data shows the category navigation menu has low click-through - users instead using the search bar. Session recordings reveal users are confused about the difference between similar products (e.g., Whey Protein vs. Plant Protein, or different protein bar flavors). The exit rate on category pages is 35%." Candidate's Task: Diagnose the issue – Write 150–200 words on why category navigation is underperforming and how it impacts the funnel (consider: information overload, product differentiation, filtering options, trust signals) Propose 3 design/UX changes — Could include: improved category page layout, better filtering, comparison tools, simplified navigation, product badge/labeling, etc. Design 1 variant – Redesigned category page or navigation menu in Figma/free tool Testing & insights plan – How would you test? What secondary metrics matter (e.g., time on category page, filter usage, comparison tool clicks)? Note : Please attach the assignment link in the assignment submission tab mentioned in the application form

jobs.title: Lead- Corporate Affairs
jobs.text: Role Summary: This person will own the company's relationships with government bodies, regulators, local authorities, and industry forums—with particular depth across Mumbai, Bhiwandi, and the wider Maharashtra region. They will protect and advance the company's interests by anticipating policy and regulatory developments, smoothing operational approvals, and building the company's reputation as a responsible, clean-label brand. Key Responsibilities: Government & Regulatory Relations ● Build and maintain working relationships with state and local government bodies, including FDA Maharashtra, FSSAI, MIDC, municipal corporations (BMC, Bhiwandi), GST/excise authorities, and pollution control boards. ● Manage licensing, approvals, inspections, and compliance matters for manufacturing and warehousing operations, especially in the Bhiwandi area. ● Track policy, food-safety regulation, and labelling-norm changes that affect clean-label products, and advise leadership on impact and response. Stakeholder & Community Engagement ● Serve as the company's representative with local authorities, civic bodies, police, labour offices, and community leaders around our Bhiwandi and Maharashtra sites. ● Manage industry association memberships (e.g., CII, FICCI, food-processing bodies) and represent the company in relevant forums. ● Lead CSR initiatives and community-relations programs that strengthen the company's local standing. Public Affairs & Reputation ● Support corporate communications, media relations, and crisis management as needed. ● Position the brand's clean-label and sustainability story with external stakeholders. jobs.title: Engineer- Field Service & Technical Operations
jobs.text: About us: At The Whole Truth, we're rebuilding the world's trust in food. As we scale our automated smoothie vending network across India, we're looking for a hands-on Service Engineer who will ensure our vending systems operate reliably and consistently across multiple locations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving technical problems in the field and working with a combination of mechanical, electrical, refrigeration, automation, and dispensing systems. Role Overview: The Service Engineer will be responsible for installation, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of automated smoothie vending machines deployed across India. The role requires frequent travel and a strong bias toward ownership and problem-solving. You will be the first line of support for machine uptime and operational excellence. Key Responsibilities: Machine Installation & Commissioning: • Install and commission vending machines at new locations. • Conduct machine acceptance checks before go-live. • Train operators and local support teams on machine operation. Maintenance & Troubleshooting: • Perform scheduled preventive maintenance. • Diagnose and resolve electrical, mechanical, refrigeration, dispensing, and control system issues. • Troubleshoot sensors, actuators, pumps, motors, PLCs, HMIs, and communication systems. • Maintain machine uptime and reliability targets. Breakdown Management: • Respond to machine breakdowns and service requests. • Identify root causes and implement permanent corrective actions. • Coordinate with OEM teams when required. Spare Parts Management: • Maintain critical spare inventory. • Track component failures and replacement history. • Recommend stocking strategies to improve uptime. Performance Monitoring: • Monitor machine performance metrics. • Identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities. • Support software and firmware upgrades when required. Documentation: • Maintain service reports and maintenance records. • Develop SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and maintenance checklists. • Ensure compliance with food safety and operational standards. Candidate Profile: Education • Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in: Mechanical Engineering/ Mechatronics Engineering/ Electrical Engineering/ Instrumentation Engineering • 2–4 years of experience in: Vending machines Coffee machines Beverage dispensing equipment Food service equipment Refrigeration systems Packaging machinery Industrial automation equipment Technical Skills Must Have: • Electrical troubleshooting • Mechanical troubleshooting • Sensor and actuator diagnostics • Preventive maintenance • Root cause analysis Good To Have: • PLC basics • HMI systems • Refrigeration systems • IoT-enabled equipment • Remote diagnostics • Food service equipment maintenance

jobs.title: Collections Executive – Accounts Receivable
jobs.text: About This Role We’re looking for a Collections Executive to support timely and consistent follow-up on outstanding receivables across customers and regions. This role exists to help maintain healthy customer ageing and predictable cash flow by ensuring payments are received as per agreed credit terms. You’ll work closely with billing and AR operations teams to track invoices, resolve disputes, and keep internal stakeholders informed on collection status. What You’ll Do Collections & Follow-ups 1.Track outstanding invoices across multiple geographies on a daily basis. 2.Follow up with customers through emails, calls, and reminders for pending payments. 3.Ensure payments are received within agreed timelines and credit terms. Ageing & Reporting 1.Monitor customer ageing and flag risks early. 2.Prepare and share weekly client collection projections. 3.Maintain accurate collection trackers and follow-up logs. Issue Resolution & Coordination 1.Coordinate with billing and internal teams to resolve invoice disputes or payment issues. 2.Provide regular status updates on collections and escalations. 3.Escalate long-overdue accounts using defined internal processes. Cash Flow Support 1.Support monthly collection goals and overall cash flow planning. 2.Contribute to improving collection efficiency and predictability. What We’re Looking For 1.2–5 years of experience in client collections or receivables follow-ups. 2.Experience working with invoicing and accounts receivable processes. 3.Strong communication and negotiation skills. 4.Fluency in English, Hindi, and Kannada. 5.Solid Excel skills for tracking, reporting, and basic reconciliations. Nice to Have 1.Experience handling collections across multiple geographies. 2.Prior collaboration with billing or finance operations teams. What Makes You a Strong Fit 1.You’re consistent and structured in follow-ups. 2.You’re comfortable speaking with customers about payments and timelines. 3.You can balance persistence with professionalism. 4.You keep clean records and communicate clearly with internal teams. Why This Role Matters This role directly supports cash flow stability and financial planning. By keeping receivables on track and issues resolved quickly, you help the business operate smoothly and make informed decisions. Why Join Us 1.Work closely with core finance and operations teams. 2.Gain exposure to multi-geo customer collections. 3.Build depth in AR and cash flow operations. 4.Operate in a role with clear ownership and impact. 5.Grow within a structured, execution-focused environment.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative  Lead
jobs.text: About This Role We run a data-driven outbound and inbound-qualification motion, with every call, email, and account touch logged and worked in structured cycles - fresh outbound, dormant-deal revival, closed-lost re-engagement, and no-deal contact revival. This role owns the numbers behind that engine: the activity that goes in, the qualified pipeline that comes out, and the CRM discipline that lets us trust both. You'll lead a team of SDRs, hold them accountable to daily and weekly targets, keep the funnel clean and measurable, and turn activity data into decisions — who to call first, which accounts to revive, and where each rep needs to improve. What You'll Do Team Leadership & Coaching Lead, coach, and develop a team of SDRs through daily huddles, call and email reviews, live listening, and weekly 1:1s tied to each rep's numbers. Own onboarding and ramp for new hires, guiding them to full quota productivity. Build a culture of accountability where targets, activity, and data hygiene are non-negotiable, without undermining team morale. Pipeline Generation & Quality Carry a team quota for qualified meetings and sales-accepted pipeline. Run structured working cycles across fresh outbound, dormant-deal revival, closed-lost re-engagement, and no-deal contact revival, using scoring and prioritisation logic to guide who the team approaches first. Enforce qualification criteria so booked meetings convert into real pipeline rather than calendar activity. Performance Management Track and report daily, weekly, and monthly on activity and output metrics for each rep and the team. Own the SDR dashboards, keeping them accurate and using them to identify who's ahead, who's behind, and why. Run a weekly numbers review covering activity vs. target, connect and conversion rates, meetings booked, pipeline generated, and stage-by-stage drop-off. Diagnose performance gaps from the funnel data — pinpoint whether shortfalls stem from dials, connect rate, pitch, or qualification — and act on the right lever. Flag under-performance early with a documented plan, and surface top performers for progression. Process, CRM & Data Hygiene Enforce complete, accurate logging of every call, email, note, and task in the CRM. Keep contact, company, and deal data clean so reporting and revival scoring remain trustworthy. Refine cadences, sequences, call scripts, and messaging based on performance data. Partner with Marketing on lead flow and SLAs, and with Account Executives on clean, well-documented handoffs. What We're Looking For 3+ years in SDR, BDR, or inside sales, including 1–2 years leading, mentoring, or acting as a senior/lead SDR, ideally in B2B SaaS. A proven track record of personally hitting SDR quota, plus a clear example of lifting a team's or peers' performance. Strong hands-on CRM skills — able to build and read reports and dashboards, not just log activity. Genuine comfort with metrics — you instinctively break a shortfall down by funnel stage and act on it. Strong coaching, communication, and objection-handling skills — you can teach a call, not just make one. An organised, consistent, and accountable operating style, running a tight cadence and expecting the same from your team. Nice to Have Experience with outbound tooling, sales engagement platforms, or lead-scoring and prioritisation systems. Exposure to rewards, engagement, loyalty, or incentive-tech, or to selling to HR, Sales, or Marketing buyers. What Makes You a Strong Fit You diagnose from data, not opinion, and know exactly which funnel lever to pull when numbers move. You hold a team to high standards while keeping morale intact. You treat CRM hygiene as core to the job, not an afterthought. You coach reps toward better conversion rather than just pushing more activity. Why This Role Matters This role is the connective layer between raw outbound activity and predictable, qualified pipeline. The quality of the team's coaching, data discipline, and funnel diagnosis directly shapes how much revenue the business can reliably forecast and close. Why Join Us Lead a team working across multiple products in a live, quota-carrying motion. Own dashboards and reporting that directly influence sales decisions. Operate with real accountability and visibility into your team's impact. Work closely with Marketing and Account Executives on shared pipeline goals.

jobs.title: Growth Associate - Category

Coordinate end-to-end campaign launches, content production, and performance tracking. Run multiple campaigns simultaneously while keeping quality and brand consistency high. 2. Growth Experimentation & GTM Design experiments that directly impact revenue and plan go-to-market activities end to end. Uncover product-led growth (PLG) opportunities by understanding customer needs, behaviors, and actions. Test, measure, and iterate on growth levers across the funnel. 3. AI-Led Content & Designs Leverage AI tools and platforms — ChatGPT, Claude, Figma, Power BI, PostHog, and email tools — to scale content workflows, data analysis, and campaign automation. Build automation workflows that increase execution speed and output per person. Produce engaging, on-brand content across formats and products. 4. Partner with CSM, Product, and clients to shape presentation decks, campaign materials, case studies, and other collateral. Coordinate cross-functionally to ensure smooth, on-time delivery. 5. Data, Insights & Reporting Analyze campaign and product data to surface insights that drive business decisions and client strategies. Track campaign performance, ROI, and success metrics; maintain a regular reporting cadence. Identify opportunities to improve outcomes and act on them. Required Skills & Competencies Hands-on fluency with AI tools and platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, Figma, Power BI, PostHog, email tools) for content, data analysis, and automation. Strong sense of ownership; a natural custodian for content, marketing, and cross-team collaboration. Ability to drive multiple projects at once without letting quality slip. jobs.title: Merchant Offers Operations Executive
jobs.text: About Xoxoday Xoxoday is a global rewards, incentives, and loyalty platform helping enterprises engage employees, customers, and channel partners through rewards, recognition, incentives, and loyalty programs. This role is the operational backbone of the Merchant Offers team, ensuring seamless execution of merchant onboarding, offer launches, catalog quality, client deliverables, reporting, and operational governance. Key Responsibilities 1. Merchant Offer Operations Support Partnerships Managers in onboarding and launching merchant-funded offers across multiple markets. Upload and maintain merchant offers, campaign information, images, terms & conditions, redemption instructions, and offer mechanics across internal platforms. Coordinate with merchants and internal stakeholders to collect onboarding documents and operational information. Maintain offer catalogs by updating expired, modified, or seasonal campaigns. Ensure timely execution of offer launches, renewals, and campaign updates. 2. Catalog Quality & Validation Perform detailed quality checks before and after merchant offer launches. Validate offer content, pricing, eligibility, campaign validity, merchant information, categories, locations, redemption channels, and offer mechanics. Ensure marketplace content complies with internal quality standards and client requirements. Identify and resolve duplicate, inaccurate, or incomplete offer listings. Maintain quality checklists, SOPs, and validation processes. 3. Client Deliveries & Marketplace Support Prepare customized merchant offer catalogs for enterprise clients and banking partners. Support client-specific offer requests, campaign documentation, and operational deliverables. Coordinate with Client Success teams to ensure timely delivery of merchant offers. Track client requests and delivery timelines while maintaining defined SLAs. Assist in resolving operational issues and client-reported content discrepancies. 4. Reporting & Business Operations Maintain merchant onboarding trackers, campaign trackers, and operational dashboards. Support Partnerships Managers with merchant performance reports and business reviews. Analyze operational data to identify bottlenecks, quality issues, and improvement opportunities. Ensure accuracy and consistency of operational data across systems. 5. AI & Process Automation Identify repetitive operational activities that can be automated. Leverage AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and similar platforms to improve operational productivity. Build AI-assisted workflows for report generation, spreadsheet management, content validation, documentation, and routine operational tasks. Support implementation of workflow automation initiatives using no-code and low-code platforms. Continuously explore emerging AI tools to improve team efficiency and reduce manual effort. 6. Operational Governance Maintain documentation for merchant onboarding, offer launches, approvals, and campaign execution. Ensure compliance with internal operational processes and governance standards. Coordinate issue tracking and follow-ups with internal stakeholders. Support audit activities and maintain operational documentation. Monitor SLA adherence and operational turnaround times. 7. Cross-Functional Coordination Work closely with Partnerships Managers to support merchant onboarding and campaign execution. Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Operations, Growth, and Client Success teams for timely delivery. Follow up with merchants and internal stakeholders to ensure timely completion of operational activities. Support process improvement initiatives across the Merchant Offers function. Required Skills & Competencies Marketplace Operations Strong understanding of operations, marketplace management, catalog operations, sales operations, merchant operations, or business operations. Excellent attention to detail with a strong quality-first mindset. Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Reporting & Data Management Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets. Comfortable working with large datasets, CSV files, and operational trackers. Strong analytical and reporting skills. Ability to prepare dashboards, operational reports, and business summaries. AI & Automation Strong interest in AI and operational automation. Hands-on experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, or Perplexity. Familiarity with Google Apps Script, APIs, Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar automation platforms is an advantage. Ability to identify automation opportunities and improve operational efficiency. Communication & Collaboration Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple stakeholders across functions. High ownership and execution-oriented mindset. Strong follow-up and stakeholder management capabilities. Experience & Qualifications 2–4 years of experience in Marketplace Operations, Merchant Operations, Business Operations, Sales Operations, Catalog Operations, Program Management, or similar roles. Experience supporting merchant onboarding, offer management, or marketplace operations is preferred. Experience in loyalty, rewards, fintech, banking, travel, e-commerce, or digital commerce businesses is an added advantage. Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Engineering, Operations, or a related field. What Success Looks Like Accurate and timely onboarding of merchant partners and offer campaigns. 99%+ accuracy in merchant offer uploads and marketplace content. Consistent adherence to client delivery and campaign launch SLAs. High-quality reporting with accurate operational insights. Significant reduction in manual operational effort through AI and automation. Faster turnaround times for merchant onboarding and offer launches. Strong operational support enabling Partnerships Managers to focus on merchant acquisition and commercial growth. Contribution towards building a scalable, AI-powered Merchant Offers Operations function. Why Join Xoxoday? Be part of one of the world's fastest-growing rewards and loyalty marketplaces. Work with leading merchants, banks, card networks, and enterprise clients across multiple countries. Gain exposure to global merchant-funded offer programs and marketplace operations. Learn and implement cutting-edge AI tools and workflow automation technologies. Collaborate with experienced partnerships, product, and operations leaders. Enjoy high ownership, continuous learning, and excellent career growth opportunities within a rapidly scaling global organization.

jobs.title: Senior Manager – Business & Commercial Intelligence
jobs.text: About the Role Xoxoday processes millions of transactions every year — across APIs, digital gift cards, rewards, payments, ecommerce storefronts, and global merchant partners. This role owns the intelligence layer behind that scale: making sure pricing, margins, catalog data, payment flows, settlement, and transaction success rates stay accurate, healthy, and continuously improving. This is not a reporting or dashboard role. You'll work directly with Product, Finance, and the CXO office to catch issues before customers do, and turn data into measurable business outcomes. What You'll Own Transaction Intelligence Understand the complete lifecycle of every transaction type on the platform — API orders, ecommerce storefront orders, gift cards, rewards redemption, payment gateway transactions, refunds, cancellations, settlement, and vendor fulfilment. Identify where and why transactions fail, and drive fixes. Commerce Analytics Continuously monitor transaction success rates, payment failures, and performance by vendor, merchant, category, country, currency, and partner. Convert patterns into insights that improve customer experience and profitability. Pricing & Margin Intelligence Own commercial visibility across the catalog — merchant margins, pricing inconsistencies, discount leakage, FX impact, and profitability trends. Recommend pricing and sourcing improvements. Revenue Assurance Track down revenue leakage from incorrect pricing, wrong commissions, settlement issues, catalog errors, data inconsistencies, workflow gaps, system defects, or operational misses — and stay on each issue with Product and Finance until it's permanently closed. Catalog Intelligence Keep the catalog commercially healthy: flag incorrect pricing, duplicate SKUs, invalid denominations, expired products, incorrect tax treatment, currency mismatches, and merchant onboarding gaps. Business Controls Build validations across critical transaction journeys to proactively catch anomalies, fraud patterns, margin erosion, vendor issues, and customer-impacting defects. AI-driven Analytics Use AI to detect anomalies, surface hidden trends, automate repetitive analysis, and accelerate investigations — building monitoring that scales beyond manual review. What We're Looking For 4–10 years in FinTech, Ecommerce, Payments, or Marketplace businesses Strong grasp of transaction-heavy platforms and commercial mechanics Comfortable working with millions of transaction records Genuinely curious — the kind of person who can't leave an unexplained metric alone Able to translate data into product and operational action, not just insight Strong SQL and Excel; Python is a plus Experience with BI tools like Looker, Tableau, or Power BI Hands-on with modern AI tools for analytics and productivity You'll Love This Role If You Enjoy finding hidden revenue leakage Like solving complex, ambiguous business puzzles Get satisfaction from improving margins through data Want to understand how commerce systems work end-to-end Prefer working directly with Product Heads, Finance, and leadership Would rather drive action than produce reports What Success Looks Like in Year One End-to-end visibility across the transaction lifecycle Measurable improvement in transaction success rates Fewer pricing and catalog errors Stronger payment and settlement controls Identified and eliminated revenue leakage Improved merchant profitability Automated monitoring in place for key commerce health metrics Recognized as the go-to source for commercial insight across the org

jobs.title: Catalog Quality & AI Automation Manager

This is not a traditional catalog operations role. At Xoxoday, we are building an AI-first Marketplace Operations function and are looking for someone who can leverage AI tools, automation platforms, and emerging technologies to transform how catalog quality is managed at scale. The ideal candidate is someone who constantly experiments with AI tools, automation workflows, and operational efficiencies. You should be equally comfortable conducting quality audits, analyzing large datasets, building AI-powered workflows, and collaborating with product and engineering teams to automate quality assurance processes. You will work closely with Category Managers, Supplier Partners, Product, Engineering, Operations, Growth, and Client Success teams to ensure world-class catalog quality across global markets. Key Responsibilities 1. Catalog Quality Ownership & Governance Own end-to-end catalog quality across all marketplace categories globally. Define and maintain catalog quality standards, SOPs, governance frameworks, and audit mechanisms. Establish quality benchmarks across Product Names, Product Descriptions, Images, Pricing & Denominations, Redemption Instructions, Terms & Conditions Etc Ensure consistency and quality across all supplier catalogs and geographies. Drive continuous improvement in catalog quality KPIs. 2. Catalog Audits & Quality Control Lead periodic catalog audits across Gift Vouchers, Merchandise, Top-ups, Airmiles, Flights, Hotels, Lounge Access, Experiences, and other marketplace categories. Identify and resolve Content inaccuracies, Incorrect category mappings, Pricing discrepancies, Missing product information, Duplicate products Etc Conduct pre-launch and post-launch quality reviews for all new products and suppliers. Build quality scorecards and audit frameworks for suppliers and categories. Ensure timely closure of catalog issues through cross-functional collaboration. 3. AI-Powered Catalog Automation Drive Xoxoday's AI-first approach to catalog quality management. Identify repetitive manual tasks and automate them using AI and workflow automation platforms. Design and implement scalable AI-powered catalog validation systems. Leverage tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini Etc Build automated workflows for: Product Naming Validation Description Quality Checks Terms & Conditions Verification Taxonomy Mapping Etc Continuously evaluate new AI technologies and implement solutions that improve efficiency and quality. 4. Taxonomy & Catalog Architecture Own category hierarchy, taxonomy standards, metadata governance, and catalog structure. Ensure standardization across global supplier catalogs. Define category mapping frameworks and naming conventions. Improve product discoverability through better taxonomy design. Collaborate with Product teams to enhance marketplace search, filtering, and navigation experiences. 5. Supplier Onboarding & Quality Validation Establish quality validation processes for all supplier onboarding activities. Review supplier catalogs before launch to ensure compliance with marketplace standards. Work with Category Managers and supplier teams to resolve onboarding issues. Develop onboarding playbooks, templates, and quality checklists. Ensure suppliers meet content and operational quality requirements. 6. Process Excellence & Automation Build scalable quality assurance processes that can support rapid marketplace growth. Partner with Product and Engineering teams to automate quality control workflows. Reduce manual effort through intelligent automation initiatives. Define and monitor operational SLAs related to catalog quality and issue resolution. Create internal quality management frameworks and best practices. 7. Data Analytics & Reporting Build and maintain catalog health dashboards and quality KPIs. Analyze quality trends, issue patterns, supplier performance, and operational bottlenecks. Generate actionable insights to improve catalog quality and customer experience. Present quality reviews and improvement recommendations to leadership teams. Measure automation impact and quality improvement outcomes. 8. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Category Managers to ensure category readiness and catalog health. Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to implement automation and quality improvements. Work with Operations and Client Success teams to resolve customer-facing catalog issues. Support Growth and Sales teams with accurate marketplace content and product information. Act as the central owner of catalog governance and quality across the organization. Required Skills & Competencies Catalog & Marketplace Expertise Strong understanding of catalog management, marketplace operations, quality assurance, e-commerce operations, or product operations. Experience managing large-scale product catalogs and supplier ecosystems. Strong understanding of taxonomy management, product content, metadata, and catalog governance. AI & Automation Expertise Strong passion for AI, automation, and operational excellence. Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, Perplexity etc Strong prompt engineering and AI workflow design capabilities. Ability to rapidly prototype and deploy automation solutions with minimal engineering dependency. Familiarity with APIs, CSV processing, Google Sheets automation, data validation workflows, and no-code/low-code platforms. Analytical & Problem Solving Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, root causes, and process gaps. Data-driven decision-making capabilities. Excellent attention to detail and quality-focused mindset. Stakeholder Management Strong communication and presentation skills. Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across business, product, engineering, and operations teams. Proven ability to drive projects independently in a fast-paced environment. Experience & Qualifications 5–6 years of experience in Catalog Management, Marketplace Operations, Product Operations, Quality Assurance, E-commerce Operations, or related functions. Experience managing large product catalogs and supplier ecosystems. Exposure to categories such as Gift Cards, Merchandise, Travel, Hospitality, Top-ups, Airmiles, Loyalty, Experiences, or Digital Commerce is preferred. Experience working across multiple international markets is an added advantage. Prior experience in loyalty, rewards, fintech, travel-tech, e-commerce, or marketplace businesses is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience using AI tools to improve operational efficiency, quality, or scalability is strongly preferred. What Success Looks Like Industry-leading catalog quality across all marketplace categories. 60%+ reduction in manual catalog review effort through AI and automation. Significant reduction in customer-facing catalog issues and operational escalations. Faster supplier onboarding and catalog launch timelines. Automated quality validation across major marketplace categories. High accuracy, consistency, and completeness of product information globally. Strong governance and standardization across categories and geographies. Establishment of Xoxoday as an AI-first marketplace operations organization. Contribution towards making Xoxoday's marketplace the most trusted rewards and loyalty marketplace globally. Why Join Xoxoday? Opportunity to lead quality and automation for one of the world's fastest-growing rewards marketplaces. Build AI-powered operational systems from the ground up. Work with cutting-edge AI tools and automation technologies. Collaborate with global suppliers, category leaders, and product teams. High ownership, visibility, and growth opportunities.

jobs.title: Sales & GTM Analyst
jobs.text: About Xoxoday Xoxoday is a global SaaS company building the infrastructure for people-first workplaces. Xoxoday serves thousands of businesses worldwide, from growth-stage startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, across HR, sales, and marketing functions. Empuls is Xoxoday’s employee engagement product. It helps companies build a culture of recognition and belonging — through peer-to-peer appreciation, milestone celebrations, rewards, surveys, and more. What sets Empuls apart is its own global rewards catalog: not a reseller, but a builder. From France and Germany to Canada, the US, Singapore, Australia, India, and 100+ other markets, every employee gets the same quality of recognition experience — fulfilled locally, in local currency, on one unified workflow. Automated where it should be, human where it matters. About this role We’re looking for a sharp, execution-driven Junior Associate to work directly out of the Founder’s Office, supporting the US go-to-market motion for Empuls. You’ll sit at the intersection of outreach, pipeline hygiene, and operational coordination — making sure nothing slips through the cracks as the US team scales. This is a high-visibility, high-accountability role. You’ll operate from the founding team’s handles, engage directly with prospects, and keep the sales engine running smoothly behind the scenes. What you’ll do Run consistent, high-quality outreach on behalf of the Founder via email and LinkedIn — owning the cadence and ensuring no prospect falls through without a proper follow-up. Monitor and track pipeline movement alongside the US sales team, flagging stalled deals and resolving blockers proactively. Maintain HubSpot hygiene — logging activities, cleaning records, and ensuring data accuracy across the pipeline. Conduct targeted data research to identify and enrich prospect lists for the US GTM motion. Collate and organise marketing resources, enablement materials, and campaign assets for the US team. Coordinate with internal stakeholders — the Founder, Pranshu Sharma, the US team, and external prospects — to keep execution on track. Why this role matters The US is one of Empuls’s most critical growth markets, and this role sits right at the centre of that push. The Founder’s Office is where strategy meets execution — and without tight outreach discipline, clean pipeline data, and sharp coordination, opportunities stall and momentum is lost. This role isn’t administrative support. It is the connective tissue between the Founder’s vision, the sales team’s pipeline, and the prospects we’re trying to win. You will directly influence how fast the US GTM machine moves, how many conversations turn into qualified opportunities, and how well the team operates under pressure. If you do this well, the impact is visible — to the Founder, to the US team, and to the business. What we’re looking for Must-haves Strong written communication skills — you write crisp, professional outreach that gets replies. Solid Excel skills — comfortable with data cleanup, lookups, and organising large datasets. 1–3 years of experience in a GTM, SDR, operations, or Founder’s Office environment. Ability to work the US-aligned shift (3 PM – 1 AM IST) consistently. High attention to detail and ownership mindset — things don’t fall through on your watch. Nice-to-haves Prior experience in a Founder’s Office or early-stage startup GTM role. Familiarity with HubSpot or any CRM tool. Exposure to US market outreach or US-based SDR workflows. Experience with data research tools (Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar). Qualifications Undergraduate degree in any discipline. What matters more: how you think, how you write, and how you get things done. Why join us At Xoxoday, you’re not a cog in a large machine. You’re close to the decision-makers, the product, and the customers from day one. Here’s what that means in practice: Front-row seat to scaling a global SaaS product in one of the most competitive markets in the world. Direct mentorship from the Founder — you’ll understand how a GTM motion is built, not just execute tasks within one. Work that ships. Ideas and improvements here move fast; there’s no six-month approval chain. A culture that rewards ownership. If you take something and run with it, you’ll be recognised for it — not just managed through it. Real exposure to global GTM — US outreach, international pipeline, and cross-functional collaboration across time zones. A product that genuinely makes people feel valued at work. That’s what Empuls does, and it’s what we try to practise internally too.

jobs.text: About Bolt.Earth Bolt. Earth is India's largest vertically integrated P2P electric vehicle (EV) charging network, with more than 100,000 chargers deployed across 1,900+ cities, serving a wide base of EV users. Backed by collaborations with leading OEMs and ecosystem partners and supported by its proprietary Charger Management System (CMS). Bolt. About the Role We are looking for a Zoho Developer to own the development, customization, and integration of our Zoho ecosystem — primarily Zoho CRM, Zoho Creator, and Zoho Books. You will build and maintain the workflows that connect our sales, operations, manufacturing, and finance processes, ensuring data flows cleanly and reliably across systems. The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills in the Zoho platform with practical understanding of manufacturing and inventory processes — how sales orders translate into production, procurement, stock movements, and invoicing. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain custom applications on Zoho Creator to support business processes (e.g., production tracking, inventory management, dispatch, service workflows). Customize and extend Zoho CRM — modules, layouts, blueprints, workflow rules, approval processes, and automation using Deluge. Build and maintain integrations between Zoho CRM, Zoho Creator, and Zoho Books (e.g., quote-to-order-to-invoice flows, customer/vendor sync, payment status updates), using native integrations, Deluge, and REST APIs. Develop and manage integrations with third-party systems (payment gateways, ERPs, logistics platforms, internal databases) via REST APIs and webhooks. Translate business requirements from sales, operations, finance, and manufacturing teams into scalable Zoho solutions. Implement data validation, deduplication, and hygiene practices across Zoho applications; support data migration and bulk operations. Maintain documentation for all customizations, integrations, and data flows. Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve issues in existing workflows and integrations; ensure minimal disruption to business operations. Follow change-management best practices: sandbox testing, validation, and controlled deployment before pushing changes to production. Required Skills & Qualifications Technical (Must-Have) 2+ years of hands-on Zoho development experience , with demonstrable projects across Zoho CRM, Zoho Creator, Zoho Books. Strong proficiency in Deluge scripting (functions, workflows, schedules, custom buttons). Experience building Zoho Creator applications from scratch — forms, reports, pages, and workflows. Working knowledge of Zoho CRM administration : modules, blueprints, assignment rules, validation rules, approval processes, and role-based access. Understanding of Zoho Books structure: items, sales orders, purchase orders, invoices, credit notes, and how they map to CRM records. Hands-on experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and OAuth 2.0 for cross-application and third-party integrations. Familiarity with Zoho Flow or equivalent middleware for integration orchestration. Strong requirement-gathering and stakeholder communication skills — able to work directly with non-technical teams. Domain / Process Knowledge (Must-Have) Practical exposure to manufacturing and/or inventory management processes , such as: Sales order → production/work order → dispatch flows Inventory tracking: stock-in/stock-out, warehouse transfers, serial/batch tracking Procurement: purchase requisitions, POs, GRNs, vendor management Order-to-cash and procure-to-pay cycles Ability to map real-world operational processes into system workflows and identify gaps or automation opportunities. Good to Have Experience with Zoho Flow, Zoho Desk, Zoho Analytics Exposure to GST-compliant invoicing and Indian finance/taxation workflows in Zoho Books. Experience integrating Zoho with external data warehouses or BI tools. Familiarity with client-side scripting (JavaScript/HTML/CSS) for Creator pages and CRM widgets. Zoho certifications (e.g., Zoho Creator Certified Developer, Zoho CRM Certified Administrator). Experience in a hardware, manufacturing, or EV/energy company.
