Job Summary The Senior Associate – GST & TDS will be responsible for ensuring timely and accurate compliance with GST and TDS regulations, including statutory return filing, tax payments, reconciliations, and tax assessments. The role involves coordinating with internal stakeholders, auditors, consultants, and government authorities to ensure full compliance with applicable tax laws. The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and sound knowledge of Indian direct and indirect tax laws. Key Responsibilities GST Compliance Manage GST registrations, including Principal Place of Business (PPOB), Additional Place of Business (APPOB), Virtual Principal Place of Business (VPPOB), and Input Service Distributor (ISD) registrations, amendments, and cancellations. Prepare and file monthly, quarterly, and annual GST returns, including GSTR-1, GSTR-1A, GSTR-3B, ITC-04, GSTR-8, GSTR-9, GSTR-9C, Letter of Undertaking (LUT), Form DRC-03 (Voluntary Payment), and other applicable GST returns. Reconcile TDS/TCS credits reflected on the GST portal and ensure timely accounting and utilization. Perform reconciliation of GSTR-2B/GSTR-2A with the purchase register, sales register, Electronic Cash Ledger, Electronic Credit Ledger, and books of accounts. Perform E-Way Bill reconciliation with sales and dispatch records. Reconcile Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM) transactions and ensure accurate reporting and tax payment. Prepare and maintain statements for Unclaimed and Reclaimed Input Tax Credit (ITC) in accordance with GST provisions. Reconcile GST output liability with the books of accounts and ensure accuracy of tax reporting. Ensure timely payment of GST and optimum utilization of eligible Input Tax Credit (ITC). Verify vendor GST compliance, monitor vendor return filings, and follow up for invoice corrections, amendments, and GST compliance issues. Handle GST notices, departmental queries, scrutiny proceedings, assessments, and correspondence with GST authorities, ensuring timely submission of replies and supporting documents. Keep abreast of changes in GST laws, notifications, circulars, and judicial pronouncements, and ensure timely implementation of regulatory changes. TDS Compliance Calculate and deduct TDS under applicable provisions of the Income-tax Act. Ensure timely deposit of TDS and preparation of challans. Prepare and file quarterly TDS returns (Form 24Q, 26Q, 27Q, etc.). Download and issue Form 16 and Form 16A certificates. Reconcile TDS with Form 26AS and TRACES. Resolve TDS defaults, notices, and reconciliation issues. Coordinate with vendors and employees regarding TDS-related matters. Reconciliation & Reporting Perform monthly reconciliation of GST and TDS balances. Prepare MIS reports related to statutory compliance. Support month-end and year-end financial closing activities. Maintain compliance calendars and ensure adherence to statutory due dates. Process Improvement Identify opportunities to automate GST and TDS processes. Improve reconciliation procedures and compliance controls. Technical Skills Strong knowledge of GST and Income-tax (TDS) provisions. Working knowledge of the GST portal, TRACES, and the Income Tax portal. Proficiency in MS Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS). Experience with ERP systems such as Zoho Books. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 100% timely and accuracy of GST and TDS compliances. Zero statutory penalties due to compliance delays. Accurate GST and TDS reconciliations. Timely resolution of tax notices and audit queries. Reduction in reconciliation differences and compliance issues. Timely completion of monthly statutory reports and tax payments. Qualification B.Com / M.Com CA Inter / CMA Inter (Preferred) Experience 3–5 years of experience in GST and TDS compliance. Experience in manufacturing, e-commerce, EV, technology, or logistics industries is preferred. Perks That Are Perky Get Your EV Groove On: We’ll cover your EV EMIs. Yes, really. jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer
jobs.text: Job ID: 27-0354 Come Join Our Passionate Team! At Barracuda, we make the world a safer place. We believe every business deserves access to cloud-enabled, enterprise-grade security solutions that are easy to buy, deploy, and use. We protect email, networks, data and applications with innovative solutions that grow and adapt with our customers’ journey. More than 220,000 organizations worldwide trust Barracuda to protect them — in ways they may not even know they are at risk — so they can focus on taking their business to the next level. We know a diverse workforce adds to our collective value and strength as an organization. Barracuda Networks is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to equal employment opportunity and equitable compensation regardless of race, gender, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, or disability. Envision yourself at Barracuda Barracuda is looking for a highly technical security professional to join our team with a primary focus on identifying emerging threats, understanding evolving adversarial tradecraft, and translating that knowledge into actionable detection and defensive capabilities . This role sits at the intersection of threat intelligence, detection engineering, offensive security, and adversary emulation . You will research emerging vulnerabilities, exploits, malware, intrusion techniques, and attacker behaviors to understand how modern threats are evolving and how those threats can be detected across Barracuda’s security ecosystem. You will help answer a critical question for our customers and our organization: “If an attacker used this technique against us today, would we actually detect it?” You will investigate how real-world adversaries operate, identify gaps in our ability to detect their behavior, and help develop the telemetry, analytics, detections, and defensive capabilities needed to identify and disrupt them. As a secondary responsibility, you will simulate adversary behavior to validate detection capabilities and expose gaps in defensive coverage. You will safely reproduce attacker TTPs, conduct controlled attack simulations, and measure whether security controls and detections perform as expected. You will collaborate closely with Threat Intelligence, Security Operations (XDR), Incident Response, and Product teams to continuously improve Barracuda’s ability to detect and respond to evolving threats. Being a team player, strong communicator, and forward-thinking security practitioner is essential for success in this role. You will be a technical leader within the team, helping mentor others and advance Barracuda’s capabilities in threat-informed detection and adversary validation. What You’ll Be Working On Emerging Threat & Adversarial Tradecraft Research Research emerging cyber threats, vulnerabilities, exploits, malware, and adversary campaigns. Analyze evolving attacker TTPs and identify new techniques that may impact Barracuda and its customers. Track changes in adversary tradecraft and translate findings into actionable defensive requirements. Investigate how novel attack techniques can be detected through available telemetry, security controls, and product capabilities. Identify gaps in existing detection coverage and recommend improvements to close those gaps. Analyze real-world attacks and incidents to identify new detection opportunities and defensive lessons. Develop technical assessments of new threats, including attack paths, required telemetry, observable behaviors, and detection opportunities. Collaborate with Threat Intelligence and security teams to operationalize emerging threat intelligence. Detection Development & Validation Develop and improve detection strategies for emerging and known adversary behaviors. Translate attacker TTPs into detection logic, analytics, behavioral indicators, and detection requirements. Evaluate whether existing detections can reliably identify real-world adversary behavior. Identify detection blind spots and determine what additional telemetry or analytics are required to close them. Validate detection effectiveness through controlled testing and adversary simulation. Measure detection coverage against relevant threat actor behaviors and attack techniques. Partner with detection engineering and security operations teams to continuously improve detection quality and reduce missed threats. Develop automation and tooling to improve the speed, scale, and repeatability of detection validation. Adversary Simulation & Attack Validation Conduct controlled adversary simulations based on real-world threat intelligence and emerging attacker tradecraft. Reproduce relevant attacker behaviors and TTPs to validate defensive capabilities. Develop and maintain repeatable attack simulations and offensive security tooling. Conduct Attack & Defend and Purple Team exercises to determine whether security controls can detect and respond to realistic attack scenarios. Test new and existing detections against adversary behaviors and identify missed TTPs. Research and safely demonstrate novel attack techniques and exploitation paths in controlled environments. Translate offensive findings into actionable improvements for detection, monitoring, prevention, and response capabilities. Maintain appropriate cloud-based laboratories and testing environments for adversary simulation and security research. Cross-Functional Security Research Collaborate with Incident Response teams to understand real-world attack activity and incorporate lessons learned into detection and validation programs. Partner with Security Operations to improve detection fidelity and operational response. Work with Product and Engineering teams to identify opportunities to improve security visibility and defensive capabilities. Support the development of security research, threat reports, technical assessments, and internal briefings. Communicate complex technical findings, attack paths, detection gaps, and recommended mitigations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Work collaboratively and independently on unique or special assignments that require specialized security knowledge and experience. Mentor other security professionals and contribute to the team’s technical growth and capabilities. What You Bring to the Role 5+ years of hands-on experience in offensive security, threat research, detection engineering, threat intelligence, incident response, or a closely related discipline. Strong understanding of modern attacker tradecraft and the ability to analyze how real-world adversaries operate. Demonstrated experience researching vulnerabilities, exploits, malware, or emerging attack techniques. Experience translating adversary behaviors and TTPs into detection opportunities or defensive requirements. Hands-on experience with adversary emulation, red teaming, penetration testing, or attack simulation. Experience developing or validating detections using SIEM, EDR, XDR, network, cloud, identity, or other security telemetry. Strong understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and how to map adversary behavior to observable activity and defensive coverage. Ability to analyze complex attack chains and determine where meaningful detection and prevention opportunities exist. Strong scripting or programming skills in languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar. Hands-on experience with Windows, Unix, and Linux operating systems. Understanding of network protocols and enterprise security architecture. Experience working with cloud environments such as AWS or Azure. Ability to independently research unfamiliar technologies, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques and quickly develop a working technical understanding. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical attack behavior and security risk clearly. Highly Valued Experience Experience building adversary emulation tooling or automated attack simulations. Experience developing detection analytics, correlation rules, behavioral detections, or detection-as-code. Experience with EDR/XDR, SIEM, cloud security, identity security, or network detection technologies. Experience analyzing public vulnerability disclosures and determining practical exploitability and detection opportunities. Experience conducting Purple Team or Attack & Defend exercises. Experience measuring detection coverage and identifying missed adversary TTPs. Experience with threat hunting and hypothesis-driven investigations. Experience researching novel exploitation techniques or emerging attacker tradecraft. Experience contributing to open-source security research, vulnerability research, or offensive security tooling. Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, OSCE, GXPN, GCIA, GCIH, CEH, or equivalent practical experience. Success in This Role Success in this role means Barracuda is increasingly able to see attackers sooner and understand new threats before they become widespread incidents . You will help the organization: Identify emerging threats and adversarial techniques before they become operationally significant. Convert threat intelligence into meaningful detection opportunities. Discover detection blind spots before attackers exploit them. Continuously validate that detections work against realistic adversary behavior. Improve visibility into customer-relevant attack paths and TTPs. Increase measurable detection coverage against relevant threats. Strengthen the feedback loop between threat intelligence, offensive security, detection engineering, security operations, incident response, and product teams. The goal is not simply to simulate attacks. The goal is to understand how attackers are evolving, determine how we can detect them, and then prove that our defenses actually work. What you’ll get from us A team where you can voice your opinion, make an impact, and where you and your experience are valued. Internal mobility – there are opportunities for cross training and the ability to attain your next career step within Barracuda. High-quality health benefits Retirement Plan with employer match Career-growth opportunities Flexible Time Off and Paid Time Off benefits Volunteer opportunities The anticipated salary range for this role is $114,000 to $152,000 USD. Actual compensation offered will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, and qualifications as they directly relate to the requirements of the position, the budget for the position, and applicable employment laws. jobs.text: Job Description: GCP DevOps – Senior Programmer Analyst (Exp: 3+ Years to 5 Years) We are looking for a highly skilled GCP Cloud DevOps engineer to design, implement, automate, and support cloud infrastructure and application platforms on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as a Senior Programmer Analyst. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in cloud architecture, infrastructure automation using Terraform, CI/CD implementation, application deployments, monitoring, and production support. The candidate will be responsible for designing scalable cloud solutions, implementing DevOps best practices, managing cloud infrastructure, supporting application deployments, and ensuring platform reliability through monitoring and operational excellence. Experience should have 3+ Years to 5 Years of DevOps. Implement and maintain cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) under the guidance of senior engineers and architects. Provision infrastructure using Terraform following established Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices and templates. Assist in developing and maintaining Terraform modules for infrastructure automation. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, GitLab, Cloud Build, and related DevOps tools. Support automation of application deployment processes across development, testing, staging, and production environments. Assist with deployment and support of applications on GCP platforms such as GKE, Compute Engine, Cloud Run, and App Engine. Support cloud networking configuration including VPCs, Load Balancers, Cloud DNS, Firewall Rules, Cloud NAT, and VPN connectivity. Assist in implementing IAM roles, service accounts, and secrets management following security guidelines. Configure and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting using Google Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Grafana, and Prometheus. Monitor application and infrastructure health and performance, and escalate issues as needed. Participate in troubleshooting and debugging of production incidents, including P1 and P2 issues, under senior guidance. Participate in on-call support rotations as part of the operational support model. Assist with root cause analysis (RCA) and support implementation of corrective actions. Perform operational tasks such as resource provisioning, scheduling, and environment maintenance. Support database operations, including monitoring, backup validation, and routine maintenance for Cloud SQL and related services. Collaborate with development, QA, and senior DevOps team members to ensure smooth delivery and deployment processes. Actively participate in Agile ceremonies (stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives) and contribute to sprint deliverables. Document work performed, including configuration changes, deployment steps, and troubleshooting notes. Continuously build technical knowledge of GCP services, DevOps tools, and best practices. Set up and configure CI/CD pipelines for new services and assist in automating build, test, and deployment steps under senior guidance. Identify repetitive manual tasks and build scripts/automations (using Python, Shell, or Terraform) to streamline infrastructure and deployment work. Run vulnerability scans on infrastructure, container images, and dependencies, and support tracking and remediation of identified findings. Support security monitoring activities, including reviewing alerts from vulnerability scanning and cloud security tools, and escalating findings to senior engineers. Experience with Google Dataproc is a Plus. Experience with Ansible for configuration management. Familiarity with other CI tools like TravisCI, CircleCI. Monitor systems using tools such as Grafana and Prometheus. Understanding on the SDLC. Understanding on the Agile methodologies. Communication with customer and producing the Daily status report. Should have good oral and written communication. Should be a good team player. Should be proactive and adaptive. Key Skills: GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine), Compute Engine (GCE), Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, VPC Networking, Load Balancers, Cloud DNS, IAM, Secret Manager, Cloud Monitoring & Logging, DevOps & Automation, Terraform, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Cloud Build, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Python, Shell Scripting, Google Cloud Monitoring/Cloud Logging/Grafana/Prometheus/Incident Management.

jobs.text: Avionics Hardware Engineer Flight Controller, GNSS and Embedded Systems Location: Gurgaon, India (On-site) Experience: 2 to 4 years (we weight a strong portfolio of self-built hardware over years of tenure) Team: Hardware / Avionics, BharatRohan Role Overview BharatRohan builds UAVs for precision agriculture. Today, much of our flight-critical hardware - flight controllers, GNSS receivers, and carrier boards - is bought in. We are bringing that capability in- house: designing our own carrier boards to the open Pixhawk / Cube standard, building custom u- blox-based GNSS boards, porting ArduPilot / PX4 to our own hardware, and learning from teardowns of existing autopilots. We are looking for an engineer who does not just integrate off-the-shelf modules, but who designs, builds, and brings up avionics hardware from scratch. If you have personally taken a board from schematic to flying hardware, this role is for you. This is a founding hardware role with genuine end-to-end ownership: schematic to PCB to bring-up to firmware to field. Key Responsibilities Hardware and PCB Design ● Design multi-layer PCBs and schematics in Altium Designer (or KiCad) - working from IC datasheets and reference designs, not just wiring up ready-made modules ● Design custom carrier boards to the open Pixhawk / Cube (FMUv6) standard - jobs.text: Department: Remote Sensing Location: Gurugram Reports To : CTO Duration : 6 Months About Us: BharatRohan is an Indian agricultural technology (AgTech) company that specializes in providing drone-based solutions for farmers. Our primary goal is to empower farmers with advanced technology to improve their yields, profitability, and sustainability. We offer various products and services, including: • CropAssure®: A decision support system that utilizes hyperspectral imaging technology to provide farmers with early pest and disease detection, nutrient deficiency analysis, and yield prediction. • SeedAssure®: A platform that helps seed companies research and develop the right seeds for their specific market needs and conditions. • SourceAssure®: A platform that enables buyers to purchase residue-free, traceable, and sustainably grown agri-commodities BharatRohan is committed to promoting sustainable agriculture and we have aligned its operations with nine United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). We have recently received a significant investment of $2.3 million to further expand our drone-based agricultural solutions. Role Overview : We are seeking highly motivated and technically strong interns from Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or Computer Science backgrounds to join our UAV Systems Team. This internship offers hands-on experience in UAV systems development, firmware modification, electronics integration, and flight dynamics modeling. You will work closely with our engineering and field teams to contribute to the design, integration, and testing of next-gen UAV systems used for hyperspectral imaging and precision agriculture. Key Responsibilities: ● Develop and enhance the BharatRohan Ground Control Station (GCS) software – focus on UI, data flow, and communication protocols. ● Modify and optimize UAV firmware to accommodate new hardware, mission profiles and failsafe. ● Design and improve the data workflow pipeline – ensuring seamless transmission from UAV ground teams to centralized online servers. ● Support electronic hardware integration for new UAV builds – sensors, controllers, telemetry modules, etc. ● Participate in rigorous field testing of UAVs to ensure performance, stability, and reliability. ● Assist in the development of flight dynamics models for innovative quadcopter designs and validate them through simulations and real-world testing. Requirements: ● Background in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or Computer Science. ● Strong coding skills in Python, C/C++. ● Familiarity with PX4/ArduPilot, UAV flight controllers, and ground control systems is a plus. ● Understanding of aerodynamics, flight dynamics, or control systems is an added advantage. ● Ability to work in an interdisciplinary team and be hands-on with hardware. ● Enthusiasm for UAV technology, autonomous systems, and field operations. What You’ll Gain: ● Real-world UAV development experience across hardware, firmware, and software layers. ● Opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies in precision agriculture and remote sensing. ● Mentorship from experienced aerospace, electronics, and software engineers. ● Potential for full-time conversion based on performance.. BharatRohan is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We value diversity of thought, background, and experience, and believe it strengthens our team and drives our success.

jobs.text: Agentic AI Engineer | AI Labs | Founder's Office yoe: [1, 3] // inclusive on both ends, yes we mean it mode: on-site // we'll get to why status: open until we find 3 of you ``` > if you had to look up the coordinates, that's fine. if you had to look up why we wrote the role this way, this probably isn't the role for you. --- ## the work We're building agents that do actual work. Not chat features. Not "AI-powered" anything. Agents with budgets, latency targets, and on-call rotations for when they break. If you've ever stared at a `tool_use` block that hallucinated a function name and felt that specific kind of shame, you already know the job. AI Labs is a small, deliberate team. The charter is broad on purpose: coding agents, copilots, workflow automation, retrieval-heavy systems, multi-agent orchestration, and the eval harnesses that catch a frontier model release silently regressing your production loop on a Tuesday. The "will agents reshape software" debate is over. We've decided. We need people who can ship. --- ## the first 90 days, probably You'll touch most of these. Some go to prod. Some get killed at week 2. That's the job. * take an agent end to end. problem framing, tool design, eval, rollout, and actually measuring whether it moved a metric. not a demo. a loop that runs while you sleep. * build the orchestration layer that routes work across `Codex` for codegen, Claude for the hard reasoning, a small model for high-volume classification. with explicit budget, latency, and accuracy SLAs per task. cost matters. latency matters. we track both. * stand up evals that catch regressions when you swap a model, rewrite a prompt, or rewire a tool chain. not a notebook. a pipeline. with assertions, not vibes. * replace a process. pick a manual loop (ops, support triage, code review, anything). end it. we'll measure the hours saved and put it on a leaderboard. * make a stupid problem and a smart model useful to each other, which is honestly most of this job. Beyond that, you tell us what to build. The roadmap is not a menu we hand you. --- ## must-haves (we mean it) * **1 to 3 years of professional experience.** not interns. not seniors pivoting in. the role is calibrated for early-career builders already shipping. * **you live in or are moving to `17.3850° N, 78.4867° E`.** on-site. we don't believe great agentic systems get built in async slack threads, and we're not pretending otherwise. * **hands-on, opinionated experience with all of these:** `Codex`, `Cursor`, `Claude Code`, `Claude Cowork`, `Antigravity`. hands-on means you have a take on which one wins for which workflow. not "i watched a YouTube demo". * **multi-LLM fluency.** you've shipped against at least three of: Claude (Sonnet, Opus, Haiku), GPT (4o, 4.1, the o-series), Gemini, DeepSeek, Llama, Mistral. you know which one to reach for to extract structured data out of a soup of HTML, and which to reach for to write a 2000-word doc. and you know why. * **real agentic work.** you've built something that plans, calls tools, recovers from failure, and produces an outcome. you can describe the loop architecture, the eval, and what broke first. (it's always the JSON parsing. it's always the JSON parsing.) --- ## things you'll nod at if you're our person read these. if four or more land for you, please apply. 1. you've watched a context window slowly collapse under its own weight at step 30 of a 50-step plan 2. you've debugged a loop that wouldn't terminate and you knew, in your soul, that it was your fault and not the model's 3. you have an opinion on `temperature=0` that takes more than one sentence to explain 4. you've felt the specific 3am dread of an agent burning through your token budget on a task it can't complete 5. you've shipped a prompt that worked perfectly on Friday and was quietly broken by a provider update on Tuesday 6. you know the difference between an eval and a vibe check. you also know that most teams ship the second. 7. you've reached for MCP and then reached past it 8. you've put two agents in a room together, regretted it, and then done it again because it was the right call 9. you read provider changelogs the way other people read sports headlines 10. you've felt smug for ten minutes after replacing a 400-line prompt with a 40-line one that scored higher --- ## bonus signals * you've shipped a coding agent or dev productivity tool. even small. even just for you. * your last role was at a startup or product company. not services. not "we did some PoCs for a client". * a public footprint: GitHub, blog, X, a discord where you're known. we will read it. --- ## you're probably not our person if * your AI experience is "i added an OpenAI call to a Django app" * you're an ML engineer whose last three years were training pipelines and feature stores. real respect, but this isn't that role. * you list one provider on your CV. that signals you haven't compared. * you want a research role with whitepapers as the output. we ship to prod. every week. * you need a spec'd ticket to start working. --- ## how to apply skip the cover letter. send us this instead. 1. **one agent you've built.** a repo, a Loom, a deployed URL, anything. if IP stops you sharing, write 300 words on the most interesting agent design decision you've made and what you'd change next time. 2. **one opinion.** pick any two from `Codex`, `Cursor`, `Claude Code`, `Claude Cowork`, `Antigravity`. in three paragraphs, tell us which one you'd build a $10M production system on, and why. (this question is partly a rorschach. that's fine.) 3. your resume. separately. ``` to: careers@grabon.in subject: tool_use: { "name": "apply", "input": { "candidate": "[Your Name]" } } ``` we read every application. interesting work gets a reply within 5 business days. uninteresting work gets a reply too. we know some of you will use an LLM to help write this. we'd be hypocrites to mind. just don't let it sand off your voice. we can tell. --- ``` # TODO: take this posting down once we've hired 3. # if you can still see this, the seat is still open. ```

Maintain visual consistency with the Ludo STAR / Parchisi STAR brand identity across every asset. Iterate quickly based on early performance signals — this role is about volume and speed of testing, not one-off polished pieces. Workflow & Analysis Maintain trackers for creative requests, test status, and learnings. Partner closely with the UA/performance marketing team to close the loop between what's tested and what's learned. jobs.title: Category Lead
jobs.text: About Lenskart Twelve years ago, Lenskart started with a simple mission—to eliminate preventable blindness. What began as a small startup has now become Asia’s largest eyewear company , having served over 40 million customers globally. With 10,000+ Lenskartians, 2000+ omnichannel stores across 175+ cities in India, Singapore, Dubai, and beyond, we now ship a pair of eyewear every 2.5 seconds—powered by one of the world’s most automated eyewear factories. Investors include Softbank, ADIA, Temasek, Kedaara Capital, Premji Invest, KKR, Alpha Wave, Bay Capital. Our Next Chapter We’re on an ambitious mission to serve 1 billion eyes in 2025 . And we’re going beyond vision correction—to transform how people see and experience the world. This requires cutting-edge technology, unmatched customer experience, and exceptional people. Our strategic priorities over the next three years include tech innovation, global expansion, manufacturing scale-up, and building a deep bench of entrepreneurial talent. We’re growing existing categories, entering new ones, and scaling across geographies and channels. The Role: Category Head As Category Head, you will be the business owner of your category—responsible for driving exponential growth through product strategy, assortment, pricing, and margin management. You will own the entire P&L , playing a critical role in shaping customer experience, influencing repeat behaviour, and transforming eyewear from a utility to a fashion-first, high-frequency purchase. Key Responsibilities P&L and Business Ownership Full ownership of category P&L: revenue, margins, inventory turns and working capital. Drive top-line growth and bottom-line profitability across all channels (online, offline, home). 2. Strategic Category Management Build and execute the category growth roadmap. Lead assortment planning: width, depth, OTB, category gaps, and range rationalization. Define the right mix of core vs. fashion, trend-led vs. evergreen. 3. Buying & Merchandising Lead seasonal buying across geographies and channels. Partner with vendors and in-house design teams to drive trend-forward innovation. Reorder high-performing styles and ensure sufficient stock (DOH) on bestsellers. 4. Launches & Channel Execution Plan successful collection launches with targeted store assortments. Collaborate with Marketing, VM, and Training teams to drive GTM success. Avoid over-spread by tailoring assortments by store type, geography, and consumer profile. 5. Daily Trade & Lifecycle Management Monitor ROS and manage the product lifecycle: launches, in-season moves, and exits. Optimize store and warehouse distribution; identify slow movers and take timely actions. Recommend data-led product pricing and discounting strategies. Conduct product trainings for store teams to boost conversions and engagement. 6. Margins, Inventory & Quality Control Own and manage product costing to deliver healthy margins. Maintain inventory discipline with strong turns and minimal ageing. Uphold the Lenskart quality promise —reduce returns and NPS detractors by ensuring consistent product quality. Ideal Candidate 7+ years of relevant experience in category management, buying, or merchandising. Fashion industry experience preferred. Strong commercial acumen with a deep understanding of consumer trends and market insights. Proven track record in P&L ownership and scaling categories. High ownership mindset; collaborative and impact oriented. Data-driven, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Join us to shape the future of eyewear—and how the world sees.

jobs.title: Replineshment Lead
jobs.text: Role Title: AI Replenishment Intelligence Lead Location: Delhi, India | On-site | Full-time Mission Brief: Reinvent How Lenskart Never Runs Out — or Runs Over This is not a replenishment role. This is a product transformation mandate . Lenskart operates one of India's largest and fastest-scaling retail networks — thousands of stores, millions of SKUs, and a supply chain that must move at the speed of fashion and the precision of science. Today, our replenishment function is being fundamentally reimagined: from reactive and rule-based to predictive, intelligent, and productized as a scalable AI platform . You will be the architect of that shift. As the AI Replenishment Intelligence Lead , you will own the end-to-end product vision, design, and deployment of Lenskart's AI-driven replenishment platform — a system that ensures the right product reaches the right store at the right moment, every time. You will operate at the intersection of machine intelligence, product management, and retail operations , converting data into decision systems that directly drive availability, profitability, and customer delight across India and global markets. If you've been waiting for a role where AI is not a feature but the core product , this is it. 🔑 Core Mandate 1. AI Platform Development — Build the Brain Own the product vision, roadmap, and lifecycle of Lenskart's replenishment intelligence platform. Define and evolve the product architecture for real-time inventory visibility, ML-driven demand forecasting, dynamic safety stock models, and system-generated replenishment decisions that eliminate manual intervention. Translate complex retail and supply chain problems into clear product requirements, user stories, and technical specifications for Data Science and Engineering teams. Act as the product owner for all AI/ML capabilities within replenishment, ensuring models are production-ready, scalable, and continuously improving. Drive success through clearly defined product metrics such as forecast accuracy (MAPE/WAPE), fill rates, inventory turns, and system adoption — and own these as core product KPIs. 2. Intelligent Assortment & Inventory Optimization — Drive the Business Build and scale AI-powered product features that solve high-impact commercial problems: assortment optimization (store-wise product mix), demand sensing across fashion cycles, and automated markdown and liquidation intelligence. Design systems that dynamically connect inventory decisions with financial and customer outcomes , influencing working capital efficiency, sell-through, and availability. Transform Open-to-Buy into a real-time, system-led product capability , where buying signals are continuously optimized based on live demand, inventory health, and business goals — moving from static planning to always-on decisioning systems . 3. Cross-Functional Leadership — Drive Adoption Drive product adoption and behavioral change across Merchandising, Supply Chain, Finance, and Retail Operations. Ensure the platform is not just built, but deeply embedded into daily decision-making. Act as the voice of the user , continuously refining the product based on stakeholder feedback, usability insights, and operational realities. Build, mentor, and elevate a team of planners and analysts to operate as product users and contributors , fostering a culture of experimentation, data fluency, and trust in AI-led systems. The Essentials Experience: 5–8 years in product management, inventory planning, supply chain product roles, or merchandise planning , with demonstrable experience building or owning AI/ML-driven products or decision systems — not just using them. Technical Depth: Hands-on familiarity with demand forecasting methodologies (time-series models, statistical and machine learning approaches), replenishment algorithm design, and the ability to translate these into scalable product features and system requirements . Education: Degree in AI/ML, Data Science, Operations Research, Engineering, or a highly quantitative field. Top-tier MBA a strong plus. Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of retail operations, SKU-level planning, supply chain dynamics, and how fashion cycles complicate inventory logic — with the ability to translate these into product constructs and decision frameworks . The Mindset AI-Native Thinking: You don’t add AI to products — you build products around AI capabilities . You understand model strengths and limitations and design systems accordingly. Builder’s Instinct: You treat replenishment as a living product — iterating rapidly, measuring impact, and continuously improving. Analytical Rigor at Speed: You move from ambiguity to clarity fast — translating complex signals into scalable product decisions and features . Transformational Leadership: You drive alignment, build trust in AI systems, and lead product adoption across diverse stakeholders , turning skepticism into advocacy. Equal Opportunity Statement At Lenskart, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and identities — because the best intelligence, human or artificial, comes from many perspectives

jobs.title: Circle Lead - ROMG
jobs.text: Circle Head – Rest of Maharashtra & Goa Own the Region. Build the Future of Tech-Enabled Retail. Mission Brief: Lead Lenskart's Most Exciting Growth Frontier Rest of Maharashtra and Goa (ROMG) is one of Lenskart's fastest-growing and most strategically important markets — and we're looking for the leader who will own it completely. This isn't a management role. This is a founder's mandate: full P&L ownership, a high-performance team to build, and the rare opportunity to shape how an AI-powered, omnichannel retail brand scales in a dynamic, underpenetrated market. You will operate at the intersection of on-ground execution and intelligent retail — using real-time data, AI-assisted selling tools, and technology-driven insights to drive decisions that most retail leaders still make on instinct. If you've been waiting for a role where your actions move markets, this is it. 🎯 Core Mandate 1.Business Performance & P&L Ownership Own topline revenue, profitability, and unit economics across the region — with full accountability for outcomes. Drive same-store growth through conversion rate improvement, ticket size expansion, and repeat customer behaviour. Use store-level performance data and AI-driven insights to identify high-potential micro-markets and unlock new growth pockets ahead of competition. 2. AI-First Sales Strategy & Execution Define and execute a sharp, data-informed offline sales strategy — not just on gut feel, but grounded in real-time performance signals. Leverage Lenskart's technology stack including AI-assisted selling tools, demand forecasting at the store level, and live dashboards to drive precision execution across every store in your circle. Build a culture of accountability where numbers are owned, tracked, and acted upon daily. 3. Team Leadership & Capability Building Build and lead a high-performing bench of Area Managers and store teams. Create a culture where goals are clear, ownership is celebrated, and performance is rewarded. Invest in capability development across sales, customer experience, and tech-enabled operations — turning your circle into a talent factory for Lenskart's next generation of leaders. 4. Customer Experience & NPS Own end-to-end in-store experience and NPS for the region. Champion a customer-first operating model through regular store immersion, structured feedback loops, and rapid response to experience gaps. Ensure every touchpoint — from the moment a customer walks in to the moment they leave — reflects Lenskart's promise of premium, accessible, tech-enabled eyecare. 5. Operational Excellence & Intelligent Efficiency Maximize store productivity through smart staffing, AI-supported planning, and continuous operational improvement. Drive inventory discipline, cost efficiency, and process rigor — not through micromanagement, but through systems thinking and data-led decisions. Identify gaps fast and close them faster. 6. Market Intelligence & Expansion Stay deeply embedded in local markets, competition, and consumer behaviour across Rest of Maharashtra and Goa. Translate on-ground intelligence into expansion strategies — identifying where to grow next, how to win faster, and what Lenskart's customers in these markets need before they know it themselves. 7. Brand Custodianship & Tech-Led Retail Be the guardian of Lenskart's brand in the region — premium, accessible, and unmistakably differentiated. Ensure every store delivers a seamless blend of retail and technology: from AI-assisted dispensing and omnichannel journeys to data-driven clienteling. Champion an insight-led, tech-first operating culture across every team you lead. 🧠 The Mindset We're Looking For Owner, Not Manager. You feel the P&L personally. You move fast, take decisions with incomplete information, and course-correct without being told. Data-Led, Ground-Rooted. You love being in stores and markets — and you equally love opening a dashboard to understand what the data is telling you. You don't choose between instinct and intelligence. You use both. Builder at Heart. You're energized by building — teams, systems, culture, markets. You leave places meaningfully better than you found them. Tech-Forward Leader. You're genuinely curious about how AI, data tools, and technology can make your team smarter and faster. You don't wait for tech to be handed to you — you ask for it, learn it, and push for more. High-EQ People Leader. You build trust fast, give honest feedback, and create environments where people grow. Your team's success is your scoreboard. 📋 What You Bring 8–14 years of experience in retail, QSR, or consumer businesses — with a demonstrated track record of managing multi-store, multi-city operations Proven P&L ownership with consistent, measurable growth delivery Experience operating in fast-paced, high-growth environments where ambiguity is the norm Strong commercial instincts combined with comfort using data and digital tools to drive decisions A reputation as a talent builder — someone who grows teams and creates future leaders ⚡ Why This Role — Right Now Lenskart isn’t a conventional retailer dabbling in technology — we are a technology-first company with one of India’s largest and fastest-growing retail footprints. Rest of Maharashtra and Goa sits at a pivotal moment, with strong growth momentum, significant headroom, and rapidly evolving consumer demand. The leader in this role will see a clear, direct impact of their decisions on shaping one of the company’s most compelling growth You won't be executing someone else's playbook. You'll be writing it — with the full backing of Lenskart's proprietary tech stack, AI tools, supply chain infrastructure, and a leadership team that rewards bold thinking and fast action. This is the role for someone who wants to be known for building something remarkable. Lenskart is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diverse perspectives and are committed to building a team that reflects the markets we serve.

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.text: We are building the next-generation technology platforms that power the Lenskart Group — spanning multiple brands (Lenskart, Owndays, Meller, Aqualens) and operating across geographies including India, KSA, UAE, Singapore, Japan, and beyond. As a Backend Developer, you’ll play a key role in shaping the core systems that drive this global vision — from intelligent inventory and omnichannel commerce to personalized experiences powered by AI and data. jobs.title: Global Projects Lead
jobs.text: Global Projects Lead Lenskart.com · Gurugram, India · On-site · Full-time 🌍 Mission Brief: Set the Global Standard for Retail Excellence Lenskart is on one of the most ambitious retail expansion journeys in the world — scaling across Asia, the Middle East, and beyond. Every store we open is a statement: about our brand, our obsession with customer experience, and our belief that technology can transform even the most physical of spaces. This role is for the person who will own that statement globally. As Global Projects Lead, you will be the architect of Lenskart's physical retail future — defining how our stores are designed, built, and experienced across every market we enter. You will lead with data, build with precision, and raise the bar every single time. Reporting to the Global Head of Projects, you will operate at the intersection of design, engineering, technology, and commercial strategy — driving the execution engine that powers our global store network. This is not a maintenance role. This is a builder's role. 🔑 Core Mandate 1. Own the Global Expansion Roadmap Build and manage a multi-year, multi-country rollout roadmap that is anchored in data — using site analytics, demand modelling, and market intelligence to prioritise where and how we grow. Partner with senior leaders across Retail, Finance, and Supply Chain to ensure every new market entry is strategically timed and operationally ready. 4. Build a World-Class, Tech-Enabled Vendor Ecosystem Develop and govern a high-performance global vendor network spanning construction, fabrication, engineering, and maintenance. Go beyond traditional procurement — use data benchmarking, performance scoring, and AI-assisted vendor evaluation to ensure you're always working with the best partners at the best value. Build systems that make vendor governance scalable across geographies. 5. Lead Commercial Excellence & Value Engineering Champion a culture of intelligent value engineering — using material science, cost analytics, and AI-driven procurement insights to optimise every rupee spent without compromising brand experience. Own all project commercials: contracts, BOQs, procurement workflows, and financial controls. Bring the same rigour to cost as to quality.. 6. Drive Execution Excellence at Global Scale Establish quality standards and audit frameworks that travel across borders. Use technology to enable real-time visibility into project status, quality compliance, and post-handover performance across every market. Build systems that make consistent execution the default, not the exception. 7. Lead, Mentor & Inspire Regional Teams Build and lead a team of high-performing project professionals across regions. Create a culture of ownership, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement. Be the voice of the Projects function at the leadership table — representing the team's work, ambitions, and impact to senior stakeholders globally. ⚡ The Essentials Experience: 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in global retail or consumer brand projects, with a proven track record of leading multi-country expansion programmes for design-led, premium brands. Technical Depth: Strong expertise in design execution, BOQs, contracting, vendor governance, and engineering oversight — combined with a genuine appetite for using data and technology to make project delivery smarter and faster. Scale: Demonstrated experience managing large retail portfolios across multiple geographies, with the ability to balance local nuance with global consistency. Education: Bachelor's degree in Architecture or Civil Engineering. Advanced qualifications in Project Management or Business are a plus. 🧠 The Mindset Technology-Forward: You believe the future of retail project management is AI-assisted, data-driven, and real-time. Obsessed with Quality at Scale: You understand that quality cannot be a manual inspection — it has to be designed into the system. You understand that every design decision, every vendor choice, and every project milestone has a direct line to P&L — and you make decisions accordingly. Builder's Mentality: You are energised by complexity and ambiguity. You don't wait for a playbook — you write it. You see a new market as a canvas and bring the rigour, creativity, and discipline to make it exceptional. Transformational Leadership: You lead by conviction, not just authority. You inspire teams to raise their standards, challenge the status quo, and take ownership of outcomes — not just activities. At Lenskart, we are building a technology company that happens to sell eyewear. If you want to build the retail infrastructure of a global brand that is redefining an industry — this is your role.

jobs.title: Database Reliability Engineer Sql and MongoDB
jobs.text: The Role We are looking for a high‐caliber DataOps / Database Reliability Engineer who brings strong engineering fundamentals and a deep sense of ownership. You will design, build, and operate MySQL, MongoDB, MSSQL, and BigQuery platforms that enable product teams to ship quickly and safely - at scale. This role is hands‐on, impact‐driven, and aligned with top‐tier engineering standards. What You Will Do Database Architecture & Reliability ● Architect and operate highly available MySQL (InnoDB Cluster, Group Replication), MongoDB (Replica Sets, Sharded Clusters), MSSQL, and BigQuery environments. ● Lead migrations (version upgrades, cloud transitions to AWS RDS/Aurora, MongoDB Atlas, BigQuery). ● Define and enforce standards, schema design best practices, and governance policies. ● Drive SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for mission‐critical data services. Performance Engineering ● Optimize queries, indexes, and workloads using advanced profiling tools across MySQL, MongoDB, MSSQL, and BigQuery. ● Tune InnoDB internals, buffer pools, shard keys, working sets, and query execution plans. ● Resolve bottlenecks across CPU, memory, and I/O. ● Implement advanced monitoring and alerting (PMM, Ops Manager, Grafana, Datadog). Operational Excellence & Automation ● Automate backup/recovery (XtraBackup, mysqldump/mysqlpump, Ops Manager, filesystem snapshots, MSSQL native tools). ● Champion Infrastructure‐as‐Code (Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes Operators). ● Implement Change Data Capture (CDC) pipelines using Debezium and integrate with downstream systems. ● Enforce strong security: authentication, authorization, encryption, auditing. ● Conduct DR drills, capacity planning, and maintain clear documentation/runbooks. ● Continuously reduce operational toil through automation and engineering solutions. Collaboration & Incident Response ● Partner with DevOps/SRE teams to integrate DB ops into CI/CD pipelines. ● Mentor engineers on database best practices. ● Participate in on‐call rotations, lead incident response, and write clear, blameless RCAs. ● Work closely with product and platform teams to influence system design through the lens of scale, resilience, and cost efficiency. What We’re Looking For Core Engineering ● Strong foundations in Linux/Unix, networking (DNS, TCP/IP), and distributed systems. ● Proficiency in Python, Bash, or JavaScript for automation and tooling. ● Clean Git practices and strong software engineering discipline. Databases ● Deep expertise in MySQL and MongoDB. ● Proven experience with HA/DR setups, replication, and performance tuning. ● Backup/recovery expertise with XtraBackup, mongodump, Ops Manager, MSSQL native tools. ● Working knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, Cassandra, and BigQuery. ● Experience building and operating CDC pipelines with Debezium. Infrastructure & Tooling ● Infrastructure as Code using Terraform (required). ● Configuration and automation using Ansible/Chef (preferred). ● CI/CD integration with Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions. Observability & Reliability ● Metrics and alerting: PMM, Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager. ● Tracing/APM: Datadog, New Relic, OpenTelemetry. ● Incident management experience (PagerDuty or equivalent). Nice to Have ● Experience with managed database services (AWS RDS/Aurora, MongoDB Atlas, BigQuery). ● Exposure to DevSecOps and cloud security. ● Experience operating high‐traffic, consumer‐facing systems. ● Relevant certifications (MongoDB Certified DBA, Oracle MySQL DBA, MSSQL certifications). ● Strong written communication (design docs, RFCs, runbooks). What Success Looks Like at Lenskart ● Databases that are reliable, scalable, and boring in production. ● Faster delivery with fewer incidents. ● Strong developer trust in the data platform. ● Systems that scale seamlessly with business growth. Why Lenskart ● Real‐world scale with tangible customer impact. ● Strong engineering ownership and autonomy. ● Opportunity to shape data platforms used across the company. ● A culture that values craft, clarity, and engineering excellence.

jobs.title: Plant IT support executive
jobs.text: Role Summary The IT Support Engineer will be responsible for providing end-to-end technical support for all plant-level IT systems including production floor equipment, hardware, network infrastructure, shop-floor applications, and user devices. They will ensure high system uptime, timely troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and adherence to IT standards, while supporting day-to- day operations critical to manufacturing continuity. Key Responsibilities Technical Support - Provide first-line and second-line support for desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, handhelds, PLC-connected systems, and production terminals. - Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network issues raised by plant users. - Install, configure, and maintain Windows OS, industrial applications, and security software. - Manufacturing Systems & Applications - Support MES, SCADA/HMI interfaces, SAP/ERP access, and shop-floor automation devices. - Troubleshoot connectivity between OT (Operational Technology) and IT systems. - Coordinate installation, updates, and patching for plant-critical applications. Network and Infrastructure - Manage LAN/WAN connectivity, Wi-Fi access points, switches, CCTV monitoring, access control systems, and IP telephony. - Coordinate with central IT for firewall policies and network security. Maintenance & Compliance - Perform periodic preventive maintenance across plant systems. - Maintain asset inventory, AMC records, and compliance documentation. - Support IT audits, data backup, antivirus deployment, and patch compliance. User Support & Training - Provide technical guidance to employees on system usage, safety, and best practices. - Conduct basic training sessions for plant and office staff. Vendor & Stakeholder Coordination - Liaise with vendors for equipment servicing, component replacement, and AMC. - Work with cross-functional teams (production, maintenance, quality) to ensure smooth operations. Required Skills and Competencies - Strong knowledge of Windows OS, Active Directory, user management. - Basic understanding of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs). - Experience supporting manufacturing environments, OT/IT integration (preferred). - Hands-on exposure to industrial peripherals, barcode systems, production terminals. - Familiarity with CCTV, access control, printers, handheld devices. - Good analytical and troubleshooting capabilities. - Ability to prioritize and resolve issues under time pressure. Qualifications - Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or related field. - 2 to 5 years of IT support experience, preferably in a manufacturing plant. - Certifications such as CompTIA A+, N+, CCNA, or Microsoft MCP are a plus.

jobs.title: Marketing Lead
jobs.text: This is a high-impact, founder-proximate leadership role focused on one thing: taking Lenskart from a well-known eyewear company to an iconic global brand. You will be the architect responsible for transforming how the world perceives, talks about, and emotionally connects with Lenskart moving us from category leader to cultural phenomenon. Your mission is to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI-powered marketing and exponential global brand growth. You will define and deliver the system that ensures we show up with the right story, in the right format, in the right culture, at the right moment maximising brand love, customer acquisition, and revenue impact across every market we operate in. Lenskart is already a $1 billion revenue company. 2,500+ stores across India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Japan, and the US. 40M+ customers. A vertically integrated, tech-first model that designs, manufactures, and delivers eyewear end-to-end. Now we're going after the next 10x. This role is based in Thailand and owns brand and marketing strategy across all Lenskart markets globally India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Japan, and the US. 🔑 Core Mandate: Brand Transformation & Business Growth 1. Build a Cult Global Brand (The Builder's Focus) Brand Visionary: Own the strategic vision and execution for taking Lenskart from a known eyewear brand to an iconic, cult brand one that creates virality, drives style statements, and makes eyewear a fashion-first category globally. Portfolio Architecture: Define and evolve brand positioning for Lenskart and its portfolio brands (John Jacobs, Aqualens) across every market we operate in ensuring local cultural resonance without sacrificing global brand coherence. Cultural Ownership: Build a brand that doesn't just sell eyewear but owns the conversation around vision, style, and self-expression for the next billion consumers globally. 2. Social-First, Culture-First Content Engine (The Distribution Focus) Platform-Native Creative: Build and scale a content engine natively built for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and whatever platform emerges next, across every market. No repurposed TV ads. No committee-approved creative. Creator Ecosystem: Build creator and influencer ecosystems across every market from mega-influencers to nano-creators, from artists to athletes with a programmatic, data-driven approach to partnerships. Community-Led Growth: Make Lenskart a brand that Gen Z and Millennials don't just buy from they talk about, create with, remix, and feel part of, in every geography. 3. AI-Powered Marketing 10x Faster, 10x Smarter (The Leverage Focus) Non-Negotiable: This is not a role for someone who is "exploring AI." You will leverage AI better than anyone else in the industry and build a marketing function where AI is the operating system, not a tool. AI Creative Engine: Deploy generative AI to produce content at a scale and speed no traditional team can match dynamic creative variants, AI-generated ad copy, personalised visual assets, and simultaneous multi-market campaign launches. Intelligent Targeting & Personalisation: Build AI-powered audience segmentation, predictive targeting, and real-time personalisation systems across markets. AI-Driven Performance Systems: Implement automated bidding strategies, AI-generated creative optimisation loops, and LLM-powered campaign intelligence that continuously learns and improves ROAS without manual intervention. Tech-Enabled Marketing Stack: Own the architecture of a world-class marketing tech stack CDP, AI-native attribution, experimentation platforms, virtual try-on, computer vision for product discovery all wired to a single source of truth. Force Multiplier Mindset: We are not building a 200-person marketing department. We are building a lean, AI-powered marketing machine that operates at the output of one many times its size. 4. Numbers-Driven Performance & Growth (The Business Focus) Marketing P&L Ownership: Own the full marketing P&L and business plan across all markets. You're not just a creative leader you're accountable for CAC, LTV, ROAS, and incrementality across every channel and geography. Experimentation at Scale: Drive a relentless test-and-learn culture. We expect 100+ experiments a quarter, not 10. Omnichannel Integration: Drive integrated online-to-offline marketing that bridges digital channels with 2,500+ physical stores globally, creating a seamless consumer journey from first impression to in-store conversion. 5. Multi-Country Playbook & Global Scale (The Global Focus) Localised GTM: Develop localised go-to-market strategies for each market while maintaining a unified global brand playbook. What works in India won't copy-paste to Dubai, Bangkok, or Tokyo and you get that intuitively. Global Remit, Regional Base: Based in Thailand, you'll set and drive brand strategy across India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Japan, and the US with Southeast Asia as a natural anchor market given your location, while carrying full accountability across the global portfolio. New Product & Category Launches: Own the marketing engine for new product introductions across all markets from category creation moments to viral launch campaigns. The Essentials Experience: 10+ years in marketing, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership role at a high-growth D2C or consumer-tech brand. You've scaled at least one iconic brand something that went viral, became a style statement, and captured cultural attention. AI & Technical Fluency: You've built or managed an AI-native marketing stack. Not experimented with AI for copy actually deployed AI systems at scale for creative, targeting, or personalisation. Multi-Country Track Record: Multi-country experience is non-negotiable. You've led marketing across at least 2–3 international markets and understand the nuance of cultural adaptation vs. global consistency. Experience across Southeast Asia specifically is a strong plus. Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field or equivalent exceptional experience. The Mindset Culture Before Category: Obsessively plugged into global cultural currents K-pop, streetwear drops, gaming culture, regional memes, emerging aesthetics. AI as Superpower, Not Buzzword: You see AI as the most powerful leverage a marketer has ever had. Aesthetic Rigour + Data Rigour: You notice the font, the colour palette, the spacing and back every creative decision with data. Builder, Not Maintainer: You thrive in ambiguity and are energised by 0-to-1 problems as much as scaling what works. 10x Thinker: You don't optimise for 10% improvements you think 10 times better, 10 times faster. Founder-Friendly: Comfortable working closely with a hands-on Founder-CEO, moving fast, and making decisions with imperfect information.

jobs.title: Retail Merchandising Growth Lead

jobs.title: Buying Planning & Merchandise Lead
jobs.text: About Lenskart Lenskart is a tech-led, omni-channel eyewear company with a growing footprint across India and international markets. We operate an integrated value chain across design, manufacturing, retail, and e-commerce. Role Overview The Buying Planning & Merchandise Lead will own the flow of merchandise from vendor to warehouse across all categories and regions. The role is anchored in demand forecasting, OTB, vendor capacity planning, and lead-time reduction — ensuring the right quantity of the right product reaches the right warehouse at the right time, at the right cost. Key Responsibilities Demand Forecasting Own global demand forecasting across categories, channels, and regions. Drive forecast accuracy through structured S&OP cycles, sell-through analysis, and seasonality modelling. Translate top-down financial plans and bottom-up category plans into a single, executable demand view. OTB & Buying Planning Own the Open-to-Buy (OTB) process — building, tracking, and re-forecasting through the season. Manage inflow planning, phasing, and depth-vs-breadth decisions in line with sales, stock, and margin targets. Partner with the buying and category teams to convert assortment plans into actionable buy quantities. Vendor Capacity Planning Lead capacity planning with the vendor base — aligning monthly and weekly production capacity with the demand plan. Work with sourcing and manufacturing partners to lock capacity ahead of peak periods and manage flex during demand swings. Build visibility into vendor performance on capacity, on-time delivery, and fill rates. Lead-Time Reduction & Inflow Drive reduction of lead times across the vendor-to-warehouse cycle through better planning rhythm, order release discipline, and vendor collaboration. Improve PO-to-receipt timelines, in-transit visibility, and warehouse inbound predictability. Work with logistics and warehousing teams to smooth inflow and reduce bullwhip across the network. Inventory & Allocation Own inventory health across warehouses — turns, cover, ageing, and excess. Drive allocation and replenishment models that maintain availability with controlled markdowns. Collaboration & Leadership Work closely with Buying, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Logistics, Retail, E-commerce, and Finance. Build and lead a strong planning and merch supply chain team. Key Requirements Relevant experience in demand planning, merchandise planning, OTB, or merchandise supply chain roles. Strong grounding in demand forecasting, OTB, vendor capacity planning, and lead-time management. Commercial understanding of inventory turns, fill rates, markdowns, and working capital. Hands-on with planning and analytics tools (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, or equivalent). Experience working with vendor networks and cross-functional supply chain teams. Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, data-led environment. Why Join Lenskart Own the end-to-end merchandise flow from vendor to warehouse at scale. Operate at the intersection of planning, supply chain, and commercial strategy. Work in a data-led, digitally native environment with international scope.

jobs.title: Android/ iOS - Tech Lead
jobs.text: The Role We are looking for a hands-on Tech Lead to own our Android and iOS app platforms end-to-end, along with the Java-based middleware layer that powers them. You will lead a pod of engineers, work closely with Product, Design, Analytics and Business, and be accountable for both how fast we ship and how reliably the platform runs. This is a technical leadership role, not a purely managerial one: you will still reason about code, architecture and trade-offs, set technical direction, and step in on the hardest problems yourself What You Will Own • Mobile platforms: architecture, release management, performance and stability for both the Android and iOS applications . • Backend & middleware: the Java middleware layer between the apps and core services, handling millions of requests a day with high availability. • Engineering leadership: technical decision-making, code and architecture reviews, hiring, mentoring and delivery for your pod. • Release & reliability: release processes, feature rollout safety, observability and the platform's overall reliability posture. • Scale & expansion: enabling new brand and new market launches on the existing codebase without forking it. What You Will Do • Set and drive the technical roadmap for the mobile platforms and the middleware, balancing feature delivery against platform and tech-debt investment. • Lead a team of engineers across mobile and backend, owning hiring, mentoring, performance and day-to-day delivery. • Make and defend architecture decisions, including what ships in the binary versus what is configured dynamically from the server. • Own release safety across app stores feature flags, staged rollout, kill switches and lead incident response when things break in production. • Keep Android and iOS at feature parity without duplicating every effort, and keep both platforms fast, stable and within crash and performance budgets. • Partner with Product and Business to connect technical work to measurable outcomes, and to launch new brands and markets on the existing platform. What We Are Looking For • Significant hands-on experience owning production Android and iOS applications at scale, with genuine depth in at least one and strong command of the other. • Strong backend engineering ability in Java, including designing services for high availability, handling partial failures, caching correctly in e-commerce paths and managing API versioning for users who cannot be force-upgraded. • A track record of leading engineering teams — setting technical direction, hiring well, handling underperformance, and negotiating scope and timelines credibly with Product. • Practical debugging depth: the ability to diagnose cold-start regressions, ANRs, memory leaks, retain cycles and production incidents using real tooling, not just describe them. • Sound judgment on trade-offs migrations, server-driven configuration, multi-brand and multi-region architecture — with clear reasoning about cost and risk. • Experience with high-scale consumer e-commerce or similarly demanding mobile products is strongly preferred. Why Join Us You will own the technology behind how millions of customers experience Lenskart, at a company scaling aggressively across India and internationally. The work is high-ownership and high-impact: your decisions directly shape platform reliability, delivery speed and the company's ability to enter new markets. also hiring manager said

jobs.title: Research Leader
jobs.text: Retail is at a pivotal point, approaching the singularity we envisioned earlier. The convergence of AI, real-time visibility, autonomous operations, and composable commerce is fundamentally reshaping how retailers compete. This isn't incremental disruption; it is a transformation so complete that traditional retail models will become obsolete. Retailers who understand and navigate this inflection will dominate. Those who don't will disappear. You will author the definitive book on this moment. No other work comprehensively addresses retail singularity with the rigor and insight this book demands. It will be the authoritative resource for retail executives and technology leaders navigating this critical transition. While you author this seminal work, you'll simultaneously drive Litmus7's thought leadership, research, and market intelligence strategy. You'll lead a research team, establish proprietary POVs, and generate market insights that fuel sales opportunities. This is a business-critical, multi-dimensional leadership role. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES • Author the Retail Singularity Book: Own intellectual vision, research methodology, and primary authorship. Conduct 40–60 primary interviews with retail C-suite and technology leaders. Deliver publication-ready manuscript with original insights, rigorous sourcing, and compelling narrative. • Sales Enablement & Market Intelligence: Translate research into actionable market insights that directly fuel Litmus7's sales pipeline. Identify emerging opportunities where we can pitch, compete, and differentiate. Provide sales teams with competitive positioning, customer intelligence, and market context that wins deals. • Lead Research Team: Build and manage a team of 3–5 researchers and analysts. Set priorities, establish methodologies, mentor talent. Drive quality, productivity, and intellectual rigor. • Deal Intelligence: Analyze customer engagements, RFPs, and competitive wins/losses. Synthesize into organizational learning. Identify gaps and market opportunities Litmus7 should exploit. Support major deals with research-backed due diligence. • Establish Proprietary POVs: Build 4–6 proprietary points of view on critical retail transformation topics. Author 8–12 thought leadership articles annually for LinkedIn, Forbes Tech Council, industry publications. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Research & Book Authorship • Design and execute multi-modal research: primary interviews, market data analysis, competitive intelligence, trend forecasting, scenario development. • Conduct strategic interviews with retail C-suite (CIOs, CMOs, COOs, CEOs) and technology leaders. Uncover competitive intent, technology investments, business imperatives. • Write publication-ready prose across formats: book chapters, articles, white papers, market briefs. • Create compelling case studies, examples, and frameworks that illuminate complex concepts. Maintain editorial schedules; coordinate with editors and publishers. Sales & Business Impact • Support Quarterly Business Reviews with market insights that can lead to farming opportunities. • Develop market context decks, competitive summaries, battle cards. Support RFP responses and customer engagements with research-backed positioning. Team & Stakeholder • Recruit, onboard, mentor and develop research team members. Establish clear expectations and growth paths. Conduct regular 1-on-1s, performance reviews, career development conversations. • Set research priorities and assign projects. Monitor progress and quality. Provide mentoring and feedback. Foster culture of intellectual rigor. Mandatory Qualifications • Postgraduate in engineering/business/economics with 10–12 years of specialized experience in retail technology research at tier-1 analyst firms. • Deep retail domain expertise: Genuine understanding of retail operations. Know what drives retail technology decisions. Should have spent at least 8-9 years in analyzing the Retail industry. • Writing at scale: Published reports, white papers, monographs, or articles demonstrating analytical depth and publication-ready quality. • Primary research mastery: Design methodologies, recruit and conduct interviews, analyze qualitative data, draw defensible conclusions, transparently address limitations. • C-suite credibility: Engage senior executives as a peer advisor. Conduct strategic interviews that uncover authentic business imperatives. • Sales acumen: Understand how research translates into business opportunities. Experience supporting sales teams and identifying market gaps. • Team leadership: Experience managing or mentoring research teams, analysts, or junior consultants. Demonstrated ability to develop talent and drive quality. • Research rigor: Multi-modal research design. Comfort with ambiguity. Systematically form and test hypotheses. Synthesize disparate data into coherent narratives. Rigor in fact-checking, citation accuracy, quality assurance. • Communication excellence: Publication-ready writing across formats. Articulate speaking. Explain sophisticated concepts accessibly without sacrificing accuracy or nuance. • Collaboration & independence: Work productively with sales, marketing, practice leads without ceding intellectual independence. Transparent about research process and findings. Report honestly even if findings challenge organizational preferences. • Intellectual humility: Willing to update thinking based on evidence. Acknowledge complexity and counterarguments. Resist false certainty. #LI-AC1

jobs.text: Job Description – Customer Support Executive Location: Surat (On-site) Experience: 0-1 Year About the Role: Logicwind Technologies is looking for a Client Support & Project Coordinator who will be responsible for communicating with clients, understanding their queries, coordinating with the internal team, and ensuring timely updates and resolutions. jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.text: Job Title:- DevOps Engineer Experience:- 3 + years Job Overview:- We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and manage scalable infrastructure, streamline CI/CD pipelines, and optimize system performance. You will play a critical role in ensuring high availability, security, and seamless deployments across cloud environments. The ideal candidate is someone who thrives in fast-moving, agile environments and embraces automation-first principles to drive operational excellence. Responsibilities:- Infrastructure & Cloud Management Design, build, and maintain scalable, highly available infrastructure on AWS, GCP, Azure, or other cloud platforms. Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi. Optimize cloud resource utilization to ensure cost efficiency. CI/CD & Automation Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to ensure rapid, automated, and secure deployments. Implement rollback mechanisms for zero-downtime deployments. Automate build, test, and deployment processes for efficiency and reliability. Monitoring, Logging & Incident Management Set up proactive monitoring & alerting using Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar tools. Implement log aggregation and analysis using ELK Stack, Splunk, or CloudWatch. Handle incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), and system recovery. Security & Compliance Enforce DevSecOps practices, ensuring secure infrastructure and application deployments. Conduct vulnerability assessments and implement security best practices (e.g., IAM policies, network security, secrets management). Design backup, disaster recovery (DR), and business continuity strategies. Collaboration & Process Optimization Work closely with developers, QA, and product teams to improve deployment workflows. Continuously evaluate and introduce new DevOps tools & best practices. Advocate for Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles and observability improvements. Desired skills:- Technical Skills Experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure. Strong expertise in CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, ArgoCD). Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi). Hands-on experience with Kubernetes & container orchestration (Docker, Helm, EKS/GKE/AKS). Experience in configuration management (Ansible, Chef, Puppet). Proficiency in monitoring & logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog). Strong scripting skills (Bash, Python, Go, or PowerShell). Knowledge of networking, firewalls, and load balancers. Soft Skills Problem-solving mindset with a focus on automation & efficiency. Ability to work in fast-paced agile environments. Strong collaboration and communication skills. Passion for continuous learning and innovation. Nice to Have (Bonus Skills) Experience with GitOps workflows. Exposure to AI/ML deployment pipelines. Certifications: AWS/GCP/Azure DevOps, CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), or Terraform Associate.
