jobs.text: About the Company We are a tech company specialized in building Web and Mobile applications using advanced technologies and infrastructure. We use JavaScript as our primary language of choice along with frameworks like Node, React, etc. We adapt to industry trends. Our clients give us opportunities to implement solutions with trending technologies worldwide. jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.text: Job Title:- AI/ML Engineer Experience:- 2 to 3 years Job Overview:- As an AI/ML Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and implementing artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions that solve complex business problems. You will work with stakeholders to understand business requirements, gather and preprocess data, build and train deep learning based models, and deploy and integrate them into software applications. Your primary goal will be to develop AI/ML solutions that meet business needs while ensuring that they are accurate, reliable, and scalable. Responsibilities:- Analyze business requirements and develop AI/ML solutions to solve complex problems Collect, preprocess, and clean data from various sources to build models Build, train, test, and deploy deep learning based models using state-of-the-art techniques and frameworks Collaborate with software engineers to integrate AI/ML models into software applications Develop and maintain AI/ML infrastructure, including data storage and computing resources Monitor and optimize AI/ML models for accuracy, reliability, and scalability Create business solutions using LLMs, RAG, and Agentic architecture Document and communicate best practices for building and deploying AI/ML models Requirements:- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or related field Strong understanding of deep learning and machine learning concepts and techniques Must have experience with LLMs, Prompt Engineering, testing LLMs Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or Java Experience with AI/ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail Excellent communication and collaboration skills If you have a passion for AI/ML and a strong background of deep learning in computer vision and natural language processing, this is an exciting opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology and contribute to the development of innovative AI/ML solutions. Why Logicwind: • Opportunity to develop your own team • Fast growth and more visibility into the company • Experience working with the latest technology • Competitive Learning Environment with supportive co-workers • Paid leaves up to certain limits This position will require working from the office Website: https://www.logicwind.com/

jobs.text: Job Title: Node.js Developer Experience: 2–3 Years Location: Surat (Onsite) Job Type: Full-time About the Role: We’re looking for a passionate Node.js Developer to join our growing engineering team. You’ll be responsible for building and maintaining scalable backend systems, integrating APIs, and ensuring smooth communication between the server and client applications. If you love writing clean, efficient code and enjoy solving real-world challenges, we’d love to hear from you! Key Responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain server-side applications using Node.js and related frameworks (Express.js / GraphQL/ Nest.js ). Build and manage RESTful APIs and integrate third-party services. Collaborate with frontend developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic. Create and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code. Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing systems. Optimize applications for maximum performance and scalability. Implement and manage data storage solutions (SQL / NoSQL databases). Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and technical discussions. Ensure best practices in security, performance, and maintainability. Required Skills & Experience: 2–3 years of hands-on experience in Node.js development. Strong proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript . Experience with frameworks like Express.js , Nest.js , or Loopback . Good understanding of RESTful APIs , JSON , and asynchronous programming . Familiarity with PostgreSQL, MongoDB , MySQL , or other databases. Proficient with Git and version control systems. Understanding of authentication, authorization, and security best practices (JWT, OAuth, etc.). Strong debugging, problem-solving, and analytical skills. Good to Have: Experience with microservices architecture and cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure) . Knowledge of containerization (Docker) or CI/CD pipelines . Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies. Basic understanding of frontend technologies (React.js, HTML5, CSS3) for integration purposes.

Role Purpose The IT Admin Function Lead owns and governs IT administration across the organization and all its locations. You will be accountable for reliable, secure, and standardized IT services — end-user systems, servers, endpoints, access, and IT operations — and for the processes, documentation, and controls that keep them audit-ready as the company scales. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role. Ensure the availability and performance of end-user systems, servers, and IT services. Define and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all IT administration tasks. User, Endpoint & Device Management Govern user provisioning and de-provisioning, and set the standard for employee onboarding and offboarding end to end. Define endpoint configuration standards for laptops, desktops, and peripherals. Oversee OS builds, patching, EDR/antivirus deployment, and system hardening. Manage the fleet through MDM / UEM tools such as Jamf, Microsoft Intune, and ManageEngine . Ensure asset tagging, lifecycle management, and disposal compliance. 3. Access Control & Privilege Management Govern administrative access and enforce least-privilege principles across systems. Ensure privileged access is granted only with proper approval and documentation. Run a Privileged Access Management (PAM) program and coordinate with Security on access reviews and audits. Maintain accurate records of admin access, temporary permissions, and approvals. 4. Infrastructure & Application Support Coordinate with infrastructure and networking teams on server, storage, and network dependencies. Ensure availability and support for business applications and internal tools. Manage application installations through approved, controlled processes. Oversee endpoint and application licensing compliance. 5. IT Service Management & Reporting Ensure all IT activity is tracked through ITSM tickets, email trails, and documentation — no ad-hoc or undocumented work. Monitor SLAs and ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests. Maintain daily and weekly status reporting for management review. Keep full traceability across every change and request. 6. Security, Audit & Compliance Maintain audit-ready documentation for IT administration, and support internal and external audits (IT, security, compliance). Drive closure of audit points and corrective actions within defined timelines. Keep IT policies, SOPs, and checklists current. Coordinate with the security team and specialist vendors across DLP, web security (Zero Trust / SSE), Web Application Firewall (WAF), cloud security, server & endpoint backup, and continuous threat exposure management (red teaming). 7. Team Leadership & Coordination Lead and mentor the IT Administration team; assign clear ownership, timelines, and reporting. Review team performance and uphold professional, disciplined work practices. Act as the escalation point for complex IT administration issues. Coordinate closely with the Cyber Security and Networking / Infrastructure leads. 8. Business Continuity & Improvement Support business continuity planning (BCP) and disaster-recovery activities. Identify gaps in IT administration processes and drive continuous improvement. Recommend automation and standardization to improve efficiency and strengthen security posture. Key Accountabilities Stable and secure IT administration operations. Zero undocumented changes or access. Timely incident and request resolution within SLA. Accurate, timely reporting to management. Audit-compliant IT administration processes. Requirements Must Have 8+ years in IT Administration, System Administration, or IT Operations, including 2+ years leading a team or function. Strong Windows and Linux administration. Endpoint management and patching at scale, with hands-on experience across MDM / UEM (Jamf, Microsoft Intune, or ManageEngine) and EDR/antivirus. IT asset management, and application and license management. Hands-on experience with ITSM tools and ticketing systems, and SLA-driven service delivery. Identity and access governance across Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace and SaaS tools, including privileged access management. Proven vendor and stakeholder management. Strong documentation, process discipline, and audit-readiness. Clear leadership, coordination, reporting, and escalation skills. Good to Have ITIL certification and relevant system or security certifications (e.g., Microsoft, Jamf, CompTIA). Experience standing up and scaling IT in a startup, high-growth, or multi-entity (India + overseas) environment. Experience supporting audits in a regulated, high-governance, or pre-IPO context. Exposure to security tooling — DLP, Zero Trust / SSE, WAF, cloud security, PAM, and CTEM / red-teaming programs. Scripting or automation for IT operations. Qualification Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field. Tools & Environment You'll Govern You will own (and coordinate with the Security and Networking functions and specialist vendors on) a modern IT and security stack, including: Device & endpoint: MDM / UEM (Jamf, Intune, ManageEngine), endpoint security / EDR, antivirus, and patch management. Identity & access: Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace, SaaS access management, MFA, and Privileged Access Management (PAM). Service & operations: ITSM / ticketing, infrastructure monitoring and alerting, and server & endpoint backup. Data & network security: Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Web Security (Zero Trust / SSE), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and cloud security. Assurance: continuous threat exposure management / red teaming. Workplace: meeting-room AV and conferencing — screens, cameras, wireless presentation, and room scheduling for Teams, Zoom, Google Meet, and Webex. What We Value Ownership and accountability — leading by example. A strong customer-service mindset across the organization. Process and documentation discipline, and a bias for traceability. Proactive, pragmatic problem-solving. Raising the bar on IT reliability and security posture. Adaptability in a fast-paced environment, and a habit of continuous improvement. Why Join Us? Technology is at the core of everything we do. As the IT Admin Function Lead, you will own and shape the IT backbone that keeps every team productive and secure — and build the standards, controls, and team that let it scale as Unbox enters its next phase of growth. Your work will directly underpin the reliability, security, and governance of the entire organization.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative  Lead
jobs.text: About This Role We run a data-driven outbound and inbound-qualification motion, with every call, email, and account touch logged and worked in structured cycles - fresh outbound, dormant-deal revival, closed-lost re-engagement, and no-deal contact revival. This role owns the numbers behind that engine: the activity that goes in, the qualified pipeline that comes out, and the CRM discipline that lets us trust both. You'll lead a team of SDRs, hold them accountable to daily and weekly targets, keep the funnel clean and measurable, and turn activity data into decisions — who to call first, which accounts to revive, and where each rep needs to improve. What You'll Do Team Leadership & Coaching Lead, coach, and develop a team of SDRs through daily huddles, call and email reviews, live listening, and weekly 1:1s tied to each rep's numbers. Own onboarding and ramp for new hires, guiding them to full quota productivity. Build a culture of accountability where targets, activity, and data hygiene are non-negotiable, without undermining team morale. Pipeline Generation & Quality Carry a team quota for qualified meetings and sales-accepted pipeline. Run structured working cycles across fresh outbound, dormant-deal revival, closed-lost re-engagement, and no-deal contact revival, using scoring and prioritisation logic to guide who the team approaches first. Enforce qualification criteria so booked meetings convert into real pipeline rather than calendar activity. Performance Management Track and report daily, weekly, and monthly on activity and output metrics for each rep and the team. Own the SDR dashboards, keeping them accurate and using them to identify who's ahead, who's behind, and why. Run a weekly numbers review covering activity vs. target, connect and conversion rates, meetings booked, pipeline generated, and stage-by-stage drop-off. Diagnose performance gaps from the funnel data — pinpoint whether shortfalls stem from dials, connect rate, pitch, or qualification — and act on the right lever. Flag under-performance early with a documented plan, and surface top performers for progression. Process, CRM & Data Hygiene Enforce complete, accurate logging of every call, email, note, and task in the CRM. Keep contact, company, and deal data clean so reporting and revival scoring remain trustworthy. Refine cadences, sequences, call scripts, and messaging based on performance data. Partner with Marketing on lead flow and SLAs, and with Account Executives on clean, well-documented handoffs. What We're Looking For 3+ years in SDR, BDR, or inside sales, including 1–2 years leading, mentoring, or acting as a senior/lead SDR, ideally in B2B SaaS. A proven track record of personally hitting SDR quota, plus a clear example of lifting a team's or peers' performance. Strong hands-on CRM skills — able to build and read reports and dashboards, not just log activity. Genuine comfort with metrics — you instinctively break a shortfall down by funnel stage and act on it. Strong coaching, communication, and objection-handling skills — you can teach a call, not just make one. An organised, consistent, and accountable operating style, running a tight cadence and expecting the same from your team. Nice to Have Experience with outbound tooling, sales engagement platforms, or lead-scoring and prioritisation systems. Exposure to rewards, engagement, loyalty, or incentive-tech, or to selling to HR, Sales, or Marketing buyers. What Makes You a Strong Fit You diagnose from data, not opinion, and know exactly which funnel lever to pull when numbers move. You hold a team to high standards while keeping morale intact. You treat CRM hygiene as core to the job, not an afterthought. You coach reps toward better conversion rather than just pushing more activity. Support audit activities and maintain operational documentation. Monitor SLA adherence and operational turnaround times. 7. Cross-Functional Coordination Work closely with Partnerships Managers to support merchant onboarding and campaign execution. jobs.title: Senior Manager – Business & Commercial Intelligence
jobs.text: About the Role Xoxoday processes millions of transactions every year — across APIs, digital gift cards, rewards, payments, ecommerce storefronts, and global merchant partners. This role owns the intelligence layer behind that scale: making sure pricing, margins, catalog data, payment flows, settlement, and transaction success rates stay accurate, healthy, and continuously improving. This is not a reporting or dashboard role. You'll work directly with Product, Finance, and the CXO office to catch issues before customers do, and turn data into measurable business outcomes. What You'll Own Transaction Intelligence Understand the complete lifecycle of every transaction type on the platform — API orders, ecommerce storefront orders, gift cards, rewards redemption, payment gateway transactions, refunds, cancellations, settlement, and vendor fulfilment. Identify where and why transactions fail, and drive fixes. Commerce Analytics Continuously monitor transaction success rates, payment failures, and performance by vendor, merchant, category, country, currency, and partner. Convert patterns into insights that improve customer experience and profitability. Pricing & Margin Intelligence Own commercial visibility across the catalog — merchant margins, pricing inconsistencies, discount leakage, FX impact, and profitability trends. Recommend pricing and sourcing improvements. Revenue Assurance Track down revenue leakage from incorrect pricing, wrong commissions, settlement issues, catalog errors, data inconsistencies, workflow gaps, system defects, or operational misses — and stay on each issue with Product and Finance until it's permanently closed. Catalog Intelligence Keep the catalog commercially healthy: flag incorrect pricing, duplicate SKUs, invalid denominations, expired products, incorrect tax treatment, currency mismatches, and merchant onboarding gaps. Business Controls Build validations across critical transaction journeys to proactively catch anomalies, fraud patterns, margin erosion, vendor issues, and customer-impacting defects. AI-driven Analytics Use AI to detect anomalies, surface hidden trends, automate repetitive analysis, and accelerate investigations — building monitoring that scales beyond manual review. What We're Looking For 4–10 years in FinTech, Ecommerce, Payments, or Marketplace businesses Strong grasp of transaction-heavy platforms and commercial mechanics Comfortable working with millions of transaction records Genuinely curious — the kind of person who can't leave an unexplained metric alone Able to translate data into product and operational action, not just insight Strong SQL and Excel; Python is a plus Experience with BI tools like Looker, Tableau, or Power BI Hands-on with modern AI tools for analytics and productivity You'll Love This Role If You Enjoy finding hidden revenue leakage Like solving complex, ambiguous business puzzles Get satisfaction from improving margins through data Want to understand how commerce systems work end-to-end Prefer working directly with Product Heads, Finance, and leadership Would rather drive action than produce reports What Success Looks Like in Year One End-to-end visibility across the transaction lifecycle Measurable improvement in transaction success rates Fewer pricing and catalog errors Stronger payment and settlement controls Identified and eliminated revenue leakage Improved merchant profitability Automated monitoring in place for key commerce health metrics Recognized as the go-to source for commercial insight across the org

Consistently competitive pricing and commercial outcomes. High supplier performance and fulfillment reliability. Expansion of product assortment and sourcing capabilities. jobs.title: Senior Devops Engineer
jobs.text: Job Overview We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to join our growing technology team. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in DevOps, Infrastructure Security, and DevSecOps practices — ensuring environments are scalable, resilient, and secure . You will play a critical role in infrastructure automation, CI/CD implementation, monitoring, and enabling cloud-native operations across multiple platforms. Key Responsibilities 1.Design, build, and maintain scalable and resilient CI/CD pipelines for on-prem, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and hybrid environments. 2.Implement and manage Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or Pulumi. 3.Oversee container orchestration and deployment using Docker and Kubernetes . 4.Configure and monitor infrastructure with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack , or similar observability tools. 5.Implement security best practices (DevSecOps) across infrastructure and deployment pipelines. 6.Conduct risk assessments and vulnerability remediation across all environments. 7.Collaborate with security, development, and operations teams to ensure governance and compliance . 8.Automate system provisioning, monitoring, and scaling using modern DevOps tools. 9.Assist in disaster recovery and business continuity planning for hybrid infrastructure. 10.Perform routine system audits and patch management . Required Qualifications & Experience 1.Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field . 2 .5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering roles. 3.Proven expertise in on-premise infrastructure management and public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure). 4.Proficiency in scripting languages such as Bash, Python, or Go . 5.Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools: Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, ArgoCD, CircleCI . 6.Strong understanding of networking, firewalls, VPNs, and load balancing . 7.Deep knowledge of security practices: Zero Trust, IAM, encryption, auditing, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA) . 8.Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, CKA, CISSP are a plus. Preferred Skills 1.Experience with hybrid workload orchestrators (Anthos, Azure Arc). 2.Knowledge of observability best practices and tools like OpenTelemetry. 3.Familiarity with policy-as-code tools (OPA/Gatekeeper, HashiCorp Sentinel). Personal Attributes 1.Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. 2.Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. 3.Ability to prioritize tasks in fast-paced environments. 4.Passion for automation, scalability, and secure infrastructure design. What We Offer 1.Opportunity to work with a modern cloud-native and hybrid infrastructure stack . 2.Health benefits, flexible work options, and latest hardware. 3.A collaborative environment focused on innovation and learning. 4.Strong career growth path toward DevOps Architect or Lead SRE roles .

jobs.title: Catalog Quality & AI Automation Manager
jobs.text: About Xoxoday Xoxoday is a global rewards, incentives, and loyalty platform helping enterprises engage employees, customers, and channel partners through rewards, recognition, incentives, and loyalty programs. With a presence across multiple geographies and a diverse rewards marketplace, Xoxoday powers reward experiences for thousands of enterprises globally. Our marketplace spans categories including Gift Vouchers, Merchandise, Mobile Top-ups, Airmiles, Flights, Hotels, Lounge Access, Experiences, Charity, Prepaid Cards, Sports & Events, and other digital and lifestyle rewards across multiple countries. About the Role We are looking for a Catalog Quality & AI Automation Manager to lead catalog quality, governance, and automation across Xoxoday's global marketplace. This role will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, consistency, discoverability, and customer experience of products across all marketplace categories including Gift Vouchers, Merchandise, Top-ups, Airmiles, Flights, Hotels, Lounge Access, Experiences, Sports & Events, Charity, and emerging categories. This is not a traditional catalog operations role. At Xoxoday, we are building an AI-first Marketplace Operations function and are looking for someone who can leverage AI tools, automation platforms, and emerging technologies to transform how catalog quality is managed at scale. The ideal candidate is someone who constantly experiments with AI tools, automation workflows, and operational efficiencies. You should be equally comfortable conducting quality audits, analyzing large datasets, building AI-powered workflows, and collaborating with product and engineering teams to automate quality assurance processes. You will work closely with Category Managers, Supplier Partners, Product, Engineering, Operations, Growth, and Client Success teams to ensure world-class catalog quality across global markets. Key Responsibilities 1. Catalog Quality Ownership & Governance Own end-to-end catalog quality across all marketplace categories globally. Define and maintain catalog quality standards, SOPs, governance frameworks, and audit mechanisms. Establish quality benchmarks across Product Names, Product Descriptions, Images, Pricing & Denominations, Redemption Instructions, Terms & Conditions Etc Ensure consistency and quality across all supplier catalogs and geographies. Drive continuous improvement in catalog quality KPIs. 2. Catalog Audits & Quality Control Lead periodic catalog audits across Gift Vouchers, Merchandise, Top-ups, Airmiles, Flights, Hotels, Lounge Access, Experiences, and other marketplace categories. Identify and resolve Content inaccuracies, Incorrect category mappings, Pricing discrepancies, Missing product information, Duplicate products Etc Conduct pre-launch and post-launch quality reviews for all new products and suppliers. Build quality scorecards and audit frameworks for suppliers and categories. Ensure timely closure of catalog issues through cross-functional collaboration. 3. AI-Powered Catalog Automation Drive Xoxoday's AI-first approach to catalog quality management. Identify repetitive manual tasks and automate them using AI and workflow automation platforms. Design and implement scalable AI-powered catalog validation systems. Leverage tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini Etc Build automated workflows for: Product Naming Validation Description Quality Checks Terms & Conditions Verification Taxonomy Mapping Etc Continuously evaluate new AI technologies and implement solutions that improve efficiency and quality. 4. Taxonomy & Catalog Architecture Own category hierarchy, taxonomy standards, metadata governance, and catalog structure. Ensure standardization across global supplier catalogs. Define category mapping frameworks and naming conventions. Improve product discoverability through better taxonomy design. Collaborate with Product teams to enhance marketplace search, filtering, and navigation experiences. 5. Supplier Onboarding & Quality Validation Establish quality validation processes for all supplier onboarding activities. Review supplier catalogs before launch to ensure compliance with marketplace standards. Work with Category Managers and supplier teams to resolve onboarding issues. Develop onboarding playbooks, templates, and quality checklists. Ensure suppliers meet content and operational quality requirements. 6. Process Excellence & Automation Build scalable quality assurance processes that can support rapid marketplace growth. Partner with Product and Engineering teams to automate quality control workflows. Reduce manual effort through intelligent automation initiatives. Define and monitor operational SLAs related to catalog quality and issue resolution. Create internal quality management frameworks and best practices. 7. Data Analytics & Reporting Build and maintain catalog health dashboards and quality KPIs. Analyze quality trends, issue patterns, supplier performance, and operational bottlenecks. Generate actionable insights to improve catalog quality and customer experience. Present quality reviews and improvement recommendations to leadership teams. Measure automation impact and quality improvement outcomes. 8. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Category Managers to ensure category readiness and catalog health. Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to implement automation and quality improvements. Work with Operations and Client Success teams to resolve customer-facing catalog issues. Support Growth and Sales teams with accurate marketplace content and product information. Act as the central owner of catalog governance and quality across the organization. Required Skills & Competencies Catalog & Marketplace Expertise Strong understanding of catalog management, marketplace operations, quality assurance, e-commerce operations, or product operations. Experience managing large-scale product catalogs and supplier ecosystems. Strong understanding of taxonomy management, product content, metadata, and catalog governance. AI & Automation Expertise Strong passion for AI, automation, and operational excellence. Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, Perplexity etc Strong prompt engineering and AI workflow design capabilities. Ability to rapidly prototype and deploy automation solutions with minimal engineering dependency. Familiarity with APIs, CSV processing, Google Sheets automation, data validation workflows, and no-code/low-code platforms. Analytical & Problem Solving Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, root causes, and process gaps. Data-driven decision-making capabilities. Excellent attention to detail and quality-focused mindset. Stakeholder Management Strong communication and presentation skills. Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across business, product, engineering, and operations teams. Proven ability to drive projects independently in a fast-paced environment. Experience & Qualifications 5–6 years of experience in Catalog Management, Marketplace Operations, Product Operations, Quality Assurance, E-commerce Operations, or related functions. Experience managing large product catalogs and supplier ecosystems. Exposure to categories such as Gift Cards, Merchandise, Travel, Hospitality, Top-ups, Airmiles, Loyalty, Experiences, or Digital Commerce is preferred. Experience working across multiple international markets is an added advantage. Prior experience in loyalty, rewards, fintech, travel-tech, e-commerce, or marketplace businesses is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience using AI tools to improve operational efficiency, quality, or scalability is strongly preferred. What Success Looks Like Industry-leading catalog quality across all marketplace categories. 60%+ reduction in manual catalog review effort through AI and automation. Significant reduction in customer-facing catalog issues and operational escalations. Faster supplier onboarding and catalog launch timelines. Automated quality validation across major marketplace categories. High accuracy, consistency, and completeness of product information globally. Strong governance and standardization across categories and geographies. Establishment of Xoxoday as an AI-first marketplace operations organization. Contribution towards making Xoxoday's marketplace the most trusted rewards and loyalty marketplace globally. Why Join Xoxoday? Opportunity to lead quality and automation for one of the world's fastest-growing rewards marketplaces. Build AI-powered operational systems from the ground up. Work with cutting-edge AI tools and automation technologies. Collaborate with global suppliers, category leaders, and product teams. High ownership, visibility, and growth opportunities.

jobs.title: Sales & GTM Analyst
jobs.text: About Xoxoday Xoxoday is a global SaaS company building the infrastructure for people-first workplaces. Its suite of products helps organizations run smarter rewards, incentives, and engagement programs — at scale, across geographies, and without the operational overhead that usually comes with them. Xoxoday serves thousands of businesses worldwide, from growth-stage startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, across HR, sales, and marketing functions. Empuls is Xoxoday’s employee engagement product. It helps companies build a culture of recognition and belonging — through peer-to-peer appreciation, milestone celebrations, rewards, surveys, and more. What sets Empuls apart is its own global rewards catalog: not a reseller, but a builder. From France and Germany to Canada, the US, Singapore, Australia, India, and 100+ other markets, every employee gets the same quality of recognition experience — fulfilled locally, in local currency, on one unified workflow. Automated where it should be, human where it matters. About this role We’re looking for a sharp, execution-driven Junior Associate to work directly out of the Founder’s Office, supporting the US go-to-market motion for Empuls. You’ll sit at the intersection of outreach, pipeline hygiene, and operational coordination — making sure nothing slips through the cracks as the US team scales. This is a high-visibility, high-accountability role. You’ll operate from the founding team’s handles, engage directly with prospects, and keep the sales engine running smoothly behind the scenes. What you’ll do Run consistent, high-quality outreach on behalf of the Founder via email and LinkedIn — owning the cadence and ensuring no prospect falls through without a proper follow-up. Monitor and track pipeline movement alongside the US sales team, flagging stalled deals and resolving blockers proactively. Maintain HubSpot hygiene — logging activities, cleaning records, and ensuring data accuracy across the pipeline. Conduct targeted data research to identify and enrich prospect lists for the US GTM motion. Collate and organise marketing resources, enablement materials, and campaign assets for the US team. Coordinate with internal stakeholders — the Founder, Pranshu Sharma, the US team, and external prospects — to keep execution on track. Why this role matters The US is one of Empuls’s most critical growth markets, and this role sits right at the centre of that push. The Founder’s Office is where strategy meets execution — and without tight outreach discipline, clean pipeline data, and sharp coordination, opportunities stall and momentum is lost. This role isn’t administrative support. It is the connective tissue between the Founder’s vision, the sales team’s pipeline, and the prospects we’re trying to win. You will directly influence how fast the US GTM machine moves, how many conversations turn into qualified opportunities, and how well the team operates under pressure. If you do this well, the impact is visible — to the Founder, to the US team, and to the business. What we’re looking for Must-haves Strong written communication skills — you write crisp, professional outreach that gets replies. Solid Excel skills — comfortable with data cleanup, lookups, and organising large datasets. 1–3 years of experience in a GTM, SDR, operations, or Founder’s Office environment. Ability to work the US-aligned shift (3 PM – 1 AM IST) consistently. High attention to detail and ownership mindset — things don’t fall through on your watch. Nice-to-haves Prior experience in a Founder’s Office or early-stage startup GTM role. Familiarity with HubSpot or any CRM tool. Exposure to US market outreach or US-based SDR workflows. Experience with data research tools (Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar). Qualifications Undergraduate degree in any discipline. What matters more: how you think, how you write, and how you get things done. Why join us At Xoxoday, you’re not a cog in a large machine. You’re close to the decision-makers, the product, and the customers from day one. Here’s what that means in practice: Front-row seat to scaling a global SaaS product in one of the most competitive markets in the world. Direct mentorship from the Founder — you’ll understand how a GTM motion is built, not just execute tasks within one. Work that ships. Ideas and improvements here move fast; there’s no six-month approval chain. A culture that rewards ownership. If you take something and run with it, you’ll be recognised for it — not just managed through it. Real exposure to global GTM — US outreach, international pipeline, and cross-functional collaboration across time zones. A product that genuinely makes people feel valued at work. That’s what Empuls does, and it’s what we try to practise internally too.

jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.text: About This Role We’re looking for someone to own and grow our existing customer accounts in the Philippines. This role sits at the center of client relationships, product adoption, and account expansion, with a clear focus on long-term retention and growth. You’ll act as the primary point of contact for key customers, working closely with internal teams to ensure clients see consistent value from our platform while identifying opportunities to expand our partnership. What You’ll Do Account Ownership & Relationship Management Own and manage a portfolio of key and strategic existing customer accounts. Build trusted, long-term relationships with client stakeholders across levels. Act as the primary escalation and coordination point for client needs. Customer Adoption & Value Realization Drive product adoption by supporting clients through program planning and execution. Guide customers on best practices to maximize engagement with rewards and marketing initiatives. Monitor account usage and engagement to identify risks early. Growth & Expansion Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts. Partner with sales leadership to progress and close expansion opportunities. Proactively manage renewals and overall account health. Cross-functional Collaboration Coordinate with centrally based Customer Success and Operations teams in India to resolve issues. Translate customer feedback into clear inputs for Product, Tech, and Customer Success teams. Ensure timely follow-through on client issues and requests. Account Hygiene & Reporting Maintain accurate account documentation and updates in CRM systems. Track performance, usage, and growth indicators for assigned accounts. What We’re Looking For Experience in account management, customer growth, or client-facing roles. Exposure to managing mid-market or enterprise customer accounts. Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and remote teams. Commercial mindset with the ability to spot and progress growth opportunities. Nice to Have Experience in SaaS or technology-led environments. Prior experience supporting customer engagement or rewards programs. What Makes You a Strong Fit You take clear ownership of accounts and outcomes. You balance a customer-first approach with internal execution discipline. You work in a structured, detail-oriented way and anticipate problems early. You’re comfortable operating independently while staying closely aligned with leadership. Why This Role Matters This role directly impacts customer retention, expansion, and long-term revenue stability in the Philippines. Strong account ownership here ensures customers stay engaged, supported, and growing with us over time. Why Join Us Work closely with strategic customers and senior stakeholders. Have real ownership over customer relationships and growth outcomes. Collaborate with experienced regional and central teams. Play a key role in strengthening our presence in the Philippines market.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.text: About This Role We’re looking for a Project Manager to lead enterprise-scale project delivery for Xoxoday’s loyalty platform. This role exists to bring structure, governance, and predictable execution to complex customer programs involving multiple stakeholders and workstreams. You’ll operate as a senior individual contributor with a strong Project Manager mindset—owning planning, coordination, and delivery oversight rather than hands-on configuration. You’ll work closely with enterprise customers and internal teams to ensure loyalty programs are delivered reliably across both cloud and on-premise environments. What You’ll Do Enterprise Project Ownership Own end-to-end project management for enterprise loyalty programs from initiation through closure. Define project scope, plans, milestones, and dependencies across multiple teams. Ensure delivery commitments are met through disciplined execution and governance. Stakeholder & Customer Management Act as the primary project owner for enterprise customers during delivery. Drive structured communication with customer stakeholders, including regular status updates and alignment discussions. Manage risks, issues, and escalations to resolution while maintaining customer confidence. Project Management & Delivery Governance Establish and maintain project governance, reporting, and documentation standards. Track project health across timelines, scope, risks, and dependencies. Ensure adherence to agreed delivery processes and quality expectations. Cross-Functional Coordination Partner closely with Loyalife and Custom Storefront teams to align execution plans. Coordinate with internal product, engineering, and delivery teams across workstreams. Enable smooth handoffs and accountability across phases of delivery. Continuous Improvement Capture delivery learnings and contribute to improving project management practices. Support standardization of templates, workflows, and reporting mechanisms for enterprise delivery. What We’re Looking For 3+ years of experience in project management roles, operating in a Project Manager or enterprise delivery context. Strong experience delivering loyalty platforms for enterprise customers. Proven track record managing large, multi-stakeholder enterprise programs. Experience managing software delivery projects across cloud and on-premise deployments. Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in parallel. Strong communication skills with experience working with global clients. Experience in combination of technology service provider leading client projects Nice to Have Experience working with global enterprise customers across regions. Exposure to structured project management frameworks or governance models. What Makes You a Strong Fit You bring a project management-first mindset with a focus on planning, governance, and execution discipline. You’ve successfully delivered enterprise loyalty programs and understand their complexity. You communicate clearly, manage expectations effectively, and handle escalations calmly. You’re comfortable owning outcomes and driving alignment without direct authority. Why This Role Matters Enterprise loyalty programs are complex, high-visibility initiatives. This role ensures these programs are delivered with structure, predictability, and clarity—directly impacting customer trust, long-term relationships, and platform success. Why Join Us Lead high-impact enterprise loyalty programs. Work closely with experienced teams across delivery and product. Take ownership of complex, visible customer initiatives. Grow as a senior project management professional in a focused IC role. Be part of a team that values clarity, accountability, and execution.

jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.text: Why Xogene? At Xogene, we’re revolutionizing the future of clinical trial transparency through AI-powered solutions. Join our team of experts who are transforming how leading pharmaceutical and life sciences companies navigate regulatory compliance. If you're driven by solving complex problems in a professional environment focused on meaningful and rewarding work, we want to hear from you. Position Overview Xogene combines regulatory expertise with advanced technology to automate complex processes in clinical trials transparency. Our software streamlines workflows through AI and agentic networking capabilities, improving data transformation and regulatory compliance for leading pharmaceutical and life sciences companies. We're committed to advancing technological solutions in clinical trial transparency. As we continue to expand, we are seeking a highly motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business growth within the pharmaceutical and biotech sectors. This is a newly created role focused on acquiring new clients and deepening relationships with existing ones to expand Xogene's market presence. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of SaaS markets and life sciences, with a strong understanding of the industry’s challenges and opportunities. You will leverage your knowledge and experience to identify prospective client needs, develop strategic sales approaches, and position Xogene’s products and services as high-value solutions. This role is responsible for the full sales cycle from prospecting through deal closure and plays a critical role in accelerating revenue growth. Key Responsibilities Identify, target, and generate new business opportunities within pharmaceutical, biotech, and clinical research organizations Own and manage the full sales cycle, including prospecting, qualification, solutioning, proposal development, negotiation, and closing Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve and exceed revenue targets Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities through outbound efforts, networking, and industry engagement Establish and cultivate relationships with senior stakeholders, including C-level executives Understand client challenges and position Xogene’s offerings as tailored, value-driven solutions Partner with marketing and leadership to refine go-to-market strategies and messaging Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., product, delivery, client success) to ensure smooth handoff post-sale Maintain accurate pipeline tracking, forecasting, and reporting of sales activities Monitor industry trends, competitive landscape, and market dynamics to inform sales strategy Represent Xogene at industry conferences and events to build brand awareness and generate leads Interest in emerging technologies, including AI-driven solutions that improve efficiency, compliance, and decision-making in life sciences Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, life sciences, or related field preferred Minimum 2+ years of experience in direct sales or business development within software, cloud, or SaaS environments Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets, particularly in net-new business acquisition Experience selling into mid-market and enterprise pharmaceutical and biotech organizations is strongly preferred Strong ability to communicate, present, and influence stakeholders at all organizational levels, including executive leadership Demonstrated success managing complex, consultative sales cycles Excellent negotiation, presentation, and closing skills Strong verbal and written communication skills Self-starter with a results-driven mindset and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment What We Offer Mentorship from industry experts working at the intersection of AI technology and business strategy Clear career progression path with increasing responsibility as skills develop Exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies including LLMs and conversational systems Competitive compensation package including comprehensive benefits A results-oriented culture that values innovation, responsibility, and professional excellence Equal Opportunity Employer Xogene is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of any kind. We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Xogene are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, gender identity, military service, or any other basis prohibited by federal, state or local law. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application process and to perform essential job functions. Please contact us to discuss any accommodation you think you may need. Location This is a New York City based role with an expectation of active engagement in-market, including networking, industry events, and relationship-building within the life sciences ecosystem. Compensation and Benefits The anticipated base salary range for this position is $70,000 – $90,000, depending on experience, skills, and demonstrated track record in enterprise SaaS sales. Competitive variable compensation based on experience and performance is also available for this role. Team members are eligible to participate in our comprehensive benefits program, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, retirement savings benefits, life insurance, disability coverage, parental leave, paid time off, and company holidays, subject to the terms of the applicable plans.
